title: Director- International Logistics Operations
description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a seasoned, high-caliber logistics leader for the role of Director Cross-Border Operations. Based out of our Gurgaon headquarters, you will lead end-to-end international logistics operations for Delhivery, overseeing cross-border import and export shipments across key global trade lanes.

This is a strategic and execution-intensive role. You will spearhead the expansion of our international freight network by launching new country corridors and deferred air economy products, while driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships. This position owns P&L, SLA compliance, and operational efficiency for both air and ocean freight verticals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End International Logistics Operations**

* Lead end-to-end international logistics operations, managing and optimizing cross-border import and export shipments across global trade lanes.
* Supervise daily workflows for inbound and outbound cargo, ensuring smooth execution across origin handling, international linehaul, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery.
* Implement robust monitoring systems to track shipments, proactively resolve operational exceptions, and ensure high on-time delivery rates.

**2. Network Expansion & Product Development**

* Spearhead the physical and operational expansion of Delhivery's international freight network by identifying and launching new country corridors.
* Design, launch, and scale deferred air economy products to offer competitive, cost-effective cross-border shipping options to e-commerce, SME, and enterprise clients.
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational readiness criteria for all newly launched corridors and lanes.

**3. Strategic Partnerships & Carrier Management**

* Identify, negotiate with, and onboard key global partners, including freight forwarders, customs house agents (CHAs), customs brokers, and commercial airlines/ocean carriers.
* Build and maintain strong strategic alliances to secure capacity commitments, preferential rate structures, and reliable transit times during peak and non-peak seasons.
* Manage partner performance SLAs, conducting regular reviews to ensure compliance with Delhivery's high operational standards.

**4. P&L & SLA Compliance Management**

* Take complete financial ownership of the Air and Ocean freight verticals, managing P&L, cost optimization, and overall unit economics (e.g., cost-per-kilogram and route margins).
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Transit Turnaround Time (TAT), On-Time Delivery (OTD), Customs Clearance timelines, and first-contact dispute resolution.
* Control and minimize operational exceptions such as terminal storage costs, demurrage, detention fees, and flight offloads.

**5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Tech Enablement**

* Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Sales, Business Development, Technology, and Legal/Compliance to support business growth and process standardization.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to build scalable, automated, and technology-driven processes for tracking, billing, and customs documentation.
* Ensure 100% adherence to international trade laws, customs regulations, aviation security standards, and safety compliances.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Experience & Education**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Business, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or Post-Graduate degree is highly preferred.
* **Experience:**
  8+ years of progressive experience in international logistics, freight forwarding, or cross-border e-commerce shipping.
* **Leadership:**
  Minimum of 3+ years in a senior supervisory or managerial role directly overseeing air/ocean freight operations, partner management, or international linehaul.

**Core Competencies**

* **Domain Expertise:**
  Deep working knowledge of air freight operations, global trade lanes, Incoterms 2020, customs clearance regulations, and HAWB/MAWB rules (aligned with our
  Global Air Freight Operations
  ).
* **Commercial & Financial Acumen:**
  Strong experience managing P&L, negotiating complex commercial contracts, and optimizing unit economics.
* **Analytical Rigor:**
  Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets for tracking operations, data analysis, and building performance dashboards.
* **Stakeholder & Vendor Management:**
  Exceptional negotiation and relationship-building skills to manage high-level partnerships across multiple geographies.
* **Problem-Solving:**
  Strong critical-thinking and crisis-management abilities to handle transit disruptions, customs bottlenecks, and capacity constraints in a high-pressure environment.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
  
  
Monks is seeking an experienced Operations Manager to steer and scale the Delhi-based production team delivering rapid-turn editorial and marketing content. Sitting at the intersection of operational strategy and daily execution, this role oversees operations across multiple shifts, ensuring high-volume creative work is rigorously prioritized, staffed, reviewed, and delivered.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a seasoned operational leader who brings structure, data-informed rigor, and agility to a fast-moving, continuous delivery environment. You will manage regional capacity and team performance, establish scalable operational frameworks, partner directly with US-based Monks leadership, and serve as a key regional escalation point for senior client stakeholders.
  
  
An interest in AI, emerging technology, and modern creative production models is essential. All briefs, client communications, and creative deliverables will be in English.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead and govern day-to-day operations for the Delhi creative production hub across multiple shifts and concurrent workstreams.
* Serve as a key regional point of contact for US Monks leadership and client stakeholders, translating high-level business priorities into clear operational roadmaps.
* Oversee and optimize the end-to-end creative lifecycle, including intake, prioritization, resource allocation, QA, and delivery.
* Build and maintain regional capacity plans, balancing shifting demand against bandwidth, shift coverage, and project timelines.
* Manage, mentor, and elevate producers, project managers, and shift leads responsible for individual delivery pods.
* Establish and enforce standardized operating procedures (SOPs) across all shifts, including handoff protocols, documentation, version control, and asset packaging.
* Exercise sound operational judgment to optimize workflow continuity—knowing precisely when work stays within a shift and when a global handoff enhances turnaround speed.
* Partner with creative, editorial, and technical leadership to maintain craft quality and brand integrity without compromising delivery velocity.
* Drive client alignment on scope, deadlines, and bandwidth, resolving operational ambiguities independently and escalating to senior leadership only when strategic intervention is necessary.
* Track and evaluate operational health metrics (turnaround times, capacity utilization, SLA adherence, and error rates) to identify bottlenecks and implement continuous workflow improvements.
* Collaborate with AI and creative technology specialists to pilot and integrate automation tools into production pipelines.
* Direct structured team onboarding, cross-training, and the retention of client- and program-specific knowledge.
* Maintain discretion when handling confidential, unreleased, and sensitive client information.

**Experience You Bring**

* 7–10+ years of progressive experience in creative operations, production management, or program management within an agency, media company, or in-house creative organization.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-shift creative production hubs and mentoring mid-level producers or project managers.
* Strong client-facing communication skills with proven ability to advise senior stakeholders and negotiate competing priorities.
* Demonstrated background managing rapid-turn creative formats (digital marketing, web content, editorial, design, and motion graphics).
* Proven track record of designing, scaling, and maintaining operational processes and QA standards across distributed teams.
* Expertise in capacity planning, resource forecasting, and workflow management platforms (e.g., Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or Airtable).
* Strong analytical problem-solving abilities and comfort operating autonomously within ambiguous, high-tempo environments.
* Experience collaborating across time zones, regional offices, and cross-functional teams.
* Fluency in written and spoken English, paired with polished executive documentation and presentation skills.
* Active interest or experience in integrating AI tools, automation, and workflow innovation into creative production.
* Flexibility to operate within a 24/7 global shift structure and participate in scheduled weekend and holiday leadership rotations.

**Working Model**
This is a hybrid leadership role supporting a global, multi-shift operating model. The Operations Manager will provide leadership coverage across early morning, evening, overnight, and nontraditional shifts. The role requires sufficient schedule flexibility to maintain operational continuity, support planned weekend and holiday coverage rotations, and address urgent escalations. Coverage schedules will be planned in advance wherever possible.
  
  
**About Monks**
Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.
  
  
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
  
  
We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

About People Matters

People Matters is a leading HR and talent-focused media and community platform serving business leaders across India and Southeast Asia. We partner with CEOs, CHROs, Tech Leaders and senior decision-makers to drive conversations around talent strategy, leadership, and the future of work.

Through high-impact physical conferences, large-scale virtual summits, roundtables, research-led initiatives, and digital properties, People Matters enables meaningful engagement between brands and the HR ecosystem.

Learn more at: www.peoplematters.in

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented Event Operations Manager/Assistant Manager to lead the planning and execution of People Matters’ conferences and new experiences & Initiatives.

The role will be responsible for managing the end-to-end event operations lifecycle — from planning, budgeting and vendor management to on-ground execution and post-event closure.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in managing B2B events, conferences, corporate events, or large-scale experiences and should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Event Planning & Execution

● Own the end-to-end operational planning and execution of physical, virtual, and hybrid events.

● Develop detailed event plans covering timelines, logistics, production, staffing, vendors, and on-ground requirements.

● Coordinate with internal teams including Sales, Client Servicing, Content, Marketing, and Design to ensure seamless event delivery.

● Ensure all event deliverables are executed as per agreed timelines, scope, and quality standards.

● Manage multiple events and projects simultaneously.

2. Vendor & Partner Management

● Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and manage event vendors and service partners.

● Manage production agencies, AV partners, venues, F&B, fabrication, branding, logistics, travel, and other event suppliers.

● Ensure vendor deliverables meet agreed quality, timelines, and commercial commitments.

● Build a reliable and cost-effective vendor ecosystem.

3. Budget & Cost Management

● Prepare and manage event budgets in line with approved commercial plans.

● Track event expenses, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor payments.

● Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising the attendee or client experience.

● Monitor event profitability and ensure operational decisions are aligned with business objectives.

4. On-Ground Operations & Experience

● Lead on-ground event operations and ensure smooth execution across all touchpoints.

● Manage venue setup, registration, stage and production, branding, seating, F&B, hospitality, transportation, and attendee movement.

● Coordinate with venue teams and vendors to resolve real-time operational challenges.

● Ensure a high-quality experience for speakers, delegates, partners, and other stakeholders.

● Take ownership of troubleshooting and crisis management during events.

5. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Management

● Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand event objectives and translate them into operational plans.

● Coordinate with speakers, delegates, partners, venues, vendors, and external agencies.

● Maintain clear communication and timely updates across stakeholders.

● Anticipate operational risks and proactively develop contingency plans.

6. Post-Event Closure & Reporting

● Ensure timely post-event closure, including vendor reconciliation, documentation, and financial settlements.

● Conduct post-event reviews to identify learnings and improvement areas.

● Track operational KPIs and event performance metrics.

● Maintain event documentation, vendor databases, checklists, and standard operating processes.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Skills

● 2–6 years of experience in Event Operations, Conference Management, Event Production, Experiential Marketing, or related roles.

● Proven experience managing end-to-end B2B events, conferences, roundtables, or corporate events.

● Strong vendor management and negotiation skills.

● Hands-on experience with event logistics, production, AV, fabrication, venues, F&B, and attendee management.

● Good understanding of event budgeting, cost control, and commercial management.

● Strong project management and execution skills.

● Ability to manage multiple events, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

● Willingness to travel and work on-ground during events as required.

Competencies

● Strong planning and organisational skills.

● High attention to detail and ownership mindset.

● Strong problem-solving and crisis-management abilities.

● Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

● Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

● Solution-oriented and proactive approach.

● Strong commercial and cost-conscious mindset.

● Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Us?

● Opportunity to work with top HR and business leaders across India & Southeast Asia.

● Exposure to high-impact leadership conferences and premium brand experiences.

● Opportunity to work across conferences, roundtables, custom events, and exclusive CXO experiences.

● A fast-growing, innovation-driven media organization.

● Collaborative and entrepreneurial work culture.

● Opportunity to take ownership of large-scale event operations and build strong industry expertise.

Compensation

Salary: Competitive and aligned with industry standards, based on experience and capability.

**1. Job Summary**

Savi Vision Private Limited, an Audio-Visual (AV) System Integration Company, is looking for an experienced and technically sound Service Manager – AV Products to manage the service department, lead AV engineers, handle customer complaints, and ensure timely and effective service delivery.

The candidate should have strong technical knowledge of AV products and systems, excellent team management skills, and the ability to manage Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), maintain client relationships, and generate AMC business from existing customers.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Service Operations & Team Management**

Manage and supervise the team of AV service engineers and technicians.

Allocate service calls to engineers based on their expertise, location, and availability.

Monitor engineers' daily schedules, site visits, attendance, and service reports.

Ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and technical issues.

Track pending service requests and ensure proper follow-up until closure.

Conduct regular team meetings to review performance, challenges, and service quality.

**B. Technical Knowledge & Troubleshooting**

Possess sound technical knowledge of AV products, systems, and integrated solutions.

Oversee installation, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair activities.

Guide engineers in resolving complex technical issues at client sites.

Ensure proper system functioning and adherence to technical and quality standards.

Coordinate with vendors and OEMs for technical support, warranty claims, and escalations.

**C. Customer Complaint Management**

Handle customer complaints and escalations professionally.

Coordinate with clients and engineers to ensure quick and effective resolution.

Maintain regular communication with customers regarding service status and pending issues.

Ensure high customer satisfaction and build long-term client relationships.

Maintain service records, complaint logs, and customer feedback.

**D. AMC Management & Business Development**

Manage existing Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), including renewals, service schedules, and compliance.

Contact existing clients to discuss AMC renewals and identify new AMC opportunities.

Convert eligible existing clients into AMC customers and generate recurring service revenue.

Prepare and coordinate AMC proposals, quotations, and renewal follow-ups with the sales team.

Maintain an AMC database with contract expiry dates, renewal status, and client details.

Identify opportunities to upsell service packages and additional maintenance support.

Ensure timely preventive maintenance visits as per AMC commitments.

**E. Reporting & Coordination**

Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly service reports to management.

Track service KPIs, complaint resolution time, engineer productivity, and customer satisfaction.

Coordinate with the Sales, Projects, Procurement, and Finance departments for smooth operations.

Monitor spare parts requirements, service tools, and inventory coordination.

Maintain proper documentation of service calls, site visits, AMC contracts, and service expenses.

**3. Technical Skills Required**

The candidate should have sound knowledge of the following AV products and technologies:

Professional audio systems, amplifiers, mixers, DSPs, microphones, and speakers.

Video conferencing systems and collaboration solutions.

Projectors, professional displays, LED walls, and interactive flat panels.

Video switchers, matrix switchers, scalers, and signal processors.

Control systems, automation, and room control solutions.

AV over IP, HDMI, HDBaseT, and other AV connectivity technologies.

Basic networking concepts, IP configuration, and system integration.

Preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and fault diagnosis of AV systems.

**4. Educational Qualification & Experience**

Diploma or B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Communication, or a related engineering field.

5–8 years of relevant experience in AV system integration, technical support, or service operations is preferred.

Prior experience managing AV engineers and handling customer escalations is essential.

Experience in AMC management, renewals, and service business development will be an added advantage.

Good communication, coordination, planning, and leadership skills.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Service Manager will be evaluated on the following parameters:

Timely resolution of customer complaints.

Reduction in pending and repeated service calls.

Productivity and performance of the AV engineering team.

Customer satisfaction and quality of service.

AMC renewal percentage and new AMC conversions.

Revenue generated through AMC contracts and service opportunities.

Timely preventive maintenance and compliance with AMC commitments.

Accuracy and timeliness of service reports and documentation.

**6. Desired Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be technically strong, organised, customer-focused, and capable of leading a team of AV engineers independently. The candidate must demonstrate ownership of service operations, effective complaint resolution, proactive AMC renewal follow-ups, and the ability to convert existing client relationships into long-term service business.

**About The Hosteller**

The Hosteller is a people-first backpacker hostel brand built around travel, community, and shared experiences. We create spaces where travellers from across the world connect, stories are exchanged, and memories are made. Powered by passionate teams on-ground and at the corporate level, The Hosteller values ownership, empathy, collaboration and a deep respect for both people and places.

At The Hosteller, you’ll be part of a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment where ideas matter, ownership is encouraged and growth is real. We offer hands-on exposure, opportunities to learn across functions and the chance to build meaningful experiences for both travellers and teammates-every single day.

**Role overview**

The Area operations manager shall be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations, performance, and compliance of multiple properties/units within an assigned geographic area (10-15 hostels in an area). This role ensures consistent service quality, operational efficiency, cost control, and team performance, while acting as the key link between on-ground teams and central leadership. His/her role shall involve overseeing multiple facets of hotel operations such as staffing, hiring, guest experience, day-to-day operations, repairs/maintenance, P&L, etc., centrally and as per the company's standard operating procedures

**Responsibilities**

* Understanding of the hospitality/hotel industry, various functions in the sector including front office, housekeeping, F&B, concierge along with departmental knowledge across human resource (both white & blue collar) requirements, vendor management, guest relations, housekeeping, R&M, etc.
* Oversee end-to-end operations across multiple properties / units in the assigned area including work areas as: licensing & compliances, owner-tenant relationship management, P&L management & optimisation, maintenance & upkeep, crisis management, etc.
* Ensure brand standards, SOPs, safety norms and guest experience benchmarks are consistently met
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective actions proactively
* Lead, mentor and manage a high performing, disciplined, trained and effective hotel/hostel level team with adherence to the company culture
* Support hiring, onboarding, and retention of on-ground teams
* Monitor property-level P&Ls, costs, and operational budgets along with controlling wastage, shrinkage and inefficiencies across properties
* Ensure compliance with statutory norms, licenses, audits, and safety standards and liaise with various departments such as local police, health/fire/safety departments, local vendors, etc. and ensuring a cordial relationship
* Oversee preventive maintenance, asset upkeep, and vendor performance
* Ensure properties are audit-ready at all times
* Act as the primary interface between central teams (operations, HR, finance, supply chain, marketing) and on-ground teams
* Coordinate with vendors, local authorities, and partners when required
* Support new property launches (pre-ops), stabilisation and scale-up efforts
* Monitor guest feedback, reviews, and NPS across properties
* Lead resolution of escalated guest issues and service failures
* Drive continuous improvement in guest experience and community engagement

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Hotel management, Hospitality administration, Operations management, or Business administration
* Postgraduate qualification (MBA/PGDM in Operations, Hospitality, or Tourism) preferred
* 7+ years of experience in multi-unit hospitality or service operations (hotels, hostels, resorts)
* Minimum 2–3 years in a supervisory/area/cluster operations role managing multiple properties
* Experience in new property launches, stabilisation, or turnaround will be an added advantage
* Hands-on experience with Property Management Systems (PMS) such as eZee Absolute, Opera, IDS, RMS or similar platforms

* Exposure to revenue management tools, dashboards, and MIS reporting systems
* Solid understanding of hotel P&L structures, cost controls, budgeting, and variance analysis
* Experience managing operational KPIs such as occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, GOP, guest satisfaction scores, and audit ratings
* Knowledge of statutory compliance, safety standards, and operational audits
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to interpret operational and revenue data
* Proven people leadership and performance management capabilities
* Willingness to travel extensively across assigned locations
* Language knowledge - Hindi, English, etc.

title: Sourcing & Procurement Manager (Construction)
description:
Location: Remote, India (flexible hours with U.S. team overlap)
  
  
Engagement type: Full-time
  
  
Compensation: USD 2,000 - USD 2,500 per month (based on experience and interview process)
  
  
Please note: Only apply if you're ready to join immediately or within 30 days
  
  
**About Sanctuary**
Sanctuary builds nature - led, wellness - centered communities that feel alive. Our first 135-acre residential community in the Texas Hill Country is designed with:
  
  
🌱 Non-toxic materials
  
  
💧 Clean water and filtration systems
  
  
⚡ EMF-conscious design
  
  
🌿 135 acres of preserved land and eco - sensitive planning
  
  
We are a global team (spread across 8 countries) of designers, architects, engineers, and dreamers building spaces that restore and inspire. For us, it’s not just where people live - it’s how they live.
  
  
Our vision is to bring Sanctuary to major cities around the world: healthy, sovereign communities that sit on the edges of every modern metropolis.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Sourcing, Procurement & Supply Chain Manager to find, buy, and move the building materials that go into our homes. You will source construction materials from manufacturers and suppliers overseas, manage purchasing, and make sure everything reaches our project sites in Texas on time, on budget, and to spec.
  
  
This role sits at the center of how we build. Many of our materials are chosen for health and sustainability - non-toxic finishes, clean water systems, low-EMF components - so you will be checking more than price and lead time. You will work closely with our architects, construction team, and finance team to turn material specifications into confirmed orders and delivered shipments.
  
  
This is not a role for someone who needs a fixed process handed to them. We are a fast-moving startup, and you will often be the one building the vendor list, the tracker, and the shipping plan from scratch. We are looking for someone highly resourceful who can chase down missing information, negotiate with confidence, and flag risks early before they turn into site delays.
  
  
****What you’ll do****
*Sourcing and vendor management*

* Identify, evaluate, and shortlist manufacturers and suppliers for construction and building materials, primarily overseas
* Request and compare quotations, samples, and technical data sheets against our design and material specifications
* Build and maintain an approved vendor list with pricing, lead times, certifications, and performance notes
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery commitments with suppliers

*Procurement and purchasing*

* Translate material schedules and specifications from the architecture and construction teams into purchase orders
* Track every order from quotation to delivery, and keep the team updated on status and risks
* Work with the finance team on budgets, payments, and cost tracking for each project

*Logistics and supply chain*

* Coordinate international shipping from suppliers to our project sites in Texas, working with freight forwarders and customs brokers
* Manage export and import documentation, shipping schedules, and delivery timelines
* Plan orders around construction schedules so materials arrive when the site needs them

*Quality and compliance*

* Verify that materials meet our health, sustainability, and quality standards before they ship
* Arrange pre-shipment inspections and resolve quality issues with suppliers
* Make sure materials meet U.S. building code and certification requirements where applicable

*Process building*

* Set up simple, reliable trackers and workflows for sourcing, orders, and shipments
* Find opportunities to reduce costs and lead times as we scale to more projects

****What you bring****

* 3-6 years of experience in sourcing, procurement, or supply chain, ideally for construction or building materials
* Hands-on experience with international or export sourcing, including working with overseas suppliers
* Working knowledge of export and import documentation, freight forwarding, and customs processes
* Strong negotiation skills and comfort managing multiple vendors at once
* Ability to read material specifications and technical data sheets, and ask the right questions about them
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for tracking orders, costs, and timelines
* Experience sourcing for U.S. projects, or knowledge of U.S. building codes and certifications, is a strong plus
* Comfortable working with high autonomy in a fast-moving, remote, cross-cultural team
* Clear, proactive communicator in English, both written and spoken since you’ll do outreach and coordination with international consultants/vendors

****Hiring process****

* Stage 1: Intro interview - Role alignment, experience overview, and culture fit
* Stage 2: Test task - A short practical assignment to assess your sourcing and supply chain approach
* Stage 3: Final interview - Deep dive into workflows, expectations, and growth

title: Head Barista
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Head Barista

Location: New Delhi, India

About Us:

Mira’s is a premium bakery and café in New Delhi, offering artisanal baked goods, gourmet beverages, and a

thoughtfully curated guest experience. Our brand focuses on warmth, consistency, and refined service, making

guest satisfaction and staff excellence equally important.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a seasoned, passionate, and leadership-oriented Head Barista with a minimum of 5 years of hands-

on specialty coffee experience to lead our coffee and beverage department at Mira’s. The Head Barista will take

full ownership of the coffee program, oversee espresso and manual brewing consistency, calibrate machinery,

drive seasonal beverage menu development, and mentor junior baristas to deliver an unmatched coffee

experience.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Coffee Program Leadership & Quality Control:

 Oversee end-to-end coffee bar operations, ensuring world-class extraction, brew recipes, and beverage consistency

across all shifts.

 Calibrate and dial in espresso grinders daily based on ambient temperature, humidity, bean origin, and roast

profiles.

 Maintain perfection in milk texturing, micro-foam density, temperature standards, and intricate free-pour latte art.

 Standardize manual pour-over brewing recipes (V60, Aeropress, French Press) and cold brew extractions.

2. Menu Development & Beverage Innovation:

 Conceptualize and introduce innovative seasonal coffee beverages, signature iced coolers, craft syrups, and

specialty tea infusions.

 Curate beverage pairings to complement Mira’s signature artisanal baked goods, viennoiserie, and pastries.

 Create standardized recipe cards, portion control guides, and visual presentation standards for the entire beverage

menu.

3. Equipment Upkeep & Bar Maintenance:

 Supervise the daily calibration, maintenance, backflushing, and deep sanitization of commercial espresso machines,

grinders, and water filtration setups.

 Establish and monitor preventive maintenance schedules for all coffee equipment to avoid operational downtimes.

 Enforce strict bar hygiene, food safety compliance, clean workstation discipline, and opening/closing bar checklists.

4. Team Training, Inventory & Cost Management:

 Conduct structured training sessions for baristas and service staff on coffee theory, extraction science, sensory

tasting, and latte art techniques.

 Manage indenting, stock replenishment, and wastage tracking for coffee beans, dairy, plant-based milks, syrups,

and packaging disposables.

 Track pouring costs, yield efficiency, and implement portion controls to minimize waste and optimize profitability.

 Engage guests passionately at the counter, explaining coffee bean origins, flavor notes, and roast profiles.

Mira’s Bakery & Café – Head Barista

Qualifications & Skills:

 Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in specialty coffee roasteries, cafés, or premium casual dining

establishments.

 Proven background of at least 1–2 years in a senior or supervisory capacity (Head Barista, Coffee Lead, or Bar

Supervisor).

 Deep expertise in espresso extraction science, brew ratios, TDS evaluation, grinder burr calibration, and cupping

protocols.

 Mastery of milk steaming, texturing, and advanced free-pour latte art (rosettas, swans, winged tulips).

 Comprehensive knowledge of commercial espresso machines (e.g., La Marzocco, Nuova Simonelli, Sanremo) and

precision grinders (Mahlkönig, Mythos, Fiorenzato).

 Strong leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills in English and Hindi to coach and manage a bar team.

 High personal grooming standards, guest-centric attitude, and stamina to lead during peak operational rush hours.

 Willingness to work operational shifts, weekends, and festival holidays.

What We Offer:

 Budgeted Salary: ₹28,000 – ₹35,000 per month (commensurate with expertise, coffee credentials, and leadership

capability).

 Full creative and operational ownership over Mira’s specialty coffee and beverage menu.

 Opportunity to work with premium specialty coffee beans and state-of-the-art brewing machinery.

 A supportive, craft-centered, and quality-driven workplace culture.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

 Food provided

description:
**We’re Hiring | Tender & GeM Manager**

Department: Tendering & Government Business

Experience: 3–7 Years

Qualification: Graduate in any discipline; MBA or relevant professional qualification preferred

Location: Delhi

Employment Type: Full-Time

**About the Role**

9AP Energy is looking for a skilled and result-oriented Tender & GeM Manager to manage government tendering activities, GeM operations, bid submissions, and government business opportunities. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in government e-procurement portals, tender documentation, bid compliance, and end-to-end tender management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and evaluate relevant government tenders through GeM, CPPP, and other e-procurement portals.

* Manage the GeM seller account, product catalogues, bid participation, and reverse auctions.

* Prepare declarations, undertakings, affidavits, certificates, and other supporting documents.
* Manage pre-bid queries, clarifications, corrigendums, and post-bid follow-ups.
* Track tender results, purchase orders, delivery schedules, invoicing, and payment status.
* Maintain tender MIS, bid submission records, win/loss reports, and regular management updates.

* **Required Skills & Qualifications**
* 3–7 years of relevant experience in tender management and government e-procurement.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of the GeM portal and government tendering processes.
* Excellent understanding of tender documentation, eligibility requirements, and bid compliance.
* Working knowledge of Make in India, MSE/MSME benefits, and OEM documentation.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and professional email communication.
* Strong analytical, coordination, follow-up, and deadline-management skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple tenders and ensure accurate, timely submissions.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely and error-free tender submissions.
* Compliance with tender eligibility and documentation requirements.
* Number of qualified bids submitted and government orders secured.
* Effective coordination for order execution and payment follow-ups.
* Accurate tender tracking, MIS maintenance, and management reporting.

**What We’re Looking For**

A proactive professional with strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to identify government business opportunities and convert them into successful orders.

**Join 9AP Energy and be part of our growing journey in energy storage and power solutions.**

title: CAMO Quality Manager
description:
Hiring: CAMO Quality Manager

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced aviation quality professional to oversee continuing airworthiness compliance, quality monitoring and maintenance audits. The role will ensure adherence to DGCA regulations, approved procedures, maintenance contracts and safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor CAMO activities for compliance with CAR-M Subpart G and approved procedures.
* Ensure the effectiveness and implementation of the CAME (Continuing Airworthiness Management Exposition).
* Plan and conduct quality audits of continuing-airworthiness activities and contracted maintenance organisations.
* Monitor maintenance contracts, organisational approvals, staff competency and resource availability.
* Track non-compliances and ensure corrective and preventive actions are completed effectively.
* Monitor repetitive defects and MEL-related issues in coordination with the Continuing Airworthiness Manager.
* Report maintenance-related occurrences to DGCA and aircraft manufacturers, as applicable.
* Participate in internal safety audits, Safety Review Board meetings and incident investigations.
* Support the Safety Management System (SMS), risk assessments and safety performance monitoring.

Mandatory Requirements

* Degree in Aeronautical, Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering,
  **or a DGCA CAR-66 AME licence**
  .
* Minimum
  **8 years of experience**
  in aircraft maintenance or continuing airworthiness.
* At least
  **3 years of quality assurance or auditing experience**
  in a CAR-M Subpart G CAMO or CAR-145 organisation.
* Strong knowledge of CAR-M, CAR-145, CAR-66 and DGCA occurrence-reporting requirements.
* Formal quality auditor training.
* Hands-on experience handling DGCA audits, addressing findings and verifying corrective-action closure.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience as an accepted Quality Manager (QM), Continuing Maintenance Manager (CMM) or deputy.
* Business-jet experience, preferably on relevant aircraft types.
* Training in Human Factors and Safety Management Systems (SMS).

title: Site WHS Manager
description:
**Description**
The Site WHS Manager will partner with the site operations team at a Fulfillment Center to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance with all applicable local, state, and central regulations. Leveraging lean principles and kaizen methodology, this role will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in processes, ensuring a safe and healthful working environment for all Associates.
  
  
The incumbent must build trust and confidence with the Operations Team, influence change through comprehensive risk assessments and data-driven safety analysis, and serve as the subject-matter expert on safety, environmental, and ergonomic standards.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Partner with site operations leadership to implement and sustain WHS policies across the Fulfillment Center.
  
  
Ensure compliance with all applicable Amazon Safety Policies and local/state/central regulations (Factories Act, 1948; Building & Other Construction Workers Act; state-specific rules).
  
  
Measure site performance against published safety policy requirements; identify gaps and develop corrective action plans with defined timelines.
  
  
Analyse safety metrics; review weekly and monthly incident trends to allocate resources to highest-risk areas.
  
  
Conduct frequent site safety audits to identify non-compliant equipment and processes; implement solutions to eliminate exposure and prevent recurrence across the network.
  
  
Audit record-keeping practices and system entries to ensure compliance with global safety standards and local regulations.
  
  
Audit workplace organisation and Associate behaviours to ensure training, auditing, and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
  
  
Deliver on-time, quality safety projects aligned with Operations priorities.
  
  
Lead, manage, and mentor the site safety team comprising Safety Specialists, Safety Coordinators, and Onsite First-Aid Associates.
  
  
Create and execute leadership development plans for direct reports; set clear expectations and provide regular, constructive feedback.
  
  
Engage with Associates and leaders at the site to identify safety programme improvement opportunities; maintain open communication on progress and resolution.
  
  
Ensure site leadership and Associates are trained on their responsibilities under each policy; audit the quality, delivery, and effectiveness of all required safety training.
  
  
Identify and incorporate best practices into company safety standards for continuous improvement.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of increasing responsibilities in WHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience
* Bachelor's degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment

title: Materials Sourcing/Production Manager - Linen (India)
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
**Material Sourcing / Production Manager - Linen (India)**
****RESPONSIBILITIES:****
Fiber Inventory & Quality Control
  
  

* Oversee linen fiber inventory levels to ensure adequate supply for spinning schedules while minimizing waste and overstock.
* Inspect and verify that only quality fiber—meeting specified micron, length, and color consistency standards—is released into the spinning process.
* Implement checkpoints to catch non-conforming fiber before production begins, preventing downstream defects.
* Coordinate with sourcing and warehouse teams to maintain accurate inventory records and proper storage conditions for raw linen.

On-Time Delivery (OTD) Management
  
  

* Own fiber OTD performance, tracking delivery timelines from suppliers to spinning mills and flagging potential delays.
* Prolinenly manage production schedules to ensure fiber is available when needed, communicating risks to cross-functional partners.
* Resolve supply interruptions by expediting shipments or reallocating inventory as necessary to meet production deadlines.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for supplier lead times and delivery reliability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Coordinate with planners and production team to align fiber availability with production demand and spinning schedules.
* Collaborate with R&D, Product Development, and Sourcing teams to support seamless production handoffs.
* Provide input on fiber purchasing decisions based on production capacity, lead times, and quality performance history.
* Escalate production blockers (e.g., fiber shortages, quality holds) with recommended solutions to meet OTD goals.

Spinning & Production Support
  
  

* Partner with spinning mills to ensure fiber lots are processed according to technical specifications and quality expectations.
* Monitor fiber consumption during spinning to identify discrepancies, yield loss, or quality deviations.
* Work upstream with suppliers to align fiber bale composition, lot sizing, and traceability for smoother mill integration.
* Maintain clear documentation of fiber lots, test results, and production flow to support traceability and continuous improvement.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Education: Degree in Textile Engineering, Material Science, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* Production Experience: Proven experience managing raw materials in a textile or apparel production environment, preferably with linen or other luxury fibers.
* Quality Focus: Strong ability to assess fiber quality and enforce standards before spinning.
* Inventory & OTD Acumen: Demonstrated skill in tracking inventory levels and driving on-time delivery performance.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to use data to monitor fiber usage, identify yield issues, and improve production flow.
* Collaboration: Experience working with spinning mills, suppliers, planners, and internal production teams to resolve issues quickly.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with linen fiber grading, testing, or lot management.
* Knowledge of spinning mill operations and fiber-to-yarn conversion.
* Familiarity with inventory management systems or ERP tools.
* Understanding of sustainable fiber sourcing and production practices.

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

title: Director (Portfolio Support)
description:
ACT is looking for a Director (Portfolio Support) to lead its new Systems Scale Acceleration Unit (SSAU), a dedicated platform that builds the capabilities, networks and institutional readiness high-potential nonprofits and social enterprises need to move from proven innovation to population-scale impact. This is a leadership role.
  
  
We are looking for a leader with experience in the impact sector, someone who has worked inside nonprofits or social enterprises in operating roles such as fundraising, operations, technology or programs, and understands firsthand what it takes to move from a proven model to scale. You will lead the Unit’s full scope: strategic fundraising support, facilitating engagement with the public sector, supporting technology adoption, sharing knowledge, and building new capabilities as the Unit evolves. You will be supported by two team members who will focus on fundraising and public systems engagement respectively.
  
  
**About ACT**
ACT provides catalytic capital to founders building category-defining innovations for population-scale impact. We provide flexible, risk-tolerant grant capital to founders aiming to create “impact unicorns”: ventures that use technology and other innovation to solve large, systemic challenges in sectors such as education, health and environment.
  
  
Over the past five years, ACT has developed a distinctive venture philanthropy model. We support organisations early, provide the risk capital needed to experiment and innovate, and double down on those showing strong signals of scale. Till date, ACT has supported 60+ technology-led impact organisations, including Rocket Learning, Khushi Baby, Adalat AI, Indra Water and Forus Health.
  
  
**About The Systems Scale Acceleration Unit**
India has a growing pipeline of high-potential, impact-focused organisations, but many are not yet institutionally equipped to make the transition to systems-scale impact. Proven pathways for government adoption exist, yet they vary widely across sectors, geographies and institutional contexts, and early innovators occasionally lack the capacity to adapt them.
  
  
ACT is incubating the SSAU to close this gap. The Unit builds the capabilities organisations need most on this journey: government engagement and adoption pathways, strategic fundraising and scale-capital readiness, technology adoption, evidence generation, scale strategy and ecosystem partnerships.
  
  
**The Unit Will Work Across Five Complementary Areas**

* Scale-readiness programs: cohort-based programs, co-created with founders, that address common barriers to systems-scale adoption.
* Embedded fundraising and market intelligence: hands-on support that operates as an extension of founding teams.
* A library of systems-scale knowledge: practical playbooks, case studies and learning forums drawn from the sector's existing body of knowledge.
* Pathways for institutional navigation: access to the people and organisations with deep public sector knowledge and trusted public sector relationships.
* Digital public goods: reusable technology assets, toolkits and workflow solutions that address common scale barriers.

**Role Description**
This is a high-ownership leadership role at the intersection of strategy, fundraising and ecosystem-building. As Director, you will set the Unit’s direction, build and lead its team, and stay close to founders on the highest-stakes moments in their scale journey. You will:
  
  

* Lead the Unit: Own the strategy, delivery, budget and outcomes of the SSAU, and serve as its senior-most representative internally and externally. Build and lead a team that includes a Lead (Portfolio Fundraising) and a Lead (Public Systems).
* Provide embedded fundraising support: Guide the Unit’s work as an extension of founding teams across funder mapping, pitch refinement, positioning and diligence preparation. Engage directly on key funder relationships and help portfolio organisations build clear pathways to larger scale capital.
* Pilot and institutionalise scale-readiness programs: Design and manage cohort-based programs, possibly delivered with specialist partners. Co-create them with founders, refine them through feedback, and codify them into repeatable models.
* Oversee institutional navigation and the knowledge library: Ensure founders can reach the public sector stakeholders, experts and implementers they need, and guide the curation of existing knowledge on scaling through public systems into playbooks, case studies and learning forums.
* Contribute to digital public goods: Identify opportunities to codify reusable technology assets, implementation toolkits and workflow solutions into DPGs that benefit the wider sector.
* Measure and report impact: Track progress against the Unit's outcomes, and communicate learnings and results to ACT's leadership, partners and funders.

**Required Qualifications**
We are looking for a senior, high-agency leader with a strong track record and a genuine interest in building institutions that scale impact. The ideal candidate will bring:
  
  

* Leadership experience in impact organisations: 8–12 years of experience, including senior roles leading fundraising, operations, technology or programmes in nonprofits or sociel enterprises.
* Depth in fundraising, technology or public systems: Hands-on experience in at least one of these areas, and enough fluency in the others to direct and support a specialist.
* Relationships built on trust: The ability to build deep, lasting relationships with individuals and institutions, especially funding organisations and the public sector.
* Hustle with high standards: The drive to move fast without compromising on quality, working at the pace our founders deserve.
* Team building: The ability to hire, develop and bring out the best in a small, high-calibre team with a mix of seniority, which may be geographically dispersed.
* Collaborative leadership: Comfort working alongside ACT's leadership to jointly define the Unit's vision, manage progress and communicate it transparently.

**Location**
We operate a hybrid model with teams based in Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru. Candidates should be based in one of these and available to work from the office 2-3 days per week.

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will be a direct report into the Head of IAM.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Synchrony Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is seeking an experienced IAM End User Operations leader to oversee and drive the operations and support of End User IAM Services. This role will lead a team responsible for delivering secure, efficient, and seamless identity and access management experiences for our end users across the organization. Acting as a critical bridge between technology, security, and business stakeholders, you will ensure operational excellence of IAM solutions, streamline user lifecycle processes, and enhance service delivery aligned with our digital transformation goals.

The ideal candidate for this role will embrace the exciting blend of technical expertise, program management, engagement ability and leadership that is required to be successful.

* Stay current with emerging IAM operational technologies, tools, and industry trends to continuously enhance the IAM service portfolio.

* Knowledge of automation tools and DevSecOps principles applied in IAM environments (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD).
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with proven stakeholder management experience.

title: Independent Director
description:
**The mandate follows a component through its entire consequence chain**

The Audit and Risk Chair must be able to begin with a customer programme and follow it through design, sourcing, tooling, production, quality, dispatch, cash and field performance. Each stage can change the accounts and the risk profile. The Board is looking for a director who can identify where optimistic commercial assumptions, operational evidence and financial judgement diverge.

**Programme economics**

Material nominations should show expected volume and mix, customer schedules, price-reset clauses, development responsibility, tooling ownership, localisation, working capital, qualification and downside. Engineering change and customer recovery must enter forecasts promptly. The Chair will examine whether revenue, margins and capital are supported by acceptance and cash rather than programme optimism.

**Supply network**

Critical materials, components and processes should be mapped beyond immediate suppliers. Sole-source exposure, financial fragility, geopolitical restrictions, counterfeit prevention, long lead times, obsolescence and alternate qualification belong in Board risk. Inventory buffers will be judged against cash, redesign and shelf-life consequences.

**Quality and field risk**

The committee will receive evidence on process capability, internal and external defects, concessions, rework, line stoppage, warranty, field events and corrective action. A recurring small defect can be strategically material before the provision is large. Traceability should survive plants, systems and subcontractors.

**Financial and control remit**

The Audit agenda includes inventory, capex, revenue, provisions, customer debit notes, foreign exchange, government incentives where applicable, related parties, procurement integrity, fraud and IT access. Post-investment reviews should distinguish equipment installed, capacity qualified, utilisation achieved and cash return realised.

**Cyber-physical and continuity risk**

Plant systems, engineering repositories, remote vendor access and customer data require integrated governance. The Chair will seek evidence of segmentation, access, backup, restoration and safe manual operation. A cyber scenario should consider quality, shipment, customer notification and financial reporting—not only system recovery.

**NRC and CSR connection**

As an NRC member, the director will examine succession for operations, quality, engineering, finance and commercial leadership and whether incentives encourage escalation. CSR oversight will focus on measurable outcomes, responsible sourcing and plant-community integrity.

**Entry assignment and candidate profile**

The Chair's first assignment will trace one material programme from bid case to current cash and field performance, then use the gaps to reset Audit and Risk agendas. Candidates should bring senior automotive, industrial, finance, audit, quality or enterprise-risk leadership. Dual-chair experience is preferred. Independence, DIN, databank compliance and willingness to visit plants are mandatory.

**How the two committees will decide**

Audit will determine whether reported positions and controls are supportable; Risk will determine whether the exposure remains acceptable and what action is required. The same evidence may produce different decisions. The Chair must preserve that distinction, ensure conclusions are reconciled at Board level and prevent a favourable accounting treatment from being presented as proof that the underlying risk is well managed.

title: Electrical Foreman
description:
**Company Description**
Varindera Construction Ltd. is a growing construction company that delivers commercial and residential projects with a focus on quality, safety, and timely completion. The organization emphasizes strong technical standards and efficient project management to meet client requirements. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of their work and collaborate closely across disciplines. The company values integrity, professionalism, and continuous improvement in all aspects of its operations.
  
**Role Description**
The Electrical Foreman is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram, responsible for supervising and coordinating all electrical activities at the project site. Day-to-day tasks include overseeing electrical wiring and installation work, assigning tasks to electricians and helpers, monitoring progress, and ensuring adherence to drawings, specifications, and safety standards. The role involves inspecting electrical systems, identifying and resolving issues, coordinating with project engineers, site managers, and contractors, and verifying that materials and tools are available and properly used. The Electrical Foreman will also maintain documentation of work completed, support quality checks and testing, and ensure compliance with relevant codes and regulations.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong foundational knowledge of electricity and practical experience working with electrical systems.
* Candidates should possess skills in electrical contracting, including planning, coordinating, and supervising electrical work on construction projects.
* Candidates should possess competencies in electrical engineering principles relevant to building services and site installations.
* Candidates should possess hands-on expertise in electrical wiring, installation, and commissioning of fixtures, panels, and equipment.
* Candidates should possess troubleshooting skills for diagnosing and resolving electrical faults and performance issues on site.
* Diploma or degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field is preferred, along with relevant trade certifications.
* Proven experience in a supervisory or foreman role on construction sites, with strong leadership and team coordination abilities.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, safety standards, and technical documentation, with good communication and reporting skills.
* Commitment to workplace safety, adherence to electrical codes, and willingness to work on-site in dynamic project conditions.

title: Head of Logistics
description:
**#Hiring#Logistics Head#Leading MNC**

Location: Delhi/NCR

Experience: 20+ Years

Qualification: Graduate and Master's degree or equivalent

Industry Preference: FMCG/ Manufacturing

We are looking for an experienced logistics leader to manage end-to-end logistics operations across India and the SAARC region. The role involves developing logistics strategies, optimizing transportation and warehousing costs, managing import operations, and ensuring timely and damage-free delivery of products.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage international shipments and coordinate with domestic and overseas factories.
* Monitor logistics expenses against approved budgets and identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising service quality.
* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements, internal policies, audits, and logistics procedures.
* Lead, mentor, and develop the logistics team while driving operational efficiency and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate and Master's degree or equivalent.

**Required Skills**

* Minimum 20 years of relevant experience in logistics, transportation, distribution, or supply chain management.
* Strong knowledge of PAN India or Central logistics networks, warehouse management, freight operations, and import procedures.
* Proven experience in logistics cost optimization, vendor management, and large-scale logistics operations.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Working knowledge of SAP is an advantage.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in the FMCD, consumer durables, home appliances, electronics, or manufacturing industry is preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Logistics cost optimization
* On-time shipping and delivery
* Inventory accuracy

* Warehouse and transportation efficiency

title: INM057: Manager, Supply Chain Operations
description:
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and results-oriented Manager – Supply Chain Operations to lead and manage end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations across warehousing, transportation, distribution, inventory management, 3PL operations, and customer service.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have 12–15 years of strong experience in supply chain operations, with significant exposure to 3PL and third-party contract logistics environments. The candidate will be responsible for managing large-scale operations, multiple warehouses/DCs, logistics partners, manpower, transportation networks, service providers, Region P&L , and customer relationships.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking and hands-on operational leadership, with the ability to drive operational excellence, cost optimization, process improvement, service-level adherence, technology adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The candidate will be expected to build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, customers, transporters, 3PL partners, vendors, and other external service providers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Supply Chain Operations
* Manage and oversee end-to-end supply chain operations covering warehousing & Transportation .
* Develop and implement operational strategies aligned with business requirements, customer expectations, and company objectives.
* Monitor operational performance across warehouses, distribution centers, transport operations.
* Ensure achievement of agreed SLA, KPI, OTIF, productivity, quality, cost, and customer service targets.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Establish standardized operating processes across locations and ensure adherence to SOPs.
* Ensure optimum utilization of warehouse space, manpower, material handling equipment, and infrastructure.
* Drive warehouse productivity through appropriate manpower planning, process design, layout optimization, slotting, and workflow improvements.
* Establish and monitor warehouse productivity metrics.
* Ensure accurate inventory records and minimize inventory discrepancies.
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, security, and operational standards.
* Support warehouse expansion, relocation, consolidation, and new facility implementation projects.
* Ensure effective management of warehouse assets and material handling equipment.
* Own and monitor operational logistics costs across warehousing, transportation, manpower, packaging, handling, and other logistics activities.
* Prepare and manage annual operating budgets for supply chain operations.
* Analyze actual versus budgeted costs and identify deviations.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives without compromising service levels.
* Identify opportunities for:

+ Freight optimization
+ Warehouse productivity improvement
+ Manpower optimization
+ Space optimization
+ Packaging optimization
+ Route optimization
+ Vendor consolidation
+ Process automation
+ Asset utilization

* Conduct regular P&L reviews with warehouse in charges .
* Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to improve supply chain efficiency, productivity, quality, and cost.
* Lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Apply methodologies such as:

+ Lean
+ Kaizen
+ 5S
+ Six Sigma
+ Root Cause Analysis
+ PDCA
+ Process Mapping
+ Standard Work

* Conduct process audits and identify gaps against defined SOPs.
* Drive automation and digitization initiatives.
* Eliminate non-value-added activities and process bottlenecks.
* Standardize best practices across locations.
* Lead productivity improvement projects with measurable financial benefits.
* Technology & Digital Supply Chain
* Identify opportunities for automation and technology-led process improvements.
* Ensure data accuracy and system discipline across supply chain operations.
* Work with IT teams to implement enhancements, integrations, dashboards, and automation.
* Leverage analytics and operational data to improve decision-making.
* Promote real-time visibility of inventory, orders, shipments, and logistics performance.
* Support implementation of digital supply chain solutions.

**5 . Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through consistent service delivery.
* Handle critical customer escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Conduct regular operational reviews with key customers.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into actionable operational processes.
* Develop strong relationships with internal stakeholders including:
* Ensure effective communication and cross-functional collaboration.

**6 . Vendor & Commercial Management**

* Manage commercial relationships with logistics vendors and service providers.
* Negotiate rates, contracts, SLAs, and commercial terms.
* Validate vendor invoices against agreed rates and actual service delivery.
* Ensure proper governance over additional charges, claims, penalties, and recoveries.
* Conduct periodic vendor performance and commercial reviews.
* Identify opportunities for vendor consolidation and strategic sourcing.
* Support procurement/commercial teams during logistics tenders and contract negotiations.

**7 . Compliance, Safety & Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with company policies, statutory requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable logistics regulations.
* Implement robust operational controls across warehouses and transportation.
* Ensure adherence to health, safety, security, and environmental standards.
* Conduct periodic operational and safety audits.
* Identify supply chain risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Establish business continuity and contingency plans for critical logistics operations.
* Ensure proper incident reporting, investigation, and corrective action.
* Team Leadership & People Management
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of supply chain, warehouse, logistics, and operations professionals.
* Manage both direct employees and outsourced/contract manpower.
* Define roles, responsibilities, objectives, and performance expectations.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
* Identify training and development requirements.
* Build a strong performance-oriented culture.
* Improve employee productivity, engagement, and retention.
* Develop succession plans for critical operational positions.
* Ensure adequate manpower planning based on business volumes and operational requirements.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.

The Company
  
  
FedEx Logistics provides e-Commerce, freight forwarding, as well as import and export services that allow companies to reach markets throughout the world. They help customers of all sizes solve the intricacies of shipping goods globally by providing comprehensive international ocean and air freight forwarding, surface transportation and distribution, customs brokerage, trade and customs advisory services, and advanced e-commerce and trade facilitation solutions.
  
  
The Philosophy
  
  
People–Service–Profit (P-S-P). We take care of our People so that they can deliver impeccable Service to our customers who will give us the Profit necessary for FedEx to be successful. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages employees to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for our employees' well-being and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
The Culture
  
  
We honor innovation, integrity and diversity. We have many formal policies, procedures and programs to bring out the best in our staff, individually and in teams.
  
  
The Mission
  
  
We strive to be the Best Company to work for with the Best Service and the Best Brand in our industry.
  
  
We're glad you stopped by and hope your job search experience with FedEx Logistics, Inc. will be rewarding. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Manager – Operations (FM & Security)
description:
Easy Source is a tech-enabled workforce solutions company with 10,000+ deployed staff across 180+ client locations, and a fast-growing security business.

You’ll lead manned guarding operations across multiple client sites. That covers guard deployment, discipline, compliance, client relationships, and procurement of uniforms and kit. * Monitor site-level costs and profitability

Graduate in any discipline. Ex-servicemen or ex-paramilitary candidates are welcome. A diploma in Security Management, Operations, or Facility Management is a plus.
