title: Field Application Manager – Robotics
description:
Location for this opening: Delhi region

Field Application Manager – Robotics

Lead field applications at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. It is a priceless opportunity to shape robotics in India.

Own applications, demos and commissioning for cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with regular travel to customer sites

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6–10 years

The Role

You will lead Luna's Field Application Engineers and own the technical success of every robotics project across our Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree range: industrial robots and cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoid robots and quadruped robot dogs. You will be the senior technical partner for key accounts and the sales team, and set the standards our field team works to.

What You Will Do

• Lead, coach and plan the work of the FAE team across sites.

• Own application success by validating feasibility, cycle time, cell layouts and AMR/AGV fleet concepts before commitment.

• Plan and deliver high-impact demos and proof-of-concept projects for robot arms, mobile robots, humanoids and robot dogs.

• Set and enforce standards for commissioning, programming, service, documentation and handover.

• Act as the senior technical contact for key accounts, and lead escalations to fast resolution.

• Build training programs for FAEs, sales engineers, partners and customer teams.

• Feed field insight to our in-house robot design team, principals and management.

Must Have

• BE/BTech in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical or Automation Engineering.

• 6–10 years in robotics or automation applications, including at least 2 years leading engineers or projects.

• Hands-on robot/cobot or mobile robot commissioning, with PLC, servo and machine vision integration.

• Proven experience delivering demos, technical presentations and customer training.

• Strong customer-handling skills and willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet deployment, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Robot cell layout, simulation or offline programming.

• Exposure to safety standards and risk assessment for robot cells and mobile robots.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work directly with our design and manufacturing teams, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: build your team, set the standards and make fast calls, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the robotics vertical scales, your role grows into senior technical and business leadership.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and motion control.

• High-impact projects: lead flagship deployments in factories, warehouses and new applications for key customers.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives and a supportive, growing team.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAM – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Account Director
description:
**About Us**

Humour Me is a creative agency that is built for the here and now. We’re a contemporary creative services and content marketing agency with an expertise in driving relevance for our clients and delivering high impact business results. The independently-owned agency was founded in 2012 and has its office in the capital city of the country. Humour Me has been recognised as a global honouree at The Webby Awards and has won over 16 global creative awards for excellence in storytelling, filmmaking, animation and new media disruption.

The Account Director will be the senior point of contact for the day-to-day management of the business and the ability to sell new ideas and solutions to existing/new business opportunities

**Role Overview**

The Account Director is a senior business leader responsible for the overall health, direction and growth of multiple client accounts. The role sits between Account Management and senior business leadership, with a strong focus on strategic client leadership, commercial growth and team development.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the overall health and direction of a portfolio of client businesses, ensuring strong client relationships, quality of work and commercial performance.

* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and act as a strategic partner beyond day-to-day account requirements.

* Develop a strong understanding of the client’s business, category, marketing priorities and competitive landscape, and use this to identify opportunities for the agency.

* Provide strategic direction to Account Managers and account teams, ensuring businesses are being managed proactively and not simply driven by incoming briefs.

* Review the health of accounts regularly across client relationships, revenue, profitability, scope, quality of work and growth potential.

* Identify opportunities to deepen existing relationships through upselling, cross-selling and expanding the agency’s role within the client’s business.

* Develop account growth plans and work with Account Managers and senior leadership to convert identified opportunities.

* Own the commercial health of the portfolio, including revenue, scope, budgets, resource requirements and profitability.

* Lead senior-level client reviews and conversations, bringing recommendations, insights and a clear point of view to the table.

* Challenge client briefs and internal thinking where required, ensuring the agency is solving meaningful business and brand problems.

* Work closely with Creative and Strategy leadership to ensure the work across the portfolio is strategically strong, relevant and aligned with client objectives.

* Lead and mentor Account Managers and wider account teams, setting clear expectations around client management, business growth and ownership.

* Build strong second-line leadership within accounts, ensuring Account Managers are empowered to independently manage their businesses.

* Identify capability and resource gaps across the portfolio and work with leadership to build the right team structure.

* Act as the senior escalation point for significant client, commercial or team-related issues and drive them towards resolution.

* Partner with the AVP on larger business opportunities, key client relationships, strategic decisions and portfolio-level priorities.

* Support new business development and identify opportunities emerging from existing client relationships.

* Track performance across the portfolio through regular reviews, identifying risks early and driving corrective action.

* Contribute to improving account management standards, processes and ways of working across the wider business.

* Swift decision making and driving outcomes will always trump effort in our eyes.

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of experience in Account Management, Brand Management, Digital Marketing, Advertising or related fields, with significant exposure to creative agency environments.

* Prior experience in managing large businesses like P&G, HUL, Reckitt Benckiser preferred.

* Proven experience in managing multiple client accounts and independently leading sizeable or strategically important businesses.

* Strong experience in building and maintaining senior client relationships. • Demonstrated ability to grow existing client relationships and identify commercial opportunities.

* Strong understanding of brand strategy, content marketing and integrated communication.

* Experience in leading, mentoring and developing Account Managers and account teams.

* Strong commercial understanding, including account revenue, budgets, scope and profitability.

* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills. • Strong strategic thinking and business acumen, with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.

title: Manager, Product Support Incident Management
description:

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox’s Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution.
  
  
You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager. The team provides support to Roblox’s global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Manager of Product Support Incident management, you’ll be focused on managing the team that manages technical escalations, supports product reliability, process improvement and design along with playing a critical role in managing and resolving escalations and high-impact incidents affecting our Roblox users and platform.
  
  
You will coordinate across multiple teams to ensure rapid response to minimize the impact on customers and business operations, identifying trends, enhancing support processes, improving agent efficiency, and reducing operational costs while maintaining high reliability and service quality.
  
  
This role requires participation in a shift rotation to maintain 24/7 operations, which includes on-call duties and weekend coverage.
  
  
**You Will**

* Lead and Mentor: Manage a high-performing team of Specialists responsible for incident response and technical escalations, providing coaching, development, and performance management.
* Drive Issue Management: Oversee the end-to-end incident management lifecycle within support operations, ensuring the team meets SLAs for critical and high-severity issues while serving as the final point of escalation for complex issues.
* Incident Management Strategy: Coordinate the incident response activities, gather the response team, and set up a virtual command center for communication and collaboration. Due to its potential impact, critical decisions must be made to classify the incident, and be willing to participate in on-call support for incident management issues. Along with this, you will be responsible for providing regular updates and reports to upper management on the status of operations, including performance metrics and any issues encountered.
* Cross Function Collaboration - Collaborate with Knowledge Management, Training and Quality Assurance teams to ensure process adherence, identify areas for improvement in support workflows, and implement quality control measures.
* Strategic Partner to Product Support - Is a strategic thought partner to product support, aligning on goals and objectives for launch readiness and building in quality escalation and issue management principals to readiness initiatives.

**You Have**

* Management Experience: 10+ years of experience in technical support or operations, with at least 2+ years in a people management role, preferably within a high-growth tech environment..
* Advanced Problem Solving: Strong ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business strategies. Proficiency in SQL or Python to audit team dashboards and validate data-driven decisions is highly preferred.
* Process Improvement: Demonstrated success in reducing operating costs and improving Automation Rate/ Contact Rate/CSAT/Quality scores.
* Systems Fluency: Deep familiarity with the architecture of CRM tools (Zendesk), Jira, and automated ticketing workflows.

**You Are**

* Innovative: You proactively identify emerging risks and execute on out of the box ideas to achieve goals.
* A Strategic Leader: You look beyond the immediate incident to solve for the root cause and prevent future friction at scale.
* Growth-Oriented: You are invested in your team’s success, fostering an inclusive environment that encourages continuous learning.
* A Master Communicator: You can distill highly technical incidents into concise "so-what" summaries for non-technical stakeholders and executives.
* Data-Driven: Uses data to identify trends, measure results, and drive decision-making.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
  
  
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. title: Jewellery Brand Operations & Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Kritika Khurana Jewels is an emerging jewellery brand focused on contemporary, fashion-forward designs that blend style with everyday wearability. The brand emphasizes high-quality craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a curated customer experience across online and offline channels. Based in Gurugram, the team works closely with artisans and suppliers to deliver well-finished, trend-led pieces. Joining Kritika Khurana Jewels offers the opportunity to contribute to a growing label and shape its operational and production standards.

**Role Description**

**Product and production tracker**

Maintain one tracker for every active design and SKU, including:

* Product name, SKU or temporary product code and collection
* Design owner and design status
* Vendor and contact person
* CAD, sample and production status
* Quote, approved cost and purchase order status
* Sample, production and delivery dates
* QC status and correction notes
* Quantity ordered, received and sellable
* Photography, listing and launch status
* Current blocker, next action, owner and due date

Use clear statuses such as Not started, In progress, Waiting on vendor, Waiting for approval, Blocked, QC hold, Ready for shoot, Ready for listing and Complete.

**New product and sampling process**

1. Receive a design brief from Kritika or the jewellery designer, including the reference, specifications and intended use.

2. Create a product code and add the product to the tracker.

3. Confirm with the jewellery designer what technical information the vendor needs.

4. Request quotes and timelines from vendors.

5. Send costs and purchase commitments to Kritika for approval.

6. Once approved, confirm the specifications, cost, quantity and timeline in writing with the vendor.

7. Follow up on CAD, sample and production milestones and record updates in the tracker.

8. Record sample receipt and arrange QC.

9. Route technical questions to the jewellery designer and commercial or launch decisions to Kritika.

10. Do not mark a product ready for production, photography or launch until the required approvals are recorded.

**Vendor coordination**

* Own routine vendor communication about samples, production status, corrections, quantities and delivery dates.
* Keep written records of agreed specifications, timelines, costs and changes.
* Send a written recap after calls where a decision or deadline was agreed.
* Follow up before due dates if an update is missing and flag overdue items early.
* Coordinate technical feedback with the jewellery designer so vendors receive one clear design direction.
* Escalate cost increases, missed deadlines, quality disputes or requests for unapproved payment to Kritika.
* Do not commit to new costs, quantities, design changes or public delivery dates without approval.
* Send approved invoices and payment details to Jessica for accountant coordination.

**Quality control**

Check pieces when samples or production arrive and record the result against the SKU. Check:

* Finishing, plating or oxidation consistency
* Stones, pearls and other components
* Clasps, hooks, closures and moving parts
* Sizing and fit against the approved specification
* Colour and material consistency across the batch
* Design accuracy against the approved reference or sample
* Visible damage, sharp edges, loose components or other defects

If a piece fails QC, mark it QC hold, keep it separate from sellable stock, photograph and record the issue, and coordinate a correction or replacement. Ask the jewellery designer to review design or technical issues. Recheck corrected pieces and record the outcome before releasing them.

**Inventory and dispatch coordination**

* Check stock with the internal team on agreed days each week.
* Compare physical stock information with the inventory tracker and Shopify availability.
* Flag low or inconsistent stock and prepare reorder recommendations.
* Track incoming stock against the purchase order and record discrepancies.
* Coordinate which pieces are needed for shoots, PR gifting, stylist requests or campaigns.
* Keep a product loan and gifting log with item, quantity, recipient, dispatch date, expected return and return condition.
* Coordinate dispatch priorities with Deepak. Deepak remains responsible for physical stock handling, packing and dispatch.
* Escalate lost, damaged, missing or returned items that affect sellable stock.

**Photography and e-commerce readiness**

* Prepare a shoot list with product name, SKU, quantity, styling notes and required angles.
* Confirm pieces are QC-approved and available before the shoot.
* Coordinate dates and logistics with the photographer, model, stylist and creative team.
* Track products photographed, edits pending and final images received.
* Match final images to the correct SKU and confirm samples are returned to Deepak.
* Coordinate product listings with the website team, including the correct SKU, approved price, specifications, materials, size information, images and stock availability.
* Check product pages against approved information before launch. Do not make unsupported material or quality claims.
* Coordinate sold-out and restock updates with Deepak and the website team.

**Social, PR and campaign coordination**

* Share approved product details, pricing, availability and launch timing with the social media team.
* Make sure pieces requested for campaigns, stylists, celebrities or PR activity are available and logged.
* Coordinate product dispatches and returns with Deepak.
* Flag stock shortages or production delays to Kritika, PR and social as early as possible.
* PR owns outreach and relationship management; social owns the content calendar and publishing. The operations manager ensures products and logistics are ready.

**Workflow:**

**Daily:**
Review due and overdue tasks, check expected deliveries and stock issues, update the tracker after confirmations, and flag urgent blockers or approvals to Kritika.

**Weekly:**
Share completed work, overdue items, upcoming deadlines, stock risks and decisions needed. Review sampling and production with the jewellery designer, stock and dispatch with internal, and readiness for upcoming shoots and launches.

**Monthly:**
Review the product pipeline, propose the next month’s production and shoot calendar, and flag recurring delays or process issues.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Jewelry Design and a strong understanding of fashion jewelry trends and aesthetics.
* Candidates should possess skills in Communication, with the ability to communicate professionally with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess skills in Polishing and quality inspection to ensure consistent finishing and craftsmanship.
* Candidates should possess skills in Training, including the ability to guide and coach production staff or artisans on processes and standards.
* Experience in jewellery production, operations management, or fashion accessories is highly beneficial.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities, with proficiency in basic digital tools (spreadsheets, inventory or order-tracking software).
* Ability to work independently in a hybrid environment, collaborate with a small team, and manage multiple orders or projects simultaneously.
* Relevant education or certification in design, fashion, jewellery, or operations management is an advantage.

title: Manager - Golf Course Maintenance
description:
**PURPOSE**

To manage the overall management, maintenance, repair, and operational readiness of all golf course machinery, equipment, utility vehicles, and workshop facilities. The role ensures that all turf maintenance equipment is maintained in optimal working conditions to support efficient golf course operations while maintaining safety, quality, and cost control standards.

**KEY ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**

**Reports to**
: Golf Course Superintendent

**Reporting Roles: Finance**
Executives, Supervisor, Associates

**Interacts with**
:

* **External:**
  Vendors, Auditors, Statutory Authorities, Consultants, Service Providers
* **Internal:**
  Golf Course Team, Procurement Team, Department Heads, Store & Receiving Teams, HR, Senior Management

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Equipment Maintenance & Repair**

* Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance of all golf course machinery and equipment.
* Ensure timely repair and servicing of mowers, tractors, utility vehicles, sprayers, aerators, and other turf equipment.
* Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules to maximize equipment lifespan and minimize breakdowns.
* Diagnose mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, and engine-related issues and ensure prompt resolution.

**Workshop Management**

* Manage day-to-day operations of the workshop and maintenance facilities.
* Maintain cleanliness, organization, and safety standards within the workshop.
* Ensure availability of tools, equipment, spare parts, and consumables required for maintenance activities.
* Monitor fuel, lubricants, and inventory consumption.

**Inventory & Asset Management**

* Maintain accurate records of all machinery, service history, breakdown reports, and maintenance schedules.
* Manage procurement and inventory of spare parts and workshop supplies.
* Conduct periodic audits of equipment and workshop inventory.
* Recommend replacement or refurbishment of aging equipment.

**Team Leadership**

* Supervise workshop technicians, mechanics, welders, and support staff.
* Allocate work assignments and monitor team productivity.
* Provide technical guidance and training to workshop personnel.
* Conduct performance reviews and identify development opportunities for team members.

**Cost Control & Budgeting**

* Prepare annual workshop operating budgets.
* Monitor maintenance expenses and ensure cost-effective utilization of resources.
* Negotiate with vendors and service providers for parts and equipment repairs.
* Track and report maintenance costs and equipment performance metrics.

**Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all workplace health, safety, and environmental regulations.
* Conduct regular safety inspections and risk assessments.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal of oils, lubricants, batteries, and hazardous materials.
* Maintain adherence to organizational policies and industry best practices.

**Vendor & Contractor Management**

* Coordinate with external service providers for specialized repairs and warranty services.
* Evaluate vendor performance and maintain effective supplier relationships.
* Ensure completion of annual maintenance contracts and statutory inspections.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS / HIRING PROFILE**

**QUALIFICATIONS**

· Diploma/bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Automobile Engineering, or related field.

· Certification in Heavy Equipment Maintenance or Automotive Systems preferred

**WORK EXPERIENCE**

· 8-12 years of experience in equipment maintenance, workshop operations, or mechanical engineering.

· Minimum 3-5 years in a supervisory or managerial role.

· Experience managing turf equipment, golf course machinery, agricultural machinery, or heavy equipment preferred.

**Job Description – GDS Independence | Process Lead**
**Role title GDS Independence Process Lead**
**Position Summary**
The Process Lead is accountable for the governance, quality, and overall health of an assigned GDS Independence process portfolio. Acting as the process steward and independent quality oversight leader within the operating model, the role provides a consolidated view of process performance, recurring issues, control effectiveness, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities across the portfolio.
  
  
The role establishes process priorities, directs and supports Process SMRs, and drives assurance, remediation, and capability initiatives to strengthen consistency, compliance, and operational effectiveness. Working closely with Global Process Owners, Geo Leads, Regional/Country Leaders, and other stakeholders, the Process Lead ensures global standards are effectively embedded, risks are proactively managed, and process improvements are implemented in a controlled and sustainable manner.
  
  
Through strong governance, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement, the Process Lead enables consistent execution, strengthens process maturity, and supports the delivery of high-quality Independence services across GDS.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Process Governance & Portfolio Leadership:**

* Lead the governance agenda for assigned GDS processes.
* Maintain an integrated view of process health, quality, risks, capability, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish portfolio priorities and determine focus areas for assurance, remediation, and process improvement.
* Drive consistent application of Global standards and approved process requirements.
* Partner with Global and Regional Process Owners to support effective process governance and decision-making.

**Quality, Assurance & Risk Oversight:**

* Approve and oversee risk-based quality and assurance coverage across the portfolio.
* Review significant findings, recurring issues, control weaknesses, and emerging risks.
* Determine when additional review, remediation, or escalation is required.
* Oversee thematic reviews, trend analysis, and quality assessments to identify systemic risks.
* Ensure assurance outcomes lead to meaningful and sustainable improvements.

**Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement:**

* Analyse recurring issues, root causes, assurance findings, and process risks across the portfolio.
* Establish remediation priorities and monitor progress to closure.
* Hold designated owners accountable for delivering corrective actions.
* Confirm remediation activities address underlying causes and reduce future risk.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve process effectiveness.

**Process Change & Knowledge Management:**

* Oversee implementation of approved process improvements and changes across GDS.
* Maintain process documentation, SOPs, playbooks, controls, job aids, and knowledge repositories.
* Translate approved Global changes into practical guidance and readiness actions.
* Ensure process standards remain current, accessible, and consistently applied.
* Support successful adoption through effective communication and learning strategies.

**Stakeholder & Process Stewardship:**

* Partner with Global Process Owners, Geo Leads, Regional/Country Independence Leaders and other stakeholders to strengthen process performance and governance.
* Provide clear recommendations on process risks, quality concerns, and improvement opportunities.
* Influence decisions through data-driven insights and objective process oversight.
* Represent the process portfolio in governance forums and strategic discussions.
* Foster strong collaboration between process, service, and delivery teams.

**People Leadership & Capability Development:**

* Lead, coach, and develop assigned Process SMRs.
* Establish clear expectations, ownership, and accountability for portfolio outcomes.
* Drive calibration and consistency of technical judgment across teams and locations.
* Strengthen succession planning, knowledge continuity, and leadership readiness.
* Build a sustainable pipeline of process stewardship capability to support future organizational needs.

**Success measures**

* Quality: Quality at source, rework, Second-line review themes, business escalations, independent QA themes and sustained remediation
* Experience: RIL pulse, Voice of Customer, communication quality.
* People: Capability, engagement, retention, coaching, succession and primary/secondary coverage
* Risk & Assurance: Reduced systemic risks and recurring quality issues through effective assurance and independent oversight.
* Improvement & Transformation: Measurable improvements in process effectiveness, efficiency, standardization, and user experience.
* Capability & Succession: A strong pipeline of capable Process SMRs supported by effective coaching, knowledge continuity, and succession planning.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Strengthen stakeholder confidence through effective governance, strategic insights and Global alignment.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong Independence or risk and compliance knowledge, with the ability to link process decisions to regional and business outcomes.

* Proven leadership of multi-location teams, with clear accountability for capacity, performance, risk and people outcomes.
* Strong executive communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted stakeholder relationships.
* Sound judgment, using service, quality, demand, people and stakeholder insights to set priorities and improve performance.
* Inclusive and culturally aware leadership, with a strong focus on coaching, talent development and succession.
* Proven ability to lead change, drive technology adoption and deliver sustained service improvements.

**To qualify for the role**

* A university degree (master’s or post-graduate degree) or equivalent professional experience in business, accounting, finance, risk, compliance, operations or a related area.
* 12-14 years of relevant experience in professional services, global delivery, Independence, risk or another controlled service environment.
* Demonstrated people leadership, stakeholder management, Quality and controls and change implementation.
* Excellent written and spoken English and confidence operating across time zones and cultures.
* Evidence of portfolio leadership, senior stakeholder credibility and cross-process judgment appropriate to Rank 62 or aspiring Rank 62.

**What You Can Look For**

* A team of people with technical experience, business acumen and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment.
* A team of professionals driven by growth and client enablement mindset, while safeguarding EY’s brand name.
* A team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills.
* A team that functions with One-Team mindset and values diversity and inclusiveness.
* Opportunities to work with regional teams and stakeholders on strengthening the compliance framework.
* A team that thrives on continuous improvement and bringing in efficiency to processes.

We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, Philippines, Poland and UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

description:

Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Service Delivery Management**

* Monitor expenditures, identify cost-saving opportunities, and control costs

* Prepare regular reports on service levels, KPIs, and operational performance
* Document processes, procedures, and best practices

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred
* 3-5 years of experience in facilities management with focus on soft services
* Experience managing multiple service contracts and vendors
* Background in commercial real estate or corporate facilities environment

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of soft services operations and industry best practices
* Proficiency with CAFM/CMMS systems and MS Office Suite
* Understanding of health and safety regulations and compliance requirements
* Familiarity with sustainability and environmental management practices

**Competencies**

* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail
* Customer service orientation with professional demeanor
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Financial acumen and budget management capabilities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* IWFM (Institute of Workplace and Facilities Management) certification
* IOSH Managing Safely or equivalent health and safety qualification
* Experience with integrated facilities management
* Knowledge of CAFM systems (e.g., Planon, Archibus, FM:Systems)

Working Conditions
  
  

* Office-based with regular site visits across portfolio
* Standard business hours with occasional evening/weekend coverage required

description:

discipline,ECE
  
About the Role
  
We are looking for an experienced Technical Manager – Solar to lead and supervise Solar
  
PV module testing, certification, laboratory operations, technical documentation, quality
  
systems, audits and compliance activities.
  
The candidate should have strong experience in Solar PV testing, IEC standards, BIS
  
requirements, NABL laboratory systems, audits, certification activities, and client
  
coordination. The profile should also have experience in managing end-to-end testing
  
workflows and technical teams.

title: Deputy Boutique Manager
description:
**Job Title: DEPUTY BOUTIQUE MANAGER**

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Company:**
ABPR Jewels Pvt Ltd

**About AMARIS**

AMARIS is one of the fastest-growing luxury jewellery maisons, created for the neo-luxe woman - bold, expressive, and unapologetically herself. Loved and trusted by leading Bollywood celebrities and global clientele, AMARIS has quickly established itself as a statement-making brand in the fine jewellery space.

Blending global design sensibilities with Indian craftsmanship, AMARIS creates fine jewellery that moves effortlessly across every facet of her life. With a strong digital-first approach and a deeply engaged global community, the brand is redefining how modern women experience and wear luxury.

Currently present across 4 flagship stores, AMARIS is on a strong growth trajectory with a vision to expand to 20 stores across India over the next 5 years - building a truly pan-India luxury brand.

At its core, AMARIS is not just about jewellery - it’s about confidence, individuality, and making a statement every day.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a dynamic and customer-focused Assistant Store Manager to support the Store Manager in driving store sales, team performance, operational excellence, and an exceptional luxury client experience.

The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, a passion for luxury retail, and a proven ability to drive sales and build meaningful relationships with clients. The Assistant Store Manager will play a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of the boutique while actively contributing to revenue growth, team development, clienteling, and brand experience.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is comfortable being on the shop floor, leading by example, coaching the team, engaging with clients, and taking ownership of day-to-day store performance.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Store Operations**

* Support the Store Manager in managing end-to-end boutique operations and ensuring adherence to brand SOPs.
* Take ownership of day-to-day store functioning in the absence of the Store Manager.
* Ensure the store is always client-ready, well-maintained, and aligned with AMARIS brand standards.
* Support staff rostering, attendance, shift planning, and daily operational requirements.
* Conduct daily team briefings and ensure clear communication of priorities and targets.
* Ensure adherence to store opening and closing procedures.
* Coordinate with internal teams including Marketing, VM, CRM, Operations, and Finance for store-related requirements.
* Ensure timely execution of store initiatives, campaigns, launches, and events.

**2. Sales & Business Performance**

* Support the Store Manager in achieving monthly and annual store sales targets.
* Drive daily sales performance and ensure consistent achievement of individual and team targets.
* Monitor sales performance and identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Actively participate in client interactions and lead by example on the sales floor.
* Drive key retail performance indicators including conversion, ATV, UPT, repeat business, and client acquisition.
* Ensure effective follow-up on leads, enquiries, trials, appointments, and pending sales.
* Support the team in converting high-potential prospects and walk-ins into customers.
* Assist in implementing sales strategies and initiatives to maximize store revenue.

**3. Client Experience & Clienteling**

* Deliver a best-in-class luxury experience to every client visiting the boutique.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Develop and nurture relationships with HNI and high-value clients.
* Support the team in developing strong clienteling practices and maintaining meaningful client relationships.
* Ensure timely follow-ups with clients through calls, WhatsApp, and other approved CRM channels.
* Track important client occasions, preferences, purchase history, and follow-up opportunities.
* Drive repeat business and customer referrals through strong relationship management.
* Monitor customer feedback and proactively address client concerns.
* Support the Store Manager in improving CSAT, NPS, customer retention, and repeat business.

**4. Team Management & Development**

* Support the Store Manager in leading, motivating, and developing the store team.
* Conduct regular floor huddles, product briefings, and sales discussions.
* Coach team members on product knowledge, selling skills, client engagement, and luxury service standards.
* Track individual performance and provide regular feedback to team members.
* Identify performance gaps and work with team members to improve productivity.
* Ensure 100% completion of mandatory product, process, and service training.
* Foster a high-energy, collaborative, client-first, and performance-driven culture.
* Lead by example in professionalism, grooming, punctuality, client engagement, and sales behaviour.

**5. CRM & Client Data Discipline**

* Ensure the team maintains accurate and updated client information.
* Drive disciplined usage of CRM systems and ensure all client interactions are recorded appropriately.
* Monitor lead follow-ups, client appointments, trials, and pending opportunities.
* Ensure timely updating of customer interactions and sales pipeline information.
* Work with the CRM and Marketing teams to execute client engagement campaigns.
* Identify opportunities for reactivation of dormant clients and engagement of high-value customers.

**6. Visual Merchandising & Brand Standards**

* Ensure the boutique consistently reflects AMARIS's premium visual and brand standards.
* Support the Store Manager in maintaining product presentation, displays, counters, and client areas.
* Ensure adherence to VM guidelines during launches, campaigns, and collection changes.
* Coordinate with the VM and Marketing teams for execution of new campaigns and visual updates.
* Ensure all team members maintain appropriate grooming and professional presentation standards.

**7. Inventory & Operational Controls**

* Support the Store Manager in maintaining accurate inventory and stock movement records.
* Ensure adherence to jewellery handling, stock movement, transfer, and security protocols.
* Support periodic stock audits, inventory verification, and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure proper documentation for billing, deliveries, dispatches, and stock transfers.
* Maintain strict adherence to internal controls, audit requirements, and security protocols.
* Escalate discrepancies, operational issues, or control concerns to the Store Manager and relevant teams promptly.

**8. Reporting & Compliance**

* Maintain accurate daily and periodic store performance reports.
* Track sales, conversion, ATV, UPT, footfall, leads, appointments, and other relevant KPIs.
* Ensure timely submission of reports and store updates to the Store Manager.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, and team discipline.
* Ensure compliance with all AMARIS policies, SOPs, and operational guidelines.
* Support the Store Manager during internal and external audits.

**9. Leadership & Business Support**

* Act as the Store Manager's key support in driving overall store performance.
* Take charge of the boutique in the Store Manager's absence.
* Serve as a role model for sales excellence, customer service, and professional conduct.
* Work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams on store initiatives.
* Proactively identify operational and business improvement opportunities.
* Contribute ideas that improve customer experience, team productivity, and store profitability.

**Requirements**

* Graduate in any discipline; degree/diploma in Fashion, Retail, Luxury Management, Business, or a related field will be preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in luxury retail, premium retail, jewellery, fashion, lifestyle, or related industries.
* Prior experience in a supervisory, senior sales, team lead, or assistant management role will be preferred.
* Strong experience in direct sales and client relationship management.
* Proven ability to engage with HNI and high-value clients.
* Strong understanding of luxury selling and customer experience.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets and drive team performance.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
* Strong leadership and people management abilities.
* Good understanding of CRM practices and customer lifecycle management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an understanding of retail KPIs.
* Excellent attention to detail and operational discipline.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and perform effectively in a fast-paced retail environment.
* Strong grooming and professional presentation appropriate for a luxury retail environment.
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

**Why Join AMARIS Jewels**

AMARIS is building one of India’s most exciting luxury jewellery brands - loved by Bollywood, trusted by a discerning global clientele, and growing at speed.

With 4 flagship stores already operational and a clear vision to scale to 20 stores in the next 5 years, we are in a defining phase of expansion and looking for people who want to build, not just participate.

At AMARIS, performance, ownership, and creativity are non-negotiable. If you thrive in high-growth environments, take pride in your craft, and want your work to be seen, valued, and rewarded - this is where you accelerate.

**What Sets Us Apart**

**Fast-Track Growth**

* Exceptional performers don't wait years for recognition. Growth here is merit-driven, visible, and fast.

**Real Ownership**

* You don't simply manage a floor - you help build a store, a team, and a customer experience that represents the AMARIS brand.

**Lead from the Front**

* Be on the floor, engage with clients, coach your team, and directly influence store performance.

**Build Exceptional Customer Experiences**

* Every interaction matters. Your work directly influences how clients experience and remember AMARIS.

**High Performance Culture**

* We operate with ambition and accountability. The bar is high; and so are the rewards.

**Interested Candidates**

Interested candidates can mail their resume to hr@amarisjewels.com

title: Senior Manager / Manager – Health & Benefits Consulting - RxPharmacist
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Health Operations team at Marsh
  
  
This role will be based in GGN. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
**H&B Consulting - RxPharma**
**What can you expect?**
The Senior Pharmacy Clinical Pharmacy Consultant will lead accurate and timely compilation of data and financial analysis on mid-sized and large, complex pharmacy projects
  
  
A significant part of this role is to be a key contributor for projects while developing and growing intellectual capital and driving operational efficiencies
  
  

* Manages the scope, quality, timeliness of multiple client deliverables in researching, analyzing, and evaluating drug therapies, disease states, and pharmacy benefit plans and programs in the US.
* Learn and understand high level financials related to pharmacy benefit offerings, plan designs and assist with contract reviews.
* Reviews RFP outputs of clinical and formulary information gathered by the team, analyzes and interprets the results, edits and finalizes the executive summary report, and sends this report to the US team.
* Supports pharmacy and medical medication focused assessments and plan design diagnostics.
* Assists in developing/writing Summary Plan Documents for US based employers based on program decisions made by employers (crosswalk to be provided by US based colleagues).
* Assists with evaluation model development and maintenance for projects that involve both medical and pharmacy claim data.
* Organizes and maintains databases for employer clients and industry vendors.
* Develop and maintains personal and working relationships with key US team stakeholders facilitate the sharing of advice and information relevant to the client, developing new and expanded business.
* Creates or supports written industry points of view/blog posts/whitepapers/clinical reviews.
* Supports written responses for US based clients seeking information about Mercer’s US Pharmacy Team - Request for Proposal (RFP) response support.
* Continually evaluates processes looking for opportunities to automate or improve upon current workflow.
* With a growing understanding of the US healthcare system, provide clinical guidance on PBM/carrier programs and services.
* Helps to draft points of view and assist other clinicians with clinical reviews.
* Advises on the implication for plan sponsors on the release on new clinical studies, drug approvals, and guideline changes.
* Keeps up with US industry happenings, news, and new vendor offerings.
* Performs other research and analysis as related to the US prescription drug marketplace and industry.
* Guides and trains other local pharmacy team members and peer review their work.
* Acts as an advisor to junior staff for problem resolution and guidance on appropriate ways to deal with challenges.
* Possesses an active pharmacy license (does not need to be licensed in the US).

**We will count on you to**

* Manage the day-to-day project management and support with the key members of the US pharmacy team
* Prepare project results for US pharmacy colleagues supporting clients, carriers, managed care entities and other related entities
* Work with the US based pharmacy colleagues to initiate projects. This may include meetings with the internal Mercer pharmacy team and in some occasions the client team from time to time, understand project scope, timelines and deliverables. You will develop and propose essential project documents, including the strategy, budget and work plans.
* Maintaining project documents and produce documents stating project results, including reports, charts and analyses
* Manage data and analytical work, summarizing claim experience and providing recommendations for employers

**Note: Applicants should be flexible working in shifts (3:00 pm - 12:00 am) and most work will be during normal local business hours.**
**What you need to have:**
  
  

* Doctorate of Pharmacy (PharmD) or Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy degree
* Licensed pharmacist in country/state of residence
* Excellent project management and interpersonal skills
* Strong English oral and written communication skills
* Proficient in Microsoft suite of programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, OneNote)
* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience

**What makes you stand out?**

* Adaptable communicator, facilitator, influencer and problem solver
* High attention to detail
* Good relationship skills, Proven ability to work on own initiative as well as in a team
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize time effectively
* Masters in Business Administration (MBA)
* Pharmacy benefit management (PBM) or managed health care experience
* Understanding of the US healthcare industry, including pharmacy claim payment systems

**Why join our team?**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

* Monitor customer feedback and proactively address client concerns.
* Support the Store Manager in improving CSAT, NPS, customer retention, and repeat business.

**4. Team Management & Development**

* Support the Store Manager in leading, motivating, and developing the store team.
* Conduct regular floor huddles, product briefings, and sales discussions.
* Coach team members on product knowledge, selling skills, client engagement, and luxury service standards.
* Track individual performance and provide regular feedback to team members.
* Identify performance gaps and work with team members to improve productivity.
* Ensure 100% completion of mandatory product, process, and service training.
* Foster a high-energy, collaborative, client-first, and performance-driven culture.
* Lead by example in professionalism, grooming, punctuality, client engagement, and sales behaviour.

**5. CRM & Client Data Discipline**

* Ensure the team maintains accurate and updated client information.
* Drive disciplined usage of CRM systems and ensure all client interactions are recorded appropriately.
* Monitor lead follow-ups, client appointments, trials, and pending opportunities.
* Ensure timely updating of customer interactions and sales pipeline information.
* Work with the CRM and Marketing teams to execute client engagement campaigns.
* Identify opportunities for reactivation of dormant clients and engagement of high-value customers.

**6. Visual Merchandising & Brand Standards**

* Ensure the boutique consistently reflects AMARIS's premium visual and brand standards.
* Support the Store Manager in maintaining product presentation, displays, counters, and client areas.
* Ensure adherence to VM guidelines during launches, campaigns, and collection changes.
* Coordinate with the VM and Marketing teams for execution of new campaigns and visual updates.
* Ensure all team members maintain appropriate grooming and professional presentation standards.

**7. Inventory & Operational Controls**

* Support the Store Manager in maintaining accurate inventory and stock movement records.
* Ensure adherence to jewellery handling, stock movement, transfer, and security protocols.
* Support periodic stock audits, inventory verification, and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure proper documentation for billing, deliveries, dispatches, and stock transfers.
* Maintain strict adherence to internal controls, audit requirements, and security protocols.
* Escalate discrepancies, operational issues, or control concerns to the Store Manager and relevant teams promptly.

**8. Reporting & Compliance**

* Maintain accurate daily and periodic store performance reports.
* Track sales, conversion, ATV, UPT, footfall, leads, appointments, and other relevant KPIs.
* Ensure timely submission of reports and store updates to the Store Manager.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, and team discipline.
* Ensure compliance with all AMARIS policies, SOPs, and operational guidelines.
* Support the Store Manager during internal and external audits.

**9. Leadership & Business Support**

* Act as the Store Manager's key support in driving overall store performance.
* Take charge of the boutique in the Store Manager's absence.
* Serve as a role model for sales excellence, customer service, and professional conduct.
* Work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams on store initiatives.
* Proactively identify operational and business improvement opportunities.
* Contribute ideas that improve customer experience, team productivity, and store profitability.

**Requirements**

* Graduate in any discipline; degree/diploma in Fashion, Retail, Luxury Management, Business, or a related field will be preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in luxury retail, premium retail, jewellery, fashion, lifestyle, or related industries.
* Prior experience in a supervisory, senior sales, team lead, or assistant management role will be preferred.
* Strong experience in direct sales and client relationship management.
* Proven ability to engage with HNI and high-value clients.
* Strong understanding of luxury selling and customer experience.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets and drive team performance.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
* Strong leadership and people management abilities.
* Good understanding of CRM practices and customer lifecycle management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an understanding of retail KPIs.
* Excellent attention to detail and operational discipline.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and perform effectively in a fast-paced retail environment.
* Strong grooming and professional presentation appropriate for a luxury retail environment.

**Why Join AMARIS Jewels**

AMARIS is building one of India’s most exciting luxury jewellery brands - loved by Bollywood, trusted by a discerning global clientele, and growing at speed.

With 4 flagship stores already operational and a clear vision to scale to 20 stores in the next 5 years, we are in a defining phase of expansion and looking for people who want to build, not just participate.

At AMARIS, performance, ownership, and creativity are non-negotiable. If you thrive in high-growth environments, take pride in your craft, and want your work to be seen, valued, and rewarded - this is where you accelerate.

**What Sets Us Apart**

description:

Since 2009, ib vogt has commissioned plants with a capacity of almost 2 Gigawatt. We employ over 840 specialists, in all areas of the solar power plant value chain in over 40 countries. **Education & Required Skills & Competencies**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical (preferred)
* Strong knowledge of EHV Transmission Lines, Switchyard execution & project coordinatio
* Expertise in Project Management, Planning & L2/L3 Scheduling

title: Senior Manager - Procurement Change Delivery
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Job Type: Permanent

**Title Senior Manager- Procurement Change Delivery**
**Department**
Global Procurement
  
  
**Location**
India (Gurgaon)

Associate Director - Procurement Operational Performance

Grade 6
  
  
We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
  
  
**About Your Team**
You will be part of our Global Procurement function which has c.130 staff based across the UK, India, Continental Europe, and Asia Pacific, managing $800m of spend across 26 countries.
  
  
The Procurement Operational Performance team is responsible for driving operational excellence across Procurement by leading, supporting and delivering strategic performance objectives through two specialist teams:
  
  

* Procurement Systems & Tooling, responsible for the operation, support, governance and continuous improvement of Procurement technology, ensuring systems remain stable, effective and aligned to business needs.
* Procurement Development, responsible for leading strategic transformation initiatives, managing the Procurement change roadmap and ensuring successful implementation and embedding of change into business-as-usual operations.

Together, these teams enable Procurement to operate efficiently today while building the capabilities required for the future.
  
  
**About Your Role**
As the Senior Manager for Procurement Change Delivery, you will be responsible for managing change and delivering key projects across Global Procurement.
  
  
The role will require an understanding of end-to-end Procurement functions and processes, Procurement systems and tools, experience in change and project management, and a proven track record in successfully deploying and embedding new and enhanced processes and technology to achieve defined benefits and outcomes.
  
  
Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Manage a portfolio of change initiatives across Procurement throughout the Change Lifecycle

+ Lead, manage, develop and support the Procurement Change Delivery - Assistant Manager

+ Lead the identification and management of project risks and problems, determine solution options and gain consensus from relevant decision makers on action plans
+ Lead the development and execution of effective stakeholder management and communication throughout the project lifecycle
+ Lead the execution of Change Impact assessments and ensure that robust and effective business readiness plans are in place and executed
+ Represent projects at various governance forums within Procurement and across the broader FIL organisation
+ Own, maintain and enhance Procurement Change Management tools developed using PowerApps, PowerBI and Power Automate

**About You**
You are a collaborative individual with a positive can-do attitude. You can work independently and as part of a team, with proven organisation skills and an ability to multitask by managing projects and activities concurrently.
  
  
You’ll bring;
  
  

* MBA/BBA and/or B-Tech Graduate
* 8+ years of experience in the Procurement domain with a good knowledge of Procurement related processes and functions that may include Sourcing, Supplier Management, Contract Management, Purchase to Pay, Third Party risk management, Due diligence, Supplier onboarding
* 8+ years of experience in delivering Change
* Knowledge of Procurement technology solutions e.g. ProcessUnity, Oracle Fusion, Contract Management systems
* Experience in developing solutions using MS Power Apps/Automate/BI
* Strong track record of delivering positive business outcomes through process and technology enhancements
* Awareness of risk management concepts and processes, ideally in FS or other regulated industry
* Stakeholder Management - Ability to work in a global environment with people across the globe in different time zones and with different cultures
* Ability to collate & challenge requirements gathering, and be able to effectively communicate how requirements will be accommodated in future process or technical solutions
* Ability to positively challenge stakeholders when necessary, and to identify alternative solutions when needed
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to communicate complex issues simply.
* Technical mindset, and a natural interest in and aptitude for learning about new tools and systems
* Willingness to learn, and evidence of building and applying knowledge
* Strong understanding of change management practices including governance, project management, planning, communications etc
* Experience in process mapping and analysis

**Feel rewarded**
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. title: Delivery Manager
description:
**About dunnhumby**
dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.
  
  
**Technology & Engineering**
dunnhumby’s Technology and Engineering team builds the platforms, pipelines and systems that make customer data science possible at scale. From the data infrastructure that ingests billions of transactions to the APIs and cloud architecture that power our products, we engineer reliable, high-performance software trusted by the world’s leading retailers and brands.
  
  
**About the Role**
We're looking for an experienced Delivery Manager to lead delivery across a portfolio of technology teams and strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for driving predictable delivery, operational excellence, and governance across multiple teams while partnering with senior leaders to ensure successful business outcomes. You'll play a key role in developing delivery capability and continuously improving how we plan, deliver, and scale technology solutions.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
You'll help shape and lead delivery across multiple teams, ensuring that technology initiatives are delivered effectively while balancing priorities, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
  
  

* Own delivery performance across a portfolio of teams and strategic initiatives, driving alignment to quarterly and annual commitments.
* Establish and evolve delivery governance, planning standards, forecasting processes, and delivery best practices.
* Proactively manage portfolio risks, issues, and dependencies, ensuring effective mitigation and informed decision-making.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to provide clear delivery insights, lead governance reviews, and support strategic prioritisation.
* Coach and develop Delivery Leads and Scrum Masters while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

**What We're Looking For**
You'll bring strong delivery leadership experience, a collaborative approach, and the ability to influence outcomes across complex technology environments.
  
  

* Experience leading delivery across multiple agile teams, programmes, or value streams within Product and Engineering-led organisations.
* People leadership capability, including coaching and developing Delivery Leads, Scrum Masters, or similar delivery professionals.
* Strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and modern delivery practices, with a focus on continuous improvement and predictable delivery.
* Proven ability to manage complex dependencies, risks, and stakeholder relationships while navigating competing priorities.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage senior stakeholders and drive decision-making.
* Experience delivering projects or programmes within the consumer retail domain.
* Familiarity with delivery analytics and forecasting tools such as Plandek, Jira Align, or similar platforms.
* Experience establishing delivery governance frameworks and operating models.
* Relevant Agile or delivery certifications, such as Scrum, AgilePM, PMP, or equivalent.

**What You Can Expect From Us**
We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.
  
  
And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.
  
  
**India Benefits**

* Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and dependents, including dental and vision cover, with optional top-up plans available.
* Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover, with coverage based on employee grade.
* Retirement benefits including Provident Fund, Gratuity and optional National Pension Scheme participation.
* Employee Assistance Programme, Indian Health Organisation membership and access to wellbeing resources through the dh Wellness Hub.
* Office commute support, internet allowance, Talent Scout referral programme, long service awards and additional family support benefits.
* 25 days annual leave plus public holidays, enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off on your birthday.

**Our approach to Flexible Working**
At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.
  
  
We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

**Delivery Manager**
to manage and scale
**International CPI campaigns**
across mobile advertising and affiliate marketing channels.

title: Manager, TPA
description:

As an associate on the GSSO team, you'll be at the forefront of the ongoing transformation of Gartner's sales and services teams, which drive approximately $5.3B in Contract Value (CV). *.*

title: ITSM Manager
description:
IT helpdesk Leader, managing helpdesk for
  
  
IT Helpdesk Team Manager to lead day-to-day helpdesk delivery supporting Unifi’s digital workplace. The role will oversee a 24×7 L1 service desk, coordinate with L2/L3 resolver teams, and ensure responsive support across phone, email and the ServiceNow portal.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Service delivery and operational ownership

Knowledge, transition and continuous improvement
  
  

* Maintain SOPs, FAQs and knowledge articles, using ticket analysis and recurring issue themes to improve resolution quality and reduce repeat demand.
* Support transition readiness through knowledge capture, SME engagement, UAT, pilot execution and controlled parallel operations.

title: District Manager, North & East India
description:
At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether you’re welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. At Crocs, Inc. you’re not expected to fit a mold. You’re encouraged to break it and create something better.
  
  
**Overview**
The
**District Manager, North + East India**
for Crocs is responsible for leading end-to-end operational execution across Retail DTC and Wholesale Partner Monobrand stores in the assigned geography, reporting to the National Retail Operations Manager (skip level: Commercial Director). The role drives regional business delivery, store and partner operating standards, inventory productivity, replenishment effectiveness, talent hiring and capability, and network expansion readiness, partnering closely with Commercial, Product, Marketing, Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, Visual Merchandising, Retail, Human Resources, Real Estate, franchisee and wholesale partner teams.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Own sell-out, profitability and operational performance across DTC and Partner Monobrand stores in North + East India, driving achievement of the regional annual operating plan, comp growth and productivity targets through weekly and monthly operating reviews.
* Ensure consistent execution of retail operating standards, SOPs, store visit discipline, performance review completion, DTC audit compliance and VM compliance, building scalable regional processes for operating cadence, governance and action tracking.
* Drive regional inventory productivity through effective stock deployment, replenishment discipline and stock balancing, monitoring WOH, ageing, sell-through, shrinkage and store-level gaps with Planning and Supply Chain.
* Jointly own DTC store expansion, including market mapping, catchment assessment and property scouting with Commercial and Real Estate teams, and ensure new store operational readiness across hiring, training, VM, stock and launch checklists.
* Establish a structured review cadence with franchise, Partner Monobrand and wholesale partners covering sell-out, inventory health, replenishment, store standards and action closure, ensuring adherence to commercial and brand standards.
* Own Store Manager hiring and coordinate end-to-end store team hiring for existing and new DTC stores in partnership with Human Resources, and influence partner staffing quality for Partner Monobrand stores.
* Lead, coach and develop Store Managers and field operations teams, building a performance-oriented culture focused on accountability, execution excellence, succession planning and talent retention.
* Act as the regional operating link across Commercial, Product, Marketing, Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, VM, HR, Real Estate and partners, ensuring timely closure of priorities, escalations and corrective actions with clear, data-led updates.

****What You'll Bring to the Table****

* MBA preferred; Bachelor’s degree in Business, Retail Management, Operations, Supply Chain or a related discipline – or equivalent years of relevant and related experience.
* Minimum 8–12 years of experience in Retail Operations, Wholesale Operations, Franchise Management or Commercial Operations, with multi-state exposure preferred.
* Background knowledge in retail hiring, new store openings and property/site evaluation.
* Strong understanding of retail operations, store P&L, inventory productivity, replenishment processes and partner governance.
* Highly influential across cross-functional stakeholders and external partners, including situations without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multi-location operations and Store Managers, identify business risks early and drive corrective action.
* Ability to attract, select and build strong Store Manager and frontline teams, with strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication and people leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across North + East India, with a field-oriented, process-driven and data-led approach.

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability, or any other protected classification.
  
  
At Crocs, Inc. we believe in the power of a blend of in-person and virtual collaboration to drive creativity and strengthen relationships. Your participation in this flexible schedule plays a key role in building a connected and successful team. In-office requirements vary by our work personas: Resident (5 days), Collaborator (4 days), Connector (2-3 days), Explorer (fully remote). This role has been aligned to the Collaborator persona.

title: Founder's Office - Fulfillment Lead
description:
Every company knows how to generate pipelines. Very few know how to deliver consistently at scale.

At SalesMonk, we're building AI-native GTM systems that help customers turn events and outbound into predictable revenue. As we grow, the biggest challenge isn't shipping more work- it's building the operating system that ensures every customer engagement is executed consistently, efficiently, and repeatedly.

That's where this role comes in.

**Why This Role Exists**

Today, our delivery works because smart people are solving problems every day.

Tomorrow, it needs to work because we've built systems that make great execution repeatable.

We're looking for someone who can build the processes, operating rhythms, and delivery playbooks that allow us to scale without adding operational chaos.

This isn't a project management role, this is a systems-building role.

You'll work directly with the founders to create the delivery engine that supports the next stage of the company.

**What You Will Own**

**Build the Delivery Operating System**

Design how delivery should work- from customer kickoff to successful execution.

Build repeatable workflows, SOPs, templates, governance, and playbooks that reduce dependency on tribal knowledge.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

Own delivery health across all customer engagements.

Identify bottlenecks, eliminate operational friction, and continuously improve execution quality.

Ensure delivery standards remain high as the team scales.

**Cross-functional Execution**

Work closely with Product, GTM Engineers, Customer Success, and the founders to ensure priorities move quickly.

Bring structure, accountability, and visibility across teams.

**Process & Automation**

Identify manual workflows that should be standardized or automated.

Help build scalable systems that improve speed, quality, and consistency.

**Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

Define what great delivery looks like.

Build dashboards and operating metrics around delivery quality, turnaround time, customer outcomes, and execution efficiency.

Use data to continuously improve the way we operate.

**What We're Looking For**

* MBA from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school.
* 3-4 years of post-MBA experience in Management Consulting, Strategy, Business Transformation, or Operations Consulting.
* Experience designing operating models, improving business processes, or leading transformation initiatives.
* Strong structured problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Comfortable working in ambiguity and creating structure from scratch.
* High ownership with a bias towards execution.

**Brownie Points**

* Experience in a B2B SaaS or AI startup.
* Exposure to customer delivery, implementation, or GTM operations.
* Experience building operational dashboards and business metrics.
* Familiarity with Notion, ClickUp, Jira, Linear, Airtable, or similar tools.
* Experience driving automation using AI or no-code workflows.

**Why This Seat**

You'll build the operating backbone of an AI-native GTM company.

Instead of maintaining existing processes, you'll design them.

You'll work directly with the founders, influence how the company scales, and solve problems that don't have predefined answers.

If you enjoy building systems, simplifying complexity, and creating leverage across teams, you'll have an outsized impact here.

title: TRC Supervisor
description:
**Company Description**
JNS INSTRUMENTS LIMITED is a manufacturing and industrial company based in the GT Karnal Road Industrial Area in Delhi, India. student experiences and making a meaningful impact through research, innovation and engagement.

At RMIT, leadership is a shared responsibility demonstrated by all staff. It is grounded in RMIT’s six core

values and reflected through the Be–Know–Do Leadership Model:

 Be: Open, authentic, inclusive, empowering and purpose-driven.

 Know: Self-aware and informed about stakeholders, the sector and priorities.

South Asia teams. The role ensures that operations are efficient, compliant, consistent and aligned with

RMIT’s strategic priorities and student-centred approach.

Working with Melbourne-based functional leaders across Admissions, Recruitment, Sales and Conversion,

capability, process governance, performance, risk, compliance and continuous improvement across the

teams.

Functional ownership of Admissions, Recruitment and Conversion remains with the relevant Melbourne-

based functional leader. The Senior Manager, Operations ensures that these priorities are translated into

coordinated, compliant and effective local execution across South Asia.

Conversion.

and operating rhythms.

dependencies, risks and escalations.

 Provide local operational insight to support planning, resourcing, decision-making and student-

centred service delivery.

 Build effective relationships with functional leaders, corporate teams, agents, partners and other

stakeholders.

2. Process governance, risk and compliance

 Translate global requirements into practical local procedures, controls and operating guidance.

 Drive adherence to RMIT policies, approved systems, delegations, workflows, turnaround times,

quality standards and service levels.

 Maintain clear documentation, role responsibilities, approval pathways, escalation arrangements

and audit trails.

 Identify and reduce process deviations, duplication, rework, inconsistency, unclear ownership and

compliance risks.

 Maintain risk and issue registers, coordinate corrective and preventative actions, and support

audits and compliance reviews.

3. People leadership and capability

 Lead, support and develop South Asia Team Leads and staff in partnership with Melbourne-based

functional leaders.

 Set clear expectations for performance, conduct, accountability, priorities and service delivery.

 Monitor team productivity, capacity, workload distribution and effectiveness.

 Support workforce planning, resource allocation, training, succession planning and professional

development.

 Build an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing culture aligned with RMIT’s Be–Know–Do

Leadership Model.
