 Establish and monitor measures for productivity, quality, compliance, service levels, turnaround

times, backlogs and capacity.

 Use data and stakeholder feedback to identify trends, resolve root causes and improve operational

outcomes.

 Lead process reviews and approved changes to systems, policies, processes and operating models.

 Ensure changes are communicated, implemented and embedded effectively.

 Promote continuous improvement that strengthens efficiency, compliance, service quality and

student outcomes.

in education, admissions, student services, international recruitment or another compliance-driven

environment.

 Experience leading high-volume, process-intensive operations and managing teams across multiple

functions, locations or markets.

 Experience translating global or organisational processes into practical local procedures and

operating models.

 Experience with governance, risk, compliance, audit, quality assurance or internal control

frameworks.

 Experience using performance data to improve productivity, quality and service outcomes.

 Experience working with senior stakeholders in a global, matrixed or geographically dispersed

environment.

 Experience in international education, student services, process improvement, systems

implementation or organisational change is desirable.

 Ability to lead change and embed consistent ways of working.

 Integrity, accountability, sound judgement and attention to detail.

 Commitment to RMIT’s values, student-centred approach and Be–Know–Do Leadership Model.

Immediate, however any notice period for the right candidate will be honored.

title: Network Operations Manager
description:
**Why Mobility Global?**
At Mobility Global, our mission is to provide the trusted information that helps billions of people build, sell, and own vehicles with confidence. As we shape the next generation of automotive intelligence through innovation, AI, and industry-leading data, we're creating new opportunities for our customers, our business, and our people.
  
  
Join a team singularly focused on transforming the automotive industry. S&P Global Mobility is Mobility Global — the company behind CARFAX, automotiveMastermind, Market Scan, and Polk Automotive Solutions. Our strength comes from our people, and here, the progress you make helps the entire automotive ecosystem move faster and with greater confidence.
  
  
**The Role**
The Network Operations Manager leads the operational core of the network organization, reporting to the Head of Network. This role spans two primary areas: managing network business functions and driving daily network operations to maintain a high-availability 24/7 environment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Maintains consolidated lifecycle documentation, asset records, and cost reporting.
* Ensures end-to-end accuracy of network asset and service records, from CMDB to circuit inventory.
* Runs the daily operational cadence—including huddles, alarm triage, outage tracking, and change facilitation—to maintain environment stability.
* Oversees firmware maintenance and ensures high availability across a distributed network infrastructure.

**Network Business Functions**

* Lifecycle Management: Oversee network assets and services from acquisition through refresh and retirement.
* Financial Administration: Consolidate team budget records into a single version-controlled document, track spend, and report rollups to the Head of Network.
* CMDB & Compliance: Keep asset and service records accurate, integrated, and audit-ready.
* Circuit & Carrier Operations: Manage inventory, orders, disconnects, and billing accuracy.
* Vendor & Purchasing Strategy: Partner with peer managers on purchasing, support renewals, and remote-hands vendor relationships.

**Network Operations**

* Operational Leadership: Lead the team in triaging daily alarms, running morning operational huddles, and managing out-of-band management networks.
* Observability & Tooling: Administer network intelligence and monitoring platforms (e.g., Kentik, LogicMonitor, NodePing, Forward Networks).
* Incident & Change Management: Facilitate major changes, log activities, track outages, and supply engineers with operational data to speed recovery.
* Global Coverage: Maintain a follow-the-sun operational model, delivering daily hand-off reports and extending triage coverage across time zones.

**Team Leadership**

* Support and guide a distributed team across Canada, the US, and India, including internal staff, contracted engineers, and remote-hands providers.
* Set clear priorities, support team performance, and coordinate seamless coverage across time zones.

**Required Skills**
**What We're Looking For:**

* Operational Leadership: Experience leading or coordinating 24/7 critical network operations, including monitoring, alarm triage, and incident response. 3+ years of experience.
* Team Leadership: Experience managing or supporting distributed technical teams across multiple time zones. 3+ years of experience.
* Business & Asset Operations: Familiarity with network asset lifecycles, CMDB/ITSM workflows, and circuit/carrier management. 3+ years of experience.
* Financial & Spend Validation: Experience reviewing vendor invoices, tracking spend, or managing functional budget documentation. 3+ years of experience.
* Tooling Familiarity: Working knowledge of network monitoring and observability platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Vendor & Partner Management: Experience working with contracted engineers, managed service providers, or remote-handed vendors.
* Experience with Kentik, LogicMonitor, or Forward Networks.
* Transformation Context: Exposure to standing up processes in a transformation, carve-out, or TSA-exit environment.
* Technical Depth: Network engineering understanding (such as CCNA-level concepts) to effectively partner with engineering teams.
* Automation & Modernization: Interest or experience in network scripting, ITIL frameworks, or integrating automation/AI into operational workflows.

*This is a hybrid role with in-office expectations determined by location and subject to change based on evolving business needs.*

title: Chief Manager - O&M Commissioning
description:
****Position Title****
Chief Manager - O&M Commissioning
  
  
****Position Summary****
The Chief Manager - O&M Commissioning is responsible for ensuring reliable operation, maintenance, testing, commissioning support, protection system performance, and grid compliance for EHV/UHV substations across Resonia assets. The role provides centralized technical leadership for protection, control, automation, SCADA/SAS systems, disturbance analysis, relay coordination, asset reliability improvement, and implementation of best-in-class protection engineering practices across operational and project sites in India.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities**

* Lead operation, maintenance, testing and commissioning support of protection, control and automation systems for 220kV, 400kV and 765kV substations.
* Ensure reliability and performance of numerical relays, protection panels, CTs, PTs, CVTs, DC systems, battery banks and associated protection equipment.
* Conduct disturbance analysis, fault investigations, RCA preparation and timely restoration support following grid events and protection system operations.
* Review and validate relay settings, protection coordination studies, fault level studies and compliance with CEA, CERC, Grid Code and utility standards.
* Drive testing and commissioning best practices including scheme checks, secondary injection testing, primary injection testing and end-to-end protection validation.
* Monitor and ensure optimum performance of IEC 61850 based Substation Automation Systems, SCADA, RTU, Gateway and communication infrastructure.
* Support outage planning, shutdown management, resource mobilization, risk mitigation and asset reliability improvement initiatives.
* Develop technical capability of site teams and ensure adherence to safety, quality and operational excellence standards.

****Critical Success Factors - Essential****

* Expertise in protection relays, automation systems and protection schemes
* Hands-on experience with Omicron, CPC-100, CT Analyzer, FREJA, Megger or equivalent testing platforms
* Strong knowledge of CEA Regulations, Grid Codes, IEC/IEEE standards and electrical safety practices

****Critical Success Factors - Desirable****

* Experience with 132kV, 220kV, 400kV and 765kV AIS/GIS substations
* IEC 61850 engineering and digital substation implementation experience
* Exposure to predictive maintenance, digital asset management and analytics tools

**About Us**
Resonia is one of India's leading developers of power transmission infrastructure, building and operating the grid assets that move electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed most. Operating in one of the world's largest greenfield transmission markets, Resonia has established a proven end-to-end model — developing critical assets across India's most complex geographies, then monetising them through a disciplined capital recycling strategy. To date, the company has monetised assets worth over US$1 billion, and sponsored IndiGrid, India's first power transmission InvIT, which attracted marquee global investors including KKR and GIC.
  
  
Resonia offers a rare combination: world-class execution capability, a demonstrated monetization track record, and a front-row position in India's accelerating energy transition.
  
  

* Integrity & Ethics
* Respect
* Innovation
* Speed

title: Assistant Manager - Customer Experience
description:
**Customer Experience Team**
The Customer Experience team plays a critical role in ensuring the successful adoption and ongoing performance of GreyOrange’s warehouse automation solutions. Acting as the primary bridge between customers and internal teams, the CEM function drives solution optimization, handles operational escalations, ensures SLA adherence, and delivers a seamless post-go-live experience. The team focuses on maximizing customer satisfaction, system uptime, and business value through proactive support, data-driven insights, and continuous engagement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Engagement & Communication**

* Manage day-to-day customer interactions, ensuring clear and consistent communication across all touchpoints
* Handle escalations promptly and professionally, ensuring quick issue resolution and customer satisfaction
* Conduct periodic business reviews (MBR, QBR, EBR) and ensure stakeholder alignment
* Lead daily and weekly performance reviews with high-level stakeholders. Assist and ensure success of monthly and quarterly business reviews.
* Act as the lead coordinator to address customers prioritized hot topics
* Own crisis coordination for any severity-1 incident within your personal account portfolio, escalating only for true exceptions

**Solution Performance & Optimization**

* Understand solution configurations and optimize them for operational and technical performance
* Support planning for peak periods, including volume forecasting, resource planning, and system readiness
* Track and report system performance metrics (hardware/software uptime, throughput, order accuracy)
* Own performance governance for a personal portfolio of 4-6 complex, high-stakes accounts (multi-site, high 24/7-criticality, or highly technical configurations), often including a peak-critical account
* Coordinate peak readiness and cross-functional escalations across more than one account, supporting peer Customer Experience Managers when needed

**Data & Reporting**

* Use basic SQL and tools like Grafana and Power BI to analyze performance data and generate insights
* Monitor dashboards for real-time system visibility and performance tracking
* Own operational reporting and performance metric updates for internal and external stakeholders
* Maintain a Customer Happiness Index (CHI) score above 7 across your personal account book, or maintain a credible, documented improvement plan where it is not

**Customer Success & Process Improvement**

* Drive customer success metrics such as CSAT, NPS, and AMC renewals
* Identify and implement initiatives to improve customer onboarding, adoption, and satisfaction
* Document lessons learned, best practices, and enablement content for continuous improvement
* Contribute at least one improvement per year to a shared template or playbook (e.g., Joint Success Plan, Path to Green, onboarding playbook) used by the wider Customer Experience team

**Collaboration & Upgrades**

* Work closely with Product, Solution Architecture, Support, and Program Management to deliver software enhancements and new features
* Plan and coordinate system upgrades, patch deployments, and feature rollouts
* Align with customers on change requests, scope, and delivery timelines.
* Engage CloudOps, SRE, and QA teams credibly on complex technical detail for high-stakes, multi-site accounts

**Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Serve as an informal quality reviewer and sounding board for peers’ Joint Success Plans (JSPs), Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), and health-check decks — leading through expertise, not formal authority
* Provide coaching and informal mentorship to junior Customer Experience Managers (CEM I/II) across the team

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Adherence to Software & Hardware uptime greater than 98%
* Ensuring higher MTBF and lower MTTR
* Operational KPIs such as order fulfilment speed & accuracy greater than 99% and Inventory Management
* SLA-based issue resolution and escalation turnaround
* Customer satisfaction and NPS scores
* AMC renewal rate and service utilization
* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting and dashboard updates
* Customer Happiness Index (CHI) score greater than 7 across personal account portfolio
* At least one shared template or playbook improvement contributed per year
* Successful coordination of peak readiness across personal portfolio and at least one peer account

**Required Qualifications**

* A proven track record managing enterprise-level clients with high-stakes, 24/7 operational requirements, or deep warehouse-operations management experience
* 5-7 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Facing roles, Consulting, Technical Project Management, Solutions Design, Warehouse Operations or Account Management within the SaaS, Robotics, or Industrial Automation sectors
* Proficiency in data visualization tools to turn raw logs into executive-level performance stories
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), database management, and API-driven integrations.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Familiarity with SQL and analytics platforms (e.g., Grafana, Power BI)
* Understanding of customer success metrics: CSAT, NPS, renewals
* Experience in warehouse automation, robotics, or supply chain preferred
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
* Strong project management skills to manage multiple cross functional initiatives in parallel
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, or informally lead junior colleagues; experience managing 2-3 direct reports is a plus.
* A valid US visa with the ability to travel for US customer engagements is preferred and highly advantageous.

Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.

title: Manager, Technical Services
description:
At MongoDB, we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing applications that people use every day. We are a leading developer data platform, helping organizations build, scale, and operate modern applications.
  
  
MongoDB Technical Services partners with customers to help them successfully run MongoDB in production. Our globally distributed organization provides 24x7x365 support through a follow-the-sun model, combining deep technical expertise with a strong commitment to customer outcomes.
  
  
We are looking for a Manager, Technical Services to lead and grow a team in Gurugram. This leader will manage engineers supporting customers across MongoDB’s database, cloud, and emerging application-platform capabilities. The role is well suited to a people leader who can build a high-performing, inclusive team; lead complex customer situations; and partner effectively with Engineering, Product, and go-to-market teams.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
The role
  
  
As a Manager, Technical Services, you will lead a team of highly skilled support engineers. You will create the conditions for excellent customer outcomes, develop technical and people leadership capability within the team, and help scale the support model for evolving customer workloads.
  
  
Your team will support a broad range of technologies, including MongoDB database and cloud services, distributed applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, observability, and modern AI-enabled application workflows. You will help establish durable operating practices for a fast-growing area while ensuring seamless collaboration with the wider global Technical Services organization.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Services Engineers, including regular 1:1s, clear goals, performance feedback, career development, and succession planning
* Build an inclusive, accountable, and customer-focused team culture where engineers can do their best work
* Own regional service delivery for your team, balancing customer experience, case health, quality, operational discipline, and team sustainability
* Lead and coordinate high-impact customer escalations, ensuring timely communication, sound technical judgment, clear ownership, and effective follow-through
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, Customer Success, Sales, and other Technical Services teams to resolve complex issues and bring customer feedback into product and process improvements
* Work with global peers to maintain consistent follow-the-sun processes, effective handoffs, and high-quality support across regions
* Help scale support for modern application workloads involving APIs, cloud services, distributed systems, containers, observability, data services, and AI-enabled application workflows, including agent orchestration, model and tool integrations, MCP, retrieval, memory, and production reliability considerations
* Establish and improve team operating mechanisms, including incident management, case reviews, root-cause analysis, knowledge management, quality practices, and capacity planning
* Identify recurring customer issues and drive improvements to self-service content, diagnostic tooling, runbooks, and support processes
* Participate in hiring and onboarding, and build a strong local talent pipeline
* Use operational metrics and customer feedback to identify trends, communicate performance, and prioritize improvements
* Contribute to regional and global Technical Services initiatives that improve the customer experience, operational efficiency, and technical capability of the organization

What you’ll bring
  
  
**Required**

* 3+ years of experience leading a technical support, customer engineering, site reliability, operations, or similar customer-facing technical team
* Demonstrated success developing people, managing performance, hiring strong talent, and building inclusive, high-performing teams
* Experience coordinating complex or high-severity customer escalations and working effectively with Engineering and Product organizations
* Strong technical foundation in troubleshooting production systems, with the ability to guide structured investigations across application, infrastructure, network, identity, and data layers
* Experience with one or more of cloud platforms, distributed systems, databases, containerized workloads, APIs, observability, or enterprise software
* Foundational knowledge of AI-enabled applications and agentic workflows, with the ability to assess technical judgment in areas such as agents, model-provider integrations, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval and memory, orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows
* Strong customer advocacy and sound judgment under pressure, with the ability to set expectations and drive issues to resolution
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for technical, business, and executive audiences
* Experience translating organizational objectives into clear team priorities, measurable outcomes, and individual goals
* A collaborative, pragmatic leadership style and the ability to operate effectively across global, cross-functional teams

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting MongoDB, MongoDB Atlas, or another database or distributed data platform
* Experience with cloud-native technologies, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker; Kubernetes; networking; identity and access management; or CI/CD systems
* Familiarity with logs, metrics, traces, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis
* Experience supporting developer platforms, platform services, or AI-enabled applications
* Experience using operational metrics, dashboards, or scorecards to improve support performance and customer outcomes

Success in the role
  
  
Within 30 days
  
  

* Complete MongoDB onboarding and build rapport with the team and key partners
* Develop a working understanding of the Technical Services operating model, customer support processes, and product portfolio
* Establish a regular 1:1 cadence and begin assessing team strengths, development opportunities, and operational priorities

Within 60 days
  
  

* Build productive relationships with peer managers and stakeholders in Engineering, Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Escalation Management
* Understand regional and global follow-the-sun workflows, escalation processes, and the team’s current performance measures
* Begin contributing to regional escalations, case reviews, and team operating rhythms

Within 90 days
  
  

* Own the day-to-day leadership of the team, including development planning, performance management, and delivery oversight
* Identify opportunities to improve team efficiency, knowledge sharing, customer experience, or technical readiness
* Define a practical plan for scaling the team’s capability and operational maturity over the following 6–12 months

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Head of Operations, Voice of India
description:
**Head of Operations, Voice of India**

**Josh Talks · Voice of India · Full-time · Gurgaon**

**About Josh Talks**

Josh Talks helps enterprises, governments and not-for-profits make better decisions about which AI services to buy and deploy, through independent, human-powered evaluation. Voice of India, its evaluation platform, sits at the centre of this work.

Josh Talks began as one of India's largest regional-language storytelling platforms, and the reach it built over a decade now underpins its work in AI.

**About Voice of India**

Voice of India is India's first human-powered multimodal evaluation platform, built by Josh Talks and co-developed with IIT Madras. It measures how well AI models work for the people of India, in their own languages and on the tasks they care about.

Our founding principle is that AI should be judged by people, not by other AI systems. Every ranking is backed by independent human evaluation, a published methodology and transparent evidence, rather than vendor claims or automated judges.

Live leaderboards today cover speech to text, text to speech, speech to speech and text to image, across 15 Indian languages. Leaderboards for language models, translation, legal tasks, document OCR, video and AI agents are in development. What sets the platform apart:

* **Independent human judgment.**

  Evaluations are carried out by people under blind conditions. Model names remain hidden until a judgment is recorded, the order of answers is randomised, and no vendor evaluates its own model.
* **Built for procurement.**

  Results are designed to inform procurement and deployment decisions. Scores are broken down by language, domain, geography and use case.
* **Academically rigorous.**

  Every benchmark follows a published protocol with sound statistics and reproducible experiments.
* **Built from how India speaks.**

  The speech to text benchmark uses 536 hours of unscripted telephone conversations from 36,691 speakers across 139 regional clusters. Its test set is closed, so models cannot be trained on it.
* **Sovereign and global models side by side.**

  Indian and global, open-source and proprietary models are ranked on the same boards.

**Milestones so far**

Since its launch, Voice of India has established itself as an independent reference for AI evaluation in India:

* **Government engagement at launch.**

  Launched in New Delhi on 4 August 2026. Shri S. Krishnan, Secretary, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, attended the launch.
* **Financial regulators in attendance.**

  Representatives of the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH) and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) attended the launch.
* **Peer-reviewed research.**

  The speech to text benchmark is described in a paper accepted at Interspeech 2026.
* **Trusted by model providers.**

  Global and Indian model providers submit their models to Voice of India for evaluation and re-evaluation.

Press coverage:
Business Standard, 4 August 2026

**About the role**

Josh Talks is hiring a Head of Operations to own Voice of India end to end. You will decide what Voice of India evaluates, run every evaluation from methodology to publication, make each release widely cited, and build the engine that keeps it rigorous and low-cost to run.

The pace is the defining feature of this role. Voice of India aims to publish a new evaluation almost every week, and to be the first in the world to put numbers on every major new model for India. You will set that cadence and hold it.

This role requires a high agency person who is hands on and not afraid to get their hands dirty. You will work directly with the founders of Josh Talks, our research and engineering teams, and the leads for enterprise partnerships and policy, and you will be accountable for what Voice of India publishes and its influence on AI deployment in the country.

**How we work**

This is a senior role by title, but it does not sit above the work. Our founder is deeply hands-on and involved in every detail of the company, from the wording of a methodology to the timing of a release, and expects the same of you.

* **Know every moving part.**

  You will understand how every evaluation works, from the data and the raters to the leaderboard, and know every word of every methodology document.
* **Own every evaluation.**

  Every evaluation Voice of India publishes is either written by you or thoroughly reviewed by you before it goes out.
* **Stay close to the detail.**

  You will work side by side with the founder on the details that decide whether a release is credible, rather than managing from a distance.

**How this role is measured**

We believe the companies that matter in AI right now will be the ones that move fastest without losing rigour. Speed is therefore the primary measure of this role:

* **Speed of releases.**

  How quickly you ship new evaluations and put numbers on every major new model.
* **Speed of partnerships.**

  How quickly you turn conversations with labs, enterprises and government into working partnerships.
* **Speed of impact.**

  How quickly Voice of India's evaluations come to shape how AI is deployed in India.

If you would rather read the methodology than a summary of it, if a late release keeps you up at night, and if you want to work with a founder who cares about every detail as much as you do, you will feel at home here. If you are looking for a role where you manage from a distance, this is not it.

**In this role, you will**
**Ship a new evaluation almost every week**

* **Decide what to evaluate.**

  Choose the models, tasks, languages and use cases that matter most, and own the evaluation calendar.
* **Design the methodology.**

  Work with our research team to define the protocol, test sets, rater instructions and statistics for each evaluation.
* **Run production.**

  Coordinate raters, vendors, data and engineering so each evaluation is delivered on time and to standard.
* **Publish.**

  Release results, leaderboards and methodology notes that stand up to scrutiny.

**Be first in the world to put numbers on every major new model**

* **Track every major release.**

  Follow new models from global and Indian labs as they launch.
* **Keep evaluations ready to run.**

  Maintain the pipelines, test sets and rater capacity needed to evaluate a new model within days of its release.
* **Publish first.**

  Make Voice of India the first credible source of results for how each major model performs in Indian languages and conditions.

**Make every release widely cited**

* **Plan each release.**

  Give every evaluation a clear headline finding and a release plan, working with our communications team.
* **Reach the people who matter.**

  Ensure labs, researchers and the press see, discuss and cite each release.
* **Build credibility quickly.**

  Respond to questions on methodology openly, establish collaborations across industry and government and publish corrections where needed.

**Get Voice of India adopted by enterprises and government**

* **Make scores part of AI decisions.**

  Work with our Lead - AI Partnerships, India and our VP, Policy Programs & Partnerships so that a Voice of India score becomes part of how Indian enterprises and government choose AI.
* **Shape evaluations around real decisions.**

  Turn what enterprises and government need to know into evaluations Voice of India can deliver.

**Build a low-cost, rigorous evaluation engine**

* **Raters.**

  Build and manage a reliable network of human raters across Indian languages, with clear quality controls.
* **Vendors.**

  Select and manage data, annotation and technology vendors, and get quality work from people you do not fully control.
* **Tooling.**

  Work with engineering to build the tools that make each evaluation faster and cheaper to run.
* **Cost and quality.**

  Track the cost and quality of every evaluation, and reduce cost without losing rigour.

**What success looks like**

We expect the following milestones, which we will refine together in your first month:

* **First 90 days.**

  Own the evaluation calendar, ship 6 evaluations at a regular cadence, and map the raters, vendors and tooling behind each one, with a clear view of its cost.
* **Six months.**

  A new evaluation published almost every week, major new models evaluated within days of release, and a lower cost per evaluation with no loss of rigour.
* **Twelve months.**

  Voice of India regularly cited by labs, researchers and the press, its scores used in enterprise and government AI decisions, and a repeatable engine that runs at low cost.

**Who we are looking for**

* **A builder's track record.**

  A past founder or early operator who shipped something every week.
* **Technical rigour.**

  Semi-technical and rigorous enough to defend a methodology to a researcher at a frontier AI lab.
* **Senior credibility.**

  Credible in conversation with a bank CTO or a ministry official.
* **Ownership.**

  You treat Voice of India as your own, and you hold a weekly cadence without cutting corners.
* **Communication.**

  Excellent writing, and the judgment to turn evaluation results into findings people cite.
* **Quality through others.**

  Experience getting quality work out of freelancers, vendors or contractors you did not fully control.

Experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, research operations or Indian-language AI is an advantage, but not required.

**Why join**

* **Own a national benchmark.**

  Run the platform that shows how AI performs for the people of India.
* **Work at the frontier.**

  Evaluate new models from the world's leading labs as they launch.
* **Shape how India chooses AI.**

  See your work used by enterprises, government and researchers.
* **Build from the ground up.**

  Define how Voice of India operates, its team and its standards.

**Working setup and assessment**

The role reports to the founder and CEO of Josh Talks and works closely with research, engineering, partnerships, policy and communications. It is a full-time position based in Gurgaon.

Assessment will cover something you shipped on a weekly cadence and a tight budget, how you managed people you did not fully control, and a short case exercise on designing and publishing an evaluation of a newly released model within one week.

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a short note to amritansh@voiceofindia.ai. Tell us about something you shipped every week on a tight budget, and what it achieved.

title: Associate Manager - Drone Ecosystem
description:
**About QCI**

The Quality Council of India (QCI) is the Scheme Owner of the Certification Scheme for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (CSUAS), which was notified in official gazette by the Ministry of Civil Aviation on 26 January 2022. The scheme has since been revised and its scope enhanced, evolving into a Type based certification framework that covers Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) and Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) UAS operations, and it also promotes the indigenisation and development of the domestic drone industry, contributing to the vision of India becoming a global drone hub by 2030.

**Role Summary**

As part of the team, you contribute to the development and operation of a national certification framework for UAS. Our work spans into designing and developing certification schemes aligned with international best practice, formulating technical standards, and creating certification ecosystems in partnership with industry, regulators, ministries, academia and other stakeholders, scale them through conformity assessment bodies. Deep understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential.

The next phase of this work is about collaborating with the industry on the segments that still need enabling, namely autonomous drones, Drone-as-a-Service and UAS traffic management, along with the digital transformation that simplifies compliance and the aggregator led facilitation that scales the use-case adaptation to advance the growth of Industry These are areas where the standards, the quality assurance mechanisms and in some cases the market itself are still taking shape, and the people who join us now will help shape the Nation’s Drone Ecosystem.

**Role & Responsibility-**

QCI is seeking professionals to support the implementation of CSUAS. The role will contribute to the development and operation of the CSUAS workstreams below:

* **Scheme Design & Development**
  : Conceptualise UAS related quality interventions that help the industry and the regulator, and develop and revise the scheme criteria, technical standards and guidelines that give them effect with a in-depth understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS.
* **Research, Analysis & Knowledge Products**
  : Conduct rapid primary and secondary research on UAS domain and policy, including comparative study of standards and international best practice to draft standards for UAS and its components.
* **Report Writing & Deck Preparation:**
  Draft and structure reports, concept notes, technical circulars and knowledge products, and create data driven presentations for relevant stakeholders.
* **Scheme Operations**
  : Lead the day to day operations of the scheme and its projects, scheme documentation, deliverables, work plans, trackers and minutes of meetings and report periodically on developments; collect, clean and analyse scheme data and maintain its records, website and dashboard; propose the features and changes required in the dashboard to support operations; monitor scheme-related activities; coordinate with vendors and internal and external stakeholders; and frequently update FAQs.
* **Stakeholder Engagement**
  : Identify key stakeholders, analyse their expectations, and develop and execute appropriate strategies to work with them; manage and regularly engage multiple stakeholders i.e., regulators, Certification Bodies, manufacturers, assessors, technical experts, laboratories and academia to ensure timely information exchange and seamless coordination.
* **Business Development & Marketing of the Scheme**
  : Ensure quantitative improvement in the number of Certification Bodies; identify potential clients and partners for adoption of the scheme; market the scheme to increase its uptake; and develop a comprehensive plan to improve scheme processes and revenue generation.

**Eligibility Criteria & Requirements-**

**Educational Qualification**
:

* A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline is required. A Bachelor’s degree in a related engineering discipline, coupled with strong relevant experience, may also be considered for the Associate Manager role.
* An additional qualification in management, public policy, or conformity assessment ecosystem, or quality and compliance, or training in ISO/IEC 17065, ISO/IEC 17067, or ISO/IEC 17024, or ISO/IEC 17020, or ISO 9001 will be considered a strong added advantage.

**Experience-**

* Minimum 3 years of professional work experience in areas including manufacturing, R&D, operations, consulting (private or government), or testing, auditing or a managerial role specifically in drone industry, or should have experience with stakeholder management, or operating a certification scheme, or national program.
* Knowledge of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential, along with knowledge of the relevant rules and regulations with respect to drones operations in India and type certification.
* Excellent Microsoft Office skills, strong verbal communication, and sound organisational and planning skills, with a proven ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines, are required.
* Experience in marketing of products and creation of knowledge products is desired. Prior experience of working with government agencies, regulators or CABs in any capacity (operations or consulting) will be preferred.
* Working experience in any programming language, or with dashboards and AI tools, would be an added advantage. Exposure to UAS design, manufacturing, testing or flight operations, including VLOS/BVLOS flying experience, will be preferred though not mandatory.
* Fluency in English, both written and oral, is required. Fluency in Hindi, both written and oral, is desired.
* Location for the role is based out of New Delhi, on a full time engagement, with travel anywhere in India or abroad as and when required.

**Technical Capabilities-**

**Strong Research Skills:**
Ability to rapidly identify, read, and understand dense, technical documents (e.g., government reports and research papers) and extract the most relevant information.

**Structured Thinking & Writing:**
Ability to break down large, ambiguous topics into a structured research plan and produce clear, logical, professional, and well-written outputs.

**Data Analysis:**
Comfortable with data cleaning, essential MS Excel functions, and creating charts. Experience analysing survey data using Stata, R, or Python is an added advantage.

**Visualization & Presentation Skills:**
Strong data-visualization skills using MS Office Suite, with Tableau/Power BI proficiency being an added advantage; ability to create well-structured and visually compelling presentations.

**Behavioural Capabilities-**

**High Degree of Curiosity:**
Genuine interest in how India’s public policy and governance systems work; naturally follows current affairs and asks “why.”

**Integrity & Accountability:**
Takes ownership of tasks, delivers on commitments, and upholds the highest ethical standards in all work and workplace interactions.

**Meticulous Attention to Detail:**
Able to identify typos, formatting errors, inconsistencies, and mismatched numbers that others may overlook.

**Proactive & “Get-it-Done” Attitude:**
Self-starter who takes complete ownership of tasks, anticipates what needs to be done, and delivers results without waiting for instructions.

title: Procurement & Costing Manager - Interiors & Turnkey Execution
description:
**Location:**

Delhi NCR

**Company:**

Hub and Oak Interiors

**About Hub and Oak Interiors**

Hub and Oak Interiors is an established commercial interior design and turnkey fit-out company based in Delhi NCR. We specialise in designing and delivering offices and commercial workspaces for startups, corporates and established businesses across Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida and Faridabad. 

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Procurement & Costing Manager to take end-to-end ownership of BOQs, project estimates and cost planning for office interiors and turnkey projects. The role involves working closely with the Interior Design Head, Business Development Manager and Project Manager to ensure proposals are accurately costed, commercially viable and submitted on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **BOQ Preparation and Quantity Take-Offs:**

   Prepare detailed BOQs by reviewing layouts, working drawings, specifications and site measurements. Identify missing information, scope gaps and discrepancies before finalising estimates.
2. **Project Estimation and Costing:**

   Prepare item-wise estimates covering materials, labour, installation, transport, wastage, site overheads and contingency allowances. Cover all relevant trades, including civil works, partitions, ceilings, flooring, furniture, joinery, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire safety and IT infrastructure.
3. **Vendor Quotations and Rate Analysis:**

   Obtain quotations from vendors and contractors, prepare comparison statements, assess scope completeness and negotiate rates to establish reliable project costs.
4. **Commercial Proposals and Tender Support:**

   Prepare priced BOQs, quotation inputs, inclusions, exclusions and assumptions. Coordinate with business development to ensure client proposals reflect the approved scope, costs and margins.
5. **Budget Planning and Value Engineering:**

   Develop execution budgets and recommend alternative materials, specifications or construction methods to meet client budgets while maintaining design intent, functionality and quality.
6. **Design and Execution Coordination:**

   Work with the design and project teams to validate quantities, specifications, site conditions and execution requirements. Hand over approved costing sheets and budgets to the Project Manager before execution.
7. **Variation Costing and Cost Monitoring:**

   Estimate additional work and scope changes, maintain variation records and support approval before execution. Compare actual and committed costs against budgets with the project and accounts teams, highlighting overruns and margin risks.
8. **Cost Database and Documentation:**

   Maintain updated material and labour rates, vendor quotations, standard BOQs and historical project costs. Ensure estimates are version-controlled, traceable and supported by clear calculations and approvals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Preferably 5–8 years of relevant experience in estimation, costing or quantity surveying, with hands-on experience in commercial office interiors and turnkey fit-outs.
* Degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management or a related discipline. Candidates with equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
* Ability to read architectural, interior and services drawings and independently prepare quantity take-offs and detailed BOQs.
* Strong understanding of interior materials, construction methods, labour productivity and vendor pricing.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and AutoCAD for drawing review and measurement; familiarity with estimation software is an advantage.
* Strong commercial judgement, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple estimates within deadlines.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with designers, project managers, vendors and the business development team.

**Success in This Role**

Accurate and timely estimates, complete BOQs with minimal scope omissions, reliable execution budgets, prompt costing of variations and clear visibility of expected project margins.

****Personnel****

* Ensures all employees maintain an updated awareness of Hotel product knowledge, current promotion, policy changes and appropriate internal communication.
* Assists in the recruitment and selection of Sales employees if required.Adheres to hotel guidelines when recruiting and uses a competency-based approach to selecting employees.
* Assists to oversee the punctuality and appearance of Events Sales employees, making sure that they wear the correct uniform and maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene, according to the hotel and department’s grooming standards.
* Maximises the effectiveness of employees by developing each of their skills and abilities through the appropriate training, coaching, and/or mentoring.
* Assists to conduct annual Performance Development Discussions with employees and to support them in their professional development goals.
* Assists to plan and implement effective training programmes for employees in coordination with the Training Manager and Departmental Trainers.
* Encourages employees to be creative and innovative, challenging and recognising them for their contribution to the success of the operation.
* Supports the implementation of The People Philosophy, demonstrating and reinforcing Hyatt’s Values and Culture Characteristics.
* Supports the implementation of changes as a result of the Employee Opinion Survey.
* Supports the implementation of changes as a result of the Associate Opinion Survey.

****Administration****

* Ensures that an efficient and accurate filing system, both manuals as well as electronic, is maintained at all times.
* Maintains complete and supported records of all Event Sales Agreements, Contracts and Quotations for the Hotel.
* Establishes an efficient trace file to ensure that all business booked is properly tracked.
* Submits Sales report to Associate Director of Events in a timely manner.
* Provides accurate reporting of business booked to the Sales Coordinator for monthly consolidation.
* Prepares and ensures all Events Orders are distributed to concerned department in a timely manner.

****Leadership Profile:****
Hyatt’s Leadership Profile clarifies what is expected of Hyatt’s leaders and the specific behaviors that successful leaders exhibit to achieve business results.
  
  
Be familiar with Hyatt’s Leadership Profile as the expectation and measure of your performance. Additionally, exhibiting these behaviors will help you hire, develop, evaluate and reward talent successfully.
  
  
**Learn & Grow**
Leaders are quick and curious. They are more likely than others to be energized by the challenge of the unfamiliar, to quickly understand new or complex situations and data, and to share that learning with others. They are also likely to be more open to feedback, to reflect and learn from experiences, and to recover quickly from setbacks. They probably also have a higher risk tolerance and greater resilience to recover from mistakes or failures than many of their peers. These behaviors and personal qualities are an adsvantage in becoming more effective as a leader over time.
  
  
**Foster a Culture of Care**
Leaders build trust through listening first, acting ethically and with integrity. They truly care about others and demonstrate that as they display empathy, create an inclusive environment, encourage diverse viewpoints, and recognize and reward excellence. They assume responsibility for the customer experience, prioritize stakeholder needs, and ensure colleagues have the resources and support they need to demonstrate to customers that we really care.
  
  
**Adapt and Thrive with Change**
Leaders look ahead and make needed changes happen. They are comfortable adapting or transforming existing processes or directions to customer needs, and are more proactive in identifying and removing barriers to change and engaging key internal stakeholders. They also tend to be aware of the broader business climate, able to connect trends in the external world to changes needed internally, and more likely to sponsor or coach teams driving change.
  
  
**Achieve Results**
Leaders are action-oriented, understand how to effectively work through others, and are undeterred by challenges. They move quickly to address issues and tend to be comfortable making decisions even when the right answer isn’t totally clear. They are more likely to set clear expectations for colleagues on their team, hold their team to higher performance standards, and give direct feedback. At the same time, they tend to provide support to their team in order to achieve the goals—communicating, coaching and developing, helping them connect their individual work to a greater goal, and entrusting them to act. They are also more likely to see the bigger picture, think longer-term about their team’s talent needs, and to take a longer-term view of results that count.

title: Event Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Viraaya Weddings is a luxury wedding planning and destination wedding company in India, known for creating sophisticated, bespoke celebrations for discerning families. The team specializes in luxury wedding planning, destination weddings, high-end venues, customized décor and design, hospitality, and full-scale event management. Each celebration is carefully curated to reflect the clients’ vision, from royal Rajasthan weddings to grand Indian and international destination events. By combining strategy, creativity, design, hospitality, and precise execution, Viraaya Weddings delivers distinctive, seamless, and unforgettable wedding experiences for its clients.

**Role Description**

The Event Operations Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India. This role oversees the end-to-end operational planning and execution of luxury and destination wedding events, ensuring timelines, budgets, and quality standards are consistently met. Responsibilities include coordinating with clients, vendors, venue partners, and internal teams; managing event logistics such as setup, décor, guest flow, hospitality, and on-ground production; and addressing any operational issues in real time to maintain smooth event delivery. The Event Operations Manager will also prepare and track operational budgets, create detailed event run sheets, supervise event staff, and ensure all touchpoints align with the brand’s luxury service standards. Regular travel to event locations within India and occasionally abroad may be required.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Operations Management and Event Planning skills to oversee complex, multi-day luxury wedding events from concept to completion.
* Excellent Customer Service and Communication abilities to manage client expectations, coordinate with vendors, and lead on-site teams effectively.
* Budgeting and financial management skills to plan, monitor, and optimize event budgets while maintaining high-quality standards.
* Experience in hospitality, weddings, or high-end events, with the ability to handle large guest lists and intricate logistical requirements.
* Proven leadership and team management capabilities, including training and supervising event staff and ensuring collaborative workflows.
* Strong problem-solving, time management, and organizational skills, with the ability to work under pressure and handle multiple events concurrently.
* Proficiency in basic office and project management tools; experience with event management software is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Event Management, Hospitality, Business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
* Willingness to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required by the event calendar and to travel to event locations.

title: Store Manager - Furniture
description:
**Company Description**
Royaloak Incorporation Pvt. Ltd. is India’s premier furniture brand, known for its wide range of stylish, high-quality products at competitive prices. Backed by over 25 years of industry expertise from its founders, the company focuses on “International furniture, Elevating Lifestyles” through its unique Country Collections inspired by designs from the USA, Italy, Turkey, Malaysia, India, and more. These collections are curated by in-house designers to help customers select furniture that aligns with different concepts and tastes. Royaloak offers a one-year warranty on manufacturing defects for most items and operates an expansive network of 200+ stores across the country, supported by a strong online presence at royaloakindia.com.

**Role Description**
The Store Manager – Furniture is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India, responsible for overseeing daily store operations and ensuring an excellent customer experience. The role includes managing the showroom floor, supervising and motivating sales teams, and ensuring product displays and visual merchandising standards are consistently maintained. The Store Manager will monitor sales performance, handle customer queries and escalations, manage inventory levels, and coordinate with logistics and back-office teams to ensure timely deliveries. Responsibilities also include implementing retail loss prevention measures, tracking store KPIs, preparing sales and performance reports, and maintaining compliance with company policies and procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Sales & Customer Service skills to deliver a high-performing, customer-centric store experience.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to interact with customers, mentor team members, and coordinate with internal stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess proven Store Management capabilities, including staff supervision, inventory oversight, and daily operations handling.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of Retail Loss Prevention practices to reduce shrinkage and safeguard store assets.
* Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or degree in business, retail management, or a related field are beneficial.
* Prior experience in furniture retail or lifestyle/home décor stores, with exposure to sales targets and performance metrics, is an advantage.
* Strong organization, problem-solving, and leadership skills, along with the ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, are preferred.

title: Assistant Manager - Restaurant
description:
**Job Description**
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! Overseeing daily restaurant operations to ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently, you will create a warm and welcoming atmosphere where every guest feels like a VIP. You are responsible for developing a menu that creates unique dining experiences that will leave our guests in awe. As an
**Assistant Manager - Restaurant**
, you’re not just elevating the dining experience – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
  
  

* Operational Oversight: Manage daily outlet operations to ensure smooth service and adherence to brand standards.
* Team Leadership: Supervise, train, and motivate staff to deliver exceptional guest experiences and maintain high performance.
* Guest Experience Management: Ensure personalized service, handle guest feedback, and resolve issues promptly to enhance satisfaction.
* Inventory & Cost Control: Monitor stock levels, manage ordering, and control costs to optimize profitability.
* Sales & Revenue Support: Drive upselling initiatives, monitor sales performance, and support revenue targets.
* Compliance & Hygiene: Ensure adherence to health, safety, and hygiene regulations across all outlet areas.
* Coordination & Communication: Collaborate with kitchen, housekeeping, and other departments for seamless service delivery.
* Food Safety Regulations: Ensuring that all food safety standards are met.

**Qualifications**
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
  
  
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
  
  
**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**

* Proven experience as an Assistant Manager - Restaurant or similar role in a high-end restaurant or hotel, or 2-3 years as an Assistant Manager.
* Assistant Manager: The ideal candidate should possess at least 1 year of experience as an Assistant Outlet Manager.
* High school diploma or equivalent; hospitality training is a plus
* Excellent communication, grooming, and interpersonal skills
* Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage
* Friendly, professional, and guest-focused
* Able to work flexible shifts

**About Us**
**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
  
  
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
  
  
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
  
  
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
**Clinical Study Manager (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your clinical trial management expertise could directly shape how AI understands and advances healthcare research? We're looking for experienced Clinical Study Managers to oversee the operational execution of clinical trials — ensuring studies run on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards — while contributing to some of the most exciting AI development happening in the medical research space today.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role designed for seasoned clinical operations professionals who want meaningful work on their own terms.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Manage clinical trial timelines, milestones, and deliverables to keep studies on track and stakeholders aligned
* Oversee study budgets, financial forecasting, and cost tracking across multiple vendors and research partners
* Coordinate with CROs, investigative sites, and internal teams to ensure smooth, high-quality study execution
* Identify operational risks early, resolve issues proactively, and maintain clear communication across the trial lifecycle
* Apply your real-world clinical research expertise to help evaluate and improve AI systems being trained on healthcare data

**Who You Are**

* Experienced clinical trial project manager with a strong track record managing budgets, timelines, and deliverables
* Skilled at coordinating CROs, external vendors, and cross-functional research teams
* Comfortable managing multiple complex workstreams simultaneously without losing sight of the details
* A clear, structured communicator who keeps stakeholders informed and aligned
* Self-directed and reliable when working independently in a remote environment

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality evaluation, or AI training workflows
* Familiarity with AI tools or clinical data platforms
* Background spanning multiple therapeutic areas or study phases

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI and healthcare research projects alongside leading AI labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high-impact project work
* Gain unique exposure to how advanced AI models are trained using real-world clinical data
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Sr. Cost Manager - MEP
description:
**Job Description**
Undertake quantity works for Building projects - Residential, Commercial, Hotel, Hospital, Fitout, Industry / warehouse (depending on project requirement)
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Perform advanced quantification across complete MEP works Electrical, HVAC, Fire Fighting, Plumbing, DG, Lift, IBMS.
  
  
Draft or modify trade-specific preambles, quantify preliminaries and general items, review cost plan quantities, audit team measurements.
  
  
Apply suitable assumptions (when required) where project information is incomplete.
  
  
Lead preparation and review of cost plans at various stages and tender estimates.
  
  
Analyse and evaluate items of work unit rates to project specifics by incorporating risk factors.
  
  
Carryout benchmark against similar projects, price preliminaries, reconcile BOQs with budgets, and provide input on cost strategies, sustainability elements, and fee allowances.
  
  
Oversee and review pricing work prepared by junior team members.
  
  
Advise on procurement strategies and contract selection based on project needs. Draft or review special contract conditions, manage end-to-end tender processes, review documentation and reports, and present to Client.
  
  
Prepare formal correspondences such as letters of intent, award, or agreement. Provide guidance to junior team.
  
  
Oversee post-contract cost management, including review and approval of payment recommendations, cost reports, and cash flow forecasts and present to Client. Establish change control protocols, advise on risk mitigation, evaluate claims and variations, monitor expenditure of provisional sums, and review Final Account Statement.
  
  
Lead and support junior team members in cost control tasks.
  
  
Apply working knowledge of construction technologies and methods in cost planning tasks. Assess cost implications of materials, labour and construction methods during design and execution stages.
  
  
Should be proficient in CAD, Cost-X (qty take off tools) and other quantification / estimation software.
  
  
Good skills on MS excel and word and ability to learn and adapt to customized software
  
  
**Qualifications**
Qualification- Degree in Mechanical Engineering

title: Clinical Business Intelligence Manager
description:
**Clinical Business Intelligence Manager (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your deep expertise in healthcare analytics could directly influence how AI understands and reasons about clinical data? We're looking for an experienced Clinical Business Intelligence Manager to lead analytics work that sits at the intersection of healthcare intelligence and cutting-edge AI development.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for senior professionals who know how to turn complex clinical and operational data into decisions that matter. You'll bring your healthcare BI leadership experience to a team working on some of the most advanced AI projects in the industry.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and mentor a business intelligence team in building dashboards, reports, and analytics that support clinical and operational decision-making
* Design, maintain, and optimize BI infrastructure — including data models, SQL queries, and reporting pipelines — ensuring accuracy, reliability, and performance
* Analyze clinical, operational, and performance data to uncover meaningful trends and surface insights that support leadership decisions
* Translate complex healthcare datasets into clear, trusted outputs that drive improvements in care delivery and organizational efficiency
* Apply your domain expertise to evaluate, quality-check, and improve AI-generated outputs related to clinical analytics and healthcare data reasoning

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in healthcare or clinical analytics, business intelligence, or data management within regulated environments
* Proven track record designing and managing BI systems — including dashboards, reporting pipelines, and data models
* Comfortable working with clinical, operational, and administrative datasets and understanding their real-world implications
* Strong communicator who can translate technical findings into meaningful narratives for both clinical and operational stakeholders
* Self-directed and reliable — you deliver quality work independently without hand-holding

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or evaluation systems
* Familiarity with AI tools, LLM outputs, or AI training workflows
* Background in health informatics, population health, or value-based care analytics
* Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar BI platforms

**Why Join Us**

* Work alongside world-leading AI research labs on genuinely cutting-edge projects
* Fully remote and flexible — structure your work around your life, not the other way around
* Freelance autonomy with the substance of meaningful, high-impact work
* Gain direct exposure to advanced large language models and how they're trained and evaluated
* Contribute clinical intelligence expertise to AI systems that will shape how healthcare data is understood at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: life insurance team leader
description:
**Company Description**
SMC Insurance Brokers Pvt Ltd is a Composite Insurance Broker registered with the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI), offering a wide range of life and non-life insurance solutions under professional guidance. The company serves both corporate and retail clients with products such as group medical coverage, fire, burglary, and motor insurance, supported by trusted partnerships with leading car dealerships across India. Headquartered in Delhi with a pan-India service network, SMC combines decades of domain experience with a dynamic, growth-oriented culture. Its philosophy centers on client-first advice, comprehensive claims support, and fair resolution, reflected in millions of policies sold and claims assisted. With multiple insurance partners and extensive business volume, SMC provides customers and team members with strong industry exposure and career development opportunities.
  
**Role Description**
The Life Insurance Team Leader is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India. This role is responsible for leading and mentoring a team of life insurance advisors or sales representatives, setting targets, monitoring performance, and ensuring adherence to compliance and quality standards. Daily activities include guiding the team on product offerings, overseeing client onboarding, reviewing proposals, and supporting the closure of sales opportunities. The Team Leader will collaborate with internal stakeholders to optimize processes, provide regular training and coaching, and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and policy retention. The role also involves reporting key metrics, forecasting sales, and contributing to strategic initiatives that drive growth in the life insurance portfolio.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong knowledge of Finance and Insurance, particularly in life insurance products and regulatory requirements.
* Candidates should possess effective Team Management skills, including mentoring, performance tracking, and coaching diverse teams.
* Candidates should possess excellent Customer Service skills, with the ability to handle queries, resolve issues, and maintain long-term client relationships.
* Candidates should possess proven Sales skills, including target achievement, pipeline management, and consultative selling.
* Additional beneficial qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in business, finance, or a related field; experience in brokerage or insurance distribution; strong analytical and reporting abilities; proficiency in MS Office; and clear, professional communication skills in English and local languages.

Team Leader (International Expert) will lead and coordinate multi-disciplinary consultancy/PMC team for Dam Rehabilitation & Improvement Project (DRIP), focusing on dam safety, planning, and design aspects.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Minimum 20 years’ experience in water resources projects with strong expertise in dam safety, dam planning, and design.
