title: Service Manager
description:
**Location:**
New Delhi (Sarita Vihar)

**Working Hours:**
Any 9 hours between 9am - 9pm

**Working Days:**
5 days per week

**Weekly Offs:**
2 rotational offs between Monday and Friday

**Saturday & Sunday:**
Mandatory working

**Experience:**
5–9 years

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Service Delivery Manager**
to lead service delivery operations for a premium customer segment within a leading consumer internet organization.

The role will involve managing a team of
**Relationship Managers and Team Leads**
, ensuring high-quality customer service, effective escalation management, and strong customer retention and renewal outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and manage a team of approximately
  **30–40 Relationship Managers and Team Leads**
  .
* Drive consistent service delivery and ensure a high-quality customer experience.
* Manage customer escalations and ensure timely, structured resolution of issues.
* Monitor team performance against defined service and business objectives.
* Drive customer engagement, retention, and
  **renewal outcomes**
  .
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve operational and customer-related challenges.
* Coach and mentor Team Leads and Relationship Managers to improve productivity, service quality, and performance.
* Identify recurring customer issues and work with relevant teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Maintain strong relationships with
  **high-value/HNI customers**
  and ensure a premium service experience.
* Track operational metrics and provide regular performance updates to leadership.
* Ensure adherence to organizational processes, service standards, and compliance requirements.

What We’re Looking For

* **5–9 years of relevant professional experience**
  , preferably in service delivery, customer success, customer experience, relationship management, or operations.
* Experience managing
  **large customer-facing teams**
  of 30+ members.
* Strong experience in
  **escalation management and customer relationship management**
  .
* Exposure to customer retention, renewals, or account management.
* Strong people-management, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, customer-centric environment.
* Experience handling premium, high-value, or HNI customer segments would be an advantage.

Why Join Us?

* Opportunity to work with a
  **leading consumer internet brand**
  .
* Manage a high-performing customer-facing team.
* Work with a premium and high-value customer segment.
* Opportunity to influence customer experience, retention, and service delivery at scale.

**Work Location:**
New Delhi

* **Work Schedule:**
  5 days a week, with Saturday and Sunday working and two rotational weekly offs between Monday and Friday.

title: Regional Business Manager
description:
**This position requires the candidate to be based in the northern region of India and will require a minimum of 60% travel. The targeted annual compensation for this role is 21–24 LPA (CTC).**

**The ideal candidate will bring proven account management experience and be comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. They must demonstrate the ability to develop and implement strategic initiatives, as well as proficiency in technology platforms such as Microsoft Office Suite, Zoom, SAP dashboards, and similar tools.**

**About the Role:**

In this role you will develop and implement India regional strategy to achieve growth targets and sales objectives. Assess and understand the needs of sales leaders and supervise the implementation of regional business strategies. Work closely with other departments to build business building tools, training and support materials, and other programs that drive distributor growth and retention. Manage, train, and mentor a team of Senior Sales Managers and Sales Managers to ensure excellent support for sales leaders. Travel within the region to foster alignment with sales leaders around corporate initiatives, provide training, and promote the business opportunity to potential distributors.

**What you'll do:**

* Participate in development of India Regional Sales Strategy, including Revenue/Expense forecasts and budgets
* Analyze competitive and program data; identify gaps and recommend solutions that drive/support Regional Strategy
* Participate in design of new programs and tools to support Distributor Sales
* Develop implementation plans for new program/tools including tactical support of marketing programs and materials, promotions, product launches.
* Complete implementation plans that support marketing programs and materials, promotions, product launches; identify most effective communication channels and develop content to effectively support leaders
* Facilitate communications of new programs/tools between internal teams and Distributors.
* Develop content and messaging for Distributor meetings and events
* Train sales leaders on corporate initiatives, strategy, success drivers, etc. Coordinate with key sales leaders in regional goal setting. Lead and present material at Distributor meetings and company sponsored events
* Manage a Sales Team of Senior Sales Managers and Sales Managers, including distribution and review of workload/accounts, train on policy and process, coach and mentor, performance reviews, disciplinary action, problem resolution, identify and share standard practices, leadership development, improve and refine processes, optimize support to sales leaders

**What you'll need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field
* 8-12 years’ work experience, 5-8 years management experience
* Ability to meet tight deadlines and make decisions under pressure
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
* Outstanding teaching, training, and motivation skill
* Excellent presentation skills
* In-depth understanding of representative oriented functions/services
* General understanding of direct selling industry as it applies to Nu Skin/Pharmanex and competitors

title: Area On Premise Manager
description:
**PURPOSE OF THE JOB**
The Area On Premise Manager is responsible for the On Premise volume and the development of the brand in the assigned region by leading the musketeers in an effective way, and by managing and optimizing the available resources, in order to achieve Business Plan objectives. The ROPM trains and develops the Musketeers permanently to secure a high performing team.
  
  
**All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:**
**Key Responsibilities**

* “Living” the Red Bull On Premise culture:

Assume and live the Red Bull OP Culture. Creation of “kindred spirits”. Being brand ambassador in front the Musketeers and the On Premise network. Monitoring image standards within the Musketeer team regarding the brand premium values of Red Bull.
  
  

* Communication:

Fluent communication and know-how exchange with his/her Musketeers and the National On Premise Manager. Permanent teamwork with other On Premise Regional Managers. Securing and optimizing the relation with all regional business units, especially Off Premise and Culture in the region.
  
  

* Event Activation:

Ensures availability, premium On Premise activation and High 5 execution at third party and Red Bull events. Attendance on key 3rd party and Red Bull events. Monitor customer incentives by searching the profitability of all invitations.
  
  

* Area Management:

Planning and continuously developing of her/his area in the regional business plan. Secure the implementation of the national business plan in the region. Manage team to drive horizontal and vertical growth by putting the national On Premise strategy into practice. Permanently searching for new opportunities and securing the existing ones. Setup a proper route planning to secure perfect outlet coverage in the respective area. Builds and maintains relationships with key On Premise partners in the assigned area.
  
  

* Administration:

Ownership of the regional On Premise budget in relation with the national business Plan. Keeping records of all Musketeer activities in the region. Fulfilment of reports dead lines. Compile and reports of competitors activity in the region.
  
  

* On Premise Marketing

Development of the regional On Premise marketing strategy together with the National On Premise Marketing Manager and putting it into practice. Locate offset financial contribution with added value solutions to main accounts which build long term credibility & partnership.
  
  

* Training, Coaching, Motivating and Assessing

Set up and execute the regional training plan for the Musketeer team. Responsible for conducting training sessions with the team towards desired outcome. Coaching and training of Musketeers on the job based on observed strengths and opportunities. Spends a minimum of four days a week in the field with his/her Musketeers.
  
  

* Art of Musketeering

Seek out and engages continuously potential qualified candidates that best fit Musketeer job description. Screen Applicants based on resume and referrals, ask relevant questions during interview process. Assess Candidates on both substantive answers to interview questions as well as overall communication and sales skills and presentation.
  
  
**Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:**

* EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS
* University – Bachelor’s degree preferred (business, marketing or similar).
* EXPERIENCE
* Recommended 3-4 years sales experience with a strong track record of success.
* Recommended 2-3 years of management experience (in the On Premise beverage industry is a plus).
* Strong On Premise industry knowledge, contacts and experience in “the scene”.
* KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
* Strong analytical, planning and financial skills.
* Clear understanding of markets, sales & distribution, competitor activity, consumer behaviour in FMCG context
* Fluent in written and spoken English.
* Very high negotiation and communication skills.
* Fully understands and embraces the musketeer profile.
* Must be proficient in EDV (Word, Excel, Power Point, etc.).

title: Planning Lead
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
  
  
Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
  
  
Context
  
  
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
  
  
Our unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Our fully integrated services are tailored to plan and manage projects using proven best practices.
  
  
CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to Detailed Design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.
  
  
CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with Front Office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2.
  
  
CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  

* We are seeking a Planning Lead to manage the planning team while maintaining a hands-on role in project planning, scheduling, monitoring, and reporting using Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project (MSP).
* The successful candidate will provide planning leadership across projects, ensure consistent scheduling standards, and personally develop and maintain schedules for assigned projects. This is a working leadership role that combines team management with practical project delivery.
* Lead, mentor, and develop the planning team, managing workloads and ensuring quality and consistency of schedules and reports.
* Establish planning standards, procedures, and reporting templates; support recruitment, training, and performance reviews.
* Develop, baseline, and maintain integrated project schedules using Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project (MSP), including WBS, milestones, dependencies, and resource/cost loading.
* Monitor progress against baselines, analyse critical paths and variances, and develop look-ahead and recovery plans.
* Prepare progress reports, dashboards, S-curves, and performance indicators; communicate schedule status, risks, and corrective actions.
* Assess the impact of changes and delays, support delay analysis and extension-of-time assessments, and maintain schedule records.
* Coordinate with project teams and clients to align schedules, lead progress reviews, and resolve or escalate delivery risks.

Profile/Skills
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* Typically 8–12 years of relevant planning and scheduling experience, including experience leading a planning team.
* Demonstrated hands-on proficiency in Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project; experience must extend beyond reviewing schedules prepared by others.
* Experience developing and controlling schedules through the full project lifecycle.
* Strong knowledge of critical path methodology, resource planning, progress measurement, and schedule recovery.
* Experience coordinating multiple projects or complex work packages.
* Relevant industry experience in infrastructure projects.
* A relevant planning, scheduling, or project management certification is desirable.

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job - it’s a career!

title: Head/Director – National Conservation Programme
description:
**Background**
WWF India is consolidating its National Conservation Programme to strengthen and deepen its engagement and outreach on key conservation issues of national importance. The Director, NCP will help to strategise and lead theprogramme, building on the current initiatives.
  
  
Initially, the NCP will bring together WWF India’s work on raptorconservation, small grants and conservation initiatives being run out of our State Office network. Future directions and new initiatives can also be developed based on strategic priorities and funding opportunities. The NCP will complement and work in synergy with other WWF India programmes including wildlife & landscape conservation; freshwater & wetland conservation and coastal & marine conservation.
  
  
The role's core responsibilities will initially be focused around managing the Raptor Conservation Programme which brings together science, innovation and stakeholder engagement to design and implement high-priority interventions for vultures, other threatened raptors, and their habitats. The Director, NCP will also be responsible for the management of the Conservation Catalyst Programme which channels targeted small-grant resources and technical mentorship to local partners for conservation of lesser-known, threatened species & habitats. Providing strategic & technical support and coordinating the conservation activities undertaken by WWF India’s branch offices in different states will also be a core responsibility. In addition, as a senior member of the WWF India conservation programme team, the Director, NCP will also be expected to contribute to the larger strategic vision and conservation priorities of the organisation.
  
  
He/she should be a strategic, dynamic, resourceful and organised conservation professional. This senior leader must have at least ten years of experience managing field conservation and research projects. Experience in raptor or avian ecology would be an added advantage. This role will be based at the WWF-India Secretariat in New Delhi and will report to senior management at WWF-India.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**RAPTOR CONSERVATION PROGRAMME (RCP)**

* Provide strategic vision and leadership for the raptor conservation programme to establish WWF-India as aleader in the raptor conservation space.
* Manage and build the raptor conservation team in the Secretariat and landscapes.
* Support implementation of innovative and scientific approaches for raptor conservation.
* Ensure timely data analysis and report publication and coordinate outreach activities.
* Coordinate with stakeholders as required for the long-term survival of threatened raptors including government and civil society partners
* Collaborate with the central and state governments to support policies that might have immediate or long-term effects on the conservation of vultures & other raptors and their habitats
* Lead the preparation of half-yearly technical & financial reports and scientific publications for RCP.
* Keep track of the finances of the RCP including budgeting and adaptive management.

**CONSERVATION CATALYST PROGRAMME (CCP)**

* Continue development and evolution of the strategy for CCP to achieve the larger objective of strengthening small, grassroots conservation organizations.
* Work with the CCP team to coordinate with grantees, develop and implement capacity building approaches.
* Assess grant proposals for technical quality, feasibility, and alignment with organizational priorities
* Oversee grant disbursement schedules, compliance with financial and procurement norms, and timely submission of narrative and financial reports by grantees.
* Provide technical backstopping to grantees, including advice on project design, field methodologies, data management, and communication of results.
* Coordinate periodic field reviews and audits of grant‑supported projects; document lessons learned, success stories, and scalable models for integration into WWF-India’s wider programmes.
* Compile programme‑level synthesis reports on the CCP, highlighting contributions to biodiversity conservation in the country

**STATE AND BRANCH OFFICES**

* Provide strategic oversight to WWF-India State and Branch offices to ensure alignment with WWF-India’s conservation strategy, annual work plans, and compliance requirements
* Support state and branch teams in planning, implementing, and monitoring biodiversity conservation projects
* Establish and periodically review branch‑level performance indicators (e.g. project delivery milestones,takeholder and partner engagement, financial utilisation, reporting quality) and support course‑correction where needed
* Facilitate cross‑learning between branches and landscape programmes

**Requirements**

* PhD or equivalent in the field of ornithology/ecology/wildlife/environment/biology.
* At least 15 years’ experience in the field of conservation or a related area.
* Ability to design and implement strategies and programmes independently.
* Experience in managing teams and working collaboratively.
* Ability to drive high-level discussions with stakeholders, including government departments, scientific institutions and NGOs.
* Strong written and spoken communication skills in English, with knowledge of any regional language.

Last date for application - 2 October 2026
  
  
**WWF-India is an equal opportunities employer. We encourage applications from women and diverse candidates.**

title: Chief Field Office (P-4), FT, #82112, Hyderabad, India - APRO
description: UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence.At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling.UNICEF is a place where careers are built: we offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package.Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF.For every child, a brighter futureThe Hyderabad Field Office covers Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka and provides strategic leadership for UNICEF's engagement with state governments and key stakeholders across the Area of Responsibility.In line with UNICEF India's evolving differentiated programme approach, the Hyderabad Field Office plays a strategic role in advancing upstream engagement and strengthening UNICEF's position as a convener and catalyst for results for children.The office fosters innovation, generates evidence and supports the development of sustainable, scalable approaches aligned with state development and governance priorities. Building on the strong public-sector capacity and vibrant private-sector, philanthropic and innovation ecosystems across the region, the office also plays a key role in strategic partnership development, advocacy and resource mobilization to accelerate results for children.How can you make a difference?Under the guidance of the Chief Field Operations, the Chief Field Office (CFO) is accountable for representing, managing and leading the total programme commitment of a field office within a country programme. The CFO represents UNICEF in their Area of Responsibility (AoR), leads and oversees the various program sectors and operational service teams ensuring the delivery of quality results in accordance with UNICEF’s programme of cooperation, country programme management plan and overall vision set forward by the Representative. The incumbent is also expected to provide strategic leadership in partnership development, resource mobilization, policy advocacy and innovation, while positioning UNICEF as a trusted thought leader and partner of choice.Key Functions And Accountabilities Effective management of UNICEF presence, staff and assets Partnership, Coordination and Collaboration Knowledge Management for Programmes Programme Development and Management Optimum Use of Program Funds Programme Monitoring and Evaluations Rights-Based and Results-Based Programme Management Approach National and Local Capacity Building/Sustainability Rights Perspective and Advocacy at the National, Community and Family Levels Partnership and Resource MobilizationIf you would like to know more about this position, please review the complete Job Description here: Job Description Chief Field Office.pdfTo qualify as an advocate for every child you will have…Minimum RequirementsEducation: An advanced university degree (Master’s or equivalent) in one of the following fields is required: social sciences, international relations, public administration, government and public relations, public or social policy, sociology, social or community development, or another relevant technical field.Work Experience: A minimum of eight (8) years of professional work experience in programme management, planning, monitoring and evaluation, project administration or another relevant area is required. Demonstrated experience in advancing upstream programming, policy dialogue and systems strengthening through strategic engagement with senior government officials, development partners, academia, private sector and civil society stakeholders that advance children's rights and development outcomes is required. Experience leading and managing teams, with the ability to nurture talent, foster collaboration and innovation, and build high-performing teams capable of delivering results in increasingly upstream and partnership-focused programming environments is required.Skills: Strong strategic leadership, programme management, stakeholder engagement, partnership development, advocacy, negotiation and resource mobilization skills, with demonstrated ability to lead high-performing teams, foster collaboration and innovation, and deliver results for children.Language Requirements: Fluency in English is required.DesirablesLanguage: Knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish) is an asset.Experience in identifying, cultivating and leveraging strategic partnerships and in resource mobilization in support of children's rights and development outcomes is considered a strong asset.Experience working in a developing country is considered as an asset.Relevant experience in a UN system agency or organization is considered as an asset.For every Child, you demonstrate...UNICEF's Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF ValuesUNICEF Competencies Required For This Post Are… Builds and maintains partnerships Demonstrates self-awareness and ethical awareness Drive to achieve results for impact Innovates and embraces change Manages ambiguity and complexity Thinks and acts strategically Works collaboratively with others Nurtures, leads and manages peopleFamiliarize yourself with our competency framework and its different levels.This position has been assessed as an elevated risk role for Child Safeguarding purposes as it is either a role with direct contact with children, a role that works directly with identifiable children's data, a safeguarding response role, or an assessed risk role. Additional vetting and assessment for elevated risk roles in child safeguarding (potentially including additional criminal background checks) apply.UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status.UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer a wide range of benefits to our staff, including paid parental leave, breastfeeding breaks and reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. UNICEF provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance.UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, fraud, corruption and other forms of serious misconduct. UNICEF is committed to promoting the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference, safeguarding and background verification checks. These checks may include verification of academic credentials and employment history, screening against relevant United Nations misconduct databases, and requests for misconduct disclosures from current and former employers, professional associations, other relevant organizations and participating organizations under inter-agency safeguarding initiatives, including the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS), where applicable. Appointment, selection and continued engagement are subject to the satisfactory completion of all required checks. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information and consent to enable UNICEF to undertake these checks. Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially.UNICEF appointments are subject to medical clearance. Issuance of a visa by the host country of the duty station is required for IP positions and will be facilitated by UNICEF. Appointments are conditional on the selected candidates willingness to comply with current or future vaccination requirements, should UNICEF mandate it for personnel. Failure to comply with such requirements, where applicable and without a duly approved medical exemption from the relevant UN authority, will result in the cancellation of the selection or may lead to other administrative measures, including separation from service.RemarksAs per Article 101, paragraph 3, of the Charter of the United Nations, the paramount consideration in the employment of the staff is the necessity of securing the highest standards of efficiency, competence, and integrity.As part of UNICEF’s commitment to building an ever more diverse workforce and fostering an inclusive work environment, we particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in our workforce, including candidates from geographically underrepresented regions within the ICO IP workforce, particularly East Asia and the Pacific, Middle East and North Africa, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, and West and Central Africa; persons with disabilities; and people of diverse gender identities and expressions.Government employees who are considered for employment with UNICEF are normally required to resign from their government positions before taking up an assignment with UNICEF. UNICEF reserves the right to withdraw an offer of appointment, without compensation, if a visa or medical clearance is not obtained, or necessary inoculation requirements are not met, within a reasonable period for any reason.UNICEF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). UNICEF will not ask for applicants' bank account information.Mobility is a condition of international professional employment with UNICEF and an underlying premise of the international civil service.Humanitarian action is a cross-cutting priority within UNICEF's Strategic Plan. UNICEF is committed to stay and deliver in humanitarian contexts. Therefore, all staff, at all levels across all functional areas, can be called upon to be deployed to support humanitarian response, contributing to both strengthening resilience of communities and capacity of national authorities.All UNICEF positions are advertised, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and advance to the next stage of the selection process. An internal candidate performing at the level of the post in the relevant functional area, or an internal/external candidate in the corresponding Talent Group, may be selected, if suitable for the post, without assessment of other candidates.Additional information about working for UNICEF can be found here.

title: Front Desk Manager
description:
**Job Description**

* maintain a high customer service focus by approaching your job with the customers always in mind.
* To have a positive impact, taking personal responsibility and initiative to resolve issues, always clearly communicating with both customers and colleagues.
* To be motivated and committed, approaching all tasks with enthusiasm and seizing opportunities to learn new skills or knowledge in order to improve your personal performance.
* To be flexible, responding quickly and positively to changing requirements including the performance of any tasks requested of you.
* To maintain high team focus by showing co-operation and support to colleagues in the pursuit of team goals.
* To maintain an environment that promotes flair, creativity and consistency in the quality of customer service delivery and presentation.
* To ensure that all Front Office related polices and guidelines are followed and implemented.
* Staffing and Scheduling of the shift and allocation of duties.
* Implement systems and procedures that achieve higher cost efficiency and guest satisfaction.
* Facilitate learning and development for all the team members of the outlet
* Performance Appraisal/ Management of the staff in the department.
* Maintain the Log Book and effective follow up system, Check the daily arrival list and monitor all VIP movement.
* Ensure that the guest has a pleasant stay by supervision of;
* Room allocation
* Smooth Check In & Check Out
* Special requirements of the guest
* Co-ordinate with departments like Security and Housekeeping to ensure that all the security, hygiene and aesthetic standards of the hotel are met.
* Act as a ‘One Point Contact’ for the guest ; constantly interact with guests in order to solicit feedback.
* Prepare reports on Occupancy, Average rates, Reservations etc.
* Monitor daily performance and manage revenue through revenue and yield management techniques.
* Ensure through regular monitoring of SALT and feedback, prompt, efficient and accurate service to all guests.
* Maintain the Guest History System and updating of all the guest profiles.
* Monitor the business of competition hotels in terms of new accounts and rates.
* Ensure that all the operational standards set for all the processes are followed.
* Co-ordinate operations with Concierge, Travel Desk, Guest Services Hotline or any other sub departments, through the guest cycle.
* Ensures norms, procedures and systems for safety and security of guest belongings (e.g. Lockers, Left luggage etc.) are followed.
* Maintain regular contacts with corporate and individual customers, and build strong relationships with them.
* Ensure that all the statutory requirements for in house guests are met (C–Forms etc.)

title: Supervisor, Client Contact
description:

Full time
  
  
**Type Of Hire**
Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

Associate's Degree
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you will be doing**

* Oversees one or more teams of customer service associates who handle customer service inquiries and problems via phone and/or email
* Monitors operations to ensure adherence to service level standards and company/department policies and procedures
* Ensures professional and courteous customer support services are delivered to remote a productive and positive relationship with customers
* Ensures adequate phone coverage including making decisions regarding scheduling changes
* Acts as an escalation point for resolving the most difficult customer issues

* Demonstrated analytic and root cause analysis skills for process improvement initiatives

* General skill in the use of MS Office and other standard software applications required to perform the job duties

* Working in an international company, alongside international colleagues
* Being a part of an innovative and entrepreneurial environment of a growing department and team. Option to work fully remotely, with the necessary equipment provided by the company (computer, monitors, accessories)
* Development opportunities by using the company's on-line training database and LinkedIn Learning. Unique working atmosphere (team integration meetings, friendly working environment, support of experienced employees)
* Opportunity to get involved in social projects and local initiatives
* A broad range of professional education and personal development opportunities
* A work environment built on collaboration and respect

**Fis Job Level Description**
Entry level supervisory role. Works under general direction of customer service management. Typically supervises a team of ten to twenty-five Contact Center Associates. Typically requires one or more years supervisory or team leadership experience. Demonstrates basic competencies of the supervisory position focused on customer satisfaction, communication, team management and execution with a results focus.

title: Area Debt Manager-Call Centre
description:
**Job Requirements**
About the Role
  
  
The Area Debt Manager – Call Centre is responsible for managing a team and coordinating operational recovery activities for a credit portfolio within an assigned territory. This includes administering corporate policies and procedures to minimize front-end delinquencies. The role involves close collaboration with the legal team to obtain sound legal advice on managing delinquencies. The role bearer holds end-to-end responsibility for collections in the allocated area, contributing to the bank’s broader organizational objectives. This is a critical role with direct impact on the financial institution’s budget planning.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Handle collections for specific products in the assigned area.
* Ensure collection efficiency and manage the cost of collections.
* Track and control delinquency bucket-wise and DPD-wise, with a focus on non-starters.
* Review account allocations and set collection targets by bucket for agencies and in-house teams.
* Follow up regularly with defaulting customers through a dedicated team.
* Ensure adherence to legal guidelines by collection agencies and executives.

title: Vice President, Settlement & Currency Services
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Vice President, Settlement & Currency Services
  
  
**Overview:**
Settlement & Currency Services is Mastercard’s center of expertise for global settlement, cross-border payments, currency and foreign exchange services, and value movement across traditional and digital financial networks. The team supports initiatives related to fiat and digital currencies, settlement infrastructure, and emerging payment technologies, working across products, markets, and functions to advance strategic priorities. The team also develops solutions that enable funds movement between Mastercard customers, engages with regulators and manages relationships with commercial and central banks.
  
  
Mastercard is seeking an execution-focused Vice President, Settlement & Currency Services to lead settlement and FX capability development and implementation across AP & EEMEA. This role will prioritize regional initiatives, support regulatory reporting requirements, and help manage responses to regulatory inquiries.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Conducting thorough analysis to assess the financial, operational, regulatory, customer, and system impacts and requirements needed to support settlement/FX initiatives
* Collaborating with the global team on strategic efforts such as introducing new settlement and FX enhancements in AP & EEMEA region
* Partnering with business units to strategize, develop and implement enhancements to settlement service offerings, ensuring alignment with market needs and operational capabilities
* Driving initiatives to ensure liquidity availability for settlement in AP & EEMEA region
* Engaging with regulators, central banks, and other stakeholders in AP & EEMEA region to manage regulatory audits and inquiries related to Settlement and FX and staying abreast of regulatory changes and legal developments
* Overseeing the timely and accurate preparation and submission of regulatory reports related to Settlement activities, ensuring compliance with reporting requirements across jurisdictions
* Managing global settlement invoice processing including establishing new vendors, routing invoices for approvals/payment through Oracle, and triaging processing issues
* Ensuring that all project aspects are compliant with Mastercard policies and procedures
* Formulating and presenting strategic recommendations to executive management

**All About You:**

* Educational qualification: MBA or a degree in business or finance
* Proven track record in payment systems product/project management, including the implementation and maintenance of external systems or proprietary technology
* Demonstrated ability in leading high-impact transformation initiatives with strong project management and stakeholder management skills across global and cross-functional teams
* Advanced level of expertise in Treasury settlements / payment operations and banking infrastructure gained through experiences in multinational corporates’ Regional/Global Treasury centers, financial institutions or banks
* Proficient in payment network systems, including authorization, clearing, and settlement, and bank connectivity solutions like Host-to-host and SWIFT
* Significant experience managing regulatory correspondence on Settlement/Payment matters. Experience with payments‑related regulatory compliance requirements across APAC and EEMEA regulators like MAS, HKMA, ASIC, JFSA, RBI, PBOC, SARB is highly valuable while not mandatory
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with the ability to initiate and implement the needed changes to achieve business unit /corporate objectives
* Ability to think creatively and out-of-the box; ability to challenge the status quo; demonstrated ability to innovate
* Strong leadership qualities, including getting work done through others, being organizationally savvy, thought leadership
* Demonstrated ability to manage a diverse team with varying skillsets
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills, and proven ability to lead complex cross-functional projects
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, particularly the ability to work and communicate cross-functionally
* Management style that is proactive towards employee development

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: IT & BI Operations Manager
description:
**Position - IT & BI Operations Manager**

Experience: 10–15 Years

Location: Gurgaon

Work Mode: Work from Office

Industry: IT Services / Data & Analytics / Managed Services

Role Type: Client-facing Operations & Service Delivery

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced IT & BI Operations Manager to manage end-to-end IT Operations and BI Operations for a global enterprise.

The candidate will be responsible for managing day-to-day operational activities across BI, Database, Infrastructure, Cloud, Windows/Linux, SCCM, Application Deployment and Microsoft technologies.

This is a client-facing leadership role where the person will act as the key point of contact for operational requirements, incidents, service requests, escalations and delivery.

The candidate will manage multiple technical teams, assign and prioritize client requirements, monitor SLAs/KPIs, coordinate issue resolution and provide regular updates to client stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary point of contact for client for IT & BI Operations.
* Understand client requirements, incidents, service requests and business priorities
* Analyze requirements and assign tasks to the appropriate technical team.
* Manage day-to-day operations across BI and IT Infrastructure towers.
* Monitor SLA, KPI, incident, request and change management.
* Manage escalations and ensure timely resolution of critical issues.
* Coordinate between client stakeholders and internal technical teams.
* Conduct regular client calls and operational review meetings.
* Track open issues, dependencies, risks and action items.
* Prepare weekly/monthly operational reports and dashboards.
* Ensure proper RCA and corrective actions for recurring/critical incidents.
* Drive process improvements, automation and operational efficiency.
* Manage team performance, workload, utilization and delivery timelines.
* Ensure proper documentation, SOPs, KT and operational processes.

**BI Operations – Exposure Required**

The candidate should have good understanding of:

* Enterprise Data Warehouse / Legacy Data Warehouse
* SQL Server / Database environments
* SSIS / ETL
* SSAS
* Power BI
* SSRS / Reporting
* BI production support
* Data refresh and pipeline monitoring
* Report and dashboard support
* Data validation and issue troubleshooting

**IT Operations – Exposure Required**

**Good understanding of:**

• SCCM / Endpoint Management

• Application Deployment

• Application Packaging

• PowerShell

• Windows Server Administration

• Linux Administration

• VMware / vCenter

• Microsoft SQL Server Administration

• Azure SQL

• AWS RDS

• High Availability & Disaster Recovery

• Active Directory

• Microsoft 365 / O365

• Microsoft Entra ID / Azure Administration

• Windows Patching

• Alert / Infrastructure Monitoring

• Technical Support

**Service Management**

• Incident Management

• Problem Management

• Change Management

• Service Request Management

• SLA / KPI Management

• Root Cause Analysis

• Escalation Management

• Service Delivery Governance

**Candidate Profile**

• 10–15 years of experience in IT Operations, Infrastructure Operations, BI Operations, Application Support or IT Service Delivery.

• Experience managing multiple technical teams/towers.

• Strong client-facing experience with international clients.

• Experience in Managed Services / Production Support / IT Service Delivery.

• Strong understanding of IT infrastructure and BI environments.

• Ability to understand technical issues and identify the right team for resolution.

• Strong stakeholder and escalation management skills.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Experience managing SLAs, KPIs and operational governance.

• ITIL certification will be an advantage.

• Experience with ServiceNow or other ITSM tools will be an advantage

**Important**

We are looking for a hands-on Operations/Service Delivery Manager, not a pure BI Developer, DBA, System Administrator or Project Manager.

The candidate should be capable of managing the complete flow:

**Client Requirement → Understand & Prioritize → Assign to Technical Team → Track → Resolve → Validate → Communicate → Report → Improve**

title: Restaurant Manager
description:
The
Radisson Blu Hotel, Faridabad
is a 5-star upscale business hotel located on Mathura Road (Sector 20B), directly across from the Bata Chowk metro station. Opened in 2016, it features 124 modern rooms, extensive event spaces, multiple dining venues, and wellness amenities tailored for business and leisure travelers.

**Job Description**

Job Description – Restaurant Manager

**Department:**
Food & Beverage
  
  
**Location:**
Radisson Blu Faridabad

**Job Purpose:**

Responsible for managing the day-to-day restaurant operations of a five-star hotel, ensuring exceptional guest experiences, consistent service standards, operational efficiency, and achievement of revenue and profitability targets.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee daily restaurant operations, ensuring seamless service delivery in line with five-star hotel standards and brand SOPs.
* Ensure exceptional guest satisfaction through personalized service, effective complaint handling, and prompt service recovery.
* Lead, motivate, and develop the restaurant team through regular briefings, training, and performance monitoring.
* Drive revenue through suggestive selling, upselling, menu knowledge, and effective guest engagement.
* Monitor food and beverage costs, inventory, breakage, wastage, and operating expenses.
* Ensure compliance with hygiene, food safety, grooming, and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with the kitchen, stewarding, and other departments to ensure smooth operations and consistent food and service quality.
* Monitor guest feedback, operational reports, and performance indicators to drive continuous improvement.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Diploma or degree in Hotel Management or a related discipline.
* 4–6 years of experience in Food & Beverage operations, preferably in a reputed five-star hotel, with prior supervisory or restaurant management experience.

**Key Competencies:**
Leadership, guest relationship management, communication, service excellence, commercial awareness, team development, and operational problem-solving.

**Qualifications**

Diploma or degree in Hotel Management or a related discipline.

**Additional Information**

We are seeking a dynamic, guest-focused, and results-oriented Restaurant Manager to lead Food & Beverage operations in a premium five-star hotel environment. The ideal candidate should possess strong operational expertise, exceptional leadership capabilities, and a passion for delivering memorable dining experiences while maintaining the highest standards of service excellence.

The candidate must have proven experience in managing restaurant operations, leading and developing service teams, handling guest feedback, driving revenue through upselling, and maintaining effective cost and inventory controls. A strong understanding of restaurant service standards, food and beverage knowledge, hygiene and safety regulations, and brand SOPs is essential.

The successful candidate should be hands-on, commercially aware, proactive, and capable of maintaining operational excellence during high-volume business periods. Excellent communication, interpersonal skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to teamwork are critical for success in this role.

**Candidates with relevant experience in reputed five-star hotels, a strong guest-centric approach, and a passion for hospitality excellence are encouraged to apply.**

title: Senior Manager - Strategy and Process Governance
description:
**About the Role**

The role is responsible for supporting the Head of Group Sourcing - Clothing in facilitating through leading the implementation of long-term strategic roadmaps across the regional sourcing hubs. They will establish and maintain standardized operational frameworks to ensure consistency and efficiency and managing cross-functional projects designed to modernize our sourcing workflows and digital integration across Asia sourcing offices.

Meanwhile, this is a role will also play an important part in designing and executing sourcing strategies to meet long-term commercial objectives and scale the Own Brand business. A key priority is leading our operating model transformation—optimizing processes, aligning systems, and standardizing 'ways of working'. This role is the key to unlock OB growth potentials across the group.

**What You'll Do**

The scope of the role will include, but not limited to the following main areas:

* **Strategy & Delivery:**
  Lead the end to end design, planning and execution of Sourcing Strategy (including strategic partnership, SRM, Risk Management, Diversification) to deliver category growth, Own Brand ambitions and optimize COGS benefits
* **Operating Model Transformation:**
  Lead the end-to-end mapping of global sourcing operations to identify and drive process optimizations including but not limited to develop and implement standardised procedures, best practices, and guidelines. You will ensure organizational alignment, integrate systems and tools, and manage the end-to-end change process to deliver a highly efficient and effective global sourcing function
* **Strategic Insights**
  : Consolidate and analyze internal and external data to identify emerging trends, commercial risks, and white-space opportunities. Translate these insights into executive-level narratives and actionable recommendations that influence long-term strategy
* **Project Management:**
  Lead the execution of high-priority strategic projects (team level or Group level) from inception to completion. Establish project governance, track milestones, and manage cross-functional dependencies to ensure initiatives are delivered on time
* **AOP Planning:**
  Orchestrate the annual planning cycle for Asia Sourcing team, translating multi year strategies into actionable targets - defining budget requirements, resource allocation and KPIs that ensure the Group’s commercial and operation goals are met
* **Thought Leadership:**
  Act as a subject matter expert on strategic framework designs, global sourcing trends, emerging technologies, and geopolitical shifts. You will proactively identify industry best practices and innovative sourcing models to challenge the status quo, ensuring the Group remains competitive and resilient in a changing global market.
* **Collaboration Facilitation:**
  Build communication and internal collaboration within the Sourcing and Asia teams and between the Australian business commercial teams. Identify opportunities and ensure teams are working towards common goals.
* **Stakeholder Engagement and Management:**
  Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the Group commercial and enablement teams and within sourcing teams to understand their needs and align sourcing strategies and strategic initiatives accordingly

**What You'll Bring**

***Personal Characteristics***

* Influence, adaptability, judgment, collaboration, managerial skills, interpersonal skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Horizontal Leadership capabilities and the ability to work well in a pressured situation
* Ability to influence, establish and maintain strong relationships with senior management.

***Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities***

* 10+ years of relevant retail / industry experience necessary.
* Proven experience in sourcing, procurement, or supply chain management. Project management experience is an added advantage.
* Strong business acumen analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good understanding of retail operations, industry trends, supply chain and AI Integration.
* Track record of managing and delivering change as well as results
* Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of relevant sourcing tools and buying processes & systems.

**What you’ll experience**

* Be a part of Australia’s largest retailer
* Constant mentoring and training provided
* Generous performance based bonus
* 20 days annual leave
* A flexible approach to work
* Premium insurance coverage for you and your dependents

We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. As one of the largest employers in Australia and New Zealand, we aim to create a truly inclusive workplace where everyone feels that they belong, can be their best selves, and reach their full potential.

• Policy placement & renewals

title: Marketplace Manager
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Marketplace Manager to own and grow our presence across India's leading online marketplaces — primarily Amazon and Flipkart, and others such as Myntra, Nykaa, Meesho, and JioMart as relevant to our categories. You'll be responsible for the full commercial and operational health of these channels: driving sales, protecting margins, keeping listings and inventory in top shape, and turning major sale events into our biggest revenue days of the year.

This is a hands-on, data-driven role for someone who knows Seller Central and Seller Hub inside out and can move comfortably between the spreadsheet and the strategy.

Key Responsibilities

* Own end-to-end management of the brand's storefronts on Amazon, Flipkart, and other marketplaces, including revenue targets and channel P&L.
* Create and optimize product listings — titles, images, bullet points, descriptions, and A+ / enhanced brand content — to maximize search ranking and conversion.
* Manage pricing strategy and win/defend the Buy Box while protecting margins against competitor activity.
* Plan and execute marketplace advertising (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display) against clear ACOS / ROAS targets.
* Forecast demand and coordinate inventory and fulfillment across FBA, Flipkart Assured / FBF, and self-ship models to avoid stock-outs and overstock.
* Lead planning and execution for major sale events — Great Indian Festival, Big Billion Days, Prime Day, and brand-day activations.
* Monitor and protect account health: seller ratings, return rates, policy compliance, and listing suppressions.
* Build and manage relationships with platform category / account managers to unlock visibility, deals, and co-marketing opportunities.
* Track, analyze, and report channel performance — sales, traffic, conversion, ad efficiency — and translate the data into actions.
* Stay ahead of marketplace policy changes, new features, and category trends.

Requirements

* 3–6 years managing brands or accounts on Amazon and/or Flipkart (in-house, or at a seller / aggregator / agency).
* Hands-on expertise with Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.
* Strong command of marketplace advertising and the metrics that govern it (ACOS, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate).
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills and comfort working with large datasets.
* Solid understanding of marketplace SEO, listing optimization, and Buy Box mechanics.
* Commercial acumen — able to balance growth, margin, and inventory.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

Nice to Have

* Experience with tools like Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar.
* Exposure to additional platforms (Myntra, Nykaa, Meesho, Ajio, and quick-commerce such as Blinkit / Instamart).
* Experience managing external agencies or a small team.
* Category experience relevant to [our products].

What Success Looks Like

* **First 3 months:**
   listings audited and cleaned up, clear targets set per channel, and a firm handle on account health.
* **First 6–12 months:**
   measurable growth in marketplace revenue and improved ad efficiency, with well-executed festive sale events.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**About the Opportunity**

**Role:**
Revenue Management

**Level:**
Assistant/ Deputy Manager

**Reporting To:**
Associate Director - Revenue Management

**Location:**
Gurgaon

**About the Function**

Being the largest online travel aggregator in India, MMT witnesses a sizeable number of users visiting the app and transacting every day.

The Ground Transport(GT) business offers an unmatched booking experience to this vast user base, with the widest range of Bus, Rail, and Cab booking options—also playing a crucial role in acquiring new users, especially from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across India.

This is further complemented by a world-class post-booking experience—whether it's through the app's numerous self-help features or our hand-picked executives who strive to deliver customer delight at every step. The Ground Transport SBU embraces a strong innovation mindset and has consistently launched industry-first features that make the booking experience truly seamless and delightful.

At MMT, the Ground Transport unit takes immense pride in its team members who work tirelessly to champion the best possible experience for our users. An orchestra of product managers, tech developers, designers, researchers, and revenue managers comes together to ensure we continue to lead and differentiate ourselves in the industry.

**About the role:**

As part of the GT Online Revenue function, you will join a whip-smart team responsible for managing revenue, driving growth, and increasing profitability. You will embody our values of consumer focus, commitment to results, and continuous improvement by developing innovative solutions that raise challenging questions and demand both creative and practical answers.

The ideal candidate is an independent, self-starting, quick-witted, entrepreneurial, and intellectually curious individual. This person must excel at cross-functional collaboration, blend creativity with strong organizational skills, manage deliverables under tight deadlines, and consistently produce high-quality work under pressure.

**What will you be doing**

**P&L and Revenue Management**

* Own and manage the business P&L, working with internal stakeholders to devise strategies aimed at achieving revenue goals.
* Closely monitor performance parameters, ensuring tight control over key business KPIs such as conversions, transactions, and margins.
* Conduct deep dives into competitor pricing data and use insights to inform category pricing strategies.
* Adjust pricing strategies based on demand signals and market conditions to maintain competitiveness and maximize revenue.

**Growth Strategy Development**

* Define annual and quarterly plans based on short- and long-term growth strategies, influencing key cross-functional teams to align on common objectives.
* Develop and implement initiatives focused on customer acquisition.
* Analyze demand signals and traffic data to understand business and marketing trends.
* Use these insights to shape business and marketing strategies, driving greater engagement and higher conversion rates.

**Customer Engagement & Marketing Collaboration**

* Work closely with the marketing team to develop and execute customer engagement strategies and campaigns that maximize customer lifetime value.
* Lead tactical initiatives around active revenue drivers such as pricing, seasonal trends, and topical promotions using relevant marketing channels.
* Collaborate with various marketing functions to maximize order volumes while maintaining a healthy ROAS.

**Collaboration with Product & Operations Stakeholders**

* Partner with product teams to develop first-class, customer-centric experiences.
* Work with operations teams to streamline processes that drive strong NPS and CSAT scores.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Create and maintain rich, interactive visualizations through effective data interpretation and analysis.
* Integrate reporting components from multiple data sources to provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Apply statistical methods to analyze data and answer key business questions, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and performance.

**Qualification & Experience**

* MBA from a reputed institute with 2–5 years of experience in a revenue or category management role within a consumer-facing, technology-enabled business—preferably in the e-commerce industry.
* Proven track record of working in high-growth, data-driven environments with a strong understanding of business levers and consumer behavior.
* Advanced proficiency inMS Excel and MS PowerPointfor data analysis and business storytelling.
* Sound understanding of SQL and Python is mandatory to independently work on data extraction, modeling, and analysis.

**Key Success Factors for the Role:**

* A mindset that consistently focuses on return on investment, business outcomes, and revenue growth.
* High energy, team-oriented, and brings a positive, can-do attitude.
* Strong understanding of data analysis, with hands-on experience in data-driven decision-making.
* Proven track record of driving business growth through both tactical and strategic initiatives.
* Excellent communication skills and strong stakeholder management capabilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

title: Ecommerce Growth Specialist
description:
Marketplace Ecommerce and Expansion Manager

**Company:**
Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Gurugram (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–6 years

About Bluethread

Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd. is a fashion company building and scaling a portfolio of contemporary fashion brands, including Dorabi and Aamili with a focus on design, craftsmanship, and inclusive fashion, we are building brands that combine distinctive aesthetics with everyday wearability.

We are looking for a driven, commercially minded
**Marketplace E-commerce & Expansion Manager**
to own and grow our presence across Indian and international marketplaces. This role goes beyond managing existing accounts. You will be responsible for identifying the right platforms for our brands, evaluating new growth opportunities, launching new marketplace channels, and scaling revenue across geographies, particularly the United States.

You should understand how marketplaces work as businesses, how to build a profitable presence on them, and what it takes to take a fashion brand from onboarding to meaningful scale.

Key Responsibilities1. Marketplace Expansion & Strategy

* Identify and evaluate relevant marketplaces across India and international markets, with a particular focus on the
  **US marketplace opportunity**
  .
* Research marketplace models, customer demographics, category demand, competitive positioning, commercial terms, commission structures, fulfilment requirements, and profitability.
* Build a marketplace expansion roadmap, prioritising platforms based on revenue potential, brand fit, operational feasibility, and contribution margins.
* Lead the onboarding and launch process for new marketplaces, from initial research and commercial discussions to catalog setup, integrations, and go-live.
* Explore opportunities across fashion marketplaces, multi-brand retail platforms, and other relevant online distribution channels.
* Develop market-entry strategies for international platforms, particularly the US, considering pricing, assortment, fulfilment, returns, duties, and local customer expectations.
* Build scalable processes for launching and managing multiple marketplaces simultaneously.

2. Marketplace Ownership & Growth

* Own the end-to-end performance of existing marketplace accounts, including Myntra, Nykaa Fashion, and other relevant platforms.
* Drive GMV growth through assortment planning, catalog optimisation, search visibility, conversion improvements, pricing, promotions, and best-seller scaling.
* Plan and execute marketplace campaigns, promotional events, and sale calendars.
* Work with platform account managers to unlock better visibility, marketing opportunities, and commercial growth.
* Identify underperforming products and categories and implement corrective action plans.
* Build strategies to improve sell-through, inventory productivity, repeat sales, and overall marketplace profitability.

3. US Marketplace Expansion

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the US e-commerce landscape and the operating models of major marketplaces.
* Evaluate opportunities across platforms such as Amazon US, Walmart Marketplace, and relevant fashion-focused marketplaces, based on their suitability for our brands.
* Understand the differences between first-party retail (1P), third-party marketplace selling (3P), and direct-to-consumer models, and recommend the right approach for each opportunity.
* Evaluate fulfilment models such as Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA), seller-fulfilled operations, and third-party logistics providers.
* Assess US-specific requirements around catalog compliance, product listings, sizing, pricing, returns, shipping, taxes, and customer expectations.
* Build a practical launch and scaling plan for the US market, including platform selection, onboarding, assortment strategy, unit economics, and growth milestones.
* Coordinate with external partners, agencies, logistics providers, and platform representatives wherever required to establish and scale international operations.

4. Marketplace Operations & Backend Management

* Own catalog onboarding, product content, imagery, attributes, tagging, pricing, and listing quality.
* Manage inventory availability, stock accuracy, order fulfilment, cancellations, returns, and marketplace reconciliations.
* Use Unicommerce for inventory, order management, and marketplace integrations.
* Work with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms wherever required.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to improve fulfilment SLAs and minimise cancellations, returns, and operational penalties.
* Establish standard operating procedures to support efficient operations across multiple platforms and geographies.

5. Analytics, Performance & Profitability

* Build and maintain marketplace dashboards tracking GMV, net revenue, conversion rates, returns, sell-through, advertising performance, and contribution margins.
* Analyse product-level performance, customer demand, size-related returns, discount dependency, and inventory ageing.
* Evaluate marketplace commissions, fulfilment costs, advertising expenses, promotional funding, and other channel-specific costs to assess profitability.
* Develop business cases for new marketplace launches, including expected investment, revenue potential, operational requirements, and break-even considerations.
* Translate performance data into clear action plans and regularly report progress against revenue and profitability goals.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with design and merchandising teams to plan assortments and prioritise products for different markets.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on marketplace advertising, campaign participation, and brand visibility.
* Collaborate with finance, operations, logistics, and technology teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Ensure consistent brand positioning, pricing discipline, and product presentation across all platforms.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in marketplace e-commerce, online retail, or marketplace expansion.
* Demonstrated experience managing fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brands across one or more marketplaces.
* Strong understanding of Myntra and/or Nykaa Fashion, with the ability to independently manage existing accounts.
* **Practical exposure to international marketplaces, particularly the US market, or demonstrable experience building marketplace expansion strategies for international markets.**
* **Understanding of US marketplace models, including 1P versus 3P selling, FBA, seller-fulfilled operations, and marketplace unit economics.**
* **Experience identifying, onboarding, and scaling new sales channels is highly desirable.**
* **Proficiency in Unicommerce is mandatory; familiarity with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms is an advantage.**
* **Strong commercial acumen, analytical skills, and an understanding of marketplace profitability.**
* **Ability to manage platform relationships, negotiate opportunities, and work independently without extensive hand-holding.**
* **A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to turn research and strategy into actual marketplace launches and revenue.**

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field preferred.
* 3–6 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience working with Indian fashion marketplaces and international e-commerce platforms is strongly preferred.

Why This Role Matters

* **Build new revenue channels:**
  Take ownership of identifying and scaling marketplaces rather than simply maintaining existing accounts.
* **Expand internationally:**
  Play a key role in building Bluethread's presence in the US and other global markets.
* **Own business outcomes:**
  Work directly on marketplace revenue, growth strategy, and profitability.
* **Work with an ambitious fashion portfolio:**
  Help scale brands with distinct identities, established products, and growth potential.
* **Have meaningful ownership:**
  Work in a founder-led environment where decisions are made quickly and your work has a direct impact on the business.
* **The ideal candidate is not just a marketplace account manager. They are a marketplace growth operator who can identify where a brand should sell, build the business case, launch the channel, and scale it profitably.**
