title: Associate Director – Hotel API Commercials
description:
**Associate Director – Hotel API Commercials**

**Inward Hotel Supply & Outward API Distribution Management**

**Company:**
AIRIQ B2B Online private Limited

**Department:**
Hotel Business

**Reporting To:**
Head – Hotel Business

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
8–10 years in management of hotel API commercials

**Role Overview**

The Associate Director – Hotel API Commercials will lead the commercial strategy and management of AIRIQ’s
**inward hotel API supply and outward hotel API distribution**
.

On the inward side, the role will manage commercial partnerships with hotel aggregators, bed banks, OTAs offering B2B hotel supply, hotel chains and other accommodation suppliers connected through APIs. On the outward side, the role will oversee commercial arrangements for distributing AIRIQ’s hotel inventory to OTAs, bed banks, travel platforms, travel management companies and other hotel API buyers.

The position will be responsible for securing competitive hotel supply, developing profitable distribution partnerships, improving margins and managing commercial and financial exposure.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Inward Hotel API Supply Commercials**

* Identify and evaluate hotel API suppliers based on destination coverage, hotel portfolio, rate competitiveness, inventory availability and commercial viability.
* Negotiate hotel supply agreements covering net rates, discounts, commissions, production-linked incentives and overrides.
* Finalise supplier deposits, credit limits, payment schedules, settlement currencies and refund timelines.
* Evaluate rate conditions covering room categories, occupancy, meal plans, taxes, mandatory supplements, cancellation policies and nationality or residency restrictions.
* Secure competitive domestic and international hotel inventory across relevant destinations and customer segments.
* Compare overlapping supply on equivalent room types, meal plans, cancellation conditions and total payable prices.
* Review supplier production and renegotiate commercial terms based on business delivered and future potential.

**2. Outward Hotel API Distribution Commercials**

* Develop commercial structures for distributing AIRIQ’s hotel inventory to B2B API buyers.
* Establish pricing arrangements for pre-purchased hotels, directly contracted hotels and inventory sourced through hotel APIs.
* Negotiate buyer mark-ups, commissions, incentives, deposits, credit terms, settlement cycles and production commitments.
* Develop partner-specific commercial arrangements based on destination demand, sales potential and expected contribution.
* Define permitted markets, sales channels and onward redistribution rights in line with supplier agreements.
* Support API Sales and Relationship Management teams in acquiring, activating and growing productive accounts.
* Review buyer profitability and renegotiate commercially unsustainable arrangements.

**3. Hotel API Pricing and Profitability**

* Own agreed revenue, room-night, margin and contribution targets for the hotel API portfolio.
* Evaluate profitability after supplier costs, buyer incentives, connectivity and mapping charges, payment costs and foreign exchange costs.
* Establish guidelines for mark-ups, minimum margins, promotional pricing and commercial exceptions.
* Coordinate hotel-level, destination-level and partner-level pricing with Revenue.
* Identify margin leakage arising from incorrect rate configuration, currency conversion, tax treatment or cancellation charges.
* Ensure outward booking, cancellation and refund commitments appropriately reflect inward supplier obligations.
* Prepare commercial business cases for new hotel API partnerships and integrations.

**4. Agreements and Commercial Governance**

* Lead commercial negotiations and coordinate agreement reviews with Finance, Legal and Leadership.
* Ensure agreements clearly define booking confirmation, rate revalidation, amendments, cancellations, no-shows, refunds and settlement obligations.
* Negotiate responsibility for failed or duplicate bookings, incorrect rates, overbooking, denied check-in and guest relocation.
* Define escalation procedures and financial responsibility for hotel service failures.
* Ensure hotel rates are distributed in accordance with agreed market, channel and rate-display restrictions.
* Maintain records of agreements, renewals, deposits, incentives and contractual commitments.
* Ensure commitments remain within approved commercial policies and authority limits.

**5. Supplier and Buyer Performance Management**

* Conduct regular commercial reviews with inward hotel suppliers and outward API buyers.
* Monitor searches, availability, conversion, room nights, cancellations, booking failures and net contribution.
* Review search-to-book ratios and API usage charges with Technology and Sales to assess commercial viability.
* Identify the most competitive suppliers for priority hotels and destinations.
* Review non-producing integrations and coordinate corrective action.
* Resolve commercial disputes affecting bookings, settlements or partner relationships.

**6. Deposits, Credit and Settlements**

* Coordinate supplier deposits, buyer credit limits and payment arrangements with Finance.
* Monitor utilisation of supplier advances and financial exposure across partners.
* Track booking-level reconciliation, cancellation refunds, credit notes, debit notes and disputed charges.
* Support timely recovery of buyer receivables, supplier refunds and commercial claims.
* Review foreign currency settlement terms and associated exposure.
* Recommend corrective action where production, payment behaviour or service performance does not justify the financial commitment.

**7. Cross-functional Leadership**

* Work with Hotel Procurement to distribute pre-purchased and directly contracted inventory through suitable API channels.
* Coordinate with Technology and Distribution on integration priorities, hotel mapping and commercial configuration.
* Work with Operations on booking fulfilment issues involving commercial liability.
* Guide API Sales and Relationship Management teams on pricing, negotiations and account profitability.
* Present hotel API performance, forecasts, partnership opportunities and commercial risks to Leadership.

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in business, commerce, hospitality or a related discipline; an MBA is preferred.
* **8–10 years of relevant experience**
  in hotel API distribution, hotel aggregators, bed banks, OTA hotel supply or B2B accommodation distribution.
* Demonstrated experience managing
  **both inward hotel API supplier commercials and outward hotel API buyer commercials**
  .
* Established relationships with hotel API suppliers, bed banks, OTAs and accommodation distribution partners.
* Strong understanding of hotel room categories, occupancy, meal plans, rate conditions, cancellation policies, taxes and supplements.
* Experience negotiating hotel supply and distribution agreements, deposits, credit arrangements and production-linked incentives.
* Ability to assess profitability at supplier, buyer, destination, hotel and booking levels.
* Working knowledge of hotel mapping, rate revalidation, booking confirmation and cancellation flows.
* Strong negotiation, financial analysis, stakeholder-management and leadership skills.

**Relevant hotel API commercial experience is essential. Experience limited to flight APIs or general travel sales does not meet the core requirements of this position.**

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Hotel API revenue, room nights, gross margin and net contribution.
* Competitiveness of inward hotel rates and commercial terms.
* Profitability, growth and retention of outward API accounts.
* Productive hotel API suppliers and buyers activated.
* Distribution and utilisation of pre-purchased and directly contracted hotel inventory.
* Supplier deposit utilisation and management of financial exposure.
* Buyer collections, supplier refund recovery and settlement ageing.
* Incentives and overrides earned and recovered.
* Reduction in pricing leakage and unresolved commercial disputes.
* Adherence to hotel supply agreements and redistribution conditions.

**Position Summary**

Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP-enabled transformation. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.

This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.

* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules - SD-FI & MM-FI

You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.
  
  
This role requires a proactive leader who can translate operational trends into technical inputs, manage an Operating Expenses (OpEx) budget, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to hold technical solutions accountable to real-world performance metrics.
  
  
Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours. However, ensuring a seamless customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well-being, Google provides support for any non-standard operational shifts.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the end-to-end operational strategy for Google's customer support models, with a specific focus on scaling automated and agentic solutions for designated user segments.
* Manage, track, and execute an annual operational expenditure budget. Design resource allocation models, evaluate multi-variable operational scenarios, and manage partner staffing ramps or transfers in line with budget guidelines.
* Oversee minimum quality bar frameworks and dedicated partner teams focused on pre-release testing, UAT, logic stress testing, and model tuning. Ensure all systems adhere to Google's core customer experience quality and safety standards.
* Design and execute quantitative studies to calculate and show the case of managing time savings of future tool and feature rollouts. Partner with Data Science and product teams to standardize measurement assumptions.
* Act as the liaison between scaled operations and technical teams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: National Air Logistics Trucking Manager
description:
**It's more than a job**
As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
We are looking for an experienced National Air Logistics Trucking Manager to lead and drive the trucking strategy across India. This role will be responsible for managing end-to-end trucking operations supporting air logistics, ensuring efficient, scalable, and high-quality service delivery aligned with business goals.
  
  
**How you create impact**

* Lead and manage pan-India trucking operations supporting import and export air shipments
* Drive 70% road logistics (core focus) and 30% air freight coordination
* Develop and implement trucking strategy, processes, and operational frameworks integrated with air logistics
* Oversee resource planning, cost management, and operational efficiency
* Manage supplier relationships, carrier networks, and drive procurement initiatives
* Monitor KPIs, service quality, and customer satisfaction through continuous improvement
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and operational standards
* Lead pricing coordination and contribute to business growth and profitability
* Manage and transition the current outsourced team to an in-house capability, building a strong internal team
* Support solution design and transportation planning across complex logistics requirements

**What we would like you to bring**

* 10–15 years of experience in logistics, with strong focus on road trucking operations
* Proven experience in national-level trucking / transportation management
* Strong understanding of air logistics integration with road transport
* Expertise in costing, vendor management, and operational execution
* Exposure to industries such as Semiconductor, Aerospace, Healthcare, White Glove, or Hyperscalers preferred
* People management experience with ability to build and scale teams
* Strong analytical, leadership, and stakeholder management skills

**What's in it for you**
At Kuehne+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact—on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100+ countries.
* People-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning & Development: Grow with us—personally and professionally—through world-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation & Sustainability: Be part of a future-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards & Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds—a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.

**Who we are**
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

  

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**Position Summary**

The position is in the CRM Team based at Bain’s GBS office in Gurgaon, New Delhi, and is an integral part of the Global Commercial Operations department. CRM is a key tool for the firm’s frontline leaders in pursuing commercial objectives, including relationship cultivation, opportunity management, and account plan execution. The CRM Team enables this pursuit by enhancing the platform, processes, analytics, and user experience that support effective commercial decision-making.

Under the direction of the CRM Senior Manager, the
**Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation**
owns core workstreams within the team, driving projects and initiatives across CRM optimization, innovation, analytics, and automation. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end-to-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**Own projects and initiatives related to advanced analytics**

* Leads a team of data analysts, who are utilizing their advanced technical skills to support complex end user requests that require data to be visualized from multiple sources
* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.
* Evaluate best in market tools and provide solutions which will lead to efficiencies (time savings) as well as automation (advancement) on team’s processes.
* Leads projects and initiatives requests relating to data quality often require quick turnaround time. Collaborate closely with the wider Global CRM team and communicate with the senior stakeholders during various phases of these projects or requests including cross-functional collaboration.

  

**Invests comprehensively in continuous development of programs**

* Evaluates current CRM design and propose functional improvements in the system to enhance overall user experience. Articulates clear recommendations on how to improve the interface/processes and thus quality of CRM output.
* Utilizes exceptional communication skills to develop programming and deliver insights. Drives necessary process changes and facilitates brainstorming with impacted stakeholders to get to resolve issues and build consensus. Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.

  

**People Management**

* Oversee day-to-day CRM analytics projects. Collaborates with other senior leaders within the New Delhi GBS office to manage oversight of the entire team.
* Works with senior leadership to ensure regular processes and project work do not exceed team capacity
* Daily task oversight and addressing queries as needs arise with a team of 1-3 direct reports. Provides daily direction as well as ongoing coaching and evaluation of team, including yearly performance reviews and professional development plans.
* Responsible for overseeing the quality of output of the team members. Identifies areas for operational improvement. Proactively resolve problems and escalate issues to the senior leadership, as necessary.
* Leads team in accordance with Bain’s operating principles encouraging optimum performance and an unwavering focus on results. Maintains transparent two-way communication.
* Plans required staffing levels to maintain required processes and procedures. Teams with HR and senior leadership to recruit, interview and hire employees.
* Demonstrated ability to understand company policies/practices and be able to explain this information and advice and influence an audience that is not knowledgeable in this area of the business

  

**Qualification**
**Education**
 Required 

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration - Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is required

Preferred

* Master’s degree in business administration - Computer Science, Data Science or a related field is highly preferred

  

**Experience**
 Required

* Salesforce experience
* Project management experience is desired, and a formal certification will be an added advantage
* Overall 10+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems

Preferred

* Overall 10+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems from a professional services environment

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

Required

* Experience with:
  + Salesforce / CRM
  + Advanced SQL
  + Advanced Alteryx
  + Python / ML

+ AI / Custom GPT / Agentic AI

* Data Analysis

+ Data Research
+ Data Integrity
+ Data Visualization
+ Automation
+ Project Management
+ Team Leadership

* Able to work closely with teams in other parts of the world, which will require flexible hours.
* Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written language. The candidate must communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and possess a natural intellectual curiosity about Bain’s business.
* Excellent customer management skills to work with internal global clients. We should work with flawless customer service, diligence, and collaboration across internal teams.
* A strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. Analyzes trends and monitors problem areas to identify areas for operational improvement.
* Reliable, consistent and mature and able to work independently with a positive attitude.
* Ability to calmly multitask, and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and develop sustainable solutions to deliver practical results
* Should deepen understanding and knowledge of the consulting industry
* Consistent alignment with Bain’s Operating Principles
* Skilled with advanced Excel and PowerPoint

  

Preferred

* Experience with:

* ServiceNow
* Coaching
* Mentoring
* Training
* Advanced Tableau
* Helpdesk support (email, live user training)

If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you..

**Job Summary:**

* Execute the Service Desk roadmaps, strategy, and business decisions related to IT.
* Collaborate with senior management and key stakeholders to understand current and future IT requirements, particularly those related to an AI-driven Service Desk.
* Manage and improve the global Service Desk through automation, AI assistance, and self-service.
* Organize and communicate Global IT standards and processes.
* Manage vendor relationships in APAC region for software and hardware purchases.
* Maintain global hardware and software procurement and inventory.
* Oversee IT Enterprise Services onboarding of new employees in India.
* Conduct and improve incident management routines.
* Actively coach the team in learning new technologies and industry best practices.
* Serve as the escalation point for all requests and incidents in APAC region.
* Oversee the team's day-to-day operations, ensuring that infrastructure in Cvent offices in APAC region is highly available, secure, and scalable.
* Work closely with US-based functional managers to ensure alignment with global IT strategy and initiatives.
* Build and advance processes and culture to empower the team.
* Work with IT Management to build an annual IT budget and monitor expenditure.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.
* Experience in Enterprise IT Managed Services supporting 1000+ end users.
* Strong customer service experience and sensibility.
* Familiarity with hardware troubleshooting and maintenance.
* Prior experience with service desk technical platform administration.
* Advanced knowledge of Change, Configuration, and Incident Management.
* Familiar with AWS, Azure, Office 365, Box, Slack, Zoom Video conferencing, Atlassian products, and other SaaS services.

* Experience in Enterprise IT Managed Services supporting 5000+ end-users.
* Understanding of IT structure in a global organization.
* ITIL v4 Foundation.
* PMP Certification.
* Experience with managing AWS, Office 365, Box, Slack, Zoom, Atlassian, and other SaaS services.
* Experience in managing IT budgets.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

title: Laboratory Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description**
House Of Diagnostics (HOD) is a young, dynamic, and rapidly growing integrated medical diagnostic service provider in the direct-to-consumer space, focused on making a positive impact in healthcare. The organization currently manages its operations in the Delhi-NCR region and aims to become a national healthcare player through rapid expansion. HOD is recognized as a trusted partner by patients, clinicians, and other stakeholders. The company is committed to providing high-quality, reliable diagnostic and imaging services at an affordable cost. Since its inception, HOD has concentrated on achieving and benchmarking best-in-class industry standards.
  
**Role Description**
The Laboratory Operations Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Delhi, India. The individual in this role oversees daily laboratory operations, including workflow planning, resource allocation, and coordination with clinical and administrative teams to ensure timely and accurate diagnostic services. Responsibilities include maintaining laboratory safety standards, managing laboratory equipment and supplies, and implementing quality control procedures to meet regulatory and internal benchmarks. The Laboratory Operations Manager monitors performance metrics, supports process improvements, and ensures adherence to standard operating procedures and accreditation requirements. The role also involves supervising and mentoring laboratory staff, facilitating training, and collaborating with management to support operational efficiency and service excellence.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong laboratory skills, including sample handling, test process oversight, and familiarity with diagnostic workflows.
* Candidates should possess expertise in laboratory safety, including adherence to safety protocols, biohazard management, and compliance with relevant regulations.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in managing laboratory equipment, including routine maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and equipment utilization planning.
* Candidates should possess solid quality control capabilities, including implementation of quality assurance programs, documentation, and continuous improvement practices.
* Candidates should possess operations management skills, including team supervision, scheduling, inventory management, and process optimization.
* Relevant academic background such as a degree in Medical Laboratory Technology, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related field; advanced certifications are an advantage.
* Experience in a clinical or diagnostic laboratory leadership role, preferably in a high-volume or multi-site environment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced healthcare setting.

title: Senior Incident Manager (infrastructure and Data Center Experience)
description:

WELCOME TO SITA
  
  
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a
**Great Place to Work**
® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
As a
**Senior Incident Manager**
, lead the Digital Customer Operations Incident Management function to ensure the consistent handling of all incident priorities and backlogs, effective communication, and continuous improvement in service restoration performance and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As a
**Senior Incident Manager**
, you will also play a critical role in driving transformation and innovation within the Incident Management function. To successfully support the wider vision, the role requires strong capabilities in
**Self & Business Leadership, Continuous Improvement, and Digitalization**
.
  
  
  
  
**what You’ll Do**

* Lead and develop the Incident Management team, ensuring consistent delivery and process compliance.
* Monitor global incident queues, track SLA performance, and identify risks or bottlenecks impacting restoration times.
* Coordinate communication and escalation across resolver teams, Customer Support Team Leaders (Regional Liaisons), and key stakeholders.
* Chair regular incident governance meetings, reviewing metrics such as MTTA, MTTR, SLA, backlog, and communication quality.

* Collaborate with Quality & Performance, Problem, and Change Management to align metrics, lessons learned, and service improvements.

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Business Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

* Major Incident Management (expert level), including command, coordination, escalation, and stakeholder communication.
* Stakeholder & Customer Management, with the ability to engage confidently with senior customers, executives, and operational leaders.
* Clear and authoritative communication, including crisis communications, executive briefings, and customer updates.
* Influence, negotiation, and decision facilitation in high-pressure, cross-functional environments.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking, with strong focus on service restoration and continuous improvement.
* Change and risk awareness, ensuring incident resolution aligns with change, release, and stability controls.
* Collaboration and leadership, working effectively across Customer Support, Technical Support, Engineering, SRE, Problem, and Change teams.
* IT Service Management (ITSM) practices, including Incident, Service Request, and Event Management.

+ ITIL® 4 Foundation or higher (strongly preferred – mandatory for ITSM practice alignment)
+ PRINCE2® Foundation or PMP® (strongly preferred – supports structured coordination and stakeholder management)
+ COBIT® Foundation (preferred – strengthens governance, risk, and control alignment)
+ ISO/IEC 20000 Foundation (preferred – supports ITSM compliance and audit readiness)
+ Technical certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, cloud fundamentals) (nice to have – enhances technical understanding in complex environments)

**PROFESSION COMPETENCIES**

* Crisis leadership and decision-making in high-pressure, time-critical environments.
* End-to-end service ownership, with strong accountability for service restoration and stability.
* Customer-centric mindset, ensuring impact, communication, and outcomes remain business-focused.
* Operational governance and discipline, enforcing processes, standards, and compliance.
* Analytical thinking and continuous improvement, using incident data and trends to drive measurable improvements.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Leadership and accountability
* Clear and structured communication
* Influence without authority
* Resilience and composure under pressure
* Collaboration across functions and geographies
* Execution focus and results orientation

**What We Offer**

Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
  
  
⏰

Make your workday suit your life and plans.
  
  
🌎

🌿

We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
  
  
🚀
**Professional Development:**
At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
**LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,**
and

title: Associate Director
description:
**Company:**
AIRIQ 365 LIMITED

**Department:**
Hotel Business – Procurement & Supply

**Open Positions:**
**3 – Delhi NCR – North | Bengaluru – South | Mumbai – West**

**Reporting To:**
Head – Hotel Business

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

Regular travel within the assigned region

**Role Overview**

The Regional Lead – Hotel Contracting will develop and manage AIRIQ’s hotel supply network within the assigned region. The role involves identifying suitable hotel partners, negotiating competitive commercial terms and securing inventory through pre-purchase arrangements and direct contracts, with distribution enabled through channel managers.

The position requires strong hotel relationships, commercial judgement and ownership of inventory availability, utilisation and profitability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Regional Supply Development**

* Build and execute the hotel contracting plan for the assigned region, covering key business cities, leisure destinations and emerging markets.
* Identify hotels based on agent demand, booking trends, destination potential, seasonality and market competition.
* Develop relationships with hotel owners, promoters, general managers, sales heads and revenue teams.
* Maintain a pipeline of hotel partnerships and expand coverage across independent hotels and hotel chains.

**2. Contracting and Commercial Negotiation**

* Negotiate pre-purchase arrangements, direct contracted rates, room blocks, rolling deposits and other approved inventory models.
* Finalise room categories, meal plans, occupancy terms, extra-person charges, taxes, blackout dates and peak-period supplements.
* Negotiate payment schedules, credit terms, release periods, cancellation policies, refunds and treatment of unutilised deposits.
* Secure competitive rates, priority inventory and favourable commercial terms.
* Prepare commercial proposals and coordinate internal approvals before confirming commitments.
* Ensure negotiated terms are accurately documented and contracts are executed through authorised signatories.

**3. Pre-Purchase and Inventory Management**

* Recommend hotel-wise inventory commitments based on demand forecasts, achievable selling rates and expected returns.
* Prepare acquisition plans for peak, shoulder and low-demand periods.
* Monitor room-night utilisation, unsold inventory, deposit balances and release deadlines.
* Coordinate corrective action through promotions, inventory adjustments and renegotiation of terms.
* Track hotel obligations and escalate inventory denial, rate discrepancies or breaches of agreed terms.

**4. Market Intelligence and Demand Mapping**

* Benchmark hotel rates and commercial terms against competing suppliers and distribution channels.
* Track festivals, weddings, conferences, exhibitions, sporting events and other demand drivers.
* Map major venues and nearby hotels to identify advance contracting opportunities.
* Share regional market intelligence with Revenue, Research, Sales and Leadership.

**5. Onboarding and Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate with Distribution and Technology teams for hotel onboarding through channel managers, APIs or the extranet.
* Ensure accurate property information, room descriptions, photographs, rate plans and booking policies are obtained.
* Work with Sales and Revenue teams on pricing, offers and inventory promotion.
* Support Operations in resolving hotel-related booking, availability and service escalations.
* Coordinate with Finance on advances, deposits, payments, reconciliations and recoveries.

**6. Reporting and Team Coordination**

* Maintain updated contracting pipelines, agreement trackers and regional performance reports.
* Review hotel productivity, commercial performance and upcoming inventory requirements.
* Guide regional procurement executives and coordinate with consultants, where applicable.

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in hospitality, tourism or business management is preferred.
* Typically
  **10–12 years of relevant experience**
  in hotel contracting, hotel procurement or hotel supply development.
* Strong relationships with hotels and decision-makers in the assigned region.
* Experience with a B2B travel company, OTA, bed bank, tour operator or hotel distribution business.
* Proven ability to negotiate hotel rates, inventory commitments and payment terms.
* Working understanding of pre-purchase risk, margins, inventory utilisation and hotel distribution.
* Strong communication, negotiation, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.
* Proficiency in Excel and commercial reporting.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Productive hotels contracted and activated.
* Coverage of priority destinations and high-demand hotels.
* Competitiveness of contracted rates and commercial terms.
* Availability and utilisation of contracted inventory.
* Room nights, revenue and contribution generated from the regional portfolio.
* Utilisation and recovery of advances and deposits.
* Contracting pipeline conversion and onboarding turnaround time.
* Accuracy of contracts, trackers and commercial records.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – HR MANAGER

**Company:**
All India Institute of Occult Science

**Department:**
Human Resources

**Experience:**
4–5 Years

**Salary:**
₹4 LPA – ₹7.2 LPA

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
On-site

About the Role

All India Institute of Occult Science is looking for a result-oriented and technically strong HR Manager who can independently manage HR operations, payroll processing, statutory compliance, and employee-related matters. The ideal candidate must possess practical, execution-level knowledge of EPFO/PF compliance, ECR filing, PF challans, TDS, statutory returns, compliance audits, and EPFO notices.

We are looking for a professional who can take complete ownership of HR functions, resolve complex compliance issues, maintain accuracy in payroll, and ensure timely statutory submissions without excessive dependence on external consultants.

Key Responsibilities1. HR Operations & Employee Management

* Manage end-to-end HR operations, including onboarding, employee documentation, attendance, leave management, employee records, and exit formalities.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, HR policies, and workplace issues.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and ensure proper documentation.
* Coordinate with management on manpower planning, employee performance, and HR requirements.

2. Payroll Management

* Independently manage monthly payroll processing, including attendance validation, LOP calculations, salary revisions, arrears, deductions, and full-and-final settlements.
* Verify payroll inputs and ensure accurate salary calculations and timely salary disbursement.
* Reconcile payroll data with attendance records, employee master data, bank statements, and statutory deductions.
* Investigate and resolve salary discrepancies, incorrect deductions, and employee payroll complaints.
* Maintain payroll registers, salary statements, and supporting documentation.

3. EPFO / PF Compliance – Critical Requirement

* Independently manage monthly EPFO compliance, including PF calculations, ECR preparation, validation, and filing.
* Generate, verify, and reconcile PF challans and ensure timely payment of statutory dues.
* Handle UAN-related issues, employee PF complaints, missing contributions, and ECR errors.
* Reconcile payroll PF deductions with ECR records, challans, and applicable EPFO records.
* Investigate and resolve PF contribution mismatches and rejected ECR submissions.
* Handle EPFO notices, inspections, audits, queries, and related documentation.
* Coordinate with EPFO authorities and prepare appropriate responses and supporting records.
* Maintain accurate PF registers, employee contribution records, challans, returns, and compliance documentation.

4. TDS, Taxation & Other Statutory Compliance

* Manage or coordinate employee salary TDS calculations, declarations, investment proofs, tax projections, and year-end reconciliation.
* Review TDS deductions following salary revisions and changes in employee tax declarations.
* Coordinate timely TDS deposits, applicable returns, and related documentation.
* Ensure applicable ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, and other statutory obligations are met.
* Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and track filing dates, payments, returns, and acknowledgements.
* Identify compliance gaps, take corrective action, and minimise the risk of penalties or notices.

5. Compliance Audits & Management Reporting

* Prepare payroll and statutory records for internal audits, external audits, and government inspections.
* Maintain organised records of ECR filings, challans, payroll registers, TDS documents, and statutory returns.
* Prepare HR MIS reports covering payroll, employee strength, attendance, compliance status, and pending issues.
* Provide regular compliance updates to management and highlight risks with corrective action plans.
* Ensure that all applicable statutory obligations are completed accurately and within prescribed timelines.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in HR operations, payroll management, and statutory compliance.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience in EPFO/PF, ECR filing, PF challans, reconciliation, and employee PF matters.
* Practical exposure to EPFO notices, audits, inspections, and compliance-related queries.
* Strong working knowledge of salary TDS, payroll taxation, and applicable statutory filings.
* Experience in handling payroll discrepancies, statutory mismatches, and deadline-driven compliance issues.
* Good command of MS Excel, payroll systems, HR MIS, and compliance documentation.
* Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain strict confidentiality.

Mandatory Selection Criteria

**This position requires practical execution, not merely theoretical knowledge.**

**Candidates must be able to explain the actual steps they have personally performed for:**

* Monthly payroll processing and reconciliation.
* ECR preparation, validation, filing, and error resolution.
* PF challan generation, payment, and reconciliation.
* Resolving UAN issues and missing PF contributions.
* Handling EPFO notices, audits, and inspections.
* Salary TDS calculations and applicable statutory filings.

Candidates whose experience is limited to coordinating with consultants, forwarding documents, or having theoretical knowledge of payroll and PF compliance will not be suitable for this role.

Key Performance Expectations

* Accurate and timely payroll processing.
* Timely completion of applicable statutory filings and payments.
* Effective resolution of payroll and PF discrepancies.
* Proper maintenance of statutory records and audit documentation.
* Proactive identification and resolution of compliance risks.
* Independent ownership of HR operations and statutory compliance.

**Ideal Candidate:**
A technically sound HR professional who can independently manage HR operations, payroll, EPFO/PF compliance, TDS coordination, statutory documentation, and audit-related responsibilities while providing reliable support to management.

* **Apply Now:**
  Candidates with strong hands-on payroll and statutory compliance experience are encouraged to apply.

title: Founder's Office
description:
Full-time · Some travel

Antahā

Antahā is a global movement creating micro-communities across major cities to address loneliness at scale. Built on three core values: Compassion, Connection, Community.

The ambition is large. The method is intimate. Loneliness is not solved by reach alone, by digital tools, or by any system that removes the human from the centre. It is solved by people who actually show up — for one another, for an evening, for a quiet space to belong in.

**About the Work**

Sitender Sehrawat is a teacher shaped by years of monastic living in the Himalayas. His work spans teaching, hosting signature events and intimate gatherings, and private one-on-one consulting. The work is active across Europe, the US, and the Gulf, and it is scaling fast across cities and continents.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Founder's Office Manager to be the operational spine of everything Sitender does. The bridge between Sitender and the world— the person who holds the whole picture, ensures nothing is dropped, and protects the founder's time for the work only he can do: teaching, hosting, and building.

You will run the day-to-day across event logistics, the founder's speaking and teaching calendar, marketing, and social media — the full surface area of a founder's office. This role suits someone equal parts organised and intuitive: capable of managing a tour spreadsheet down to the last detail and sensing what a moment, a room, or a relationship needs. You will work closely with a distributed team across India, Europe, and the US.

**What You Will Do**

* Own end-to-end event logistics — venues, vendors, travel, run-of-show, and on-ground coordination for events, gatherings, and retreats
* Manage the founder's speaking and teaching calendar — inbound requests, scheduling, preparation, and follow-up
* Drive marketing execution across channels — campaigns, partner briefs, content scheduling, and asset coordination
* Run social media end-to-end — posting, community engagement, growth, and maintaining a consistent voice and aesthetic
* Coordinate across a distributed team and external collaborators spanning multiple time zones
* Keep the office of the founder moving — inbox triage, prioritisation, and ensuring projects don't stall
* Anticipate needs before they arise, so the founder can stay present to the work

**Who You Are**

*Essential*

* 3+ years in operations, executive support, chief-of-staff, or founder's office roles
* Exceptional organiser who thrives across many moving parts without losing the details
* Strong written communicator with a feel for brand voice and visual consistency
* Comfortable owning social media and marketing execution
* Calm under pressure, discreet, and self-directed — you don't need to be managed
* Drawn to the work of stillness and inner growth, and at ease in a space that values presence over noise

*Preferred*

* Experience supporting a founder, executive, or public-facing figure
* Background in events, hospitality, or a fast-moving operation with many moving parts
* A personal practice in meditation, somatic work, or related modalities
* Multilingual (Italian, Arabic, or others a plus)

**Personal Qualities**

* You hold complexity calmly — many threads at once, nothing dropped
* Quiet confidence and sound judgement; people trust you with what matters
* Discretion, depth, and integrity in all things
* A genuine desire to grow through this work, inwardly as well as professionally

**What You Receive**

* Competitive compensation, with structure and benefits discussed directly based on experience and location
* A rare seat at the centre of a growing body of work — teaching, events, and a movement being planted across cities worldwide
* Direct collaboration with the founder and a depth of perspective few roles offer
* Access to all events and sessions as a participant — your own growth is part of the role
* Room to grow as the work expands across the US, Europe, the Gulf, and beyond

**Education & Background**

We don't pay much attention to where you went to school — or whether you did. A degree is welcome but not necessary. What matters is capability, character, and care. We're looking for the kind of person whose reliability and judgement have shaped the path they've walked, however unconventional that path has been.

**Compensation & Onboarding**

This role begins with an 8-week probation period. During these first eight weeks, you'll be paid a mutually agreed figure while we both find our rhythm and see the work in motion. On successful completion — based on performance and delivery — you'll step into the role permanently, with a full CTC
upwards
of 6 LPA, commensurate with experience and growing as the work expands across cities.

**To Apply**

Send a personal note to hello@antaha.org — not just a CV. Tell us who you are, what draws you to this work, and why this role calls to you. We won't respond to generic applications; we're looking for a specific kind of human being, and we'll know when we find them.

www.antaha.org

www.sitendersehrawat.com

title: Buyer & Sourcing Manager
description:
The Sourcing Manager will be responsible for leading and driving sourcing activities for the PIP India
  
  
organization. This role reports directly to the India ISC Head and can be based in Pune, Mumbai, or
  
  
Delhi. The position requires strong leadership in supplier management, cost optimization, and strategic
  
  
sourcing to support business growth and operational excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* New Product Development (NPD):
* Prepare RFQs, identify suppliers, analyze quotations and commercial proposals.
* Conduct cost evaluations, negotiate with suppliers, finalize agreements, and oversee

PPAP approvals.
  
  

* Bill of Materials (BOM):
* Collaborate with engineering teams to finalize BOMs.
* Evaluate and validate costing for each part.
* Direct & Indirect Procurement Focus:
* Procure finished goods to support customer demand requirements.
* Procure services, MRO items, facilities-related purchases, IT equipment, professional

services, and other indirect spend categories.
  
  

* Procurement Activities:
* Manage end-to-end procurement activities for direct materials and indirect

goods/services to support business operations.
  
  

* Source, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers to achieve optimal cost,

quality, delivery, and service performance.
  
  

* Create, process, and manage purchase orders while ensuring compliance

with procurement policies and approval requirements.
  
  

* Monitor supplier delivery performance and proactively resolve supply,

quality, and operational issues.
  
  

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Operations, Supply Chain,

Finance, HR, IT, and Business Functions to understand purchasing
  
  
requirements and drive timely execution.
  
  

* Conduct market analysis and identify opportunities for cost savings, supplier

consolidation, and process improvements.
  
  

* Maintain accurate procurement records, supplier master data, contracts, and

purchasing documentation.
  
  

* Support supplier relationship management, contract renewals, and

performance reviews to ensure continuity of supply and service excellence.
  
  

* Commodity & Cost Management:
* Monitor commodity price trends and conduct supplier cost negotiations.
* Drive cost reduction initiatives through value analysis and value engineering (VAVE).
* Vendor Management:
* Conduct supplier risk analysis, evaluation, and rating based on QCD parameters.
* Develop and implement supplier improvement plans.
* Manage supplier relationships and resolve grievances effectively.
* New Vendor Development:
* Assess vendor capacity, production cycle times, and readiness for new product setups.
* Support localization initiatives and vendor consolidation.
* Operational Excellence:
* Set and achieve annual targets for cost reduction, program launches, and supplier

performance.
  
  

* Negotiate tooling costs, manage amortization/recovery, and draft tooling agreements.
* Ensure productivity improvements, rejection control, and business assurance.
* Benchmark costs and monitor cost walk trends over time.
* Capacity & Material Planning:
* Align supplier capacity with production schedules to meet material requirements.
* Monitor raw material planning and procurement schedules.
* Expedite materials to support fast ramp-up of NPIs and ensure timely customer

deliveries.
  
  

* Technology & Systems:
* Support acquisition of new manufacturing technologies to maintain competitiveness.
* Demonstrate proficiency in ERP/SAP systems.
* Negotiate stocking agreements and vendor-managed inventory (VMI).
* Manage IOS compliance internally and at supplier sites.
* Collaboration & Due Diligence:
* Work closely with cross-functional teams (CFT) and design engineering.
* Support ISC due diligence processes for supplier partnerships and key players.
* Conduct quarterly supplier visits to strengthen relationships and address

capacity/quality issues.
  
  

* Communication:
* Exhibit strong communication skills to interact with global suppliers and internal

teams.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or MBA (Master’s degree preferred).
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in strategic sourcing.
* Proven track record in successfully managing new projects.
* Strong knowledge of vendor management, procurement and strategic sourcing practices.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel up to 25%.
* Understanding of local market opportunities.
* Six Sigma Green Belt; Lean Expert/Black Belt certification is an added advantage.

**Other Requirements**

* Entrepreneurial mindset with agility and flexibility.
* Demonstrated contribution to business growth.
* Strong financial and business acumen.
* High integrity and strong value systems.
* Experience in setting up new business operations is an added advantage.

title: Lead, Support Operations Excellence
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
  
  
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
  
  
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
  
  
The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox's Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution. The team provides support to Roblox's global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Lead, Product Support Ops on our Safety Ops Team, you’ll be mentor and lead the team that is focused on Escalations, Product Reliability, Process Improvement and Design and plays a critical role in managing and resolving escalations and high-impact incidents affecting our Roblox users and platform. Your team will be responsible for identifying trends, enhancing support processes, improving agent efficiency, and reducing operational costs while maintaining high reliability and service quality.
  
  
You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager and leading the Support Operations Excellence team, providing coverage across billing, accounts, creator, and adjacent domains. This is a player-coach role, weighted toward leadership. You'll still go deep on the hardest problems and stay close enough to the work to be a genuine execution expert, but your primary leverage is the team, and you'll be measured on what they collectively deliver.
  
  
The Product Support Management (PSM) team is your most important partner. You and your team supply the synthesis, evidence, and prioritization that enable PSM and engineering to fix problems at the source, and you are accountable for the quality of what reaches them.
  
  
**You Will**
**Lead and develop the team**

* Manage, coach, and grow a team of four Product Support Specialists (Process Excellence team), owning onboarding, performance, and career development. You’ll set direction and hold the quality of output for the team. Coach them to grow their scope and operate with independence.
* Set clear standards for what good looks like at each level, and give direct, specific, and frequent feedback against them.
* Represent the team's work, constraints, and priorities to leadership and to cross-functional partners.

**Partner with the Product Support Management team**

* Serve as the primary point of contact between the Product Support Specialists team and Product Support Managers (PSM's), ensuring the issues your team surfaces arrive with the synthesis, evidence, and recommendation needed to act on them.
* Own the quality bar for what your team escalates into the PSM and engineering prioritization process.
* Ensure RCAs are completed, documented, socialized with the right stakeholders, and work with the PSM team to ensure they are translated into changes that prevent recurrence.
* Step in personally on the highest-stakes and most ambiguous problems, and partner with the PSM team to make the call when the path forward is unclear.

**Drive support health and operational excellence**

* Co-own the health of product support across your domains: contact drivers, resolution rates, reopen and escalation rates, deflection performance, CSAT, and where users are getting stuck.
* Turn patterns into prioritized action: recurring issues, missing coverage, misleading documentation, and product gaps get surfaced with a recommendation.
* Hold the line on quality standards, tighten workflows and handoffs between support, engineering, and product, and eliminate manual toil through better process and tooling.
* Support Launches:

+ Get ahead of launches: make sure upcoming product and policy changes are pressure-tested from a support perspective, and that content, tooling, and agent readiness are in place before users feel the change.
+ Contribute to the successful launch of new support streams and initiatives by providing subject matter expertise, process guidance, and team capacity.

* Partner closely with the PSM team to establish a regular feedback loop on support health proactively identifying areas of strength, flagging degrading performance, and driving actionable mitigation plans.
* Vendor & Escalation Quality: Partner with vendor operations (BPO/Tier 1) to establish feedback loops that improve first-contact resolution, reduce bad escalations, and ensure frontline agents are enabled on critical product changes.

**Knowledge & Support ContentOwn knowledge and scaled support**

* Co-own the accuracy/ information within support content that agents depend on along with PSMs, ensuring workflows, policies and guidance are accurate and up to date. Ensure support content which includes but is not limited to, troubleshooting guides, decision trees, structured resolution paths, policy interpretations are clear, current, and reliable for the support agents who use it.
* Partner with Knowledge Management, Training, and Quality teams to align documentation, agent enablement, and quality control with what the data says users actually need.

**You Have**

* 8+ years in technical support, product support, or a comparable operational role, including significant time at a senior or escalation tier.
* Direct people management experience, including ownership of performance and career development, with a track record of developing individuals and raising the collective performance of a team.
* A demonstrated track record of independent root cause analysis on complex technical issues, and the judgment to know when to go deep yourself and when to delegate.
* Experience owning incident response for high-severity issues, including coordinating cross-functional teams under time pressure.
* Breadth across multiple support domains, or clear evidence you can get up to speed on an unfamiliar one quickly.
* Excellent written communication. You can explain a nuanced technical failure to an engineer, to a frustrated user, and to leadership, and all three come away clearer.
* Strong cross-functional influence without authority.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You set direction for your team when the problem space is not yet well defined.
* Willingness to participate in on-call support when needed.

**You Are**

* A Leader: Your team does better work because of you, and that shows up in their output and their growth.
* Analytical: Excited to investigate large, ambiguous problems, and to measure both the problems and the solutions.
* A proactive problem solver: You anticipate problems and take decisive action rather than waiting for them to escalate to you.
* Team-oriented: You lift up your peers and find ways to make the wider organization stronger, not just your own team.
* Data-driven: You use data to identify trends, measure results, and drive decisions.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience owning support content at scale, with real evidence that content changed outcomes (deflection, handle time, resolution quality).
* Experience building or scaling a support team through a period of significant growth or change.
* Prior experience supporting a developer, creator, or partner audience alongside a general consumer base.
* Experience working with BPO or outsourced support partners.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
  
  
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
  
  
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

**About us\***

title: Head - Project Commercial (GM/AVP)
description:
**Job Title:**
GM / AVP – Project Commercial (Corporate Role)

**Job Objective:**

To manage the commercial and procurement functions for a new project or any major renovation/expansion of an existing unit. This includes the commercial oversight of OPEX/CAPEX purchases, procurement of various commodities, equipment, and other project-related requirements while ensuring cost efficiency, risk management, and compliance as per laid processes & guidelines. Manage all vendor contracts and commercial agreements, maintain excellent professional relationships with service providers, and optimize cost, quality, and timelines for project execution.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Drive the commercial strategy and manage the end-to-end procurement and contract lifecycle from planning to execution, ensuring alignment with the project budget and financial objectives.
* Conduct a comprehensive commercial evaluation of the scope, quantity & quality, ensuring an optimized procurement and sourcing strategy. Have the entire requirement document (RFP) in place to initiate bid management.
* Evaluate responses from bidders, shortlist and negotiate with vendors/service providers, and finalize cost-effective contracts with optimal quality and service levels (SLA’s, timelines, and performance standards).
* Ensure timely and cost-efficient procurement & availability of all items while mitigating risks related to price fluctuations, supplier performance, and regulatory compliance.
* Manage and oversee commercial contracts, procurement policies, and governance frameworks to ensure alignment with organizational goals and compliance.
* Implement robust cost-control mechanisms to track budgets, expenditures, and cost variances while ensuring adherence to financial approvals and governance norms.
* Oversee vendor risk assessment and ensure that all contractual obligations are met, including adherence to quality standards, delivery timelines, and service-level agreements.
* Manage inventory & distribution/indenting process, forecasting future consumption loads for an optimum inventory level.
* Track all service orders, receipts, invoices, and payments with a strong focus on commercial efficiency and financial tracking in collaboration with the Finance team.
* Excellent collaboration with cross-functional teams like Finance, Legal, Projects, construction partners, and other stakeholders to ensure commercial objectives are met.
* Manage all documentation requirements related to procurement, contracts, and compliance, ensuring adherence to legal and regulatory standards.
* Plan for department manpower requirements and utilize all team members efficiently.
* Continuously identify cost-saving opportunities through vendor negotiations, alternate sourcing, and process optimizations.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* **Commercial Acumen:**
  Strong understanding of procurement, vendor management, contract negotiations, and financial control.
* **Project Procurement & Sourcing:**
  Expertise in sourcing CAPEX/OPEX materials, equipment, and services while optimizing costs.
* **Contract Management:**
  Experience in handling legal contracts, vendor agreements, and service-level negotiations.
* **Financial & Budget Management:**
  Ability to track and control costs, budget adherence, and financial forecasting.
* **Risk Management & Compliance:**
  Expertise in mitigating procurement risks, supplier risks, and regulatory compliance.
* **Stakeholder & Vendor Management:**
  Strong relationship management with internal and external stakeholders, including suppliers and service providers.
* **Negotiation & Cost Optimization:**
  Ability to drive cost efficiencies, negotiate best-value contracts, and manage supplier performance.
* **Process Improvement & Governance:**
  Implementing best practices for procurement, inventory control, and contract management.
* **Analytical & Decision-Making Skills:**
  Strong data-driven approach to procurement, project cost analysis, and vendor selection.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Ability to work closely with Finance, Legal, Projects, and Operations teams.

**Location:**
Gurgaon (Corporate Office)

**Work days:**
6 Days from Office
