At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****Role Summary And Impact****
As part of our Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will partner with teams across the U.S., Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact, integrated media planning solutions across multiple markets and channels.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Manager – Media Planning who will:
  
  

* Lead end-to-end planning operations across multiple campaigns, brands, or markets while ensuring consistency in quality, timelines, and strategic output.
* Support Associate Directors and market stakeholders in developing integrated media planning recommendations aligned with business and campaign objectives.
* Act as a key escalation point for operational and planning-related challenges across the team.
* Drive excellence in campaign planning deliverables, including audience strategy, channel allocation, forecasting, reporting frameworks, and post-campaign analysis.
* Collaborate closely with Activation, Ad Operations, Analytics, and Client Servicing teams to ensure seamless execution of media plans.
* Ensure planning best practices, governance standards, and documentation processes are consistently followed across the team.
* Support implementation and adoption of planning tools, automation solutions, and operational efficiencies.
* Monitor team productivity, delivery quality, and workload allocation to ensure optimal operational performance.
* Provide coaching, mentorship, and developmental guidance to Managers, Senior Executives, and Executives.
* Contribute to capability-building initiatives, knowledge-sharing forums, and process improvement projects.
* Foster a collaborative and high-performing team culture focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.

****Skills And Experience****

* Media Planning teams are experts on the digital media landscape and how consumers interact with it. We architect and steward holistic media plans throughout their lifecycle, owning the creation of overall plans, cross-channel budget allocation, in-flight cross-channel optimization & reporting and post-campaign analysis. We are our clients’ key contacts for a unified view across all aspects of their campaigns, narrating the story of the campaign from planning recommendation through to PCA.
* 6–8 years of experience in media planning, integrated communications planning, or digital strategy roles, preferably within a global agency environment.
* Strong understanding of integrated media channels including digital, social, search, commerce, video, programmatic, impact buys and other non biddable emerging media.
* Proven experience managing teams in a fast-paced offshore/onshore delivery setup.
* Experience handling multi-market campaigns and collaborating with global stakeholders.
* Strong operational mindset with experience managing workflows, quality standards, and process governance.
* Excellent analytical and strategic thinking capabilities with a data-driven approach to planning and optimization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively.
* Experience with media planning tools, reporting dashboards, and planning frameworks.
* Strong presentation and storytelling capabilities.
* Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and drive operational efficiencies.
* Strong coaching and people management skills with experience developing high-performing teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a dynamic environment.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
Join us as an " Assistant Manager " at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
**About Corporate Banking**
Corporate Banking provides integrated banking solutions, specialist advice, products and services to businesses of all sizes, multi-national companies, financial institutions and multinationals in non-UK markets.
  
  
**About Deal Support Team**
The Deal Support Team (DST) was setup in May 2008 with an objective to provide support to the Corporate and Business Banking origination teams through research and analysis. It provides end to end support in the deal value chain, right from prospect generation to pitchbook and engagement books to support initial client meeting or annual discussions with the existing customers.­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­ Also supporting with ancillary services through the Coverage Support Hub.
  
  
**Overall Purpose Of Role**
Working within a Coverage Support Hub to provide first class operational support to frontline Corporate Banking UK Coverage colleagues through the completion of defined tasks including but not limited to Annual Review Process and KYC review, Transaction Monitoring, Pricing Review etc. creating capacity for Associate Bankers and Relationship Directors to focus on the key business objectives.
  
  
  

* Working within Coverage Support Hub (Deal Support Team), to provide first class operational support to UK Corporate Banking frontline colleagues (RDs/ABs) through the completion of defined activities, thereby creating capacity for them to focus on the key business objectives
* Collaborating with frontline colleagues for successful execution of essential, business critical procedures and templates within dedicated area of work, which provide significant value to the whole of UK Corporate Coverage
* Key responsibilities: BAU deliveries (70%); Training & quality management (10%); Workflow management, Reporting, Creating dashboards and presentations (10%); Simplification & Automation (10%)

**Process Specific Skillset**
**Key Skills Required for this role (Basic/ Essential Qualifications):**

* Experience of working in a MNC Bank/Financial Services organisation in backend/operational processes such as Annual Review Process, KYC Refresh, Pricing & Billing, Transaction Monitoring, Payments etc.
* Precision in undertaking critical administrative activities and ensuring all information is accurate and aligned with standard operating procedures at all times
* Leading the training and learning agenda for colleagues - Ability to guide and mentor team members and embed a Consistently Excellent mindset across the team
* Conducting quality checks to ensure high standards of work for self and the team
* Preparing reports, presentations, and leadership dashboards to depict performance and improvement initiatives to management & stakeholders
* Experience in Workflow Management to ensure smooth and efficient allocation within the team
* Stay up-to date on industry best practices & trends in operations management
* Understand the importance of risk and control in line with the ambitions of the Bank- Identify and mitigate process risks to ensure business continuity
* Drive continuous improvement to review & streamline processes. Develop and implement improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency & productivity

**Other Skills**

* Ability to prioritise & manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to support and/or execute ad-hoc initiatives, projects or remediation activity, as required
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to interact with internal teams and stakeholders
* Team player with the ability to work cross-functionally with various departments and teams
* Proficient in MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and SharePoint)
* Knowledge and understanding of the financial services industry, in particular corporate or investment banking products
* Flexible to work in shifts, particularly UK

**Some of Highly Valued Skills (Desired Skills/ Desirable skillsets/ good to have) :**

* Preferably a Postgraduate or MBA or MBA equivalent
* Experience in the banking/ middle office or related field
* Develop and maintain network of contacts within relevant specialist areas and projects; ensure business and process knowledge is up to date; use expert knowledge to positively influence decisions
* Ability to think critically and act decisively in high-pressure situations to resolve issues swiftly

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Gurugram.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To support coverage to grow income for both new and existing customers by providing marketing leading tools, a world class learning & development programme as well as analytical support in terms of sales management tools to contribute to the overall success of UKC.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Design, execution and embedding of an ongoing roadmap to provides market leading Tools for RDs and Coverage.
* Design, execution and embedding of an ongoing training plan to provide ‘World Class Learning’.
* Support the delivery of market leading client collateral to provide a competitive advantage to RDs. .
* Collaboration with Product to develop market leading industry/segment focused products and multi product solutions and develop and drive initiatives.
* Development of the data capability across UK Corporate to enable delivery of client insights to drive acquisitions and increase wallet share.
* Maximise the positive impact of UCRM and Salesforce as a tool for Corporate Banking.
* Implementation of agreed minimum standards and best practices across UK Corporate and support this with sales management tools to drive overall success.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Nursing Supervisor & Facility Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Omsorg Assisted Living provides structured step-down care for individuals who are medically stable but not yet ready to live independently at home. The facility offers continuous monitoring, nursing support, medication management, physiotherapy coordination, and assistance with daily activities in a non-hospital environment. This model helps reduce complications, readmissions, and gaps in recovery while maintaining continuity of care for patients, families, and clinicians. For healthcare professionals, Omsorg serves as a reliable extension of treatment, and for families, it offers clarity, safety, and confidence during the recovery process.
  
**Role Description**
The Nursing Supervisor & Facility Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram, responsible for overseeing nursing operations and overall facility management at Omsorg Assisted Living. This role includes supervising nursing staff, coordinating patient care plans, ensuring safe medication administration, and maintaining high standards of clinical practice and documentation. The individual will manage day-to-day facility operations, including staffing, shift scheduling, equipment and supplies, and adherence to health, safety, and regulatory guidelines. The role involves close collaboration with physicians, physiotherapists, families, and other care providers to ensure continuity of care and effective communication. The Nursing Supervisor & Facility Manager will also support quality improvement initiatives, staff training, and the implementation of best practices in assisted living and step-down care.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong expertise in Nursing Management, including supervision of clinical teams and coordination of nursing services.
* Solid foundation in Nursing and Medicine, with the ability to understand treatment plans and collaborate effectively with physicians.
* Experience in Critical Care Medicine or step-down/rehabilitation settings, with the ability to recognize and respond to changes in patient conditions.
* Demonstrated commitment to high-quality Patient Care, including monitoring, medication administration, and support with daily activities.
* Relevant nursing qualification (e.g., B.Sc. Nursing or equivalent) and current professional licensure/registration as required.
* Previous experience in supervisory or managerial roles within healthcare or assisted living facilities.
* Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams.
* Knowledge of infection control, safety protocols, and healthcare documentation standards.
* Ability to work flexible hours when needed to support round-the-clock operations.

title: Senior Manager, Safety
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Community You Will Join**
No global movement springs from individuals. It takes an entire team united behind something big. On the Delivery team at Airbnb, we're proud to be at the forefront of the sharing economy. We recognize that we are the leaders of a new, worldwide phenomenon, and that's why we're working so hard to build the world's most loyal travel community.
  
  
Together, our team provides support to more than 100 million lifetime guests and 3 million listings in over 191 countries. Our India Global operations hub delivers several of Community Support's most sensitive and complex specialty services, working as one team with our global process leads. We are looking for an agile, operationally strong leader who knows how to motivate and inspire teams in a cutting-edge and fast-paced environment.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**
As a Senior Manager, Safety you will own end-to-end delivery for a portfolio of Global Operation's most sensitive and highest-severity specialty services, spanning close to 200 team members across Specialists, Team Specialists, Supervisors and Managers. You will be accountable for KPIs, people and the overall health of the business, with direct exposure to user-safety, regulatory and financial-loss risk and the authority to make final calls on complex, irreversible decisions.
  
  
You will act as senior delivery partner to the global process leads for your services — translating global agendas into on-the-ground execution and giving those leads a single accountable counterpart at site. You will be expected to build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders while constantly looking for opportunities to streamline and optimize our operations. As our portfolio evolves, you should expect the mix of services in scope to change, and be comfortable picking up new skills and queues as the business requires.
  
  
**A Typical Day**
*Drive delivery performance across the portfolio:*

* Manage the day-to-day operations of the services in scope, driving the highest level of performance from the teams and establishing the right performance management and coaching structure and cadence in collaboration with Delivery leaders and Quality teams
* Define, monitor, report and improve efficiency and quality metrics for each service based on its performance scorecard, keeping Global operations in India aligned to global standards while accounting for local nuance
* Adapt and pre-empt adaptations of the performance management structure based on shifting business priorities, volume patterns and peak planning
* Bring a data-driven lens to occupancy, SLA, capacity and workforce decisions, and make timely calls when the numbers move

**Lead And Grow a Multi-layered Leadership Team**

* Lead a mixed layer of leadership — a Manager alongside Supervisors reporting in directly — which means being comfortable leading junior leadership hands-on rather than only through a manager layer
* Coach Supervisors on daily performance management as readily as you set quarterly direction, and stay close enough to the floor to spot execution gaps early
* Support Managers and Supervisors to ensure high employee engagement and delivery of a world class experience for both our community and our internal stakeholders
* Oversee team structure, recruitment, onboarding, training and upskilling plans, and build a credible succession and cross-skilling pipeline across the portfolio
* Be a focused, visible leader who creates supportive connections across the whole team through open communication, and who carries teams through change and periods of instability

**Partner With Global Process Leads And Eliminate Functional Silos**

* Stay ahead of global Ops priorities and make sure ACC delivery is set up to execute them — owning the on-the-ground landing of global programmes to timeline and quality
* Surface operational pain points early enough to influence global design rather than after the fact, and carry ACC best practice back into the global forums
* Work across services and with Quality, Training, Business Process Improvement, Analytics and WFM to eliminate functional and working silos, so process changes land consistently rather than function by function
* Feed insights into process, policy and tooling improvements, and drive relationships and coordinate requests with shared services teams
* Support the global consolidation agenda where ACC is scaling towards becoming the primary or sole servicing site for a skill, ensuring transitions land without disruption to the community

**Manage Senior And Executive Stakeholders**

* Be responsible and accountable for executive and senior leadership stakeholder management, adapting your communication to the audience and remaining flexible and available to our leaders
* Have a deep understanding and expertise of our operations, workflows, policies and systems, so you can assess cases yourself and make the right call on what needs to be done to solve our users' issues
* Represent ACC credibly in global forums, holding policy, quality and risk conversations independently

*Work with the long term in mind to reduce the volume and severity of complex cases:*

* Track and understand the common themes behind complex cases and escalations, close the loop, and set up the right forums to solve root causes with cross-functional teams across Global Ops
* Partner with cross-functional Airbnb teams to champion improvements to our process, policies and product that improve the customer experience and reduce community escalations

**Your Expertise**

* Strong end-to-end frontline operations management experience in a customer-facing environment, with a track record of owning KPIs, people and business health for a large team; overall experience of minimum 13 years.
* Highly agile — able to pick up new skills, services and queues quickly, and to re-prioritize as the portfolio and global agenda shift
* Advanced people leadership, performance management, coaching and mentoring experience, including leading through both a manager layer and direct supervisor relationships
* Comfortable operating hands-on with junior leadership: coaching Supervisors on daily execution while holding a longer-term agenda
* Ability to work in a high-pressure environment with visibility to sensitive, confidential and potentially traumatic content, and to support a team working with the same
* Experience in complex case management with VP-level stakeholders and above preferred; crisis management or Trust & Safety experience in a marketplace business is an advantage
* Strong influencing, presentation, interpersonal and teamwork skills — able to work collaboratively and consultatively across expansive business partner organizations, including global process leads and shared services
* Ability to handle multiple complex, fast-moving situations at once and make sound decisions with incomplete information
* Highly organized with strong project management skills, able to switch between very tactical, urgent work and long-term planning or programme management
* Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to operations
* High energy, strong attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize and deliver in a fast-paced environment
* Strong communication skills and the ability to take a team through significant change
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent required; MBA or other Master's degree preferred
* Ability to flex working hours to respond to global business demand; a high level of reactivity is expected
* Comfortable to work in 24\*7 rotational shifts with your team, and work from office in Gurugram.

**Our commitment to inclusion & belonging**
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**How We'll Take Care Of You**
Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
  
  
India Annual Pay Range
  
  
₹4,900,000—₹7,000,000 INR
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Operations Director
description:
**Overview**
**170+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.**
At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
  
  
Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our team of industry subject matter experts.
  
  
The Operations Director – Pinkerton India leads end-to-end service delivery across Pinkerton’s EPIC portfolio (Embed, Protect, Investigate, Consult) to ensure outstanding client outcomes, rigorous accountability, and optimal cost-to-value. This role orchestrates multi-service operations, vendor/partner networks, and internal teams to deliver on-time, in-scope, and within-budget results. The Director drives a culture of ownership, safety, integrity, vigilance, and excellence while scaling processes, enhancing quality, and meeting or exceeding contractual SLAs and KPIs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Serve as the senior operations point of contact for client accounts in India, aligning scope, priorities, and SLAs with Pinkerton’s EPIC model.
* Coordinate services and operational/administrative support needs; oversee dispatch, scheduling, and reporting across assignments and programs.
* Answer and triage escalations from clients, Directors, and Operations Coordinators, ensure swift, transparent communication and resolution.
* Communicate assignment/project expectations, timelines, risks, and success criteria to all parties; maintain impeccable documentation.
* Design, standardize, and enforce SOPs, operational playbooks for consistent delivery across regions and service lines.
* Manage workflows end-to-end; assign agents and specialist resources to specific assignments based on capability, compliance, and cost.
* Track program milestones and deadlines; monitor the status of assigned projects and initiate course-corrections proactively.
* Utilize scorecards to measure activities and outcomes (e.g., Deployable Assets programs), driving continuous improvement.
* Track results and issue reports on completed work, non-conformities, corrective and improvement plans; own CAPA closure.
* Ensure deadlines are met for scheduling, dispatching, audits, and post checks; verify outcomes (vendor hour approvals, virtual/onsite post checking).
* Send and manage external partner self-assessments and security questionnaires using approved web-based tools; drive timely completion and remediation.
* Lead root-cause analyses, implement preventive actions, and institutionalize lessons learned across teams and vendors.
* Build and govern a high-performing vendor ecosystem (including Global Alliance Members where applicable) with clear rate cards, SLAs, and compliance obligations.
* Negotiate, onboard, and performance-manage vendors; conduct QBRs, enforce service credits, and manage escalations to protect client outcomes and margin.
* Optimize vendor utilization, travel/logistics, and deployment patterns to balance speed, quality, risk, and cost.
* Own operational budgeting, forecasting, and margin protection; drive cost-per-outcome efficiency without compromising quality or safety.
* Implement demand planning, capacity models, and pricing/quoting discipline; monitor variance and initiate corrective actions.
* Improve invoice accuracy, WIP hygiene, and cycle times; partner with Finance on revenue recognition and profitability.
* Ensure compliance with PSARA, Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, Shops & Establishments, PoSH, client codes of conduct, and data privacy/information security requirements.
* Maintain audit readiness; coordinate internal/external audits and remediation plans.
* Champion agent safety through virtual and on-site post checks, journey management, and incident reporting protocols.
* Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing operations team; set clear goals and hold teams and vendors accountable.
* Foster a culture of integrity, vigilance, excellence, transparency, and client-obsession; recognize strong performance and address underperformance promptly.
* Drive change management and cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Finance, Legal, HR, and Regional Ops.
* All other duties, as assigned.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred. 12–15 years of progressive experience in corporate security/operations or adjacent services, including multi-vendor orchestration and client service delivery. Experience with escalation/crisis management, incident response coordination, and audit/quality systems. Certifications preferred: CPP, PSP, PMP, Lean Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) or equivalent.
  
  

* Accountability and ownership mindset; data-driven decisioning; strong financial acumen.
* Vendor negotiation, rate-card governance, and performance management.
* Program/Project management, capacity planning, and resource optimization.
* Risk assessment, SOP design, and continuous improvement (Kaizen/CAPA/RCA).
* High integrity, vigilance, and excellence aligned to Pinkerton values.
* Fluency in English and Hindi; additional Indian languages an advantage.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence at executive level.
* Proven leadership of national programs with measurable SLA/KPI achievement and cost optimization.
* Strong knowledge of India regulatory environment (PSARA, CLRA, Shops & Establishments, PoSH) and client compliance expectations.
* Proficiency with scheduling/dispatch platforms, CRM/ITSM tools (e.g., Salesforce/ServiceNow), and collaboration suites.
* Advanced Excel; reporting/BI (Power BI/Tableau) for scorecards and operational insights.
* Web-based tools for self-assessments/security questionnaires; audit and document control systems.

**Working Conditions**
With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;
  
  

* Regular computer usage.
* Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
* Frequent sitting, standing, and/or walking.
* Travel, as required.

Pinkerton is an equal opportunity employer to all applicants and positions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital/prenatal status, pregnancy/childbirth or related conditions, religion, creed, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any protected status by local, state, federal or country-specific law.

title: Service Delivery Leader
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end performance of the function across service, quality, productivity, financials, workforce, risk, and stakeholder outcomes
* Translate enterprise priorities into annual business plans, operating strategies, budgets, capacity plans, and measurable goals
* Lead a large, multi-layered organization through Service Delivery Managers, Deputy Managers, Supervisors, and operational teams
* Ensure delivery against SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, customer commitments, and regulatory or business-control requirements
* Drive Open Enrollment and peak-season readiness across staffing, training, technology, capacity, governance, and contingency planning
* Own budgeting, forecasting, utilization, productivity, cost optimization, and delivery of financial commitments
* Lead OBRs, QBRs, executive reviews, strategic planning discussions, and critical business escalations.
* Build trusted relationships with onshore leaders, clients, and cross-functional partners
* Define and sponsor the functional transformation agenda, including automation, AI, analytics, process simplification, and operating-model improvements
* Proactively identify operational and customer risks and ensure timely mitigation, escalation, and sustainable corrective actions
* Build leadership capability through coaching, succession planning, talent development, and clearly defined accountability
* Partner with Product, Technology, Finance, Workforce Management, Quality, Training, Compliance, and other business functions
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, employee engagement, and continuous improvement
* Leadership Expectations

+ Operate with an enterprise mindset and make decisions based on overall business value
+ Demonstrate solid executive presence, business acumen, and decision-making capability
+ Own outcomes across operations, customer experience, people, financials, risk, and transformation
+ Challenge the status quo and promote scalable, technology-enabled solutions
+ Build a solid leadership pipeline and create an accountable, inclusive, and high-performing organization
+ Anticipate business risks and opportunities rather than responding only after issues arise.

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Candidate should be Graduate
* Overall experience of 15+ years, including significant experience leading large and complex operational functions
* Proven experience managing through multiple levels of leadership, including Service Delivery Managers or equivalent roles
* Experience in budgeting, forecasting, capacity planning, productivity management, cost optimization, and business-case development
* Experience in workforce strategy, organizational design, leadership development, and succession planning
* Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of service delivery, people, financials, quality, risk, and stakeholder outcomes
* Solid understanding of Open Enrollment, AEP, Case Installation, Benefit Content, Benefit Configuration, ODM, or comparable healthcare operations
* Demonstrated success in leading transformation, automation, process redesign, or technology-enabled change
* Solid executive communication, business presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping, root-cause analysis, and operational excellence practices
* Ability to interpret complex business data and convert insights into strategic and operational decisions
* Willingness to work from the office and provide leadership support during business-aligned shifts, peak seasons, holidays, or critical delivery periods
* Interpersonal Skills:

+ Excellent verbal and written communication skills
+ Creative, responsive and adaptive in a dynamic environment and a good team player
+ Adhere & drive all established company policies & procedures
+ Ability to work independently and creatively research and implement new solutions
+ Ability to work under pressure and deliver within required turn-around times
+ Should be flexible to adapt to quick delivery models
+ Should be flexible to work in Evening/Night Shifts - 6:00/8:30 PM Shift throughout the year
+ Flexible to support the team during holidays and work extended hours as per the Business requirement

title: Admin and Operations Manager
description:
Who we are

PlutoPe is an all-round solution for regulated finance and digital assets. Payments, payouts, settlements — whatever a business needs to move money, we provide it. We're a small team moving fast, and we need someone who keeps the whole machine running.

The role, in one line

You make things happen. Office, operations, vendors, paperwork, people, chaos — if it needs doing, it's yours until it's done.

What you'll own

* **Office:**
   setup, supplies, vendors, maintenance, access, internet, everything that keeps the place working.
* **Startup operations:**
   onboarding, documentation, vendor and bank follow-ups, travel, events, invoices and reimbursements.
* **Founder support:**
   calendars, meetings, notes, action items, chasing people until things close.
* **Systems:**
   turn every recurring task into a documented, repeatable process. If we do it twice, it gets a system.
* **Anything else:**
   you pick up whatever falls through the cracks. The list grows with you.

Who you are

* **Stubborn about outcomes.**
   You don't stop at the first "no" — you find another route, another person, another way.
* **Zero "not my job" energy.**
   If it's broken and nobody owns it, you own it.
* **Resourceful.**
   When the standard process is slow or broken, you find a smarter path that still gets it done right.
* **Obsessively organised.**
   Trackers, SOPs, folders, naming conventions. Nothing lives only in your head.
* **Claude power user.**
   You use Claude daily for drafting, research, summarising and automating busywork — projects, skills and connectors aren't new to you.
* **Great note-taker.**
   Every meeting ends with clean notes and clear owners. Notion (or similar) is your second brain.
* **Clear communicator**
   in English and Hindi, comfortable dealing with vendors, banks and government offices.

Nice to have

* 1–3 years in operations, admin or an executive-assistant role at a startup.
* Exposure to fintech, crypto or banking paperwork.
* You've built automations or workflows with AI tools before.

How to apply

* Send your CV to ashish@plutope.io plus a short note on the messiest thing you've ever sorted out — what was broken, what you did, and the system you left behind. Bonus: show us one workflow you've built with Claude.

title: AVP - Journey Excellence and Transformation
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as “AVP - Journey Excellence and Transformation, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
You will join the Business Banking transformation team, which shapes future-state operating models and redesigns end-to-end customer and colleague journeys. Working across Operations, Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Customer Experience, the team turns strategic designs into practical transformation roadmaps that simplify processes, strengthen controls and enable sustainable digital change.
  
  
**Skills**
To be successful in this role as a “AVP - Journey Excellence and Transformation”, you should possess the following skillsets:
  
  
**Governance & Portfolio Management**

* Establish and maintain governance frameworks, standards and controls across the Business Banking Transformation portfolio.
* Manage governance forums, steering committees and executive review meetings, ensuring effective decision-making and escalation processes.
* Define and maintain portfolio governance calendars, meeting cadence, terms of reference and reporting standards.
* Ensure adherence to Barclays change governance, risk and control requirements.
* Coordinate quality assurance activities and challenge project delivery teams to ensure data accuracy and reporting integrity.
* Support business case governance, investment tracking and benefits realisation activities.

**Reporting & Business Insight**

* Lead the production of executive-level reporting packs for Transformation Leadership, Business Banking Executive teams and senior governance forums.
* Develop and maintain portfolio dashboards and performance reporting using Power BI, Excel and other reporting tools.
* Consolidate programme and project updates to provide a holistic view of portfolio health, delivery status, risks, issues and dependencies.
* Analyse data to identify trends, delivery risks, resource constraints and opportunities for intervention.
* Ensure timely, accurate and insightful reporting for monthly, quarterly and annual business reviews.

**Risk, Issue & Dependency Management**

* Oversee portfolio-level risk, issue, assumption and dependency management processes.
* Drive effective escalation and mitigation planning for critical delivery risks.
* Monitor project health indicators and provide independent challenge where required.
* Support audit, regulatory and control reviews by ensuring appropriate governance evidence is maintained.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong working relationships across Business Banking, Operations, Risk, Finance, Technology and Change functions.
* Act as a trusted advisor to Transformation Leadership on governance, reporting and portfolio performance matters.
* Engage with senior leaders to communicate portfolio health, strategic progress and delivery outcomes.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to resolve delivery dependencies and governance actions.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive PMO maturity and governance excellence across the transformation portfolio.
* Identify opportunities to automate reporting and improve data quality through enhanced tools, processes and analytics.
* Promote best practices in programme governance, reporting and delivery assurance.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to simplify governance processes while maintaining effective oversight.

**Experience**
**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience within PMO, Governance, Portfolio Management or Transformation functions in a complex financial services environment.
* Experience supporting large-scale transformation, strategic change or operational improvement programmes.
* Demonstrable experience preparing executive-level reporting and governance materials.
* Strong understanding of portfolio management, programme governance and change delivery frameworks.
* Experience managing risks, issues, dependencies and benefits tracking across multiple initiatives.

**Technical & Analytical Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI.
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable insights.
* Experience designing management information (MI), dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.
* Understanding of financial, resource and portfolio tracking methodologies.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Skills**

* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge constructively and influence decision-making at all levels.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**

* Degree educated or equivalent professional experience.
* PRINCE2, MSP, Agile, PMP or equivalent project management qualifications.
* Experience within Business Banking, Operations, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), KYC or Transformation environments.
* Knowledge of portfolio reporting tools and data visualisation platforms.
* Experience improving PMO maturity and governance frameworks.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Noida/ Gurugram office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance & optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance & optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance & optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Assistant Manager – Production & Machining Operations (Supervisor)
description:
**Job Summary**
Relevant experience to lead shop floor production activities and ensure the achievement of production, quality, delivery, and safety objectives. Managing shift operations, manpower deployment, machine utilization, process improvement, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives within the machine shop.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machining operations, CNC programming, production planning, OEE monitoring, and team management in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Production & Shift Management**

* Lead and oversee machine shop operations during assigned shifts to achieve production targets.
* Ensure adherence to production schedules, quality standards, and delivery commitments.
* Drive productivity improvements through effective utilization of manpower, machines, and resources.
* Monitor daily production performance and take corrective actions to eliminate bottlenecks.

**Manpower Planning & Team Development**

* Plan and deploy manpower effectively based on production requirements.
* Train, guide, and develop operators and new employees on processes, quality standards, and safety practices.
* Build multi-skilled teams to improve operational flexibility and efficiency.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, and overall workforce performance.

**OEE & Performance Monitoring**

* Monitor and improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Conduct daily loss analysis and downtime reviews.
* Identify productivity losses and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.

**Machining Operations**

* Supervise and optimize machining processes including:

+ Vertical Machining Centers (VMC)
+ Special Purpose Machines (SPM)
+ Expansion Honing
+ Single Pass Honing
+ Grinding Operations

* Ensure process capability, dimensional accuracy, and adherence to process parameters.
* Support cycle time reduction and process optimization initiatives.

**CNC Programming & Technical Support**

* Provide technical guidance on CNC machine programming and setup.
* Work with machine controls including:

+ Fanuc
+ Siemens
+ Brother

* Support program optimization and troubleshooting activities to improve machine performance.

**Troubleshooting & Maintenance Coordination**

* Diagnose and resolve machine-related issues and process deviations.
* Coordinate with maintenance teams for effective breakdown management.
* Implement preventive measures to minimize machine downtime and improve equipment reliability.

**Jigs, Fixtures & Tooling Management**

* Ensure availability and proper utilization of jigs, fixtures, tools, and gauges.
* Support development and improvement of machining fixtures and tooling.
* Monitor tool life and recommend improvements to enhance productivity.

**Technical Documentation**

* Interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and process requirements.
* Develop and maintain:

+ Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
+ Work Instructions
+ Process Flow Diagrams
+ Production and Process Documentation

* Ensure process documentation is regularly updated and effectively communicated.

**Quality Management**

* Ensure compliance with customer and internal quality requirements.
* Analyze defects, rejections, and process deviations.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement corrective actions using quality tools such as 5 Why Analysis and Fishbone Diagram.
* Drive initiatives for defect reduction and process improvement.

**Safety & Compliance**

* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with EHS standards.
* Conduct regular safety observations and risk assessments.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, statutory requirements, and 5S practices.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

**Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.
* Analyze production, quality, downtime, and manpower data using Excel.
* Prepare management presentations and operational reviews using PowerPoint.
* Track KPIs and recommend action plans for performance improvement.

**Specification**

* B.E. / B Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent.
* 8-12 years of experience in machine shop operations within the automotive or engineering manufacturing industry.
* Leadership and team management.
* Decision-making and problem-solving.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* High focus on quality, safety, and operational excellence.

title: Warranty Manager
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
  
  
**We are looking for Warranty Manager – Projects**
As a Warranty Manager, your main objective will be to orchestrate end-to-end warranty support, fleet reliability, field technical interventions, and depot operations for the Vande Bharat Trainsets/ EMU /MEMU /Metro /Electric Locomotives fleet powered by Siemens propulsion systems. You will support the project leadership and serve as the critical technical and operational interface between Siemens internal and external stakeholders, Management, Indian Railways (Zonal Divisions, RDSO, Railway Board and Production Units like MCF/ICF/RCF). Your role will involve ensuring contractual fleet availability, prompt resolution of line failures, flawless execution of prototype and series trials, and stringent safety adherence during yard and depot maintenance activities.
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by**

* Acting as the primary technical SPOC with Zonal Railway authorities across Indian Railways for all warranty-related operational matters.
* Coordinating and expediting critical site approvals, including Power Blocks, Non-OHE zone roof access, yard line allotment, shunting permissions, and dynamic trial slots at various railway yards.
* Maintaining proactive alignment with RDSO and Indian Railways / Zonal Divisions for fleet monitoring, warranty administration, claim settlements, and joint inspection sign-offs.
* Ensuring maximum trainset availability by driving rapid turnaround times (TAT) for trouble calls, line failures, and preventive maintenance checks.
* Leading the 24/7 on-call technical response team to troubleshoot critical operational issues during commercial service and trial runs.
* Leading detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure investigations report and Job Card Closure for component/system failures (Traction Converter, Auxiliary Converter, TCMS, High-Voltage roof gear, Pantograph, Traction Motors, Brake interface, etc.).
* Planning, monitoring and coordinating mainline dynamic performance checks and maintenance for series rakes undergoing revenue service on designated railway corridors.
* Planning and rolling out engineering change orders (ECOs), software upgrades, and hardware modifications across distributed train maintenance depots without impacting rake turnaround times.
* Enforcing strict adherence to high-voltage safety standards (25 kV AC), lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, Siemens Zero Harm Culture and Indian Railways General & Subsidiary Rules (G&SR) during roof-top and underframe inspections.
* Managing localized safety stock, critical rotable spares, and diagnostic test benches across designated maintenance sheds and depots.
* Supervising the reverse logistics and return of failed Line-Replaceable Units (LRUs) to manufacturing plants or central repair facilities for root cause failure analysis and warranty replacement.
* Generating weekly and monthly Fleet Reliability & Warranty Performance Dashboards tracking MTBF, MDBF, MTTR, and punctuality loss attribution.
* Issuing formal joint investigation reports (JIR) with Railway technical officers for disputed failure categories and maintaining comprehensive, audit-ready warranty documentation.
* Planning activities related to Warranty Management including Spares, tools and Manpower to ensure that warranty related topics are driven timely and effectively

**Desired Skills**

* You should have min 12 to 15 years’ hands-on experience in rolling stock customer service or warranty management in the Railway / Metro sector, along with a bachelor’s degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering.
* Direct working experience with Indian Railways operations, RDSO procedures, and Railway Maintenance Depots/Sheds (EMU/MEMU/Vande Bharat/Electric Locomotives/Metros).
* Deep technical familiarity with 25 kV AC propulsion equipment (IGBT-based inverters), Train Control & Management Systems (TCMS) architecture, Auxiliary Power Supplies, High-Voltage roof lines, Pantographs and dynamic braking systems.
* In-depth understanding of Indian Railways operating protocols, yard working rules, power block/traffic block procedures, Maintenance methodologies and depot escalation channels.
* Proven crisis management ability to stay composed and deliver immediate technical solutions during high-stakes punctuality and safety incidents on mainline tracks.
* Strong negotiation and diplomatic stakeholder management skills to interface effectively with Zonal Railways, RDSO, production units and depot technicians.
* Exceptional written communication skills for drafting formal Railway project letters, joint investigation notes, and technical memos, along with fluent verbal communication in English and Hindi.
* Detail-oriented approach with a high level of accuracy in reliability tracking, process adherence, and quality documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary field support teams and work effectively in a dynamic 24/7 operational environment.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**
This role is based on Gurugram. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
  
  
Find out more about mobility at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers. #SL

title: Concierge Manager Position - India (Remote)
description:
Concierge Manager | Remote | Luxury Travel Leadership
  
  
**About Ascend**
Ascend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site. We combine smart, proprietary booking methods with round-the-clock personal service delivered over WhatsApp.
  
  
We have grown from 12 to 60+ people in just over a year, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, and 5x'd our revenue year-over-year. We are at $22M+ ARR and growing fast. Our mission is to make first-class travel accessible to the people who are shaping the world.
  
  
Our clients are founders, investors, and senior executives who expect fast, accurate, and polished service. They do not chase confirmations. They trust us to get it right every time.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We are looking for an experienced luxury service leader who wants to build world-class operations and grow their impact at a fast-moving company.
  
  
As Concierge Manager, you own shift-level operations across three core functions: Client Service, Ticketing, Trip Fulfillment. You lead Team Leads who manage specialists across each function. You are responsible for making sure every client receives a five-star experience, every shift runs smoothly, and every team member is growing under your leadership.
  
  
This is a role for someone who thinks in systems but leads with people. Process without empathy is just bureaucracy. You bring both.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Lead and Develop Your Team
  
  

* Manage 3 Team Leads across Client Service, Ticketing and Trip Fulfillment,
* Coach Team Leads daily with direct, specific feedback that builds their judgment and confidence as leaders
* Build a shift culture where ownership, accuracy, and client empathy are the baseline, not the exception
* Conduct regular performance reviews that give team members clarity on where they stand and what comes next

Own Shift Operations
  
  

* Direct all client-facing operations during your shift with real-time decisions and clear priorities
* Allocate team resources, manage escalations from Team Leads, and resolve complex situations before they reach the client
* Ensure clean, complete handovers between shifts so the incoming manager has everything they need
* Maintain 95%+ SLA adherence and 98%+ data accuracy through effective team management and systems

Deliver Exceptional Client Experiences
  
  

* Own the end-to-end client experience for your shift: every request, every quote, every booking, and every follow-up
* Personally handle VIP clients and high-complexity situations that require senior judgment
* Ensure clients receive proactive updates, creative solutions, and service that consistently exceeds their expectations
* Turn service recovery moments into opportunities to deepen client relationships

Drive Process Excellence
  
  

* Submit at least two documented process improvements per month that increase efficiency or quality for the team
* Spot patterns across client feedback, system performance, and team errors, and address them systematically rather than reactively
* Partner with the Process Management team and other functions to streamline workflows across the operation
* Use data to make decisions, validate improvements, and demonstrate impact

Collaborate Across Ascend
  
  

* Work closely with Product, Operations, and Leadership to implement new systems and maintain consistency as we scale
* Represent the voice of both your clients and your team in strategic conversations
* Contribute insights that shape how Ascend grows globally while maintaining the quality standard clients expect

What You Bring
  
  
Must Have
  
  

* 4+ years in luxury travel, hospitality, or high-touch service operations. Apply even if you do not have every year listed but are confident in your skillset
* 2+ years in a leadership or management role where you coached and developed a team, not just managed tasks and deadlines
* Strong Sabre GDS proficiency: you are comfortable with fare rules, complex routing, and ticketing at a level that lets you support and QA your team's work
* A data-driven approach to leadership: you use metrics to spot trends, validate changes, and hold the team to clear standards
* Excellent written and verbal communication: you can coach with clarity, write polished client messages, and present confidently to leadership
* Composure under pressure: when everything is happening at once, you are the calm and steady presence the team needs

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with international business class or first-class bookings, or award travel programs
* Familiarity with tools like Asana, Periskope, Stripe, or similar workflow and CRM platforms
* A track record of building or improving operational processes, SOPs, or training programs
* Experience managing remote, global teams across time zones
* Background in luxury hospitality brands such as premium hotels or high-end concierge services

You do not need to check every box. If you have 80% of the skills and the drive to learn, we want to hear from you.
  
  
What Makes You Stand Out
  
  
We are especially interested in candidates who:
  
  

* Have turned around an underperforming team or operation and can speak to the specific changes they made and the results they drove
* Are known as the manager people want to work for because they genuinely develop the people around them
* Have a reputation for spotting problems early and solving them before they reach the client
* Think in systems but are not rigid: you improve processes without losing the human element that makes a service feel premium
* Are comfortable being hands-on when the situation calls for it while consistently pushing ownership down to the team

Why Ascend
  
  
Clear Growth Path
  
  
The progression here is: Concierge Manager to Senior Concierge Manager to Associate Director to Director. We promote from within based on demonstrated performance and impact, not politics or tenure.
  
  
Build, Don't Just Maintain
  
  
We are implementing our concierge framework and career systems right now. You are not inheriting a rigid legacy structure. You are helping build how Ascend's operations scale globally. Your insights will have a direct and visible effect on how we work.
  
  
Real Support
  
  

* We hire proficient people: you will not be carrying underperformers
* Regular performance reviews with clear metrics and honest feedback
* A Head of People who understands operations and partners with you
* A Process Management team dedicated to making your job easier

Work-Life Balance
  
  

* Predictable scheduling: you will know your shift in advance
* Structured handovers so the incoming manager receives everything they need without you staying late
* A global team with talented colleagues across continents
* Merit-based performance incentives

Learn While You Lead
  
  

* Advanced travel optimization strategies used by elite professionals in the industry
* How to lead global teams using shared metrics and real-time decision-making
* Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Operations
* Operational leadership at a venture-backed company growing 5x year-over-year

What Success Looks Like
  
  
First 90 days: You have learned our core systems and tools, including Sabre, Asana, and our booking platforms. You are leading shifts independently with 95%+ SLA adherence. You are coaching your Team Leads with specific, useful feedback and you have identified your first improvement opportunity.
  
  
Within 6-12 months: You are consistently delivering 95%+ SLA and 98%+ accuracy. Your team sentiment scores are at 8/10 or above. You have led at least one initiative that measurably improved client satisfaction or team efficiency. Your Team Leads are stronger leaders because of your coaching.
  
  
Our Values
  
  

* Customer Obsession: We win when our customers win
* Urgency with Impact: Clients expect answers in minutes, not hours
* Radical Candor: Honest, direct, respectful feedback builds trust
* Ownership: If something breaks, we fix it
* Relentless Excellence: Good enough is never enough

Should You Apply?
  
  
If you are thinking that you may not have all the experience listed, apply anyway. We are looking for people with 80% of the skills and 100% of the drive to learn. What we care about most:
  
  

* Have you led teams or operations in a high-touch service environment?
* Do you have a track record of meeting or exceeding operational targets?
* Can you coach, give feedback, and genuinely develop other people?
* Are you excited about building something excellent rather than maintaining something average?

If the answer to these questions is yes, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Why You'll Love This Role
  
  
This is perfect for someone who:
  
  

* Wants to work directly with founders, investors, and global business leaders
* Sees themselves at Ascend for years, building toward senior leadership
* Takes genuine pride in building something excellent and watching their team grow
* Values both high performance and sustainable, respectful working practices
* Wants to lead a high-performing team that holds itself to a standard most operations never reach

Ascend is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
**Engagement Structure, Compensation, Shifts, And Benefits**
Ascend is a remote-first, global team. For candidates based in India, employment will be through Ascend's designated Employer of Record (EOR), which will be the legal employer and administer payroll, applicable statutory deductions, tax deductions and employment-related compliance.
  
  
Compensation will be stated in USD and paid in INR through the EOR's payroll, based on the applicable conversion arrangement. The salary breakup, statutory contributions, deductions and payment terms will be detailed in the employment offer. Any personal income tax return filing obligations remain the employee's responsibility.
  
  
This role is part of Ascend's 24/7 client service operations and involves rotating shifts to support clients across different time zones. This may include overnight shifts, weekends or public holidays, depending on business and team scheduling needs. Weekly offs and shift schedules are planned in advance wherever possible and managed fairly across the team.
  
  
The monthly compensation accounts for the rotating shifts and operational coverage requirements of the role. Separate allowances for night shifts, weekends, holidays, overtime or additional hours are not provided unless required by applicable law or specified in the employment terms.
  
  
Ascend does not currently provide additional employer-sponsored medical insurance or mediclaim for this role beyond any applicable statutory coverage. Details of leave entitlements, schedules and employment policies will be shared during the offer and onboarding process.
