title: Head of Operations - Scaffolding & Painting
description:
**Company Description**
Indian Trade Links is a rapidly growing provider of mechanical and industrial services, specializing in industrial scaffolding, piping, civil, mechanical, and painting solutions. With thousands of completed projects across India, the company is recognized as a trusted construction partner delivering safe and cost-effective services. Its diverse, high-quality product range and strong network of reliable vendors support stringent quality standards and competitive pricing. A focus on expertise, ethical business practices, and continuous improvement has positioned Indian Trade Links as a market leader. Candidates can learn more about the company at www.indiantradelinks.in or by contacting info@indiantradelinks.in.

Head of Operations – Scaffolding & Industrial Services

**Company:**
Indian Trade Links

**Position:**
Head of Operations

**Department:**
Operations

**Industry:**
Scaffolding / Industrial Services / Projects

**Location:**
India, with travel to project sites as required

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Level:**
Senior Management

1. Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced and commercially aware
**Head of Operations**
to lead and control our scaffolding and industrial project operations across multiple sites.

The ideal candidate must possess
**strong practical knowledge of scaffolding operations**
, including planning, erection, modification, dismantling, material management, manpower productivity, safety compliance, measurement and billing coordination.

The position will be responsible for ensuring that projects are executed
**safely, efficiently, on schedule and within approved budgets**
, while maintaining strong client relationships.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Scaffolding Operations

* Lead and monitor scaffolding activities across all project sites.
* Have sound knowledge of
  **scaffolding erection, alteration/modification and dismantling**
  .
* Understand different scaffolding systems such as:
* Tube and coupler scaffolding
* Cup-lock/system scaffolding
* Ring-lock/system scaffolding
* Mobile scaffolds
* Birdcage scaffolds
* Suspended and cantilever arrangements, where applicable
* Review scaffolding requirements based on site conditions, work fronts, access requirements and project schedules.
* Ensure proper planning for scaffolding material, manpower and equipment.
* Monitor erected quantity versus dismantled quantity and material utilization.
* Control excessive material consumption, unnecessary scaffolding retention and material losses.

B. Project & Site Management

* Take overall responsibility for operational performance of all active projects.
* Prepare and monitor project mobilization and execution plans.
* Conduct regular reviews with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, Safety personnel and commercial teams.
* Monitor:
* Daily progress
* Planned vs. actual work
* Productivity
* Manpower deployment
* Material availability
* Site constraints
* Client priorities
* Identify potential delays and take corrective action before they affect project commitments.
* Coordinate shutdown, maintenance and high-priority activities with site teams and clients.

C. Manpower & Productivity Management

* Plan manpower requirements project-wise.
* Ensure optimum deployment of scaffolders, helpers, supervisors, engineers and other operational personnel.
* Closely monitor
  **manpower productivity against actual work output**
  .
* Prevent unnecessary overtime and idle manpower.
* Coordinate mobilization and demobilization according to workload.
* Develop capable site supervisors and project leadership teams.

D. Safety & Quality

The Head of Operations must establish a strong safety culture, particularly because scaffolding is a safety-critical activity.

Responsibilities include:

* Ensure scaffolding work is executed according to approved procedures, drawings and applicable client/site requirements.
* Ensure inspection and tagging systems are properly followed.
* Ensure use of appropriate fall-protection and personal protective equipment.
* Work closely with the safety team on risk assessments, job safety analysis, toolbox talks and corrective actions.
* Review accidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and serious safety observations.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Participate in client safety audits and operational reviews.
* Ensure defective scaffolding material is identified, segregated and prevented from use.

E. Material & Inventory Control

* Monitor scaffolding inventory across stores and project locations.
* Review material requirements before approving additional movement or procurement.
* Control:
* Material shortages
* Excess stock
* Damage
* Loss/theft
* Inter-site transfers
* Return of dismantled material
* Ensure proper reconciliation of scaffolding material at project completion.
* Improve material utilization and reduce unnecessary rental or procurement costs.

F. Commercial & Cost Control

The role should have strong commercial awareness, not only technical knowledge.

* Monitor project budget versus actual expenditure.
* Review manpower, material, equipment and subcontracting costs.
* Support measurement and certification of completed work.
* Coordinate with Accounts/Commercial teams for timely client billing.
* Monitor unbilled work and operational issues delaying certification.
* Understand the commercial implications of additional work and scope changes.
* Support variation/change-order documentation before additional work becomes a commercial dispute.
* Drive improvement in project profitability through productivity and cost control.

G. Client Management

* Act as a senior operational contact for key clients.
* Attend project review meetings with clients.
* Handle operational escalations professionally and promptly.
* Ensure client complaints are closed with proper corrective action.
* Maintain good relationships with client Operations, Projects, Safety, Maintenance and Commercial teams.
* Protect the company's reputation through disciplined and professional site execution.

H. Reporting & Management Review

Prepare/review weekly and monthly operational dashboards covering:

* Project-wise progress
* Scaffolding quantities
* Manpower deployment
* Productivity
* Safety performance
* Material utilization
* Billing status
* Cost performance
* Major site constraints
* Client issues
* Pending decisions
* Recovery/action plans

Escalate critical issues to management with
**clear facts, financial/operational impact and recommended action**
.

3. Required Experience

* Preferably
  **10+ years of experience**
  in industrial/project operations, with substantial experience in scaffolding operations.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of scaffolding erection and dismantling activities.
* Experience managing
  **multiple industrial project sites**
  is highly desirable.
* Experience dealing with large industrial clients, EPC contractors, steel plants, power plants, refineries or similar facilities is preferred.
* Experience managing large site manpower and supervisory teams.
* Good understanding of project costing, productivity and commercial controls.

4. Educational Qualification

Preferred:

* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in
  **Mechanical, Civil, Industrial or a related engineering discipline**
  .

Relevant scaffolding, safety or project-management certifications will be an advantage.

For an exceptionally experienced scaffolding operations professional,
**strong practical project experience may be considered alongside formal qualifications**
.

5. Essential Scaffolding Knowledge

The candidate should be able to confidently discuss and review:

* Scaffold types and their applications
* Erection and dismantling sequence
* Working platforms and access
* Guardrails and toe boards
* Bracing, ties and stability
* Base arrangements and foundations
* Loading considerations
* Inspection and tagging
* Work-at-height controls
* Material identification
* Scaffolding quantity measurement
* Material reconciliation
* Manpower productivity
* Safe modification of existing scaffolds
* Planning for shutdown and maintenance scaffolding

6. Key Skills

* Strong leadership and decision-making
* Excellent scaffolding operational knowledge
* Multi-site project management
* Manpower planning
* Cost and budget control
* Client management
* Safety leadership
* Material management
* Problem solving
* Negotiation
* Commercial awareness
* Strong communication and reporting skills
* Ability to work under pressure and manage urgent site requirements

7. Key Performance Indicators

Performance of the Head of Operations should be measured using objective business and project metrics such as:

* Safety compliance
* Project schedule adherence
* Scaffolding productivity
* Manpower utilization
* Material utilization and recovery
* Reduction in material loss/damage
* Project cost versus budget
* Billing and measurement readiness
* Client issue closure
* Rework reduction
* Timely mobilization/demobilization
* Project close-out performance

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a
**strong operations leader who understands scaffolding from the ground level and can also manage the commercial side of projects**
.

* The candidate should be comfortable moving between a project site, a client review meeting and a management profitability review. This is
  **not purely an office-based managerial position**
  . Regular involvement with project sites and operational teams will be essential.

**Position Overview:**
The Regional Manager – RSP / BDO Operations role is accountable for the operational performance, service quality, governance and sustainability of the Regional Service Provider (RSP) and Blue Dart Office (BDO) network across multiple states and non-metro / remote markets.
  
  
The network operates through a combination of franchise / service-partner locations, outsourced manpower and lean Blue Dart-operated offices, typically serving markets where shipment volumes do not require a full-scale Blue Dart facility.
  
  
The role ensures that customers in these markets receive consistent Blue Dart service standards irrespective of whether operations are delivered through a partner, contractor-supported office or lean Blue Dart location.
  
  
Owns regional governance of RSPs and BDOs covering pickup and delivery performance, shipment connectivity, operational compliance, partner capability, manpower productivity, customer experience, cost effectiveness and business continuity.
  
  
Acts as the regional anchor between RSP / BDO locations and Area / Branch Operations, PUD, Hub, CPU, Customer Service, Commercial, Finance and other functions to ensure reliable service delivery across the extended network.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To build and govern a reliable, scalable and cost-efficient RSP / BDO operating network across Tier 2, Tier 3 and remote markets by strengthening partner performance, operational standards, service quality, network connectivity and compliance while ensuring sustainable Blue Dart presence in lower-volume geographies.

**Regional RSP / BDO Network Leadership**

* Establish consistent operating standards across franchise, outsourced and lean Blue Dart locations.

* Establish structured performance-review mechanisms across the RSP / BDO network.
* Identify weak-performing locations and drive time-bound corrective action plans.
* Ensure appropriate escalation and intervention for locations with recurring service, compliance or viability concerns.
* Act as the regional SME for RSP / BDO operating models and remote-market operations.

**Partner & Franchise Operations Governance**

* Monitor operational performance of Regional Service Providers and franchise / channel partners against agreed service standards.

* Establish partner scorecards covering service, productivity, quality, compliance and customer experience.
* Conduct periodic operating and capability reviews with partners.
* Drive corrective action where partner performance falls below defined standards.
* Provide operational inputs for appointment, continuation, renewal, expansion or rationalisation of partners in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure business continuity during partner transitions or service disruptions.

**BDO & Remote Location Operations**

* Govern performance of Blue Dart Offices operating with lean Blue Dart manpower and predominantly outsourced resources.
* Ensure BDOs maintain adequate operational capability despite lower shipment volumes and geographically dispersed locations.
* Drive consistent pickup, delivery, shipment handling and customer-service standards.
* Monitor location productivity and ensure manpower deployment remains aligned with business volumes.
* Ensure adequate supervisory controls where direct Blue Dart manpower is limited.
* Review operating viability and recommend changes to the service model where appropriate.
* Ensure continuity of service across difficult-to-access and remote locations.

**Service Performance & Customer Experience**

* Drive achievement of pickup, delivery and service-quality commitments across RSP and BDO locations.
* Monitor First Attempt Delivery, pending / ageing shipments, NDR, pickup performance and operational exceptions.
* Identify recurring service failures and ensure structured root-cause resolution.
* Monitor customer complaints arising from RSP / BDO locations and drive preventive actions.
* Ensure service levels in partner-operated locations remain aligned with Blue Dart standards.
* Partner with Area and Branch Operations teams on customer-critical issues requiring intervention.

**Network Connectivity & Shipment Flow**

* Ensure timely shipment movement between RSP / BDO locations and parent Service Centres, Hubs, CPUs and downstream network locations.
* Monitor adherence to pickup, dispatch and network cut-offs.
* Identify connectivity gaps affecting remote-market service performance.
* Work with Surface, Air, PUD and Network teams to optimise connections and operating schedules.
* Ensure appropriate contingency plans for route disruptions, volume spikes or partner resource shortages.
* Minimise shipment delays arising from weak upstream or downstream connectivity.

**Manpower & Productivity Governance**

* Monitor productivity and manpower deployment across outsourced / partner-supported operations.
* Ensure staffing levels are aligned with shipment volumes and service requirements.
* Improve productivity through better workforce deployment, route planning and process discipline.
* Monitor absenteeism, attrition and continuity risks among outsourced resources.
* Ensure partners maintain adequate staffing and backup capability.
* Work with HR / Operations teams on workforce issues requiring regional intervention.

**Cost & Operating Model Optimization**

* Monitor cost-to-serve across RSP and BDO locations.
* Evaluate operational productivity and sustainability of remote-location operating models.
* Identify opportunities to optimise manpower, routes, infrastructure and service-partner costs.
* Balance cost efficiency with network reach and service commitments.
* Recommend alternative operating models where existing arrangements are no longer operationally or financially appropriate.
* Support development of scalable models for low-volume and emerging markets.

**Compliance, Safety & Brand Governance**

* Ensure partner and BDO operations comply with Blue Dart SOPs, security standards, statutory requirements and applicable contractual conditions.
* Conduct periodic operational and compliance reviews across locations.
* Ensure appropriate controls over shipment custody, scanning, cash / documentation processes and Blue Dart assets wherever applicable.
* Drive timely closure of audit findings and compliance gaps.
* Ensure partner-operated locations maintain required workplace, signage and customer-interface standards.
* Escalate serious compliance, ethics, security or customer-risk concerns promptly.

**Capability Building & Standardisation**

* Build operational capability among RSPs, BDO coordinators and outsourced teams.
* Drive structured onboarding and refresher training on Blue Dart operating standards.
* Standardise SOPs, dashboards and governance mechanisms across the regional network.
* Identify and replicate best practices across locations.
* Support digital adoption and use of operational systems by partners and outsourced resources.
* Build stronger local operating capability to reduce dependence on continuous regional intervention.

**Network Expansion & Rationalisation**

* Support evaluation of new RSP / BDO locations based on service reach, business potential and network requirements.
* Provide operational inputs into location feasibility, coverage and resource requirements.
* Review existing locations for service performance, productivity and continued relevance.
* Recommend strengthening, consolidation, relocation or alternate service models where required.
* Ensure new locations achieve operational readiness and defined service standards before stabilisation.
* Support expansion into underserved Tier 2 / Tier 3 and emerging markets in alignment with business requirements.

title: Training Delivery Manager
description:
**Role Summary**

The Manager – Training Delivery owns execution of assigned training programs end-to-end — converting delivery plans into consistent, high-quality learner and client outcomes across trainer teams, cohorts, and client engagements. The role is the operational layer that translates delivery governance standards set at the account and leadership level into daily execution discipline: trainer readiness, session quality, learner engagement, and client-facing delivery confidence.

This is an execution and team-leadership role, not a reporting role. Success is measured by whether programs run predictably, trainers perform and grow, risks surface early rather than at the client review, and delivery data feeds upward into account-level performance intelligence rather than sitting in a spreadsheet.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Delivery Execution & Governance**

* Own end-to-end delivery for assigned programs, cohorts, and client engagements, ensuring adherence to quality standards, delivery frameworks, and contractual SLAs.
* Plan and govern trainer scheduling, workforce allocation, and resource utilization against delivery commitments and business requirements.
* Maintain the operating cadence for each program — session tracking, milestone checkpoints, and delivery-readiness reviews — so deviations are caught before they become client-visible.

**2. Team Leadership & Trainer Capability**

* Lead, coach, and performance-manage a team of trainers and lead trainers, with structured feedback and capability-building interventions tied to observed session quality, not just tenure.
* Run trainer calibration cycles to keep delivery quality consistent across cohorts and geographies.
* Build a bench-readiness view of trainer capability so staffing decisions are proactive rather than reactive to attrition or scale-up requests.

**3. Quality Assurance & Risk Management**

* Establish and govern quality assurance mechanisms — session audits, learner feedback analysis, and corrective action planning — as a continuous loop, not a periodic exercise.
* Identify delivery risks (trainer gaps, engagement drop-off, SLA slippage) early and drive resolution through a defined escalation path, ensuring minimal impact on learner experience or client commitments.
* Escalate risks that exceed program-level authority — client-facing exposure, repeated SLA breach, or resourcing shortfalls — to the Senior Director with a clear recommendation, not just a status update.

**4. Performance Intelligence & Reporting**

* Track and interpret delivery metrics across two tiers: leading indicators (trainer readiness, early engagement signals, session quality scores) that predict outcomes, and lagging indicators (CSAT/NPS, completion, certification) that confirm them.
* Translate program-level data into a structured performance narrative for account and leadership reviews — what happened, why, and what changes as a result — rather than a metrics dump.
* Feed program-level delivery data into the broader account performance intelligence system on a defined reporting cadence, in the format required for client and leadership consumption.

**5. Stakeholder & Client Engagement**

* Support client reviews and business discussions by presenting delivery performance, learner outcomes, risks, and improvement plans with delivery-level credibility.
* Act as the day-to-day delivery point of contact for assigned client stakeholders, maintaining delivery confidence between formal review cycles.

**6. Continuous Improvement & Strategic Contribution**

* Identify process gaps and implement best practices that improve trainer productivity, program consistency, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute delivery-ground-truth into scaling decisions — new program design, trainer onboarding models, and capacity planning — as programs grow in size or complexity.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* Training Delivery & Learning Operations Management
* Team Leadership, Coaching & Performance Management
* Trainer Capability Development & Calibration
* Quality Assurance & Delivery Governance
* Data-Driven Delivery Intelligence — distinguishing leading signals from lagging results
* Risk Management & Escalation Discipline
* Resource & Workforce Planning
* Stakeholder & Client Management
* Process Improvement & Operational Excellence
* Communication, Presentation & Executive-Level Reporting
* Working familiarity with digital and AI-enabled delivery tools (scheduling, analytics dashboards, learner engagement platforms)

**Experience:**

* 8–12 years of experience in Training Delivery, Learning Operations, L&D, EdTech, Workforce Development, or Learning Services.
* 3+ years of people management experience leading trainer or delivery teams.
* Proven experience managing large-scale training programs, delivery operations, quality governance, and stakeholder relationships.
* Experience working with enterprise clients, digital learning environments, or blended learning programs is preferred; exposure to global or multi-geography delivery is a plus.

**Position Within the Delivery Organization:**

This role sits within the Customer Success & Delivery function, reporting to the Senior Director – Customer Success & Delivery. It carries program- and cohort-level ownership; it does not carry account-level commercial or client-strategy ownership, which remains with the Senior Director and account leadership. The Manager – Training Delivery is the layer that converts governance standards into execution reality and surfaces ground-truth delivery data upward.

title: Snr NSI Manager
description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior NSI Manager, you will drive international network migration projects that enhance scalability, optimize network performance, and deliver high operational standards with adept project management and cultural insight.
  
  

* Lead and manage the implementation and deployment of network migration projects to enhance optimization and scalability within the global enterprise network.
* Oversee multiple operations within the portfolio to ensure deployments are completed on time and meet quality standards.
* Perform technical and economic analyses to identify optimal solutions while ensuring compliance with engineering, business, environmental, and safety standards.
* Validate and verify documentation and compliance of studies conducted by external service providers.
* Coordinate stakeholder agreements and manage ordering processes to promote smooth operations.
* Conduct site visits and autonomously manage complex network operations, providing clear and detailed reporting.
* Implement cross-business and operational improvement plans to enhance deployment strategies continuously.
* Deploy network hardware such as routers, switches, and firewalls efficiently during greenfield and brownfield migration projects, ensuring operational readiness.
* Configure and test network equipment in staging environments prior to field shipment to ensure optimal performance and minimize deployment issues.
* Develop and implement comprehensive Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for high-risk network changes to minimize downtime and maintain service continuity.
* Supervise physical layer tasks including cable patching and labeling to uphold data center standards and facilitate maintenance.
* Conduct thorough post-deployment validation to verify adherence to design specifications and operational effectiveness.
* Produce detailed As-Built documentation and updated network diagrams to support seamless transition to network operations teams.

**About You**
You demonstrate hands-on proficiency with Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, and Arista platforms, ensuring comprehensive hardware deployment. Your strong knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and VLANs supports robust network configuration and operation. Skilled in scripting languages like Python and Bash along with automation tools such as Ansible and Terraform, you enable scalable deployment processes. Your experience with hybrid cloud connectivity involving AWS Direct Connect and Azure ExpressRoute is strong. You also maintain detail-oriented execution of technical procedures to ensure reliability. With over 8-10 years in network engineering and deployment-focused roles, along with CCNA or CompTIA Network+ certification (CCNP or JNCIP preferred), your methodical approach and communication skills enable alignment across stakeholders during complex network migrations.
  
  
**Your professional skills:**

* Demonstrates proficient hands-on expertise with network hardware platforms such as Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, and Arista to facilitate comprehensive deployments.
* Possesses a thorough understanding of network protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and VLANs, enabling stable network configuration and operation.
* Utilizes scripting languages like Python and Bash alongside automation tools such as Ansible and Terraform to promote scalable, efficient deployment processes.
* Applies practical know-how in establishing hybrid cloud interconnections like AWS Direct Connect and Azure ExpressRoute to improve network connectivity.
* Maintains strong attention to detail, rigorously performing technical procedures to minimize errors and ensure process reliability.

**Your soft skills:**

* Exhibits adaptability and resilience, maintaining composure while addressing unforeseen challenges during network deployment activities.
* Communicates complex technical information clearly to align all stakeholders during maintenance and migration phases.
* Employs excellent time management skills to ensure network deployment projects meet established schedules and deadlines.
* Approaches problem resolution through logical analysis and systematic isolation of faults, avoiding assumptions.
* Supports clients thoughtfully throughout network transitions, fostering trust and confidence during change processes.

Join Orange to bring your expertise to large-scale network projects in a collaborative environment that values precision, cultural awareness, and continuous improvement. As a Senior NSI Manager, you will shape the future of global network deployment by leading efficient initiatives that enhance connectivity and operational excellence.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
  
  
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.
  
  
Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Global Business Services (GBS) is where Diageo runs and transforms its core commercial and financial processes at scale. Within GBO, the Order-to-Cash (O2C) team owns the end-to-end journey from customer order through to cash collection — and the customer experience that surrounds it.
  
  
Customer Experience (Queries) sits at the heart of that journey. When a customer raises a query, dispute or claim, how quickly and cleanly we resolve it shapes their trust in Diageo and the cash we collect. This team is accountable for resolving customer queries at pace, removing the root causes behind them, and raising the service bar across markets.
  
  
It’s a space that blends operational delivery with transformation — where you improve today’s service while redesigning tomorrow’s, and see the impact of your work on both customers and the P&L almost immediately.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Manager – Customer Experience (Queries), you are the expert owner of customer query, orders, dispute and claim resolution across your markets, and a driving force behind improving and transforming how that work is done. This is an individual contributor role: you are accountable for service performance — speed, quality and customer satisfaction — and for reducing the volume and root causes of queries over time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end transformation of Order-to-Cash and customer service across people, process, technology and data — lifting service levels and reducing cost-to-serve across markets.
* Own process and technology solution transformation from design and business case through build, deployment and adoption, ensuring measurable service and efficiency gains.
* Drive continuous-improvement initiatives that embed a culture of ongoing improvement across query, dispute and claim resolution.
* Identify and eliminate the root causes of recurring queries, partnering with upstream O2C, master data and commercial teams to fix them at source.
* Use data and insight to track performance, prioritise improvements and report to senior stakeholders.
* Act as a subject-matter resource for the team on query-resolution best practice, helping embed standard ways of working as the market footprint grows.

**Essential**
**Experience / skills required**

* 10–12+ years' experience in Order-to-Cash, with deep end-to-end process knowledge.
* Proven track record of delivering transformation and change in an O2C or shared-services environment.
* Experience managing senior stakeholders across multiple markets.
* Strong analytical, data-driven approach to performance improvement.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-influencing skills.

**Preferred**

* Lean / Six Sigma qualification, or demonstrable process-improvement experience.
* Customer service, query or dispute-management experience.
* Experience operating across multiple international markets.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package.

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
  
  
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
  
  
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

title: Team Leader
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Entity Corporate Action team receive request from various stakeholders throughout the bank via email from Credit, Legal, Business Unit, PMA, etc. Team is responsible for proactively maintaining client data at Coper/GCI & liaison with different team for moving/closing of static for corporate action true events such as mergers, terminations, dissolutions of entities. Additionally, works on duplicate client records on CoPeR and LEI maintenance activity by linking & delinking. Account Data services (ADS) Corporate Action is responsible for adding and maintaining static data activities for global market securities operations, primarily for fixed income, equities, institutional cash products and derivatives. This includes adding and updating account details and to mark the identifier closed to support the corporate action activity. ADS Corporate action team actions multiple static changes due to different types of corporate actions, mainly Mergers, Closures, Terminations, Dissolutions of entities & non-corporate action events such as Duplicate, IA update, BO Update, Fund Code Update, Update of underlying static for Name Change & Transfer of Business. Vendor Corporate Action events (Legal name change, Acquisitions, Divestitures, Bankruptcy and Spin-offs) are received daily from Bloomberg feed in GBAM Entity Management System (GEMS). System suggests a possible match to existing Bank client. Associate reviews and confirms if a) Legal entity from Corporate Action event does match to existing Bank client, and b) if the requested change is valid. If so, associate creates Market Maintenance Request (MMR), and Corporate Action event is placed on a daily report that notifies the team. An MMR created for name change are actioned by the corporate action team & MMR created for Acquisitions, Divestitures, Bankruptcy and Spin-offs event is reviewed and either applied to the client profile Core Entity Database (CED) & Cesium or denied by assigned DMO.
  
  
**Job Description\***
Primary area of responsibility :- Validation of supporting documents provided in the corporate action request as per procedures – Perform research on internal and (approved) external sources/systems to validate events – Liaise with multiple teams to perform checks/procure approvals to proceed with corporate action request , Create Market Maintenance Requests (MMR) for Vendor Corporate Action events , received daily from Bloomberg feed in GBAM Entity Management System (GEMS) – Diligent and timely request tracker update – Query remediation for emails addressed to team group mailbox -Index documents in the Global Documentation System (GDS) - Onboard new clients assisting with Creation of CoPeR IDs-Create/modify the legal entity hierarchy by linking the CoPeR entity to its Immediate parent or Global ultimate parent-Match legal entities within Client Life Cycle Manager - (CLM) -Identify Duplicate entity– Dupe OBO - Update underlying static accounts in multiple systems of records as per the request.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, researching bank systems as well as external websites and applications to gather and validate client information, providing business partner support and participating in various data remediation projects to help maintain data integrity. Deliver and manage individual targets and contribute towards process metrics.
* Excellent Communication skills both written & spoken.
* Analytical thinking & logical reasoning for rational decision making.
* To create improvements in business processes by contributing ideas and implementing agreed changes into the team's day-to-day operations.
* Build productive teams that works effectively together to achieve or exceed set operational targets & client Service Level Agreements (SLA's)
* To perform all tasks following company policy and procedures, including legal & regulatory requirements, and to prescribed company standards.
* Understanding of Business Continuity Management
* Act as a catalyst in mentoring and grooming team members and prepare them for higher responsibilities.
* To provide coaching & support to individuals to develop their skills, acting as a role model for excellent behavior and performance.

**Requirements\***

* Education\* Any Graduate/PGs except from Tier 1 & 2
* Certifications If Any – NA
* Experience Range\* 5-9 years.

**Foundational Skills:**

* Associate should have excellent communication skills (verbal & written).
* Must possess good PC skills with proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint and web-based tools.
* Should possess excellent analytical, problem-solving and research skills.

**Desired skills\***

* Must be self-motivated, work well with minimal direction, work well in a team environment, and possess the ability to work well under tight deadlines.
* Must possess an excellent work ethic and attendance record. Prior experience in research and problem solving is desirable.

**Work Timings\***

* 17:30 – 02:30 IST

**Job Location\***

* HYD/GGM

title: Director Media (Cross Channel)
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****Role Summary And Impact****
As part of the
**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**
, the Director – Cross Channel will lead and evolve a global media execution function, working across the United States, Europe and Asia. The role combines cross-channel media expertise, operational leadership, client partnership and people development to deliver scalable, consistent and high-quality outcomes across markets.
  
  
The Director will own the operational strategy, governance, delivery standards, reporting, capacity planning and continuous-improvement agenda across multiple PODs and workstreams. The role will translate business and marketing priorities into practical activation frameworks, guide teams through ambiguity, and build a future-ready, AI-enabled delivery organisation. We are looking for a Director – Cross Channel who will:
  
  
Cross-Channel Operations and Delivery Excellence
  
  

* Lead end-to-end operations across at least two core digital media disciplines, such as Search, Social, Programmatic or Ad Operations, while maintaining a working understanding of complementary channels.
* Build and govern common delivery standards across teams, PODs and markets, covering campaign setup, quality assurance, tracking, reporting, documentation and operational controls.
* Drive measurable improvements in quality, timeliness, productivity and delivery outcomes through clear performance measures, root-cause analysis and disciplined follow-through.
* Scale and continuously improve processes, integrating workflows across media functions to enable consistent and connected cross-channel delivery.
* Champion automation, advanced measurement and AI/ML-enabled ways of working to improve efficiency, insight and scalability.
* Maintain awareness of evolving industry developments, including identity solutions, real-time analytics and server-side tagging, and translate relevant developments into the media operations roadmap.

Client, Market and Stakeholder Leadership
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with Nexus-Hub regional teams, market leaders, internal senior stakeholders and external clients.
* Confidently lead senior and CEO-level conversations, simplifying complex operational issues and translating business goals into scalable frameworks and activation plans.
* Act as a strategic partner rather than only a delivery lead, thinking beyond the immediate problem and focusing stakeholders on sustainable solutions and outcomes.
* Influence across strategy, analytics, engineering and activation teams, including situations where direct authority is limited.
* Own cross-market escalations, exercise sound stakeholder judgement and make informed decisions in ambiguous situations or where information is incomplete.
* Communicate clearly and credibly across organisational levels, both verbally and in writing.

People and Leadership
  
  

* Lead a high-performing, globally distributed organisation, with experience managing teams of approximately 30–50 people and 4–8 direct reports.
* Create clarity of direction and accountability across multiple PODs or workstreams, balancing delivery priorities, team capacity and stakeholder expectations.
* Coach and mentor leaders and team members, provide timely and actionable feedback, and build a strong succession and leadership pipeline.
* Drive training, professional growth and platform capability while reinforcing best practices, operational consistency and quality at scale.
* Foster resilience, collaboration and openness to feedback, and visibly translate feedback into action.

Planning, Risk and Commercial Discipline
  
  

* Lead or support scoping, capacity planning, staffing and resource management across markets and workstreams.
* Proactively identify delivery, capability and stakeholder risks; establish mitigations early and maintain ownership through resolution.
* Manage vendor relationships and evaluate relevant martech and adtech solutions to support platform compliance and operational innovation.
* Work independently, take ownership of outcomes and make timely decisions while balancing client needs, team sustainability and operational priorities.

****Skills And Experience****

* Minimum 10 years of relevant digital media and operations experience, with no exceptions; 12–15 years of professional experience is preferred for this Director-level scope.
* Deep expertise in at least two digital media channels among Search, Social, Programmatic and Ad Operations, with working knowledge of complementary channels.
* Hands-on experience with relevant platforms and tools, which may include Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, The Trade Desk, DV360, SA360, CM360/DCM, Microsoft Advertising, Amazon Ads, LinkedIn, AppsFlyer and tagging or analytics tools.
* Proven experience leading sizeable, multi-location media activation or operations teams and delivering centralised support to local or regional teams.
* Experience working with global and geographically distributed teams; exposure to multiple PODs or workstreams is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to manage complex client relationships, cross-functional collaboration and senior stakeholder expectations.
* Strong track record of maintaining quality standards, driving operational improvement and delivering performance at scale.
* Good understanding of scoping, capacity planning, staffing requirements and resource trade-offs.
* AI-enabled mindset, with prior experience or meaningful exposure to applying AI in work highly desirable.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in any field.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

Leadership and Behavioural Traits
  
  

* Solution-oriented and strategic: looks beyond the immediate problem and focuses on scalable, sustainable solutions.
* Mature stakeholder manager: navigates complex internal and external relationships, including senior and CEO-level conversations, with confidence and judgement.
* Delivery standard-setter: creates consistency across teams and markets and holds the organisation accountable for measurable quality and delivery outcomes.
* Decisive under ambiguity: makes sound, informed choices when information is incomplete and maintains ownership of the outcome.
* Proactive risk leader: anticipates challenges, surfaces issues early and mobilises the right action before delivery is affected.
* Continuous-improvement champion: scales processes, embraces automation and raises operational maturity over time.
* Coach and talent builder: develops people, strengthens leadership capability and creates an environment in which feedback leads to action.
* Resilient and collaborative: remains constructive under pressure, works across boundaries and responds openly to feedback.
* Influential and independent: shapes outcomes without relying on hierarchy and works autonomously while staying connected to enterprise priorities.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Category Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented
**Category Manager – Mobility, Transit & Tourism t**
o own the end-to-end performance of this unified vertical on DigiHaat. You will build and scale a comprehensive mobility and tourism marketplace covering daily/regional transit options, stays, local experiences, guided tours, and travel-linked products such as handicrafts, local produce, and curated travel kits. You will onboard and manage supply, ensure listing quality, track bookings and fulfillment, and work with product and tech teams to deliver a seamless buyer journey across transit and travel.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Strategy and Growth
* Define and execute the category strategy for mobility, transit, and tourism with clear goals, priorities, and KPIs in collaboration with product, marketing, and business teams.
* Identify high-potential segments across transit & mobility (first-mile/last-mile connectivity, intercity bus/rail integrators, local transit options) alongside tourism segments (homestays, rural & heritage tourism, craft and culinary experiences, pilgrimage and wellness travel).
* Build the category roadmap around seasonality, commuting patterns, regional demand, festivals, and travel trends.
* Align category operations with broader business objectives of growth, network adoption, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
* Supply Onboarding and Partner Management
* Onboard and nurture a diverse supply base: transit operators, mobility service providers, homestay owners, tour operators, local guides, experience hosts, artisans, and tourism-linked sellers.
* Build strong relationships with mobility aggregators, transport operators, travel suppliers, and logistics partners to ensure service reliability, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Set and monitor service standards, cancellation/refund policies, and compliance requirements, including transport permits, local licenses, and safety norms.
* Handhold small transit operators, experience hosts, and first-time digital sellers through onboarding, catalogue creation, and platform best practices.
* Booking, Transit & Order Lifecycle Operations
* Monitor the full lifecycle from route search, booking, ticket issuance, and service delivery to post-trip feedback to ensure a smooth end-to-end customer experience.
* Track and resolve operational issues such as schedule disruptions, cancellations, no-shows, overbooking, service quality complaints, refunds, and physical product deliveries.
* Work with operations teams to streamline fulfillment for mobility bookings and tourism-linked retail products.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce operational costs and maximize booking efficiency.
* Pricing, Inventory and Demand Management
* Use demand forecasting to manage inventory, seat/stay availability, and peak/off-peak capacity across daily transit and travel seasons.
* Develop dynamic pricing strategies, bundled offers, and multi-modal travel packages (e.g., Transit Pass + Stay + Experience + Local Products) to improve conversion and basket value.
* Work with marketing on customer acquisition campaigns, transit usage incentives, destination-led promotions, and seasonal travel offers.
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Use data and analytics to track category performance: GMV, total bookings, route throughput, conversion rate, repeat rate, cancellation rate, customer ratings, and partner reliability.
* Identify commuting and travel trends, regional transit bottlenecks, and category expansion opportunities.
* Deliver regular performance reports and actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders for continuous platform optimization.
* Listing Quality and User Experience
* Ensure listings, routes, and travel options are accurate, current, and compelling - covering departure/arrival schedules, stay descriptions, itineraries, amenities, pricing, availability, and policies.
* Analyze customer reviews, ratings, and ride/trip feedback to identify pain points and collaborate with tech/product teams to address them.
* Drive product enhancements for multi-modal travel discovery, transit routing, category search filters, and trust signals for mobility and travel services.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Total Experience: 8–12 years in category management, marketplace operations, or business leadership roles.
* Mandatory Industry Experience: Direct, proven experience across Mobility / Transit, the Travel Industry, and Tourism Management.
* Track Record: Proven success in building, scaling, and monetizing digital platforms in mobility, travel, or multi-service marketplaces.

**Must-Have Attributes**

* Hands-on experience with buyer-facing apps in mobility, transit, travel, hospitality, or experience marketplaces (e.g., transit/cab apps, OTAs, activity platforms).
* Deep understanding of the Indian mobility and tourism ecosystem, including urban/rural transit networks, regional travel dynamics, and localized tourism.
* Expertise in yield management, dynamic pricing, route/inventory capacity planning, and user acquisition strategies.
* Solid grasp of agile methodologies and demonstrated skill in working with cross-functional product and tech teams.
* Exceptional negotiation, partner management, and stakeholder communication skills.

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
* Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
* Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

* You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures

Location: New Delhi

Experience: 20+ years within the manufacturing industry, 12-15 years of experience in ESR, steel, forging, special metals, heavy engineering industries and downstream facilities like heat treatment & machining

**OVERALL PURPOSE OF THE ROLE:**

The incumbent will provide strategic and operational leadership for the entire ESR and Forging business with complete accountability for business growth, profitability, manufacturing excellence, customer satisfaction, technology leadership, and sustainable value creation. The role will oversee business strategy, commercial operations, manufacturing, supply chain, engineering, quality, financial performance, and organizational capability while ensuring world-class standards of safety, compliance, and operational excellence. This role will drive the business towards becoming a preferred supplier of critical forged and ESR products for Defence, Aerospace, Nuclear, Energy, Railways, Oil & Gas, Heavy Engineering, and Industrial markets.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**1) Strategic Business Leadership:**

·      Develop and execute the long-term business strategy for the ESR & Forging Business aligned with the organization's vision and growth objectives.

·      Drive business expansion through capacity enhancement, product diversification, technology upgrades, and market development.

·      Identify emerging opportunities across Defence, Aerospace, Nuclear, Oil & Gas, Railways, Power Generation, Heavy Engineering, Marine, Mining, and Industrial sectors.

·      Evaluate strategic investments, acquisitions, technology collaborations, and partnerships to strengthen competitive positioning.

·      Monitor industry trends, customer requirements, global steel and forging markets, and competitive dynamics to formulate growth strategies.

**2) Business Development & Commercial Excellence:**

·      Develop and implement commercial strategies to achieve revenue, market share, and profitability objectives.

·      Build and strengthen long-term relationships with strategic customers, OEMs, EPC companies, PSUs, Defence organisations, and international clients.

·      Lead the complete business development lifecycle including customer acquisition, tendering, techno-commercial negotiations, contract finalisation, and order execution.

·      Expand export business by identifying new international markets and strategic channel partners.

·      Strengthen key account management and enhance customer retention through superior service delivery.

3)
**Manufacturing & Operational Excellence:**

·      Provide strategic leadership for ESR, melting, forging, heat treatment, machining, testing, and finishing operations.

·      Ensure optimum utilisation of plant capacity, manpower, equipment, and production resources.

·      Drive Operational Excellence through Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Six Sigma, Industry 4.0, automation, and digital manufacturing initiatives.

·      Improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), productivity, yield, throughput, and delivery performance.

·      Lead plant modernisation, capacity expansion, and manufacturing technology enhancement projects.

4)
**Financial Performance & Business Profitability:**

·      Own the complete Profit & Loss (P&L) responsibility for the business.

·      Develop annual business plans, operating budgets, financial forecasts, and capital expenditure plans.

·      Drive EBITDA improvement through operational efficiencies, cost optimisation, value engineering, and productivity enhancement.

·      Monitor business performance using financial and operational dashboards and implement corrective actions.

·      Optimise working capital, inventory management, cash flow, and return on invested capital.

5)
**Technology, Engineering & Product Development**

·      Drive development of high-value ESR and forged products for critical engineering applications.

·      Lead product innovation and qualification programmes in collaboration with customers, engineering teams, R&D institutions, and certification agencies.

·      Promote adoption of advanced metallurgical processes, simulation technologies, automation, and digital quality systems.

·      Support development of specialised alloys, high-performance steels, and customised forging solutions.

6)
**Quality, Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

title: Clinical Operations Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Clinical Operations Manager**
**Brief Description Of Position**
This role is accountable for performance and compliance for assigned protocols in a country in compliance with ICH/GCP and country regulations, internal policies and procedures, quality standards and adverse event reporting requirements internally and externally.
  
  
Under the oversight of the Sr. COM, Head COMs or CRD, the person is responsible for budget/finance aspects, for execution and oversight of clinical trial country submissions and approvals and to ensure Site Ready.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Ownership of country and site budgets. Development, negotiation and completion of Clinical Trial Research Agreements (CTRA).
* Oversees and tracks clinical research-related payments. Payment reconciliation at study close-out. Oversees FCPA, DPS/OFAC, and maintenance of financial systems. Financial forecasting in conjunction with Sr.COM /other roles.
* Executes and oversees clinical trial country submissions and approvals for assigned protocols.
* Develops local language materials including local language Informed Consents and translations. Interacts with IRB/IEC and Regulatory Authority for assigned protocols.
* Manages country deliverables, timelines and results for assigned protocols to meet country commitments. Responsible for quality and compliance in assigned protocols in country.
* Contributes to the development of local SOPs. Oversees CTCs as applicable.
* Coordinates and liaises with CRM, CTC, CRA, (Finance and Legal if appropriate) to ensure country deliverables are obtained for submissions, budgets, CTRAs and local milestones. Collaborates closely with Headquarter to align country timelines for assigned protocols.
* Provide support and oversight to local vendors as applicable.
* Oversees and coordinates local processes, clinical and ancillary supplies management, importing and exporting requirements, supplies destruction, local electronic/hard copy filing, archiving and retention requirements, and insurance process management. Enters and updates country information in clinical and finance systems.
* Ownership of local regulatory and financial compliance. The position has a significant impact on how a country can deliver country-specific trial commitments and objectives especially during study start-up.
* Required to in/directly influence investigators, external partners and country operations and adheres to budget targets and agreed payment timelines.
* Works in partnership internally with GCTO country operations, finance, regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, legal and regional operations, HQ functional areas and externally with vendors and sites, IRB/IECs and Regulatory Authorities in submission and approval related-interactions. Through continual interaction with local clinical team/s successfully delivers clinical and financial contracts within fair market value.
* Contribute or lead initiatives and projects adding value to the business, as appropriate/required.
* Contributes strongly to COM team and other Country Operations roles knowledge by acting as process Subject Matter Expert (SME), sharing best practices, making recommendations for continuous improvement and providing training as appropriate/required.
* Contributes to COM team knowledge by acting as buddy/mentor and sharing best practices as appropriate/required.

**Qualifications, Skills & Experience**
**Core competencies**

* Expertise of core clinical systems, tools and metrics
* Excellent verbal and written influrencing and training/mentoring skills, in local language and English
* Strong coordination and organizational skills
* Skilled knowledge of budget and contract negotiations, local regulatory environment and submission and approval processes, and understanding of how these impact study start-up.
* Ability to indirectly influence investigators, vendors, external partners and country managers to address and resolve issues, with minimal support from the Sr.COM or manager.
* Ability to make decisions independently with limited oversight from Sr.COM or manager.
* Requires strong understanding of local regulatory environment
* Ability to proactively develop risk management and mitigation plans in the country and resolve issues locally.
* Ability to lead a team of CTCs as applicable

**Behavioural Competency Expectations**

* Problem solving is essential to this position. Requires the ability to pro-actively identify issues and risks, analyse root cause, and propose solutions to problems and escalate to management as applicable. Specific examples of common problems include 1) Issues in budget / CTRA negotiations, 2) Quality and compliance issues, 3) Regulatory and legal issues, and 4) issues related to functional area deliverables that could jeopardize protocol milestones.
* Effective and efficient time management, organizational and interpersonal skills, conflict management and problem-solving skills.
* High sense of accountability and urgency in order to properly prioritize deliverables
* Strong communication, leadership, and negotiation skills as well as excellent influencing and training/mentoring skills, both written and verbal, in local language and English.
* Ability to focus on multiple deliverables and protocols simultaneously is essential. Requires that the individual has ability to work effectively also in a remote virtual environment with a wide range of people.
* Positive mindset, growth mindset, capable of working independently and being self-driven
* Able to directly influence site staff

**Experience Requirements**
5 years of experience in clinical research or combined experience in Clinical Research and Finance/Business
  
  
**Educational Requirements**
Bachelor's Degree in Business Finance/ Administration/ Life Science or equivalent Health Care related experience

* Schedule staffing, oversee training, and conduct performance reviews; mentor team on luxury service, culinary basics, and cultural awareness.
* Manage budgets for concierge operations, provisions, and amenities; control costs without compromising quality.
* Support irregular operations and off-hours requests with flexible availability.

* 4–6 years inflight or airline operations experience, including 2–3 years leading a diverse team.
* Working knowledge of DGCA/CAA regulations.
* Excellent leadership, coaching, and communication skills; calm under pressure with sound judgment.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and time-management skills; proficient with MS Office and crew/ops systems.

* Experience with safety management systems (SMS) and service quality programs.

Owns premium ground-to-air concierge operations for elite, VIP, and high-touch clients. Leads a team delivering seamless end-to-end experiences, from pre-trip planning and bespoke catering to day-of-travel coordination and post-trip follow-up.

Preferred

* Experience implementing service standards and training programs.

title: Head of Retail
description:
**LENSKART**

*Job Description*

**Retail Leader**

**Mission Brief**

Lenskart's offline retail network is one of the largest and fastest-scaling in the world — thousands of stores across metros, Tier 2/3 India, and international markets, staffed by tens of thousands of frontline team members. This role owns a defined slice of that network.

You will build the operating discipline that lets every store under your charge deliver a consistent, premium, tech-enabled customer experience, while driving revenue and profitability with rigor. This is a P&L-owning, people-leading, systems-thinking role — for leaders who see retail not as a set of stores but as a network that gets smarter with every data point.

**Core Mandate**

**1. P&L Ownership & Revenue Growth**

* **Revenue Ownership:**
  Own the end-to-end P&L for the assigned store network — revenue, margin, and store-level profitability across company-owned and franchise stores.
* **Planning:**
  Build and execute the network's strategic business plan, Annual Operating Plan, and financial forecasts, aligned to the broader retail strategy.
* **Performance Management:**

* **Inventory Control:**

* **Automation:**

**4. People Leadership & Culture**

* **Talent Development:**
  Lead, mentor, and develop Area/Cluster/Zonal Managers, Store Managers, and frontline teams — building a leadership pipeline and succession bench.
* **Hiring & Retention:**
  Build a world-class retail talent pipeline through structured hiring, onboarding, L&D, and career pathing that retains top performers.
* **Culture:**
  Foster a high-performance, customer-first culture with clear accountability, recognition frameworks, and incentive structures; reduce attrition through strong ground-level connect.
* **Alignment:**
  Embed the Lenskart Way into every aspect of retail execution — agility, ownership, and customer obsession — while aligning network-level goals to the broader retail strategy.

**5. Cross-Functional Impact**

* **Cross-Functional Partnership:**

Lead a critical piece of one of India's largest and fastest-growing offline retail networks, at the intersection of physical retail and AI-driven technology. Lenskart is a founder-led, newly-listed (NSE: LENSKART) company with a bias for speed and impact — decisions move fast here, and so does your career. title: Strategy & Operations Director
description:
**About Voy**
Voy is one of the largest DTC online healthcare providers in the world. Present in the UK, Germany, Brazil and India.
  
  
Voy entered India through the 100% acquisition of EarlyFit, which was started in 2025 by two passionate co-founders who spent 6 years in New York and witnessed first-hand the power of GLP-1s and how it grew from a niche solution to over 10cr real users worldwide. Earlyfit started as India’s first full-stack tech-led GLP-1 led weight loss platform. At the intersection of healthcare, science, and consumer technology, we combined GLP-1, medical expertise, endocrinologist-led care, diagnostics, nutrition coaching, and ongoing behavioural support into one seamless experience.
  
  
**About The Space**
GLP-1s represent a quantum leap in healthcare (think penicillin!) and possibly the biggest healthcare opportunity of our lifetimes. The GLP market went from 0 to $60B in just 8 years and estimated to grow to $200B in the next 10. Several multi-billion dollar companies like Voy, Found, Ro and Hims and Hers have ridden this wave that’s only just arrived in India with the 2025 launch of Mounjaro and Ozempic. We’re 8 years behind the US and Europe (which is super frustrating but also...) means there is a unique opportunity to category- create in a white space (think Paytm for mobile wallets) and in the process, give 10+ years of healthy life to each patient we onboard. Sure, we have some catching up to do but the Indian GLP space has something the West doesn’t - Generics. The patent for semaglutide (Ozempic) in India expired in March 2026 brining monthly medication prices from Rs 20k a month to Rs3k a month. With 250 million obese Indians who can now suddenly afford life-changing medical help that’s never existed in the country before, you do the math.
  
  
**Strategy & Operations - Role Overview**
The S&O (Strategy & operations) role offers an opportunity to join the founding team of Voy India (formerly Earlyfit) in building 1-10. We’re scaling aggressively with the full backing of a tech, clinical and patient ops powerhouse that has 7+ years’ experience serving 2mn+ customers globally across not just weight loss but also hair loss, TRT, HRT, dermatology and more.
  
  
This role is a generalist that will be thrown at many business problems over their time here – some big, some small, some that will take a few weeks and IC laser focus and some that will take months and a team of 50. The role needs a high-ownership executor with a strategic mind and a builder mindset. Somebody not afraid to take risks, test and fail fast and then pivot quickly. We throw you at any business problem whether that’s in Acquisitions/Growth, Partnerships or Patient Experience/Retention - you take the problem head on, lead discovery, run 2-3 quick pilots, tell us what you want to bet on and then take all the resources you need to execute and scale. Hire, train, standardize/set SOPs, use product teams, and work cross functionally. And finally, work yourself out of the project so it continues to thrive and grow while you move to your next business problem.
  
  
**If this sounds like you, and you have**

* 8+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or similar roles.
* Proven ability to execute and lead cross-functional initiatives and teams
* A burning desire to come to Delhi and build from scratch and get your hands dirty and point to something super impactful and say ‘Hey, I made that happen'

Then let’s chat!
