title: SPL – EdTech and AI (OBF)
description:
**About The Job SPL EdTech And AI (OBF)**
**Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI (OBF)**
**Location:**
Delhi
  
  
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. Development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
  
  
We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised five critical areas of work: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN); EdTech and AI; Early Childhood Education (ECE); Schools Governance; and High Potential Students (HPS).
  
  
Read more about our work at the CSF website: https://www.centralsquarefoundation.org.
  
  
**About EdTech And AI At CSF**
CSF's EdTech and AI initiative focuses on leveraging technology to enhance teaching and learning, both in classrooms and at home, through student-focused and teacher-directed interventions. Our goal is to improve foundational learning in primary grades and provide remediation support in middle school using evidence-based, scalable technology solutions.
  
  

* Since 2012, CSF has played a pivotal role in shaping India's EdTech ecosystem by bridging demand and supply, backed by rigorous research. We drive impact by:
* Supporting EdTech organisations to build contextually relevant, pedagogically sound products for low-income learners.
* Generating evidence on what works, how it works, and how to scale effective EdTech interventions.
* Partnering with governments to adopt and effectively implement evidence-backed EdTech solutions, strengthen the utilisation of public investments in technology, and influence policy and system priorities.
* Creating public goods to drive innovation and strengthen the broader ecosystem.
* In the last five years, CSF has collaborated with 15+ EdTech organisations, 11+ state governments, and leading academic institutions, reaching over 10 million learners across India.

**About The Project**
A proposed outcomes-based financing (OBF) platform is being developed by Central Square Foundation in partnership with a selected program partner, to improve foundational literacy and numeracy outcomes in government schools. The initiative aims to build a robust, evidence-based case for personalised adaptive learning (PAL) in Grades 1–5, while creating the delivery, financing and procurement pathways required for state governments to adopt and fund effective solutions over time.
  
  
The programme is currently in its design and preparation phase. This includes defining the outcomes and payment framework, selecting states and solution providers, designing implementation and governance structures, establishing independent verification arrangements, securing implementation funding, and engaging governments early so that evidence generated through the programme can translate into long-term public-system adoption.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI (OBF) will lead CSF's programme design and government adoption work for the project. This is a build-stage role suited to someone who can create structure in ambiguity, bring together diverse stakeholders, and design a programme that is rigorous enough for outcomes-based financing while remaining feasible and relevant for government systems.
  
  
The role will work closely with state governments, EdTech solution providers, funders, program partners, independent evaluators and internal CSF teams. A core mandate will be to ensure that government adoption is not treated as an end-stage activity: the Senior Project Lead will shape the programme from the outset around government priorities, implementation realities, evidence needs and eventual pathways for public financing and procurement.
  
  
The Senior Project Lead will report to the Associate Director/Senior Project Director – EdTech and AI.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Programme Strategy, Design & Build
* Lead the end-to-end design of the OBF project from CSF's programme and government-adoption perspective, translating the concept into a clear operating model, implementation architecture, workplan and measurable outcomes.
* Define key design choices across target grades and geographies, student reach, school-level implementation, technology and infrastructure requirements, provider roles, sequencing and scale-up pathways.
* Work with internal and external stakeholders to identify critical assumptions, risks and trade-offs, and translate them into testable design decisions and mitigation plans.
* Ensure the programme design balances learning impact, implementation feasibility, provider incentives, evidence requirements, cost-effectiveness and relevance to government systems.
* Outcomes-Based Financing & Performance Framework
* Work closely with a selected program partner, funders, providers and evaluators to shape an outcomes-based financing model that is credible, implementable and aligned to the programme's learning objectives.
* Contribute to the definition of outcome metrics and payment milestones across onboarding/readiness, product usage and learning gains, including thresholds, verification approaches and implications for provider incentives.
* Support the development of templates and approaches that can inform future outcomes-linked government procurement for PAL.
* Government Engagement, Salience & Adoption Pathway
* Lead early government engagement so that programme design reflects state priorities, FLN strategies, infrastructure constraints, implementation capacity and decision-making processes.
* Develop a deliberate government salience strategy: identify the evidence, experiences, champions, review forums and decision points required for PAL to become a credible part of the state's FLN agenda in the long term.
* Create a pathway from philanthropic financing to sustained government ownership, including potential budget heads, procurement models, institutional roles and transition milestones.
* Develop government-facing narratives and outputs such as concept notes, briefs, implementation frameworks, review materials and procurement-oriented documentation.
* Multi-Stakeholder Partnership & Programme Governance
* Serve as a key integrator across state governments, solution providers, selected program partner funders, independent evaluators and CSF teams, ensuring clarity of roles, dependencies and decision rights.
* Lead programme governance processes including workplans, design reviews, decision logs, risk registers, partner reviews and senior stakeholder updates.
* Anticipate and resolve cross-stakeholder bottlenecks while protecting the integrity of the programme's learning and adoption objectives.
* Implementation Readiness, Evidence & Learning
* Co-develop the learning agenda and define the conditions for PAL to deliver outcomes at scale in government primary schools, including implementation fidelity, cost, provider performance and system integration
* Work with Evidence/M&E teams and independent evaluators to ensure that the evaluation and verification framework answers both payment-related questions and the broader questions governments will need answered before adoption.
* Use implementation data and field insights to diagnose bottlenecks, drive course correction and strengthen the programme model over time.
* Knowledge, Scale Strategy & Institutionalisation
* Translate programme evidence and implementation learning into a compelling case for state adoption of PAL in primary grades.
* Develop practical public goods such as implementation playbooks, adoption frameworks, procurement templates, cost models, case studies and policy notes that can support replication beyond participating states.
* Contribute to CSF's broader thought leadership on evidence-backed EdTech, outcomes-based financing and sustainable public financing for technology-enabled learning.
* Team, Budget & Organisational Leadership
* Lead, coach and performance-manage a high-performing team while building ownership and execution capability.
* Own CSF-side programme planning, budgeting, resourcing, reporting and leadership decision materials for the OBF project.
* Coordinate closely with CSF's EdTech and AI, Evidence, State Reform, Finance, Legal, Communications and other relevant teams.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience, including significant work with Indian state and/or central government systems. Preference will be given to applicants from Education, EdTech, or adjacent sectors.
* Exposure to outcomes-based financing, results-based financing, impact bonds, performance-linked contracts or innovative procurement models
* Track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder programmes from design through implementation and institutionalisation.
* Experience managing portfolios, budgets, teams and external partners with strong execution discipline.
* Master's degree in business, public policy, education, engineering, development studies or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability and track record in building senior government relationships and translating evidence and programme insights into policy, strategy and system-level outcomes.

**Desired Qualities**

* Strong commitment to improving learning outcomes and equity through public education systems.
* Systems thinker who connects policy, programmes, implementation, evidence and government incentives while remaining execution-focused.
* Entrepreneurial, self-directed and comfortable creating structure in ambiguous and evolving environments.
* Strong influencing, relationship-building, judgement and prioritisation skills across diverse stakeholders.
* Excellent synthesis and communication skills, with curiosity about emerging technologies and their responsible application to education and government systems.

**Compensation**
Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy and social-impact sector benchmarks, commensurate with experience.
  
  
**Application Process**
Interested candidates should submit a resume customized to role outlining relevant experience, a brief statement of interest outlining how your past experience and future aspirations connect to the role (max. 500 words), and two references through the CSF Careers Portal by
**30th September 2026**
.
  
  
We are looking for someone who can commit to at least a three-year journey to help materialise CSF's 2025–2028 EdTech and AI strategy. Shortlisted applicants will complete a case exercise and participate in 2 panel interviews and final leadership conversations. We will evaluate applications on a rolling basis and will close the application process once we find the right candidate.

title: SPL – EdTech and AI
description:
**About The Job SPL - EdTech And AI**
**Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI**
**Location:**
Delhi
  
  
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. Development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
  
  
We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised five critical areas of work: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN); EdTech and AI; Early Childhood Education (ECE); Schools Governance; and High Potential Students (HPS).
  
  
Read more about our work at the CSF website: https://www.centralsquarefoundation.org.
  
  
**About EdTech And AI At CSF**
CSF's EdTech and AI initiative focuses on leveraging technology to enhance teaching and learning, both in classrooms and at home, through student-focused and teacher-directed interventions. Our goal is to improve foundational learning in primary grades and provide remediation support in middle school using evidence-based, scalable technology solutions.
  
  
**Role**
Since 2012, CSF has played a pivotal role in shaping India's EdTech ecosystem by bridging demand and supply, backed by rigorous research. We drive impact by:
  
  

* Supporting EdTech organisations to build contextually relevant, pedagogically sound products for low-income learners.
* Generating evidence on what works, how it works, and how to scale effective EdTech interventions.
* Partnering with governments to adopt and effectively implement evidence-backed EdTech solutions, strengthen the utilisation of public investments in technology, and influence policy and system priorities.
* Creating public goods to drive innovation and strengthen the broader ecosystem.

In the last five years, CSF has collaborated with 15+ EdTech organisations, 11+ state governments, and leading academic institutions, reaching over 10 million learners across India.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI will lead CSF's government adoption, implementation and policy portfolio across EdTech and emerging AI-enabled opportunities in school education.
  
  
The role will translate CSF's EdTech and AI strategy into government adoption and sustained implementation at scale by:
  
  

* Leading partnerships across 3–4 states, from opportunity identification and programme design through procurement, implementation and institutionalisation.
* Building relationships with senior government stakeholders and supporting states to use technology investments effectively.
* Strengthening implementation systems, including Technical Support Units (TSUs), Programme Management Units (PMUs) and other technical-assistance structures.
* Contributing to CSF's engagement with the Ministry of Education and other central institutions.
* Managing teams, budgets and complex programmes while converting evidence and field insights into policy and system-level action.

The Senior Project Lead will report to the Associate Project Director – EdTech and AI.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategy, Portfolio Leadership & Growth
* Translate CSF's EdTech and AI strategy into priorities, workplans and measurable outcomes.
* Lead a portfolio of 3–4 state partnerships, ensuring clear strategies, milestones, ownership, risks and resource plans.
* Identify opportunities for evidence-backed EdTech and AI-enabled interventions and contribute to CSF's thinking on AI in education, digital infrastructure and technology-enabled governance.
* Government Adoption, Implementation & Institutionalisation
* Build demand for evidence-backed EdTech approaches and lead engagements from opportunity identification through scale-up and institutionalisation.
* Support quality-led procurement through programme specifications, technical requirements and implementation frameworks.
* Diagnose implementation bottlenecks using data and field insights, and strengthen government capabilities, ownership, monitoring and sustained usage.
* Government Engagement, Advocacy & Salience Building
* Build trusted relationships with senior state and central government stakeholders.
* Lead engagement with the Ministry of Education and other national institutions on EdTech, AI and digital education.
* Develop government-facing narratives and outputs, including concept notes, policy memos, guidelines, procurement language and implementation frameworks.
* Programme Management, Governance & Technical Assistance
* Lead programme design, partner selection, contracting, implementation planning, risk management, monitoring and course correction.
* Establish effective governance systems, including workplans, reviews, decision logs and deliverable tracking.
* Design or strengthen TSUs, PMUs and other technical-assistance structures, working with Evidence/M&E, Finance, Communications, State Reform and other CSF teams.
* Evidence, Knowledge & Thought Leadership
* Use evidence, implementation data and field learning to guide programme decisions and recommendations.
* Develop case studies, implementation playbooks, policy notes, frameworks and other knowledge outputs.
* Contribute to CSF's thought leadership on evidence-backed EdTech, AI in education, technology for governance and public investment in education technology.
* Team Leadership, Budgeting & Organisational Management
* Lead, coach and performance-manage a high-performing team while building ownership and execution capability.
* Own portfolio planning, budgeting, resource allocation, reporting and decision materials for leadership and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate across CSF teams and contribute to talent reviews, capability building and organisational priorities.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience, including significant work with Indian state and/or central government systems. Preference will be given to applicants from Education, EdTech, or adjacent social sectors.
* Track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder programmes from design through implementation and institutionalisation.
* Experience managing portfolios, budgets, teams and external partners with strong execution discipline.
* Master's degree in business, public policy, education, engineering, development studies or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability and track record in building senior government relationships and translating evidence and programme insights into policy, strategy and system-level outcomes.

**Desired Qualities**

* Strong commitment to improving learning outcomes and equity through public education systems.
* Systems thinker who connects policy, programmes, implementation, evidence and government incentives while remaining execution-focused.
* Entrepreneurial, self-directed and comfortable creating structure in ambiguous and evolving environments.
* Strong influencing, relationship-building, judgement and prioritisation skills across diverse stakeholders.
* Excellent synthesis and communication skills, with curiosity about emerging technologies and their responsible application to education and government systems.

**Compensation**
Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy and social-impact sector benchmarks, commensurate with experience.
  
  
**Application Process**
Interested candidates should submit a resume customised to role outlining relevant experience, a brief statement of interest outlining how your past experience and future aspirations connect to the role (max. 500 words) through the CSF Careers Portal by
**20th September 2026**
.
  
  
Candidates should apply only if they can
**commit to at least a three-year journey**
to help materialise CSF's 2025–2028 EdTech and AI strategy.

Leadership Profile:
  
  
Hyatt’s Leadership Profile clarifies what is expected of Hyatt’s leaders and the specific behaviors that successful leaders exhibit to achieve business results.
  
  
Be familiar with Hyatt’s Leadership Profile as the expectation and measure of your performance. Additionally, exhibiting these behaviors will help you hire, develop, evaluate and reward talent successfully.
  
  
**Learn & Grow**
Leaders are quick and curious. They are more likely than others to be energized by the challenge of the unfamiliar, to quickly understand new or complex situations and data, and to share that learning with others. They are also likely to be more open to feedback, to reflect and learn from experiences, and to recover quickly from setbacks. They probably also have a higher risk tolerance and greater resilience to recover from mistakes or failures than many of their peers. These behaviors and personal qualities are an advantage in becoming more effective as a leader over time.
  
  
**Foster a Culture of Care**
Leaders build trust through listening first, acting ethically and with integrity. They truly care about others and demonstrate that as they display empathy, create an inclusive environment, encourage diverse viewpoints, and recognize and reward excellence. They assume responsibility for the customer experience, prioritize stakeholder needs, and ensure colleagues have the resources and support they need to demonstrate to customers that we really care.
  
  
**Adapt and Thrive with Change**
Leaders look ahead and make needed changes happen. They are comfortable adapting or transforming existing processes or directions to customer needs, and are more proactive in identifying and removing barriers to change and engaging key internal stakeholders. They also tend to be aware of the broader business climate, able to connect trends in the external world to changes needed internally, and more likely to sponsor or coach teams driving change.
  
  
**Achieve Results**
Leaders are action-oriented, understand how to effectively work through others, and are undeterred by challenges. They move quickly to address issues and tend to be comfortable making decisions even when the right answer isn’t totally clear. They are more likely to set clear expectations for colleagues on their team, hold their team to higher performance standards, and give direct feedback. At the same time, they tend to provide support to their team in order to achieve the goals—communicating, coaching and developing, helping them connect their individual work to a greater goal, and entrusting them to act. They are also more likely to see the bigger picture, think longer-term about their team’s talent needs, and to take a longer-term view of results that count.

Full-time Graduate from a recognized institution. MBA / PGDM in Business Administration, Finance, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related discipline preferred.

title: Principal Manager, New Program Development (EAII Advisors)
description:
**This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.**
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families. For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
  
  
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 9 countries, our team of 800+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
Our Accelerator is the engine for new programs. It is a venture-style, stage-gated pipeline that finds the most promising health interventions and develops the strongest into programs ready to scale. Only about 2% of the interventions we evaluate make it through, and those that do have gone on to raise over $100 million. The New Program Development (NPD) team drives this work. We source and vet new ideas, dig into the evidence and cost-effectiveness, build partnerships with researchers, governments, and implementers, and test concepts in the field to turn the best ideas into real programs.
  
  
We are hiring a Principal Manager to lead the development of our next generation of health programs. You will own a set of early-stage interventions and drive each one from a research insight to a program that is proven, fundable, and ready to scale, or to a clear and well-reasoned decision to stop. You bring the rigor of an analyst who can interrogate evidence honestly and reason carefully under uncertainty. You also bring the drive of a builder who can source opportunities, cultivate partnerships, and turn ideas into programs that work in the real world. Together, those strengths let you find and build the interventions that deliver the most health impact for every dollar spent. You will join a close-knit team that puts evidence first, thinks big, acts urgently, and is willing to challenge convention to reach more people. You will report to the India Country Lead with a dotted technical line to the Accelerator Director.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own a portfolio of pipeline interventions, end to end. Drive several promising candidate programs through the Accelerator's stage-gate process, and decide what advances, what gets reshaped, and what exits our pipeline
* Interrogate the evidence with honesty. Assess each intervention's evidence base on the merits, including effect sizes and their quality, external validity, variability, negative and contradictory findings, and gaps.
* Model impact and cost-effectiveness under uncertainty. Partner with the Cost-Effectiveness team to build and pressure-test CEAs, reasoning explicitly about assumptions, sensitivity, and uncertainty, and translating them into clear go/no-go implications
* Design and run decision-relevant learning in close collaboration with our MLE team. Scope and execute lean, rigorous field activities such as scoping, formative research, and pilots, to unblock decisions
* Build the case and align stakeholders. Craft compelling, evidence-grounded investment cases. Bring researchers, implementers, governments, and donors along, anticipate objections, unblock barriers, and create momentum
* Collaborate across Evidence Action. Work hand in hand with our Growth team to build necessary resourcing and funding, relevant Program teams who bring the implementation muscle, and the Country Teams who cultivate and manage the policy and government partnerships in the places we work
* Be Evidence Action's face with partners. Independently lead conversations with study authors, implementing organizations, government officials, and funders, and use those relationships to source new ideas and partnerships
* Strengthen the Accelerator's methods, AI-enabled workflows, and quality bar, and mentor analysts and interns on the workstreams you lead

**Requirements**
**Essential**

* You have a bachelors degree and 6 - 10 years of experience in quant social science, program management, international development, or global health in a cross-country setting
* You read primary research and study design critically, synthesize large and conflicting evidence bases, and form an honest view of what the evidence does and does not support
* You build or rigorously interpret cost-effectiveness, epidemiological, or statistical models, and reason clearly about assumptions, sensitivity, and uncertainty
* You design lean learning activities that target the uncertainty actually blocking a decision, and you deliver them on a timeline
* You move things forward amid uncertainty, building, prototyping, and unblocking rather than waiting for perfect information
* You build trust and align both internal teams and external partners (researchers, implementers, government, and donors) across cultures and sectors toward a shared path
* You make complex technical findings clear and decision-useful for non-technical audiences, in writing and live
* You manage several workstreams at once, sequence sharply, and make defensible calls about where to spend scarce time
* You have experience working in an international setting and working with diverse teams
* You look for the reasons your favorite idea might be wrong, and welcome the same scrutiny of your own work

**Disclaimer:**
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and that additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.
  
  
**Position Location**
The role is based in New Delhi, India.
  
  
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an Indian employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India for roles based in India.
  
  
**Benefits**
EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. Benefits include:
  
  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions
* Life and Accidental insurance
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements
* Mental and physical well-being benefits
* Learning and Development benefit
* Generous leave
* Avenues for engagement and recognition

**Compensation:**
Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
  
  
***All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.***

title: Guest Advisory Lead
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a
**Guest Advisory Lead**
to lead a high-performing customer-facing team that turns traveller interest into confident decisions and successful conversions.
  
  
You’ll be responsible for
**leading, coaching, and developing the Guest Advisory team**
, while ensuring every customer receives clear, thoughtful, and personalised guidance. You’ll set the standard for customer conversations, drive team performance, and ensure consistent ownership of the customer journey from the first interaction through conversion.
  
  
This is a leadership role for someone who combines
**strong communication, commercial instinct, people management, and operational discipline**
, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  
  
**The Job**

* Team Leadership & Performance: Lead, coach, and motivate the Guest Advisory team to consistently achieve customer experience and conversion goals.
* Customer Engagement: Oversee customer interactions across calls, chats, and email, ensuring travellers receive relevant guidance based on their travel needs.
* Conversion & Sales: Drive team performance across lead qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and conversion while maintaining a customer-first approach.
* Coaching & Development: Conduct regular coaching, feedback, and performance reviews to improve communication, product knowledge, sales skills, and overall team effectiveness.
* Customer Experience: Ensure the team delivers clear, empathetic, and accurate guidance on Atlys products, visa processes, timelines, and next steps.
* Quality & Process Management: Monitor customer conversations and lead journeys to maintain high standards of quality, accuracy, ownership, and follow-through.
* Performance Tracking: Track key team metrics, identify performance gaps, and take proactive actions to improve productivity, conversion, and customer experience.
* Customer Insights: Identify recurring customer questions, objections, and pain points and turn these insights into actionable improvements for the team and business.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Fulfilment, Product, and other teams to resolve customer issues, improve processes, and strengthen the overall customer journey.
* Data & Operations: Ensure lead, customer, and interaction data is accurate and up to date, while maintaining strong operational discipline across the team.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 2+ years of experience in sales, pre-sales, customer success, customer experience, or another customer-facing role, with experience leading or mentoring a team.
* Have a strong track record of driving conversions, managing customer journeys, and achieving performance targets.
* Communicate clearly and confidently, with the ability to coach others and simplify complex information into easy, human conversations.
* Are empathetic and persuasive without being pushy, with a strong understanding of customer needs and buying behaviour.
* Are comfortable using data and performance metrics to identify opportunities and improve team outcomes.
* Are proactive, organised, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
* Have strong ownership and problem-solving skills, and can step in to handle complex customer situations when required.
* Enjoy building teams, developing people, giving feedback, and creating a high-performance culture.
* Are comfortable working a 6-day schedule, with Monday to Friday in-office and a rotational WFH shift on either Saturday or Sunday.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

Delhi. This is a 100% work-from-office role.

title: Pod lead - Civil and structural engineering
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced Civil or Structural Engineering expert to lead a pod of trainers building realistic, terminal-based technical tasks for Terminal Bench Science. You will review every task your trainers produce for engineering correctness, reproducibility, and grader reliability, and coach trainers to consistently deliver high-quality tasks.

**Reporting Structure:**

Reports to the Civil & Structural Engineering Team Lead. Leads a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers.

**What you'll do:**

* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, structural and geotechnical models, load cases, simulation data, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving structural analysis, finite-element methods (FEA), earthquake and wind engineering, structural dynamics, geotechnical modeling, hydraulics, hydrology, transportation, and infrastructure systems.
* Ensure tasks require genuine multi-step engineering reasoning and reflect realistic civil and structural engineering workflows.
* Verify engineering accuracy across units, equilibrium, boundary conditions, load combinations, design codes, numerical stability, convergence, and safety factors.
* Validate computational models, solvers, dependencies, and simulation results for reproducibility and technical correctness.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as forces, deflections, drifts, settlements, factors of safety, flow rates, and structural performance.
* Identify technical errors, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering analysis.
* Provide clear, actionable feedback to task developers and track revisions through completion.
* Mentor and support technical trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and productivity, and resolve technical blockers.
* Maintain quality standards, technical documentation, and best practices across engineering task development.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming experience in Python, C/C++, Julia, Fortran, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: structural analysis, FEA, earthquake engineering, geotechnical modeling, or hydraulic/hydrological modeling.
* Strong understanding of engineering principles, numerical methods, simulation workflows, and model validation.
* Working knowledge of engineering design standards such as ASCE 7, ACI, AISC, Eurocodes, or IS codes.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, engineering simulations, research outputs, or computational models.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical inaccuracies, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with engineering simulation and analysis tools such as OpenSees/OpenSeesPy, Code\_Aster, CalculiX, FEniCS, Gmsh, PyNite, EPANET, SWMM, HEC-RAS, MODFLOW, SUMO, QGIS, or GDAL.
* Familiarity with commercial engineering software such as SAP2000, ETABS, Abaqus, PLAXIS, or STAAD.Pro.
* Experience with nonlinear time-history analysis, performance-based design, reliability analysis, or structural health monitoring.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Professional engineering licensure such as PE, SE, CEng, or equivalent.
* Industry experience working on buildings, bridges, transportation networks, water systems, or major infrastructure projects.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* **Commitments Required:**
  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* **Duration of contract :**
  4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: FCS People Leader
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as FCS People Leader at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules & regulations, and codes of conduct. With competitive benefits and opportunities for career advancement, Barclays is a great place to grow your career in the banking industry.
  
  
**Key Critical Skills Required For This Role Include**

* Experience in Team management.
* Knowledge of KYC, AML, Sanctions, Adverse Media, Payment, and customer screening process to ensure adherence to internal policies and regulatory standards.
* Identify and report quality gaps or process deviations, work with relevant teams to drive corrective actions.
* Develop and maintain MIS dashboards and reports related to financial crime controls, customer due diligence, and alert handling.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports for internal stakeholders and compliance leadership.
* Ensure reports reflect accurate status of KYC, AML alerts, and sanctions screening metrics.

* Assist in maintaining and updating watchlist filtering tools and screening logic.
* Work closely with Screening operations teams to identify and resolve data issues.
* Ensure people related issues are handled.

* Should have basic MS Excel knowledge.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Gurugram.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To support Screening with day-to-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution, making decisions in line with comply with relevant regulatory and industry standards.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Support with day-to-day screening initiatives including processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution through lending technical expertise.
* Execution of screening checks on customers, transactions, and other activities to identify potential risks and comply with regulatory requirements.
* Collaboration with teams across the bank to align and integrate screening processes.
* Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations for change in screening processes.
* Development and implementation of screening procedures and controls to mitigate risks and maintain operational efficiency.
* Development of reports and presentations on screening performance.
* Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in screening Services.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve screening efficiency and effectiveness.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Center Manager
description:
**Job Description: Center Manager - Rancho Labs(Gurugram Center)**

**Position Overview:**

The Center Head will be responsible for ensuring smooth day-to-day operations at the center while maintaining strong relationships with parents, students, and internal teams. This role requires a proactive and empathetic leader who can handle both administrative and customer-facing responsibilities - ensuring excellent on-ground execution, high parent satisfaction, and consistent student retention and conversions.

* Coordinate effectively with multiple departments including Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Academics to ensure seamless execution of all center activities.
* Facilitate timely communication between teams to resolve issues and support smooth functioning.

* Build and maintain positive relationships with parents through regular and transparent communication. Share class updates, schedules, and important announcements in the respective parent WhatsApp groups.
* Act as the primary point of contact for parents, addressing their queries and feedback in a professional and empathetic manner.

* Conduct regular checks to ensure that the center is well-maintained and fully equipped for all classes and activities.
* Ensure all essential materials, kits, and components required for project work are available and in good condition.
* Coordinate with the procurement team for timely replenishment or replacement of components and kits.

**4. Lead Handling, Walk-ins & Conversions**

* Attend to every lead visiting the center for trial classes or walk-ins with warmth and professionalism. -Clearly explain the course structure, modules, learning outcomes, and fee details to parents and students. Guide them through the registration process and ensure timely follow-up for conversions.
* Collaborate with the sales team to track and update the lead status and ensure targets are achieved.

**5. Class Management & Coordination**

* Ensure that all classes run smoothly as per the schedule.
* Maintain updated records of instructors, student batches, and attendance.
* Ensure that students bring their kits for every class.

**6. Student Retention & Experience**

* Oversee the student retention process by tracking engagement and feedback.
* Identify and implement innovative strategies to enhance student satisfaction and retention rates. Gather regular feedback from parents and students to identify areas for improvement and ensure continuous enhancement of services.

**7. Reporting & Accountability**

* Maintain all necessary documentation and reports related to student progress, instructor performance, and operational updates.
* Share timely updates with management regarding center performance, parent satisfaction, and operational needs.

**Key Skills & Attributes**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong leadership and team coordination abilities
* Customer-centric mindset with persuasive communication skills
* Detail-oriented with good organizational skills
* Problem-solving mindset and proactive approach
* Ability to handle parent interactions with empathy, confidence and professionalism

title: NOC Manager | 9 to 16 years | Hyderabad
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
**Job Description**
Responsible for leading shift-level Network Operations Centre (NOC) operations in a 24x7 environment, ensuring seamless monitoring, incident management, and service restoration while maintaining high network performance and adherence to SLAs. Drives proactive issue identification and resolution, ensuring operational excellence and reliability of services.
  
  
Acts as a hands-on leader, managing frontline engineers, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring timely communication during incidents. Enforces process compliance (including E911/NORS standards) and improves operational efficiency through driving automation initiatives to enhance monitoring, alerting, and response capabilities.
  
  
Additionally, ensures high team performance, effective stakeholder communication, and strong customer experience, while delivering consistent, high-quality network services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead teams of engineers across domains (IP, Transport, Voice, Data)
* Act as primary escalation authority for critical incidents
* Oversee network performance, outages, and service restoration strategies
* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and present findings to leadership
* Ensure compliance with operational standards and reporting
* Manage managers and supervisors within NOC
* Improve operational maturity and technical accountability
* Lead strategic incident response and resolution
* Ensure stakeholder communication at executive level
* Support change management and risk mitigation processes
* Present RCA, performance reports, and service reviews (WBR/MBR/QBR)
* Provide hands-on leadership during outages

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Strong leadership and organizational influence
* Advanced problem-solving and communication skills
* Deep understanding of network operations and processes
* Ability to manage multiple teams and priorities

**Technical Skills**

* Routing & switching fundamentals, VPN technologies (L2/L3), VoIP platforms.
* Familiarity with network monitoring tools - Netcool, OpenView, ITSM platforms
* Strong focus on E911/NORS compliance and audit readiness
* Knowledge of: Automation scripting (Shell, Python, Perl),Firewalls, UNIX systems

**Experience & Education**

* Bachelor’s degree (mandatory or equivalent)
* 8+ years in NOC & ITES (24x7 NOC)
* Industry-recognized professional network certification
* ITIL Certification

**Work Environment**

* 24x7 NOC operations/Rotational Shifts
* Leadership-level on-call responsibility

**Primary Skills**
NOC Operations,Network Monitoring ,Handling International clients,Excellent Communication skills,Stakeholder Management,People Management/Team Management.
  
  
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

title: Site Operations Lead
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Site Operations Lead is responsible for building and leading the Operations function for Haleon's new greenfield manufacturing facility in Indore. The role will provide operational leadership during design, commissioning, qualification, start-up and early stabilization, and subsequently lead manufacturing operations to deliver safety, quality, service level, cost and people engagement objectives.
  
  
The role will partner closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HAPS, EHS and Project teams to establish operational systems, build workforce capability and ensure successful commissioning and ramp-up of the manufacturing site.
  
  
The incumbent will drive operational excellence through disciplined execution, capability development, performance management and continuous improvement while creating a safe, compliant and high-performing manufacturing culture.
  
  
Build a future-ready Operations organization that delivers safe start-up, reliable supply, competitive performance and sustainable growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and deliver site performance across Safety, Quality, GMP Compliance, Cost, Service, Productivity, and People Development.
* This role joins the project at an early stage to ensure operational requirements are incorporated into the facility execution. It leads operations and technical teams through a vertical startup. Then owns performance of the people and system once the site is operational.
* Lead manufacturing and packaging operations, ensuring achievement of production, OEE, cost, waste, and service targets (ATS adherence to schedule and ATP adherence to planning).
* Drive a strong safety-first and quality culture, ensuring compliance with EHS, GMP, regulatory, and data integrity requirements.
* Build, coach, and develop high-performing teams through capability building, succession planning, and performance management.
* Accountable for manufacturing budgets, MCC / PCC conversion costs, labor productivity, and delivery of productivity commitments.
* Lead operational readiness, commissioning, qualification, validation, start-up, and stabilization of manufacturing operations.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and technical teams to ensure reliable product supply and operational excellence.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks while ensuring sustainable business performance Complexity/Scope
* Integrate Haleon Operational Excellence strategies from inception by working closely with Site Director.
* Integrate industry 4.0 capabilities
* Establish effective daily management systems (HAPS), performance reviews, visual management, and KPI governance.
* Champion continuous improvement, loss elimination, problem-solving, automation, and digital manufacturing initiatives

**Qualification and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Engineering, Science, Manufacturing, Operations or a related discipline; an MBA/PGDM is desirable
* Overall 15+ years of industrial experience in manufacturing sector.
* At least 5 years of relevant experience in FMCG, consumer healthcare, pharmaceuticals, food or another regulated manufacturing sector.
* Demonstrated experience leading Manufacturing and Packaging operations, production performance, workforce capability and cross-functional delivery.
* Experience supporting a greenfield facility, major expansion, commissioning, qualification, validation, technology transfer or manufacturing start-up is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of GMP, EHS, operational risk management, production planning, OEE, cost control and continuous improvement systems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make risk-based decisions and translate project milestones into operational readiness and sustainable performance.
* Relevant certification or practical experience in Lean, Six Sigma, TPM or another recognized operational-excellence system is desirable.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong people leadership capability to build, engage and hold a large frontline organization accountable.
* Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence Project, Engineering, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain and senior leaders.
* Hands-on, collaborative and decisive leadership style with strong execution and change-management capability.
* Excellent oral, written and presentation skills, with clear communication from shop-floor teams to senior leadership.
* Strong analytical thinking, structured problem solving, risk-based decision-making and commercial awareness.
* High resilience, ownership and ability to deliver in a fast-paced greenfield and start-up environment.
* Proficiency in MS Office and working knowledge of SAP, Power BI, OEE, problem solving and digital manufacturing performance systems.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Safety, Quality & Compliance – Waste/ Scrap%, CAPA Closure Effectiveness, Deviation Reduction, GMP / EHS Compliance Adherence, Safety Observation Closure %, Zero LTI.
* Operational Readiness & Performance - Commissioning and start-up milestones, schedule adherence (ATS), OEE, throughput, right-first time (RFT), Cost (PCC, MCC), Waste, Customer Service Level (% OTIF) and productivity.
* People & Organization - Workforce readiness, drive shop floor associate ownership, role qualification, engagement, leadership capability, succession strength and a sustainable ownership culture.
* Unplanned Downtime (hrs./month),Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), Mean Time to Repair (MTTR), AM / PM and maturity assessment and Haleon Operational Excellence pillar drive and maturity assessment.

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-10-22
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
  
  
**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
  
  
**Note to candidates**
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

People Lead

**Role Summary**

This role combines Front Office Management, Studio Administration, Community Building, HR Support, and Founder Assistance. The individual is responsible for ensuring seamless studio operations while fostering a strong internal culture.

**1. Front Office & Brand Representation**

*Outcome: Efficient material sourcing and vendor alignment.*

*Outcome: Well-maintained, aesthetically aligned studio environment.*

* Maintain monthly imprest records with bills.
* Submit expense reconciliation reports.

*Outcome: Cost control, operational discipline, and transparency.*

*Outcome: Efficient and economical travel management.*

* Take minutes of weekly meetings and track action items.

* Take regular feedback for improvements.

*Outcome: Operational support to leadership with reduced dependency.*

**Performance Expectation**

* High ownership and proactive problem-solving.
* Continuous upskilling and process improvement.
* Increment and growth linked to performance, initiative, and expanded responsibilities.

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
The Global Valuation Group (GVG) team at BA Continuum provides valuation and independent price verification (IPV) support to the Global Markets Businesses, covering Equities, Rates, FX, Commodities and Credit lines of business. This particular role is for Rates/FX/Commodities.
  
  
**Job Description\***
We are looking for a seasoned individual who has strong programming skills and good knowledge of Rates/FX/Commodities as an asset class. Further a similar Valuation control role experience in a large global bank is preferable.
  
  
The position requires the person to have a deep understanding of derivatives, product knowledge, understanding of how different trading desks operate, their risk profiles and revenue generation mechanism.
  
  
This role will involve facing off with very senior stakeholders in Global Finance, Front office and Risk globally in addition to engagement with senior management at GBS.
  
  
Additionally, given the regulatory focus in this area, the person would have very strong communication and leadership skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Define the methodology for IPV and associated Liquidity/Model/Deal Specific Valuation Adjustments (VA).
* Create the standard process to execute the methodology in line with compliance requirements. Implementation should be largely in python-based infrastructure.
* Perform reviews and approval of all market data constructions, functions and models used in production to value transactions.
* Review and Challenge the IPV processes conducted by Business Finance and Control (BFC).
* Review of material, new deals and changes to models and market data configurations.
* Assist with implementation of strategic projects, such as key risk management and system enhancements.
* Working closely with Traders, Market Risk Management, Model Risk Management, FO Quants, BFC, senior managers on new product, model development, model sign-off etc.
* Define Fair Value Hierarchy categorization and justification and create the framework of a given product, risk, or portfolio as appropriate.
* Define Liquidity (covered/non-covered) and create the framework of a given product, risk, or portfolio as appropriate
* Lead the team from the front.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
Qualified PhD/MBA/Masters in a Quantitative Field from Tier I/II institute with relevant experience in Valuation controls processes in Global Markets environment and organization of similar scale.
  
  
Certifications If Any
  
  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred
* Strong Programming Knowledge (Python)

**Experience Range\***
12-15 years of experience with at least 5-10 years’ experience in Valuation control’s role
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* 12-15 years of Banking and Financial Services experience with extensive knowledge of working in a Global Markets environment.
* Strong quantitative modeling skills and programming skills in Python.
* Line experience coupled with a demonstrated ability to lead technology-based change.
* Proven experience of providing thought leadership to overcome challenges and lead without direct authority.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, and the personal ability to collaborate, operate, and communicate effectively with a culturally diverse group of peers and colleagues.
* Has the gravity to interact at all levels of management to support resolution of complex business issues.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a global matrix organization and significantly multi-geography, multi-cultural offshore service delivery environment.
* A convincing executive presence which conveys composure and confidence in all situations, the credibility and stature to carry stakeholders through influence rather than via the hierarchy.
* Individual should have the resilience to handle internal pressures and conflicts in dealing with multiple stakeholders.

**Desired Skills**

* Must be proactive and be a highly motivated self-starter
* Demonstrated ability to work in a high-pressure environment
* Takes initiative and challenges existing processes and procedures in a proactive manner
* Strong leadership skills with ability to face-off with Senior global stakeholders and auditors
* Ability to analyze issues independently and drive solutions
* Analytical skills

**Work Timings\***
12:00 PM IST to 21:00 PM IST
  
  
**Job Location\***
Mumbai/Hyderabad

title: Deputy Resident Construction Manager
description:

Your impact
  
  
**Your Impact**

The role will be instrumental in collaborating with commercial, project management, engineering and design technical leaders to create opportunities for Jacobs to plan, develop, deliver and operate a range of projects.
  
  
**Job Description**

* To ensure proper and efficient discharge of the Company’s responsibilities for plant construction, adherence to Company’s policies and requirements.
* To ensure staff recruitment, development and departmental administration and line personnel management.
* To carryout work relating to construction aspects of sub-contracts, planning, estimating and safety at construction sites are being done as per procedure.
* Demonstrate by leadership and example a strong commitment to the development and implementation of our quality management system and Core Values and to continually improve the effectiveness of construction management.
* Ensure that work carried out by the department is professional and adequate in all respects, particularly in relation to safety, quality assurance and adherence to Company’s contractual responsibilities and compliance with statutory and legal requirements.
* Ensure that Company policies are properly adhered to within his area of responsibility and the changes or additions to such policies are communicated to reporting staff and are implemented.
* Interview candidates and make recommendations for the appointment / rejection of the candidate to the Talent Acquisition Team.
* Decide on the assignment of Site staff for services group activities including staff forward loading and recruitment.
* Determine staff training needs with improved staff training in view and discuss and arrange such training needs with the HR Manager.
* Carryout regular staff assessment and appraisal and formality record the results and give recommendations in accordance with Company policies.
* Review current and future staffing needs and make recommendations regarding staff recruitments. Ensure required sub-contracting to qualified and experienced Organizations
* Prepare Manhour and cost estimates for proposals and liaise with the Proposals and Estimating groups on all matters involving construction estimates for Management.
* Authorize and approve all expenses as stipulated in Company directives.
* Arrange critical Construction planning inputs for various Projects.
* Prepare Budgets for Field Services Group needs.
* Consult and liaise with the Legal Department and liaise with all other Departments on Construction related matters as necessary.
* Prepare and/or update Department and Company procedures, Methods, Standards, Working instructions, etc. pertaining to Construction aspects of the Company’s Quality Assurance programme.
* Ensures that all personnel are aware of the latest issue of the Department’s Work instructions, procedures, specifications and methods.
* Comply with the Company's Construction Procedures and Practices in all respects, particularly those relating to Quality Assurance, Safety, Personnel and Industrial relations; wherever these are found to be inadequate immediately report the deficiencies and suggest solutions.
* Liaise with the Proposals, Project Management and Project services groups in the preparation of Construction programs for Proposals and Contracts and assist as required with the relevant planning inputs of the kay dates, manning, sub-contractors and other prescribed parameters.
* Work closely with Sales and Operations Group and ensure that recommendation for the application of construction expertise are fully considered, particularly during the early phases of proposal and contract award.
* Ensure that relationships with other departments within the Company and with the Client, Vendors, Sub-contractors are effective and cordial.
* Represent the Company in appropriate construction industry associations, as required.
* Ensure compliance of safety requirement at Project sites
* Establish procedure and systems for effective handling and monitoring safety systems / records.
* Carryout department administration functions.
* Attend Management Meetings on significant manners.

Here's what you'll need

title: Process Manager - Monitoring & Event Management
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As the
**Monitoring & Event Management Process Manager**
, you will provide hands-on technical leadership and direction for enterprise monitoring, observability, and event-management practice. You will assess existing practices and operational maturity, identify gaps and risks, and define a practical improvement roadmap aligned with business-critical service requirements.
  
  
You will collaborate with IT service owners, architects, operations and engineering teams, Incident and Problem Management teams, Cybersecurity, and external service providers.
  
  
Your primary responsibility will be to define and document monitoring practices and guidelines, while introducing or supporting the enhancement of forward-looking monitoring solutions for IT services using modern technologies such as AI. These efforts should improve event quality, reduce alert noise, accelerate detection and recovery, enable predictive operations, and support safe automation.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Assess the maturity of current monitoring and event-management practices across processes, people, tools, data, governance, and operating models.
* Identify monitoring coverage gaps, architectural weaknesses, operational risks, recurring failure patterns, alert noise, manual toil, and barriers to effective service visibility.
* Define the target-state architecture, standards, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for monitoring, observability, event management, and AIOps.
* Lead the evaluation, selection, design, integration, and implementation of enterprise grade monitoring & observability solutions covering metrics, logs, traces, events, topology, and digital experience signals.
* Establish service-oriented monitoring by mapping applications, infrastructure, cloud services, dependencies, and configuration items to business services and service objectives.
* Improve event detection, severity models, thresholds, filtering, deduplication, enrichment, correlation, routing, escalation, and response workflows.
* Introduce AIOps use cases such as anomaly detection, event correlation, probable root-cause analysis, incident summarization, predictive insights, and assisted remediation.
* Integrate monitoring platforms with IT service-management, configuration-management, notification, collaboration, and automation solutions.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture reviews, proofs of concept, product evaluations, vendor engagements, and implementation projects from design through operational handover.
* Define governance, onboarding standards, operating procedures, support models, ownership, documentation, training, and compliance controls.
* Review monitoring outcomes and incident trends regularly, prioritize continual-improvement initiatives, and track benefits such as reduced alert volume, lower mean time to detect and recover, improved coverage, and increased automation.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in IT operations, DevOps, SRE, observability, monitoring, or platform engineering, including technical leadership or architecture responsibility.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of metrics, logs, traces, events, synthetic monitoring, real-user monitoring, application performance monitoring, infrastructure monitoring, network monitoring, and service dependency mapping.
* Experience with enterprise observability and monitoring technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, SolarWinds, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, or comparable platforms.
* Practical knowledge of SRE principles, including service-level indicators, service-level objectives, error budgets, the four golden signals, reliability reviews, toil reduction, capacity planning, and blameless learning.
* Experience designing or implementing AIOps use cases using machine learning, analytics, or generative AI for anomaly detection, event correlation, root-cause support, prediction, automation, and incident assistance.
* Strong knowledge of cloud and hybrid infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, microservices, APIs, networking, security, and resilient distributed-system architecture.
* Automation and scripting capability using Python, PowerShell, Bash, REST APIs, webhooks, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and CI/CD practices.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, particularly Monitoring & Event Management, Incident Management, Availability Management, Capacity & Performance Management, and Continual Improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications in SRE, DevOps, cloud architecture, Kubernetes, ITIL, observability, ServiceNow, or enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms for operational telemetry, including scalable storage, stream processing, and data-quality governance.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and managed-service providers in complex enterprise environments.

**Key Competencies**

* SRE and DevOps Technical Leadership
* Enterprise Monitoring and Observability Architecture
* Monitoring & Event Management Process Governance
* AIOps Strategy and Responsible Automation
* Operational Maturity Assessment and Road mapping
* Program Delivery, Vendor Management, and Stakeholder Influence
* Data-Driven Continual Improvement and Benefits Realization
