title: Production Support Manager
description:
Job Title - Production Support Manager
  
  
Location - India (Gurugram / Pune)
  
  
Reports to Head of Production Support
  
  
**For Advertising:**
About FNZ Who we are: FNZ Group is an established and rapidly growing company in the financial technology sector. We partner with the entire industry to make wealth management accessible to more people. Today, we partner with over 650 financial institutions and 12,000 wealth management firms, enabling over 24 million people across all wealth segments to invest in the things they care the most about, on their own terms. We have over 30+ offices globally with 6000+ employees (and growing!). To learn more about us and our journey, check out our careers site.
  
  
Role Description Role Overview As Production Support Manager, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of Production Support outcomes for a regional cluster (e.g., UK / EU / APAC / NAM) delivered from our Global India Hub. You’ll lead talented teams across multiple platforms, set the operational rhythm, and partner closely with global stakeholders to keep our services stable, resilient, and continuously improving. If you enjoy high ownership, fast-paced delivery, and being the calm, decisive leader when it matters most, this role gives you the scope and visibility to make a real impact. Key Responsibilities Regional Ownership & Service Delivery
  
  

* Own Production Support delivery for your region from the India Hub—across platforms, teams, and priorities.
* Set a consistent, ITIL-aligned approach to incident, problem, and change management to protect stability and customer outcomes.
* Track and improve service performance through clear ownership of SLAs, KPIs, incident trends, and operational health.
* Balance demand, capacity, and cost—driving smarter planning, prioritization, and productivity.
* Proactively manage operational risk for the region, bringing visibility and momentum to mitigation and prevention. People Leadership & Team Growth
* Establish and develop regional Production Support teams, covering operating models, onboarding, and capability growth.
* Lead and develop group of analysts, creating a high-performance culture and strong succession pipeline.
* Ensure the right skill mix and shift coverage to meet regional demand—without compromising quality or wellbeing.
* Establish clear expectations and workflows to ensure consistent team delivery. Operational Governance & Continuous Improvement
* Own operational readiness for new platforms, clients, or regions transitioning into BAU support.
* Raise the quality bar for SOPs, runbooks, monitoring, and RCAs—so teams can respond faster and prevent recurrence.
* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and global teams to reduce repeat incidents and operational toil.
* Use data to prioritize improvements, including automation and tooling uplift that make support more scalable. Stakeholder & Regional Engagement
* Be the trusted India Hub contact for regional stakeholders—providing crisp updates on performance, risks, and progress.
* Drive service reviews and governance forums, ensuring expectations match delivery and supporting effective decisions.
* Influence priorities and challenge constructively on scope and risk—helping teams focus on what matters most. What This Role Is / Is Not This role is:
* Ownership of regional service outcomes—not day-to-day ticket handling.
* A leadership role focused on people, delivery maturity, and operational excellence.
* A chance to scale and strengthen Production Support from India with real influence across the organization. You’ll thrive if you:
* Like leading through ambiguity and bringing structure, pace, and clarity.
* Stay calm under pressure and communicate with confidence during incidents.
* Enjoy building teams, improving systems, and raising the bar on reliability.

**Experience**

title: Manager, Customer Order Solutions
description:

title: Studios Business Manager
description:
**Who we are**

We're Cellar Door — a video production and studio group out of Gurugram, running since 2015. We run four studio floors across Gurugram and Delhi: two podcast studios and two commercial studios. Brands, agencies, podcasters and creators book them for films shoots (ads and movies), stills and content. The studios are doing well and growing, and right now the founders are running them alongside everything else. We'd like to hand them to someone who will run them properly.

**The job, honestly.**

* **Bookings and Client Servicing:**
  Every enquiry — calls, emails, WhatsApp, DMs — lands with you. You own the response, but you're not alone: there's a small team around you for support and backup. Nobody waits more than an hour during working hours. Understand what they need, quote, and close.

* **Running the floors:**
  Work with Studio Managers, make sure shoots start on time, sets are ready, the gear works and the crew knows what's happening. Keep an eye on how much each studio is used, what's broken, what needs fixing, what we're running out of — and get it sorted before it becomes a problem. Lead the monthly revenue tracker and damage sheet with the accounts team, and put a simple per-studio P&L in front of the founders by the 5th of every month. You don't need to be an accountant; the accounts team does the books.

* **Growing it:**
  Work with the founders and core team on new things we can do at the studios —events, workshops, creator days, long-term rentals. This is where you get to make new things happen.

**You report to:**
the two founders, directly. No layers in between.

**Your team:**
the Accounts & Bookings Manager and the Studio Manager report to you. The on-floor crew across the four studios works through the Studio Manager.

**Who we think will be good at this:**

Someone with 4–7 years of managing things that are high-stakes and time-bound, where people are paying and the clock is running. Events, workshops, co-working, hotels, a studio, a venue, a club, a live production — the industry matters less than the fact that you've sold it, run it and been answerable for it.

Fluent and easy in both English and Hindi. You'll be on the phone with a brand manager and on the floor with the crew in the same hour, and both should feel natural.

A people person who can also organise, delegate and hold a team to a standard —kindly, but firmly.

Comfortable with numbers. You keep trackers clean, read a revenue sheet without flinching, and notice when something looks off. You don't need an accounting background — the accounts team handles the books.

Dependable. You finish what you start and nobody has to chase you.

You already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) for drafting, summarising and reporting, and you're curious to use them more.

Based in Gurugram or willing to relocate, and fine with moving between four studio locations in a week.

**CTA:**
₹8.4 LPA fixed, plus a performance incentive linked to studio revenue. If the studios do what we think they can, you're looking at ₹11–13 LPA in a year. The incentive formula will be written down and shared before you join.

**Where:**
our main office in Nirvana Country, Sector 50, Gurugram, with weekly visits to each studio in Gurugram and Delhi (Lado Sarai).

**Hours**
: six-day week, with flexibility around shoot schedules — shoots do happen early mornings and on weekends, and we give that back. If you've done a 6AM recce, nobody is counting your hours that afternoon.

**Start:**
as soon as you can, but we'll work with your notice period.

**How we work:**
small team, founders are reachable, decisions are quick, and ifsomething isn't working we say so and fix it rather than let it drag.

If you tick most of these but not all, apply anyway and tell us which ones you'd grow into.

title: Senior Manager, Revenue
description:
The Revenue team is a highly visible, global team responsible for accurate and timely revenue reporting. The team manages the monthly and quarterly revenue close, supports contract review and accounting conclusions, evaluates revenue treatment for new and existing product offerings, maintains controls over revenue reporting, and supports revenue forecasting and analytics.
   

  

 This role will lead the Revenue Operations team in Gurugram, India, with responsibility for managing and developing Revenue Managers and Revenue Analysts. The Senior Manager will be the primary point of leadership for the India Revenue Operations team and will be accountable for the quality and timely execution of the revenue processes owned by the team.
   

  

 The role will partner closely with global Revenue leadership and cross\-functional teams to manage close execution, resolve complex revenue and operational issues, strengthen processes and controls, and continue building the capabilities of the India team.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Candidate Profile
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA, CA, or equivalent qualification preferred
* 10\+ years of relevant experience, including experience in revenue accounting or revenue operations at a public, high\-growth SaaS or technology company
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing Managers and individual contributors
* Strong working knowledge of ASC 606, including experience with SaaS, cloud, and usage\-based revenue models
* Experience owning complex revenue close processes, including revenue recognition, journal entries, account reconciliations, revenue allocations, and related analytics
* Experience reviewing customer contracts and evaluating non\-standard terms and revenue accounting considerations
* Strong understanding of financial reporting controls, SOX requirements, and external audit support
* Demonstrated ability to independently assess complex issues, determine appropriate next steps and escalation, and drive matters through resolution
* Experience improving or scaling accounting processes through standardization, automation, documentation, or enhanced controls
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to work with large data sets and identify trends, exceptions, and underlying drivers
* Experience with ERP and CRM systems; NetSuite and Salesforce experience preferred
* Advanced Excel skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions, levels, and global time zones
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and sound judgment


 Position Expectations
   

  

* Lead, manage, and develop the Revenue Operations team in Gurugram, including Revenue Managers and Revenue Analysts, with accountability for team performance, development, workload allocation, and effective delegation
* Own the monthly and quarterly revenue close activities within the India team's scope, including revenue analyses, journal entries, account reconciliations, revenue recognition, and related review activities, ensuring accurate and timely completion
* Establish clear ownership, review, and escalation expectations across the team and ensure issues are identified and addressed on a timely basis
* Review complex sales transactions within the Company's ERP and revenue systems to ensure the accuracy of underlying data, revenue allocations, and revenue schedules
* Review contract analyses and provide guidance on revenue treatment for complex or non\-standard arrangements under ASC 606 and the Company's accounting policies
* Apply judgment to revenue accounting and operational issues, determine when escalation is required, and drive issues to resolution in partnership with global Revenue leadership and other stakeholders
* Lead quarterly review and year\-end audit activities for the revenue processes owned by the India team, including coordination of supporting documentation and resolution of auditor questions
* Review revenue analytics and complex data sets to identify trends, anomalies, and potential financial reporting or operational risks and communicate findings to Revenue leadership
* Partner with OTC, Legal, FP\&A, Product, Cloud Engineering, FinTech, and other cross\-functional teams on initiatives and issues with revenue accounting or operational implications
* Partner with global Revenue leadership to align processes, controls, and operating practices across the broader Revenue organization
* Identify and lead opportunities to improve the efficiency, scalability, and control environment of Revenue Operations through process improvement, automation, standardization, and documentation
* Coach Revenue Managers and Analysts to strengthen technical knowledge, operational ownership, judgment, and issue escalation
* Support new products, systems, and business initiatives by assessing revenue accounting and operational impacts and helping ensure appropriate processes and controls are established
* Lead revenue\-related projects and other initiatives requiring coordination across the India Revenue team and global business partners


 Success Measures
   

  

 First 30 Days
   

  

* A successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of the Company's business, product offerings, revenue streams, key systems, close processes, controls, and team responsibilities, while establishing relationships with the Gurugram team and key global stakeholders


 3 to 6 Months
   

  

* The Senior Manager will be independently overseeing the revenue close activities within the India team's scope, with clear ownership and escalation expectations established across Revenue Managers and Analysts. The individual will also have identified key opportunities to improve processes, controls, documentation, and team capability


 6 to 9 Months
   

  

* The Senior Manager will be operating as a trusted partner to Revenue leadership and key cross\-functional teams, independently resolving routine operational matters and appropriately escalating complex or higher\-risk issues. The role will also be driving targeted improvements in close execution, controls, automation, and process consistency


 12 Months and Beyond
   

  

* The Senior Manager will have established a strong, scalable Revenue Operations team in India, with clear accountability across Managers and Analysts, consistent execution of close and control responsibilities, and increased team capability to independently own complex revenue processes. The role will continue to drive improvements in efficiency, automation, controls, and operational scalability as the business evolves

title: Head of License Management Tools and Support
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As Head of License Management Tools and Support, you lead the global technology, data, operational services and transformation capabilities that enable effective Software License Management at Siemens Energy.
   

  

 You are responsible for the strategic direction and reliable operation of the License Management technology landscape, including Software Asset Management and SaaS Management platforms, engineering license\-server services, license data, automation, reporting, license administration, and operational support processes.
   

  

 A key part of your role is to define and execute the future License Management tooling strategy. You will modernize the current landscape to address existing capability gaps and prepare Siemens Energy for fundamental changes in software consumption and licensing. These include the transition from traditional user\- and device\-based licenses toward token\-, credit\-, capacity\-, transaction\-, and AI\-consumption\-based commercial models.
   

  

 You lead a globally distributed team of approximately 8–10 experienced professionals located across India, Romania, Germany, and other countries. You establish clear global ownership, service standards, technical direction, backup coverage, and effective collaboration across organizational and cultural boundaries.
   

  

 You work closely with License Management, Procurement, Contract Management, Application Management, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Finance, Legal, Service Owners, and strategic technology providers. You also act as deputy to the Head of License Management and must be able to represent the overall function in management discussions, governance bodies, escalations, and strategic initiatives.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Define and execute the global License Management technology strategy, including the target architecture, capability roadmap, sourcing approach, integration model, and modernization priorities for License Management tools and services.
* Prepare the organization for emerging software consumption models, including token\-, credit\-, capacity\-, transaction\-, and AI\-consumption\-based licensing. Establish the data, metering, forecasting, allocation, reporting, and control capabilities required to govern these models.
* Modernize the current SAM and License Management platform landscape, addressing capability gaps across the portfolio
* Own the global engineering license\-service landscape, including complex license\-server environments, concurrent licensing technologies, service dependencies, capacity planning, monitoring, resilience, lifecycle management, and technical risk reduction.
* Ensure stability and continuous improvement of License Management services, including SAM platforms, license\-metering solutions, license administration, operational workflows, software request processes, integrations, reporting, and second\-level support.
* Translate License Management strategy into technical and operational capabilities, ensuring that the tooling landscape supports compliance, audit readiness, cost optimization, contract negotiations, demand forecasting, and management decision\-making.
* Lead platform selection and transformation initiatives, including requirements definition, business\-case preparation, architecture alignment, provider evaluation, implementation, data migration, process redesign, and organizational adoption.
* Drive automation and system integration across License Management, procurement, IT service management, identity management, application management, finance and relevant supplier platforms.
* Lead and develop a global team of 8–10 experienced professionals, creating clear accountabilities, common delivery standards, effective collaboration, service continuity, and professional development across locations.
* Manage strategic providers and service partners, ensuring clear deliverables, measurable service levels, controlled costs, appropriate technical capabilities, and reduced dependency on individual suppliers or experts.
* Act as deputy to the Head of License Management, representing the overall function when required and supporting strategic supplier discussions, governance decisions, risk assessments, transformation priorities, and senior management communication.


**What You Bring**
* A university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, Business Administration, or a comparable discipline.
* 15\+ years of total experience with at least 4\+ years of leadership experience in a complex, international organization, including responsibility for globally distributed teams and experienced technical professionals.
* Lead and develop a globally distributed team expected to grow to approximately 8–10 professionals.
* Proven experience in defining and executing technology, platform or service strategies for Software Asset Management, License Management, IT Asset Management, FinOps, engineering applications, or comparable enterprise functions.
* Strong experience with SAM, SaaS Management, license\-metering, and IT service management platforms. Experience with solutions such as Flexera, OpenLM, ServiceNow, SAP License Management tools, or comparable technologies is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of complex engineering software environments, including concurrent licensing, license managers, distributed license\-server architectures, capacity management, monitoring, resilience, vendor dependencies, and service continuity.
* Practical experience with enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, SAP, engineering software, and emerging AI\-related commercial and consumption models.
* The ability to connect technical consumption data with contractual rights, commercial commitments, compliance requirements, demand forecasts, and cost optimization opportunities.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge established solutions, align competing requirements, and communicate effectively with senior management and technical experts.
* Excellent written and spoken English and the ability to lead effectively across countries, cultures, functions, and time zones.


**About The Team**
 Digital Core provides the resilient, secure and scalable digital foundation supporting Siemens Energy’s global operations and digital transformation.
   

  

 Within Digital Core, the new
 **Supplier and License Management** 
 department combines strategic supplier governance, software License Management and the operational capabilities required to manage software assets and licensing services effectively.
   

  

 The
 **Tools and Support** 
 team provides the operational and technical foundation for License Management. It is responsible for License Administration, second\-level support, software request workflows, SAM tools, license data, reporting, automation and engineering license services. Tools and Support works closely with the
 **License Management** 
 team, which owns software strategy, supplier and contract positioning, license interpretation, compliance governance, audit response and cost optimization.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90\+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than 100,000 dedicated employees, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy:
   

  

 https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company\-paid considerable family floater cover covering employee, spouse, and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for a Meal Card to all its employees, as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy, as part of CTC and as a tax\-saving measure.
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in selected salary components within a defined range, thereby optimizing tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee can determine the best possible net income from the same fixed individual base pay on a monthly basis.
* Opportunities to work with a global team and lead innovative digital transformation initiatives.
* Opportunities for professional and personal development through the Siemens Energy Learning Platform.


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs

title: Brand & Operations Manager
description:
**About Us** 




 At Excelsior Group, we thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. We started from scratch, built an agile, profitable business with no outside capital or debt, and now generate $30M in annual sales \- on track for $50M by the end of the year.
 



  





 We specialize in launching consumer products at scale. Over the past two years, we've launched 250\+ new products across multiple brands, and we're doubling down for even bigger expansion in 2026\.
 



  





 We're looking for a
 **Brand \& Marketplace Operations Manager** 
 to help us scale. This role is open to both junior and senior candidates, depending on experience and capabilities. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned operator, we offer the opportunity to grow fast, take ownership, and make a measurable impact.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 You will be responsible for driving the sales performance of your portfolio of new products. In addition to managing your portfolio, the goal is that you can progressively grow your skill, productivity and responsibilities. Your responsibilities will include:
 


* Pricing \& Marketing Strategy: Decide on the price and marketing strategy at a product level keeping customer interests in mind.
* Analyze Product Performance: Frequently assess product performance and market response.
* Inventory Coordination: Work closely with production and logistics teams to ensure inventory levels align with sales targets, preventing stockouts or overstock situations.
* Product Launch Ownership: Own or support product launches, collaborating cross\-functionally to ensure success.
* Strategic Communication: Clearly communicate strategic decisions and updates to the team, offering guidance and direction.
* Team Mentorship (Senior Level): If you're in a senior role, you'll also manage junior operations team members, helping them grow and scale alongside the company.
* VA Management (Senior Level): You may also work with a Virtual Assistant to support a larger product portfolio efficiently.



  





 There is a ton of room for growth in this position. You can expect to be involved in highly strategic subjects early on (marketing \& advertising strategy, new products development, etc.).
 



  





 But don't worry \- it will only come after proper training! 😀
 



  





 And you will report to the COO.
 



  





**About You** 




 We're looking for someone who's analytical, curious and self\-driven, someone who loves working with numbers, interpreting data, and turning insights into smart strategies. At Excelsior Group, the impact of your decisions is visible right away, making the role challenging yet highly rewarding.
 



  





**Required (All Levels)** 



* Strong analytical thinking and decision\-making based on data
* Good with numbers and spreadsheets (VLOOKUP and SUMIFS familiarity preferred)
* Understanding of basic business and operational principles (e.g. Gross Profit, ROI, COGS, Days of Inventory)
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills
* Curious, creative, and eager to learn
* Able to prioritize and take initiative in a fast\-moving environment



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with Amazon Seller/Vendor Central
* Knowledge of Pay\-per\-Click (PPC) advertising
* Experience in launching and managing e\-commerce products



  





**Senior\-Level Candidates** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in operations, e\-commerce, strategic product management or supply chain management
* Comfortable leading launches and owning product performance
* Proven ability to drive results through strategy and cross\-functional collaboration



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work in a fast\-growing company where your impact is visible
* Grow with us. Learn constantly \- we invest in skill\-building
* Have a say in high\-impact decisions, not just execute orders
* Be part of an international team



  





**About the Conditions** 




**Location:** 
 Fully remote
 



  





**Compensation \& Benefits** 




**Junior Profiles:** 




 Trial Period: 1,500 EUR
 



 Tier 3: 1,600 EUR
 



 Tier 2: 1,800 EUR
 



 Tier 1: 2,000 EUR
 



  





**Senior Profiles:** 




 Trial Period: 2,500 EUR
 



 Tier 3: 2,600 EUR
 



 Tier 2: 2,800 EUR
 



 Tier 1: 3,000 EUR
 



  





**Director of Operations: 3,500 EUR\+** 




  





**Others:** 



* Annual salary increase and promotions: According to performance.
* Performance\-based bonus: Awarded twice a year, based on company performance.
* Work anniversary bonus: 500 EUR for each year with the company.
* Yearly IT budget: 500 EUR to cover IT expenses.
* 20 days of paid holiday per year.
* Maternity and paternity leave included in our policy.
* Company holiday break from Christmas through December 31st.



  





**Working Hours:** 



* 40 hours per week, flexible depending on your location and team

 1\. title: Warehouse Manager
description:
**About First Coffee** 




 First Coffee is a culture\-first coffee brand built for a new generation. We move fast, think visually, and care deeply about how the brand shows up online, offline, and everywhere in between. As our café network grows, our supply chain and warehouse operations play a critical role in ensuring consistent product availability, accurate inventory, and timely distribution across all outlets.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We’re looking for an experienced
 **Warehouse Manager** 
 to lead end\-to\-end warehouse operations at our Okhla facility.
 



 This role will be responsible for receiving, storage, inventory management, order processing, picking, dispatch, stock reconciliation, manpower management, and warehouse compliance. You will play a key role in maintaining inventory accuracy, implementing FIFO/FEFO, controlling wastage and shrinkage, and ensuring timely and accurate supply to First Coffee cafés.
 



 The ideal candidate is hands\-on, process\-oriented, data\-driven, and comfortable managing a fast\-paced, multi\-outlet warehouse operation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilties:** 




 Warehouse Operations
 


* Manage day\-to\-day operations of the central warehouse at Okhla, including receiving, storage, picking, packing, and dispatch.
* Maintain systematic warehouse layouts, storage locations, documentation, and operational SOPs.
* Ensure all incoming and outgoing materials are accurately recorded and documented.
* Ensure uninterrupted and timely supply of products and consumables to First Coffee cafés.



  





 Inventory Management
 


* Maintain high inventory accuracy through regular physical verification, cycle counts, and system reconciliation.
* Monitor stock levels and ensure minimum and maximum inventory levels are maintained.
* Track stock movement from receiving through final dispatch.
* Investigate stock variances, shortages, damages, and unexplained losses, and implement corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate records of opening stock, receipts, issues, transfers, closing stock, and adjustments.
* Coordinate with Finance/F\&B Control for regular inventory reconciliation.



  





 FIFO/FEFO \& Product Control
 


* Implement and monitor strict FIFO and FEFO practices across the warehouse.
* Ensure expiry dates, batch details, and product conditions are checked before storage and dispatch.
* Maintain appropriate segregation of food ingredients, bakery products, coffee beans, packaging, cleaning chemicals, consumables, and non\-food items.
* Identify and report near\-expiry, expired, damaged, or rejected stock and ensure compromised material is not issued to cafés.



  





 Receiving \& Quality Checks
 


* Verify incoming materials against POs, invoices, GRNs, and approved specifications.
* Check quantities, packaging condition, batch numbers, manufacturing dates, and expiry dates.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Quality/F\&B teams on shortages, rejections, damages, and non\-conforming materials.
* Ensure proper GRN and documentation for every receipt.



  





 Cafe Supply \& Dispatch
 


* Ensure café orders are picked and dispatched accurately within defined timelines.
* Plan daily dispatches based on café requirements and monitor order fulfilment.
* Maintain high accuracy across picking, packing, and dispatch.
* Monitor urgent and emergency requirements from cafés and coordinate with Operations and Area Managers on shortages or delays.
* Track warehouse\-to\-store and inter\-store transfers.



  





 MIS \& Reporting
 


* Prepare and share daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering stock, receipts, issues, café\-wise dispatches, stock variance, damaged and expired stock, wastage, ageing, slow\-moving inventory, pending purchase receipts, café requirements, dispatch status, and inventory accuracy.
* Track warehouse productivity and identify operational gaps through regular reporting and analysis.



  





 Manpower Management
 


* Manage warehouse executives, helpers, loaders, and other warehouse staff.
* Plan manpower deployment and shift schedules based on operational requirements.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, punctuality, and workplace discipline.
* Allocate daily responsibilities and ensure timely completion of tasks.
* Train the team on warehouse SOPs, safety, material handling, and operational processes.



 Cost \& Loss Control
 


* Control warehouse operating costs and ensure efficient utilisation of space and manpower.
* Minimise stock damage, wastage, pilferage, and expiry\-related losses.
* Investigate recurring stock variances and implement corrective measures.
* Monitor storage and handling practices to reduce product damage and unnecessary movement.



  





 Hygiene Safety \& Compliance
 


* Maintain high standards of warehouse cleanliness, hygiene, and housekeeping.
* Ensure appropriate pest\-control and sanitation practices are followed.
* Ensure food and packaging materials are stored safely and hygienically.
* Maintain temperature\-controlled storage wherever applicable.
* Ensure chemicals are stored separately from food products.
* Maintain relevant hygiene, safety, and housekeeping records and support internal and external audits.



  





 Cross Functional Coordination
 


* Work closely with
 **Procurement** 
 on purchase planning, supplier deliveries, shortages, rejections, and pending POs.
* Coordinate with
 **Operations** 
 on café requirements, emergency supplies, store transfers, and service\-level issues.
* Partner with
 **Finance/F\&B Control** 
 on stock reconciliation, GRN/invoice discrepancies, inventory valuation, and stock adjustments.
* Coordinate with
 **Quality/Food Safety** 
 teams on product quality, expiry control, rejections, and food safety compliance.



  





**KPI:** 




**Inventory Accuracy \| Order Accuracy \| On\-Time Dispatch \| Stock Variance \| Wastage \& Expiry \| Warehouse Productivity \| Stock Availability \| Cost Control \| SOP \& Compliance** 




  





**Qualifications:** 



* 5–8 years of relevant experience in warehouse and inventory management, preferably within Café, QSR, Restaurant, FMCG, Food \& Beverage, Retail, Hospitality, or Central Kitchen/Commissary operations.
* Experience managing a multi\-location distribution network will be preferred.
* Graduate or Diploma in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Commerce, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of warehouse operations, inventory control, FIFO/FEFO, and stock reconciliation.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; ERP/WMS experience preferred.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven experience in manpower management and warehouse operations.
* Strong communication and cross\-functional coordination skills.
* High level of discipline, accountability, and attention to detail.



  





**What are we looking for?** 



* A hands\-on warehouse professional who understands both processes and on\-ground execution.
* Someone highly disciplined and process\-oriented, with a strong focus on inventory accuracy.
* A data\-driven individual who can identify stock issues and take timely corrective action.

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.As Fleet Coordinator – Last Mile, you will own day\-to\-day last\-mile ground operations and real\-time traffic control across our hubs and pickup/drop points in Delhi NCR — making sure passengers move smoothly between buses and cabs, cab operators deliver to standard, and your ground team runs like clockwork.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Lead and manage day\-to\-day last\-mile ground operations and real\-time traffic control across designated hubs and pickup/drop points in Delhi NCR.
* Ensure smooth, timely dispatch and coordination of last\-mile cabs against bus arrival and departure schedules.
* Act as the on\-ground escalation point, resolving operational disruptions (delays, no\-shows, route changes, demand surges) quickly and calmly.
* Work closely with last\-mile cab operators and drivers to drive app adoption, improve punctuality metrics, and elevate customer experience.
* Coach and support drivers on FlixBus standards, app usage, and service expectations.
* Manage the roster, shift planning, and day\-to\-day working of ground operations associates and last\-mile associates.
* Allocate manpower against demand patterns and peak windows; track attendance, performance, and productivity of the ground team.
* Own last\-mile cab operator governance — share performance reports regularly, run periodic review meetings, and manage the day\-to\-day partner relationship.
* Track operator SLAs and KPIs, flag underperformance, and drive corrective action plans.
* Be the owner of last\-mile passenger experience, ensuring a smooth transition from buses to cabs and cabs to buses.
* Monitor passenger feedback and complaints related to the last mile, close the loop, and drive continuous improvement.


**About You**
* 3–6 years of experience in ground operations, last\-mile logistics, fleet coordination, transport operations, or a similar field (mobility, ride\-hailing, e\-commerce delivery, or aggregator platforms preferred).
* Proven experience managing frontline teams and third\-party vendors or operators.
* Strong grasp of punctuality/SLA\-driven operations and comfort working with real\-time, on\-ground decision\-making.
* Data\-literate — comfortable working with dashboards, spreadsheets, and reporting; able to turn numbers into action.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to hold operators accountable while maintaining strong relationships.
* Customer\-first mindset with a bias for quick problem resolution.
* Working knowledge of Delhi NCR geography, traffic patterns, and transport hubs is a strong advantage.
* Willingness to work in shifts, be on\-ground, and be reachable during operational hours.
* Bachelor's degree preferred; proficiency in English and Hindi.


 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start\-up .

**Why Join Flix**
 At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting\-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Commercial & Transformation Lead
description:
**Mission Brief** 




  





 Transform how Lenskart buys, negotiates and creates value from every rupee it spends.
 



 Lenskart is scaling rapidly across manufacturing, retail, supply chain and multiple geographies. At this scale, commercial decisions are no longer just about procurement. They are a strategic lever for growth, margin and competitive advantage.
 



 The opportunity is to bring greater intelligence, discipline and technology into how we manage external spend, from manufacturing inputs and logistics to retail, technology and corporate categories.
 



 Your mandate is to close the gap between what we spend and what we should spend and create a commercial engine that is data\-led, AI\-enabled and deeply connected to the business.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous business problems and turning those solutions into measurable outcomes.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 




  





 Commercial Intelligence \& AI
 



 Shape Lenskart’s commercial intelligence layer across:
 


* Spend analytics, should\-cost models and total\-cost\-of\-ownership frameworks
* Supplier intelligence, scorecards and risk assessment
* E\-sourcing and contract intelligence
* AI\-assisted negotiation and price discovery
* Automated, data\-led decision making across categories



  





 The goal is to move from fragmented information and manual decision\-making to a system where
 **the data tells us where the opportunity is and technology helps us act on it.** 




  





 Strategic Sourcing \& P\&L Impact
 



 Own the commercial opportunity across a broad spend universe:
 



**Direct:** 
 Frames, lenses, coatings, accessories, packaging and manufacturing inputs
 



**Indirect:** 
 Store CapEx and OpEx, marketing, technology and corporate spend
 



**Supply Chain:** 
 Logistics, last\-mile, lab\-to\-store, make\-vs\-buy and network optimisation
 



 You will be expected to identify structural opportunities, develop category strategies and deliver measurable YoY P\&L impact through
 **should\-cost, TCO, value engineering and smarter commercial models.** 




  





 Negotiation \& Supplier Strategy
 



 Lead some of Lenskart’s highest\-value commercial negotiations while establishing greater negotiation rigour across the organisation.
 



  





 This includes developing stronger supplier strategies, benchmarking markets, understanding cost structures, defining negotiation playbooks and creating clear walk\-away positions.

 You will work closely with
 **Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Retail, Technology and Marketing** 
 , as well as the founders and senior leadership team, on problems where the answer is not always obvious.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 


* Break down complex business problems into clear commercial decisions.
* Challenge existing ways of working using data and first\-principles thinking.
* Translate business requirements into technology and AI solutions.
* Take ideas from analysis through implementation and measurable impact.
* Influence stakeholders across functions and drive adoption at scale.



  





 Who We’re Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone who
 **thinks like a business leader, not a functional specialist.** 




 You may come from strategy, consulting, business operations, supply chain, sourcing, procurement, corporate development or a high\-growth operating environment.
 



 What matters is that you have demonstrated:
 


* Strong problem\-solving ability across ambiguous, high\-impact business situations.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong commercial and analytical instincts.
* Exposure to supply chain, sourcing, cost structures or commercial strategy.
* The ability to connect
 **strategy, economics, technology and execution.**
* A track record of taking ownership for outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Curiosity and instinct to use AI and technology to fundamentally improve how work gets done.



 Experience with
 **manufacturing, APAC, China or Middle East supply ecosystems** 
 is a strong advantage.
 



  





 Why This Role
 



**This is not a traditional procurement role.** 




 You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most consequential commercial problems at Lenskart, with visibility into the decisions that shape
 **margin, supply chain, capital allocation and growth.** 




  





 You will work closely with the
 **founders and senior leadership** 
 , operate across the full business and have significant ownership over the direction of the commercial function.
 



 The scale is substantial:
 **2,500\+ stores, hundreds of suppliers, multiple geographies and an increasingly complex manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem.** 




  





 The opportunity is to combine

title: Senior Manager – Marketplace Operations
description:
**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a detail\-obsessed, execution\-focused Operations Manager to run the engine room of HUFT’s quick commerce business across Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and BigBasket. This role sits at the intersection of supply chain, platform operations, and data\-driven decision\-making — turning purchase orders into on\-shelf availability, day after day.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has cut their teeth on quick commerce or marketplace operations — they understand how POs, appointments, fill rate and TAT actually move, they obsess over metrics that change daily, and they have the discipline to keep a fast\-scaling channel running like clockwork.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* PO Processing \& Order Execution
* Receive, validate and process purchase orders from quick commerce platforms accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Coordinate with warehouse, 3PL and supply chain teams to convert POs into timely dispatches.
* Track every PO through its full lifecycle and resolve discrepancies — quantity, pricing, SKU or barcode mismatches, and rate differences.
* Keep the ERP/OMS and PO trackers updated so order status is always accurate and visible to every stakeholder.
* TAT \& Turnaround Performance
* Own turnaround time end to end: PO receipt → picking and packing → dispatch → inwarding at platform DCs and dark stores.
* Set and monitor TAT benchmarks by platform; review performance daily and drive continuous reduction.
* Identify and remove bottlenecks across documentation, picking, packing and logistics before they hit delivery.
* Appointments \& Inbound Compliance
* Schedule and manage inbound appointments at platform warehouses and dark stores.
* Ensure on\-time deliveries to minimise missed\-appointment penalties, rejections and reschedules.
* Coordinate closely with transporters and 3PL partners to guarantee adherence, and manage exceptions proactively.
* Fill Rate \& On\-Shelf Availability
* Drive and protect order fill rate and in\-stock rate; minimise short supply, rejections and out\-of\-stocks.
* Root\-cause fill rate gaps — inventory shortfalls, dispatch delays, appointment misses, quality issues — and implement fixes.
* Partner with supply chain on safety stock and replenishment to consistently hit fill rate targets across cities and SKUs.
* Demand Forecasting \& Planning
* Build and maintain demand forecasts for the channel by platform, city and SKU.
* Factor in promotions, seasonality, new launches and pet\-category trends to sharpen accuracy.
* Align forecasts with platform partners and internal supply planning; track and continuously improve forecast accuracy and bias.
* Platform \& Stakeholder Management
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for quick commerce Key Account Managers.
* Coordinate with logistics, supply chain, finance and category teams to meet platform SLAs and minimise penalties.
* Manage returns, claims and reconciliation, including debit notes and penalty disputes.
* Stay ahead of platform policy changes, new fulfilment models and beta programs.
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Own weekly and monthly business reviews — pulling data from platform portals and internal systems to surface actionable insights.
* Build and maintain dashboards tracking PO accuracy, fill rate, TAT, appointment adherence and forecast accuracy.
* Diagnose shifts in key metrics, connect anomalies to root causes, and drive corrective action.
* Partner with BI and analytics teams to build scalable, automated reporting frameworks.


**Must\-Have Experience**
**What We’re Looking For**
* 3–5\+ years of hands\-on experience in quick commerce, e\-commerce or supply chain operations for a consumer brand or marketplace\-first business.
* A proven track record of owning core operations metrics — PO processing, fill rate, TAT and appointment adherence — actively improving them, not just reporting them.
* Strong working knowledge of quick commerce platform operations (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart,BigBasket) — POs, inbound appointments, fill rate and penalty structures.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP/OMS systems and advanced Excel/Google Sheets; comfortable building and running dashboards.
* A data\-first mindset — able to independently pull, interpret and act on operations data without waiting for a BI team.
* Sharp coordination and stakeholder skills — keeping warehouse, 3PL, supply chain and platform teams aligned under tight timelines.


**Good to Have**
* Experience in the pet care, FMCG, D2C or consumer lifestyle category.
* Demand forecasting and inventory planning experience.
* Exposure to BI tools such as Power BI or Looker, and to supply chain or analytics tooling.
* Prior experience working directly with quick commerce KAMs and managing SLAs and penalties.

The company focuses on four critical domains: water and wastewater, agriculture and soil health, sports turf management, and industrial cleaning. Its flagship brands, Aquaritin and Bioritin, use nano\-nutrient and microbial\-enzymatic technology to restore ecosystems, enhance soil health, and deliver eco\-compliant industrial cleaning without toxic chemicals. JS WEL works with municipalities, industrial facilities, agribusinesses, turf managers, and CSR teams, with field\-validated projects across India, the United States, and Malaysia. The organization is committed to building the next generation of biological solutions for industries that sustain life.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Onsite Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gurgaon, responsible for overseeing daily operations and implementation of JS WEL solutions at client locations. This role involves coordinating field projects, supervising site teams, and ensuring that product application and processes follow technical guidelines and safety standards. The Onsite Manager will liaise with clients and internal stakeholders, manage schedules and resources, monitor project performance, and document site activities and outcomes. The position also includes training on\-ground staff, resolving operational issues, and providing feedback to the technical and research teams to support continuous improvement of JS WEL technologies.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Operational and site management skills, including coordination of field activities, resource planning, and adherence to safety and compliance standards.
* Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to communicate effectively with clients, vendors, and internal teams, and maintain professional relationships.
* Basic technical and analytical skills relevant to water treatment, agriculture, or industrial processes, with the ability to understand product application protocols and interpret field data.
* Organizational and documentation skills, including maintaining project records, preparing site reports, and tracking timelines and deliverables.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities to handle onsite challenges, prioritize tasks, and ensure smooth project execution.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering, environmental science, agriculture, industrial management, or a related field; relevant work experience in operations or field management is preferred.
* Comfort working in outdoor and industrial environments, with flexibility to visit multiple sites as needed.
* Commitment to sustainable, non\-chemical solutions and openness to learning about nano\-biotechnology and biological treatment methods.

 Faridabad

**Reports to:** 
 Head of E\-commerce.
 



**Start date:** 
 Immediate joining preferred.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on operations leadership role across Indian marketplaces, quick commerce and approved international marketplaces. You will keep the right products live and available, ensure orders and purchase orders move reliably, and close operational exceptions with evidence. The role reports to the Head of E\-commerce and carries no P\&L ownership.
 



**The essentials** 



* **Employment type:** 
 Full\-time leadership role focused on marketplace and quick\-commerce operations.
* **Location:** 
 Faridabad, Haryana. In office, five days a week, alongside e\-commerce, supply chain, warehouse, finance, catalogue and brand teams.
* **Scope:** 
 India marketplaces, quick\-commerce platforms and approved international marketplaces; operations execution rather than commercial ownership.
* **Team:** 
 Lead the E\-commerce and Quick\-Commerce Operations Executives and the Listing Manager. This is a player\-coach role with direct operating involvement.
* **Reports to:** 
 Head of E\-commerce.
* **Start date:** 
 Immediate joining preferred; notice period will be discussed early in the process.



**What you will own** 




 You will build a reliable daily operating rhythm across platforms and internal teams. Success means that availability, fulfilment, listings, purchase orders and claims remain visible, assigned and closed—not merely recorded in a tracker.
 


* **Indian marketplaces:** 
 Run operations across Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Myntra and other approved marketplaces, including catalogue, inventory, order and account\-health workflows.
* **Quick commerce:** 
 Manage availability, catalogue readiness, replenishment and operational exceptions across Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart and other approved partners.
* **International execution:** 
 Coordinate catalogue, inventory, fulfilment and account\-health requirements across approved international marketplaces and countries.
* **Fulfilment and availability:** 
 Protect in\-stock position, fill rate and order SLA through disciplined forecasting inputs, replenishment follow\-through and warehouse coordination.
* **Listings and account health:** 
 Keep listings accurate, compliant and live; resolve suppressions, content errors, onboarding dependencies and platform alerts.



**Your operating scorecard** 



* **PO\-to\-GRN control:** 
 Track purchase orders from receipt through allocation, appointment, dispatch, delivery and GRN; close shortages, rejections, ageing and documentation gaps.
* **Returns and claims:** 
 Govern returns, RTO, shortages, damages, debit notes, claims and marketplace deductions with complete evidence and ageing visibility.
* **FBA and 3PL exceptions:** 
 Resolve fulfilment\-centre, carrier, warehouse and third\-party logistics exceptions within agreed SLAs.
* **Availability:** 
 Improve in\-stock rates, fill rates and SKU\-level availability while surfacing preventable stock\-out and overstock risks early.
* **Operating cadence:** 
 Maintain clear daily and weekly dashboards, owners, ageing, escalation paths and root\-cause actions for recurring issues.
* **Team leadership:** 
 Set clear ownership, coach operators, inspect evidence and raise the standard of accuracy, urgency and follow\-through.



**What we are looking for** 



* Approximately 6–10 years of experience in e\-commerce marketplace, quick\-commerce, seller, supply\-chain or fulfilment operations, with meaningful team leadership.
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon Seller or Vendor Central and at least two other relevant marketplace or quick\-commerce portals.
* **Direct understanding of inventory availability, PO\-to\-GRN workflows, appointments, fulfilment SLAs, listing health, returns, claims and reconciliation dependencies.**
* Experience leading an operations team and coordinating across supply chain, warehouse, finance, catalogue, customer support and commercial stakeholders.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets capability, including lookups, pivots, ageing analysis and clear exception\-led reporting; familiarity with ERP, OMS or WMS tools is valuable.
* Strong written and verbal communication, sound prioritisation and the persistence to close issues across multiple internal and external owners.



**High ownership:** 
 you care whether the operational exception closes and stays closed—not only whether it appears in a dashboard.
 



 This role does
 **not** 
 own business P\&L, paid media, pricing strategy, brand marketing, country selection or international market\-launch strategy. You will work closely with the teams that own those decisions while remaining accountable for execution quality.
 



**Strong signals** 



* You have improved availability, fill rate, OTIF or GRN closure and can explain the baseline, actions and measurable result.
* You have personally resolved a listing suppression, account\-health issue or catalogue failure on a major marketplace.
* You have closed a material return, claim, shortage, debit\-note or fulfilment exception using clean evidence and persistent follow\-through.
* You have operated across quick\-commerce platforms and understand SKU\-city or dark\-store availability, replenishment and partner workflows.
* International marketplace operations experience is valuable. If your India and quick\-commerce depth is exceptional, international ownership can be developed or supported separately.

 The

 The role provides frontline leadership to Ops Staff, Senior Ops Staff, Territory Service Representatives (TSRs) and Senior Territory Service Representatives (Senior TSRs) deployed during the shift, ensuring optimum manpower utilization, operational discipline, shipment accuracy, productivity, safety and compliance. The role is responsible for delivering operational excellence while supporting strategic initiatives such as SJIT, marketplace expansion, warehouse transitions and process automation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Marketplace Operations \& Fulfilment**
* Manage day\-to\-day marketplace operations across Myntra, Flipkart, Amazon and other eCommerce channels.
* Drive order fulfilment performance, seller metrics, warehouse service levels and marketplace scorecard adherence.
* Track and resolve operational escalations impacting customer experience, dispatch performance, returns, claims or marketplace health.

**SJIT Program Management**
* Own SJIT operational planning, inventory allocation, dispatch preparedness and execution governance.
* Coordinate with marketplace teams on allocation approvals, pending ROs, dispatch planning and STN creation.
* Monitor inventory availability, fulfilment adherence and return closure for SJIT operations.
* Support allocation model discussions and ensure alignment between marketplace requirements and PUMA operating principles.


**Warehouse Operations \& Network Management**
* Support regional warehouse operations and ensure adherence to defined SOPs across forward, return and exception processes.
* Drive warehouse readiness, inventory movement planning, stock transfers and transition activities.
* Lead resolution of operational bottlenecks related to systems, infrastructure, NAS / video storage, WMS errors and process dependencies.
* Coordinate with 3PL and internal teams to ensure smooth inwards, outbound, return and stock transfer execution.


**Seller Protection Fund (SPF) \& Claims Governance**
* Manage SPF processes including claim validation, video / image evidence compliance, claim tracking and recovery governance.
* Ensure adherence to marketplace\-specific SPF policies, TATs, documentation requirements and rejection\-prevention controls.
* Partner with warehouse, logistics and marketplace stakeholders to reduce controllable operational losses.
* Drive corrective actions for recurring process gaps such as tag loop errors, QC misses, poor evidence capture or tracker hygiene issues.


**Compliance \& Business Expansion**
* Support marketplace compliance requirements such as APOB documentation, address mapping, NOC follow\-up and warehouse registration readiness.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely completion of business\-critical documentation.
* Support go\-live preparedness for new facilities, new operational flows and marketplace expansion initiatives.


**Analytics, Reporting \& Process Improvement**
* Prepare operational updates, dashboards, claim trackers and performance summaries for business reviews.
* Analyze trends across fulfilment, returns, QC failures, claims, inventory movement and warehouse performance.
* Identify improvement opportunities and drive scalable solutions across OMS, WMS, marketplace integrations and tracker automation.
* Maintain data hygiene and drive standardization of reporting formats across warehouses and partners.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Marketplace operations teams across Myntra, Flipkart, Amazon and other channels

* Logistics partners and return / delivery service providers
* Category, planning, merchandising and commercial teams
* Finance, technology, compliance and system integration teams

* Marketplace Performance: Fill rate, SLA adherence and seller scorecard improvement
* SJIT Execution: Allocation accuracy, dispatch readiness and RO closure governance
* SPF Governance: Reduced rejection rate, improved recovery and stronger evidence compliance
* Warehouse Efficiency: Productivity, inventory accuracy and issue resolution TAT
* Compliance Readiness: Timely APOB / documentation closure and no go\-live blockers
* Process Improvement: Automation, tracker hygiene and scalable reporting standards

* 4\-7 years of experience in eCommerce supply chain, marketplace operations, warehousing or fulfilment operations.
* Strong understanding of marketplace fulfilment, inventory management, claims governance, returns and logistics processes.
* Hands\-on experience with Excel\-based trackers, operational dashboards and structured performance reporting.
* Strong stakeholder management across internal functions, marketplaces, warehouses and external partners.
* Ability to manage operational escalations, process transitions and cross\-functional projects with clear ownership.


**Preferred Capabilities**
* Working knowledge of OMS / WMS workflows and marketplace integration dependencies.
* Experience in SPF / claim recovery processes, returns governance and video / evidence compliance.
* Ability to work in high\-volume operational environments with strong attention to TAT, audit readiness and process discipline.

This is not a narrow infrastructure or helpdesk role; it is a domain\-ownership role spanning internal systems, network and cloud infrastructure, our field\-deployed device fleet (iPrep Tablets and other hardware), data security, and compliance.
   

  

 You will be the person who ensures our internal teams never lose a working day to IT friction, and who ensures thousands of devices deployed across schools and NGOs in rural India stay secure, tracked, and functional. You will also be the one building the IT function itself — starting hands\-on, and growing it into a proper team as iDream scales.

**IT Infrastructure, Systems \& Support**
* Own and manage all internal IT infrastructure — networks, servers, cloud services, and systems administration — ensuring uptime, reliability, and security across office operations.
* Run IT helpdesk and support for all employees, ensuring fast turnaround on hardware, software, and access\-related issues.
* Own vendor relationships for hardware, software licenses, ISPs, cloud providers, and AMC contracts — negotiating terms, managing renewals, and controlling IT spend.


**Device \& Field Hardware Fleet Management**
* Own the full lifecycle of iPrep Tablets and other field\-deployed hardware — procurement, provisioning, tracking, maintenance, and end\-of\-life — across schools and NGO locations.
* Build and maintain systems for remote monitoring, troubleshooting, and updates of devices deployed at scale in low\-connectivity environments.
* Coordinate with product and tech teams to ensure hardware compatibility with new iPrep software releases and rollouts.


**Data Security \& Compliance**
* Own information security practices across the organisation — access controls, data backup, endpoint security, and incident response.
* Ensure the organisation's data handling practices align with DPDPA 2023 and other applicable data protection requirements.
* Conduct periodic security audits and risk assessments, and build/maintain IT policies, SOPs, and documentation.


**AI\-First IT Operations:** 
 Bring AI\-augmented workflows into IT operations — from automated monitoring and alerting to AI\-assisted troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — keeping iDream's IT stack modern and lean.
   

  

* Qualifications \& Experience


**Experience:** 
 5–7 years in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or IT operations, with demonstrable ownership across networks, hardware/device management, and security — ideally including experience managing hardware deployed outside a single office (field, retail, or distributed environments).
   

  

**Sector Context:** 
 Experience in EdTech, the Development sector, or mission\-driven B2B/B2G environments is a strong advantage. Experience managing device fleets in low\-bandwidth or rural contexts is a plus.
   

  

**Technical Proficiency:** 
 Strong grounding in networking, systems administration (Windows/Linux), cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and device/MDM (mobile device management) tools.
   

  

**Security \& Compliance:** 
 Working knowledge of IT security fundamentals and data protection principles, including familiarity with DPDPA 2023\.
   

  

**Vendor \& Budget Management:** 
 Proven experience managing vendor contracts, AMC negotiations, and IT budgets.
   

  

**AI Fluency:** 
 You use AI tools as a daily productivity layer for monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — not as a novelty.
   

  

* Key Skills \& Competencies


**What Makes You a Great Fit?**
 You think in systems, not tickets. You've owned IT for an organisation before — not just responded to issues as they came in — and you know how to build infrastructure and processes that scale without breaking. You're equally comfortable troubleshooting a server issue and thinking through how thousands of tablets in rural India stay secure and functional. You're excited about using AI to make IT operations faster and leaner, and you've already started building that into how you work.
   

  

* What We're Looking For — Values \& Culture Fit
* Integrity: Takes ownership of IT infrastructure, security, compliance, and data protection with transparency, accountability, and strong ethical standards.
* Excellence: Builds reliable, secure, scalable, and AI\-enabled IT systems while continuously improving infrastructure, processes, and support.
* Collaboration: Works effectively with internal teams, vendors, and technology partners to ensure seamless IT operations and successful hardware and system deployments.
* Impact: Enables uninterrupted business operations and ensures secure, reliable technology reaches teams, schools, and last\-mile learners at scale.
* Why Join Us


 We are on a mission to take the best of digital learning to every corner of rural Bharat. At iDream, you will have the opportunity to build and own the IT function from the ground up — one that keeps our teams productive and our technology reaching the last\-mile learner securely and reliably.
   

  

* Required Skills (Portal Tags)


 Network Administration, Systems Administration, Cloud Infrastructure, IT Security, Device/MDM Management, Vendor Management, Data Protection Compliance, Decision Making, Analytical Skills

title: Senior Lead Analyst, Supplier Governance & Performance Management
description:
The Senior Lead Analyst, Supplier Governance \& Performance Management will play a key role in strengthening supplier accountability, service performance, and stakeholder capability across EDT. This role will actively manage supplier performance for a focused portfolio of large, strategic suppliers while enabling contract owners and functional stakeholders to more effectively manage supplier performance across the broader supplier base. The role will lead structured service reviews, monitor contractual commitments and service expectations, drive issue resolution and corrective actions, and partner with Supplier Management reporting and analytics roles to turn supplier performance insights into clear actions and measurable improvement.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Lead supplier performance management for an assigned portfolio of large, strategic EDT suppliers, including service review cadence, governance routines, performance expectations, SLA/KPI oversight, and continuous improvement follow\-up.
* Facilitate structured supplier performance reviews with suppliers, contract owners, EDT towers, and functional stakeholders to evaluate service delivery, contractual commitments, risks, issues, and progress against agreed action plans.
* Monitor supplier performance against agreed service levels, obligations, commitments, and operational expectations; identify performance gaps, trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Drive issue and corrective action management by documenting performance concerns, clarifying ownership, tracking actions to closure, and escalating unresolved or systemic issues through defined governance channels.
* Partner with Supplier Management reporting and analytics roles to use supplier scorecards, dashboards, service level reporting, and performance insights to inform reviews, decisions, escalations, and improvement plans.
* Enable stakeholders managing suppliers outside the assigned strategic portfolio by providing guidance, templates, playbooks, coaching, and standard practices for supplier reviews, KPI interpretation, issue management, escalation, and corrective action follow\-through.
* Support contract owners and stakeholders in understanding supplier obligations, performance expectations, governance roles, and escalation paths, while reinforcing accountability across Stryker and supplier teams.
* Contribute to the continued maturity of the Supplier Management function by improving performance management standards, stakeholder enablement materials, governance routines, and supplier performance management processes.


**What you need:**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business administration, Data Analytics or related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
* 10\-12 years of experience in supplier/vendor management, service governance, IT service management, sourcing, procurement, or related disciplines, with a strong track record of managing strategic supplier relationships.
* Proven experience partnering directly with large\-scale or technology service providers to drive performance, accountability, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of supplier governance frameworks, service level management, KPIs, SLAs, contractual obligations, and corrective action planning.
* Demonstrated ability to lead supplier performance reviews, governance forums, issue resolution processes, and escalation management activities.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret scorecards, dashboards, and performance metrics, conduct root cause analysis, and translate insights into measurable actions.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to coach, facilitate, and drive alignment across suppliers, contract owners, and cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Executive\-level communication and presentation skills, including the ability to synthesize complex performance issues, risks, and recommendations into clear, actionable narratives for leadership audiences.
* Strong diplomacy, conflict resolution, and relationship management capabilities, with a focus on fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous service improvement.


 Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Sr Manager, Strategy & Operations
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.
   

  

 Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.
   

  

 The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 The Trade Desk is helping shape the future of digital advertising, and APAC \& EMEA are the most dynamic places to build that future. As APAC \& EMEA Strategy \& Operations (S\&O) resets from ad\-hoc executor to strategic advisor, we are standing up two accountable pillars: RevOps \& Sales Enablement, and Systems \& XFN Enablement to give the region the scalable frameworks and operating discipline it needs for sustained double\-digit growth.
   

  

 We're looking for a hands\-on operator who thrives on turning systems and process chaos into trusted, self\-serve foundations, someone who is as comfortable rolling up their sleeves in Salesforce (or equivalent platforms) as they are coaching a country manager through change. If you're energised by fixing the plumbing so teams can focus on customers, this is where you'll do some of your best work.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Reporting into the APAC Director, Systems \& XFN Enablement, you'll own the execution layer that turns the region's systems foundation from a source of friction into a source of trust. Today, channel management activities (such as, mapping rework and change requests) pull Business Development \& Client Services managers and sellers off customers; you'll close that gap for good.
   

  

  

* Own Salesforce hygiene end\-to\-end, empowering Sales teams with tools for a frictionless \& efficient experience.
* Support systems transformation at regional and global level.
* Run change management and self\-serve training series with managers, including relationship methodology as well as 1:many governance cadences with the Salesforce champion community.
* Operate governance gates for rev\-group creation and maintain a clean audit trail, partnering with Finance, HR and Deal Desk.
* Support the Top Accounts process and outbound account management logic as part of the broader sales enablement agenda and contribute to the redesign of the Ops rhythm (Weekly Revenue Call, Quarterly \& Annual Planning).
* Track and report against success measures (mapping accuracy, backlog, adoption, meetings/FTE, training completion) to demonstrate ROI and free up selling time for GTM teams.
* Identify and build automation for standard workflows, processes and reporting, in partnership with engineering where needed.


**Who You Are**
* 8\-10 years in Sales Ops, Revenue Ops, Systems/Salesforce administration or Strategy, ideally in ad tech, SaaS or digital media.
* Deep, hands\-on Salesforce or CRM expertise (account/territory mapping, workflow rules, Portfolio Manager App or equivalent tooling); Tableau or Power BI experience is a strong plus.
* A track record of designing durable, self\-serve processes rather than one\-off fixes — you build the reusable rule, not just the one\-time exception.
* Comfortable running change management directly with frontline managers: training, governance cadences, and building trust that the new system works.
* Detail\-obsessed and data\-driven, with the judgement to know when a process needs to flex versus when to hold the governance line.
* A collaborative operator who partners naturally across Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Sales and Engineering to get things done.


**Why this role, why now**
 At TTD, values like Vision, Grit, Agility, Generosity, Openness, and Full\-Heartedness show up in how we work with one another every day. We're building a team that reflects the diversity of the markets we serve, and we warmly welcome people from all backgrounds who are excited to help shape what comes next.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, The Trade Desk is committed to creating an inclusive hiring experience where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
   

  

 Please reach out to us at accommodations@ thetradedesk. com to request an accommodation or discuss any accessibility needs you may require to access our Company Website or navigate any part of the hiring process.
   

  

 When you contact us, please include your preferred contact details and specify the nature of your accommodation request or questions. Any information you share will be handled confidentially and will not impact our hiring decisions.

 **Shopify Business Manager**

 . The selected candidate will be responsible for managing and growing the complete Shopify business, including revenue, profitability, performance marketing, conversion optimization, operations, customer experience and team coordination.
 



 We are looking for someone who can
 **work independently, make business decisions and take ownership without requiring day\-to\-day supervision from the founder.** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**Shopify Business Growth** 



* Take complete ownership of Shopify revenue and profitability.
* Develop and execute strategies to grow the D2C business.
* Monitor and improve key business KPIs.
* Identify opportunities for increasing AOV, conversion rate and repeat purchases.
* Develop offers, bundles, upsells and cross\-sell strategies.

**Grow Revenue → Improve Profitability → Build the Team → Improve Systems → Reduce Founder Dependency** 




 We are looking for someone who thinks like a
