description:
**About Us:** 




  






 We are B2B Travel Tech startup that is reshaping the way travel agents sell and deliver exceptional travel experiences worldwide. We enable travel agents to book flights, hotels \& holidays conveniently and we provide comprehensive end\-to\-end on\-ground travel services.
 
**We do over INR 1000 crore\+ GMV (sales) and are growing rapidly.** 




  






 Our strong business model and focus on delivering excellent customer experience has facilitated our sustainable growth funded by internal cashflows.
 
**To fuel innovation and growth, we have raised USD 5\.5mn\+ funds from marquee global investors!** 




  





**Our Founding Team** 




  






 • Arun Bagaria – Co\-founder, Product — Ex\-Cars24, TravelTriangle, TripFactory \| IIM Bangalore
 





 • Chirag Agrawal – Co\-founder, Business — Ex\-OYO, TravelTriangle \| IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Roorkee
 





 • Ashish Thapliyal – Co\-founder, Technology — Ex\-CTO Cars24 \| CTO FabFurnish \| Gaadi
 




  





**What do we value?** 




  




* **We are a team of believers.** 

 At the same time, we are constantly learning and growing. We are on an audacious mission and have a rock\-solid belief we can get there.
* **We dream big,** 

 yet we start small and start quickly. We are not deterred by the extra effort needed to relentlessly execute, iterate, and execute to realise our dreams.
* **We are a team of differentiated and ambitious individuals** 

 , united by a common goal. We are a single team, where every member is important.
* **We believe flexibility in** 

 roles and freedom to execute ideas are the two foundational values for aggressive growth.
* **We constantly protect and** 

 evolve our culture. As a super energetic and experienced team, we want to enjoy the time we spend together.



**Our philosophy is simple :** 

 when travel agents grow, we grow with them.
 




  





**Your Mission** 




  






 Build and strengthen TravClan’s international DMC network so that our travel partners receive competitive rates, reliable service and strong on\-ground support. Own DMC sourcing, contracting, commercial performance and escalations end\-to\-end.
 




  





**Roles \& Responsibilities\-** 




  






 • Own the MICE strategy and P\&L, including GMV, revenue, contribution margin, collections and cash\-flow targets.
 





 • Build a strong pipeline across corporates, travel partners, incentive houses, conferences, offsites and large group movements.
 





 • Lead strategic opportunities end\-to\-end—from prospecting and RFP management through solutioning, negotiation, contracting and closure.
 





 • Build and grow key accounts through senior relationships, repeat business, cross\-selling and increased share of wallet.
 





 • Build and lead the MICE sales team; define targets and drive productivity through structured pipeline and conversion reviews.
 





 • Work with Quotes, Contracting, Operations and Finance to develop competitive proposals, protect margins and ensure accurate handovers.
 





 • Maintain reliable forecasts and MIS while using market and competitor insight to identify new growth opportunities.
 




  





**What is on Offer ?** 




  




* Ownership of a strategically important growth vertical.
* Direct founder and senior\-leadership interaction.
* Autonomy to shape the team, sales strategy and go\-to\-market model.
* Competitive compensation of about 18\-35 LPA (80% fixed and 20% variable)



  





**Growth Path:** 




  




* GM/Director \- 35\-50 LPA
* Head \- 18\-35 LPA
* Manager \- 10\-18 LPA
* Associate \- 5\-10 LPA



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




  






 • 5\+ years of experience in MICE sales, corporate travel, events or group travel, including meaningful business leadership.
 





 • Proven ownership of substantial revenue and profitability targets.
 





 • Strong record of acquiring and growing large corporate or partner accounts.
 





 • Established relationships across the corporate and MICE ecosystem.
 





 • Experience closing large domestic and international MICE opportunities.
 





 • Strong command of RFPs, contracting, pricing, margins, payment terms and collections.
 





 • Experience building and leading a high\-performance sales team.
 




  





**You will Thrive in This Role If....** 




  






 • You enjoy hunting for new business and owning ambitious targets.
 





 • You build senior relationships while maintaining sales discipline.
 





 • You balance growth with profitability, cash flow and delivery feasibility.
 




  





**This Role May not be the Right Fit if you.** 




  






 • Your experience is primarily in MICE operations rather than sales.
 





 • You depend mainly on inbound leads or inherited accounts.
 





 • You focus on topline without understanding margins or execution risk..

title: Retail Store Executive/manager
description:
Company Overview:
 



  





 Sneakinn Laundry, founded in 2020, specializes in delivering premium cleaning, protection,
 



 and restoration services for sneakers, footwear, handbags, luxury accessories, and
 



 garments. Our skilled technicians and cutting\-edge facility ensure each item receives the
 



 utmost care.
 



 With physical stores in New Delhi, Mumbai, and Gurgaon, a centralized workshop in Delhi,
 



 and a growing team of 100\+ members, Sneakinn is committed to providing seamless
 



 customer experiences.
 



 Recently featured on Shark Tank India, Sneakinn has gained national recognition for its
 



 innovation and commitment to high\-quality care. Learn more at www.sneakinn.in and
 



 follow us on Instagram at @sneakinn\_laundry.
 



 Position: Retail Store Manager
 



 Openings: 3
 



 Location: Delhi NCR
 



 Type: Full\-Time
 



 Role Overview:
 



 The Retail Store Manager at Sneakinn is responsible for ensuring excellent customer service
 



 at our store. The role involves greeting and assisting customers who visit to drop off or
 



 collect their articles, maintaining a clean and organized store, and ensuring that the
 



 customer experience is smooth and professional. The Store Manager will manage stock
 



 inventory, handle daily cash transactions, and resolve any customer grievances confidently
 



 and amicably. Effective communication, a hospitable demeanor, and the ability to work in
 



 sync with backend teams are crucial for this role.
 



 Responsibilities:
 


1. Attend to customers visiting the store for article drop\-off and collection, ensuring a friendly and professional interaction.
2. Maintain store cleanliness and aesthetics, ensuring it meets Sneakinn’s high standards.
3. Manage inventory of stock, ensuring items are properly logged and available as needed.
4. Handle daily cash collection and prepare end\-of\-day financial summaries with accuracy.
5. Follow up with customers regarding the collection of completed orders.
6. Resolve customer concerns or grievances politely and confidently, ensuring customer satisfaction.
7. Stay in close communication with the backend operations team to ensure smooth processing of articles and resolve any logistical issues.
8. Maintain up\-to\-date records of transactions, stock, and customer interactions to ensure transparency and efficiency.



  





 Qualifications:
 


1. Prior experience in retail, customer service, or a related role is preferred.
2. Strong verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage with customers confidently.
3. A polite, hospitable, and solution\-oriented approach to customer service.
4. Basic understanding of managing cash transactions and maintaining financial records.
5. Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
6. A proactive and positive attitude towards resolving customer issues and ensuring smooth store operations.

title: Manager, Hotel Partner Solutions
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

 Introduction to the Team
   

  

 Travel Partnerships and Advertising helps partners, including hotels, airlines, destination marketing organizations, and more, deliver excellent traveler and B2B experiences. We create growth for our partners and the Expedia Group marketplace through competitive supply, travel media, and affiliate solutions.
   

  

 As Manager—Hotel Partner Solutions, you will lead a team of analysts and technical professionals who deliver solutions supporting hotel partners and business priorities. You will connect technology decisions to partner needs, guide multi\-quarter projects, and create an environment that supports collaboration, development, and meaningful outcomes.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Provide direction, coaching, feedback, and technical guidance to a team of analysts and individual contributors.
* Establish team goals, clarify roles and accountabilities, and connect daily work to business priorities.
* Lead delivery across multiple well\-defined, multi\-quarter projects.
* Serve as a technical lead for a defined domain and select appropriate technologies for business and partner needs.
* Partner with Product teams to develop and deliver roadmaps.
* Oversee operational support activities, service performance, response trends, and adherence to established procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve technology, processes, efficiency, and productivity.
* Plan team capacity and allocate financial, material, and technical resources responsibly.
* Build trusted relationships with hotel partners and internal stakeholders by understanding needs and communicating practical solutions.
* Hire, onboard, recognize, and develop team members while supporting professional growth.
* Monitor key performance indicators, communicate team status, and surface risks, dependencies, and opportunities for simplification.
* Contribute to product reviews, communities of practice, and the product development lifecycle from idea through launch and ongoing improvement.


**Required**
 Experience and Qualifications
   

  

* 5\+ years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3\+ years of related experience with a master’s degree.
* 1–3 years of people leadership experience, including coaching, feedback, performance support, and workload planning.
* Experience leading at least three multi\-quarter projects as a technical lead or equivalent individual contributor.
* Experience with multiple technology implementations and selecting technologies for specific business or partner needs.
* Bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or equivalent related professional experience; technical degree preferred, including Information Technology, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* Proficient communication skills and the ability to connect technical concepts with business priorities.


**Preferred**
* Experience supporting hotel, hospitality, travel, or partner\-facing technology solutions.
* Experience partnering with Product teams on roadmaps and product development.
* Experience supporting technology operations or service management.
* Experience identifying process improvements and using metrics to evaluate outcomes.

**About Expedia Group**
 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

description:

title: Assistant Manager, Business Insights
description:
**Join a Team That’s Passionate About Making Lives Better!**
 At Bill Gosling Outsourcing, we believe that success starts with an amazing team. We are a global leader in outsourcing solutions, we focus on making lives better, one connection at a time. We provide tailored solutions to businesses around the globe, specializing in customer care, sales, and financial services. We’re looking for enthusiastic, driven individuals to join our dynamic work environment where
 *fun meets results* 
 !
   

  

 Bill Gosling Outsourcing Corp.The Assistant Manager – Business Insights will assist in leading and managing projects aimed at improving business processes and systems. This role involves working closely with different departments to analyze current processes, identify areas for improvement, and develop and implement solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Opportunity identification on the ground: Continuously scan the operations to surface improvement avenues, inefficiencies, and performance gaps, and maintain a prioritized pipeline of opportunities backed by data and operational evidence.
* Problem framing: Partner with the account team and functional owners to convert vague asks and observed pain points into sharp, scoped problem statements with clear business impact and decision needs.
* Diagnostics \& root\-cause analysis: Run structured deep dives using data analysis, process walkthroughs, floor observation, segmentation, and Lean Six Sigma methods to move from symptoms to underlying drivers.
* Analysis \& optimization: Build and maintain the analysis that drives decisions on the account — performance trends, driver analysis, and scenario comparisons — and translate findings into concrete optimization actions.
* Data \& analytical quality: Validate data availability, definitions, and reliability; reconcile conflicting sources; document assumptions and limitations; and assure the accuracy and reproducibility of analytical outputs.
* Solution enablement \& implementation support: Shape practical recommendations and support their implementation on the ground — coordinating owners, timelines, and dependencies so improvements are actually executed.
* Commercial \& account insight: Connect findings to account economics — productivity, cost\-to\-serve, SLA/KPI exposure, quality, and client\-impact implications.
* Technology \& process enablement: Identify where recurring problems can be addressed through dashboards, trackers, automation, or process redesign; define clear requirements and partner with development resources on delivery.
* Adoption \& impact tracking: Establish baselines, track adoption and action closure, and measure before/after business impact so improvements stick and benefits are evidenced.
* Reporting \& decision support: Translate analysis into concise, decision\-ready narratives and flags for account reviews and for the Assistant Manager / Manager, Business Insights.

title: Growth Manager - Enterprise Growth (Digital Commerce)
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 GobbleCube is an agentic growth operating system designed to help brands scale profitably across digital marketplaces. Founded in November 2022 by the ex\- core team of Blinkit, the platform went live commercially from private beta in September 2024\.
 



  





 Since then, GobbleCube has scaled rapidly, supporting 600\+ brands across enterprise and D2C, growing revenue 10X, and onboarding 45 of India’s largest CPG enterprises in just the last 9 months, including HUL, Nivea, Tata Consumer Products, ITC, Godrej, Beiersdorf, MTR, L’Oréal, Hershey’s, and many more.
 



  





 As commerce becomes more distributed and hyperlocal, GobbleCube is building agentic solutions to help brands navigate complexity in real time, across visibility, performance marketing, supply chain, and growth strategy. Headquartered in Gurugram, the company supports brands across India, MENA, and LATAM.
 



  





**About the role** 




 India's largest CPG brands do business worth hundreds of crores every year on Quick Commerce platforms. They lose share for reasons invisible from a 360 dashboard: a dark\-store availability gap, a competitor outbidding them on a category keyword, a discount ladder that buys volume at the cost of contribution margin.
 



 GobbleCube finds those reasons. Your job is to walk into the brand's boardroom, tell the CXO what is happening, recommend what to do about it, and get a room of senior people who might disagree to commit to a decision.
 



  





**What this role is not** 




 This is not a marketing growth role. No funnel, no CAC, no acquisition budget, and no performance campaigns to run. If you are a growth marketer, this isn't the job you want.
 



 This is also not a traditional Customer Success role. You are not measured on tickets closed, QBR decks delivered, or logins. Nobody here will ask you to "drive adoption."
 



 The closest analogue is what an MBB consultant does for a CPG client, except you do it under a productised strategic consulting environment, for India's largest CPG brands at once, with a product doing the work in the background.
 



  





**What you will actually do** 



* Run regular strategic connects (online and in\-person both) with each account's senior leadership. Not a status update. A point of view on their business, and recommendations backed by data, to drive their business objectives.
* Diagnose why an output metric moved: market share, offtake, margin, etc. Decompose it into availability, visibility, discounting and supply chain. Then decide what is worth acting on.
* Take a difficult position to a senior stakeholder and make it land. Frequently the recommendation is "stop doing the thing that makes your number this month."
* Build the quarterly impact story: problem identified, action recommended, outcome achieved, revenue or share impact, in the brand's own numbers.
* Find the next business problem worth solving, prove it in a pilot, and convert it into expansion revenue.
* Turn what worked on one account into a repeatable SOP or a product requirement, so the ninth account does not need a ninth person.



  





**Who you will be in the room with** 




 CMOs, Sales Heads, E\-commerce Heads, Supply Chain Heads, occasionally CFOs. They are senior, have limited face time, and each of them wants something different from the same budget. Their KAMs and brand managers are your day\-to\-day.
 



  





**What makes this different from consulting** 




 The dogwork is automated. RCA, data pulls, anomaly detection, competitive tracking, and most of the analysis run through the product and agentic workflows in the backend. You are deciding what the analysis means, what to recommend (the right action at the right time), and how to get it approved. That is also the bar. When the analysis is free, the analysis is not the value. Your judgement is.
 



  





**How you will be measured** 



* Net revenue retention across your portfolio. Zero downsell, plus expansion.
* A documented, quantified impact story per account per quarter.
* Pilot\-to\-conversion rate on expansion modules.
* Qualified expansion opportunities briefed to GTM with a written business case.
* No account goes Amber without you flagging it first.
* Strategic connect coverage and conversation quality across your book.



  





**You will do well here if** 



* You can hold your position when a senior stakeholder tells you your data is wrong, without either backing down or repeating "the data says so."
* You are comfortable being the least senior person in the room and still owning the recommendation.
* You end conversations with an owner, a decision, a metric and a review date, rather than with an action\-items list.
* You would rather be right in eight weeks than agreeable today.



  





**You will struggle here if** 



* You need a clean brief before you can start.
* You want analysis to be your main contribution.
* Confrontation with senior stakeholders drains you.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's from a Tier 1 institute (IIT, IIM, ISB and equivalent).
* 3\-7 years in management consulting, strategy and ops, growth, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS company. Consumer or retail exposure is a strong plus.
* Structured problem\-solving you can demonstrate live, not just describe.
* Presentation and stakeholder management skills at CXO level.
* Strong Excel. Enough SQL to interrogate an analysis and find the hole in it.

**Job Title**
 Project Engineer
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 This role is responsible for leading end\-to\-end project planning and controls, from baseline development through monitoring and close\-out, ensuring alignment with project scope, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and statutory requirements.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
* Serve as the central coordination point for all finishing activities, ensuring alignment between clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams to deliver high\-quality finishes in accordance with approved designs, project schedules, and quality standards.
* Lead the development of the project baseline, including scope breakdown, work sequencing, schedule preparation, cost planning, and resource loading—to establish a robust execution roadmap.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure all design, procurement, and construction activities are accurately reflected in integrated project schedules and aligned with project objectives.
* Conduct regular Planning Review Meetings to track schedule performance, monitor critical paths, assess variances, and ensure timely incorporation of approved changes.


**General Responsibilities**
* Evaluate project schedules, work programs, resource plans, and cost estimates for feasibility, constructability, and compliance with contractual and statutory requirements.
* Monitor project progress using earned value metrics, dashboards, and MIS tools to identify delays, risks, and deviations from the baseline, and recommend corrective actions.
* Support procurement planning by tracking long\-lead items, vendor timelines, and material delivery schedules to ensure seamless construction sequencing.
* Conduct periodic site visits to validate reported progress, assess productivity, identify bottlenecks, and synchronize site execution with approved schedules.
* Prepare and maintain planning documentation—including baseline schedules, look\-ahead programs, progress reports, S\-curves, recovery schedules, and risk registers—to support informed decision\-making and project governance.


**About You**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering
* 6\-8 years of experience in project management for large\-scale, Commercial projects within a PMC, developer, or consulting environment.
* Strong understanding of project planning, cost control, contract administration, construction methodologies, and regulatory compliance.
* Proficiency in project management software, scheduling tools (MSP/Primavera), and MIS/reporting systems.

description:
Supply Chain Management \& Admin Head
 



 Company: AVPL International
 



 Location: Gurugram, Haryana
 



 Department: Supply Chain, Procurement \& Administration
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Experience: 10\+ Years
 



 Payroll: AVPL International
 



 Industry Preference: Drone / UAV / Aerospace / Defence / Advanced Manufacturing
 



 About AVPL International
 



 AVPL International is a technology\-driven organization operating in the Drone \& UAV ecosystem, working across drone manufacturing, technology, training, and related applications.
 



 We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Management \& Admin Head who can lead end\-to\-end supply chain, procurement, vendor management, logistics, inventory, and administration operations.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong experience in the Drone/UAV industry, sound knowledge of drone technology and components, and an established pool/network of reliable vendors and suppliers.
 



 Role Overview
 



 The Supply Chain Management \& Admin Head will be responsible for developing and managing a robust and cost\-effective supply chain for AVPL's drone\-related operations.
 



 The person will be expected to build, maintain, and leverage a strong vendor ecosystem, ensure timely availability of critical components, optimize procurement costs, and ensure smooth administrative and operational functioning.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Supply Chain \& Procurement
 



 • Lead the complete Supply Chain Management and Procurement function.
 



 • Develop and implement strategic sourcing and procurement plans.
 



 • Ensure timely procurement and availability of materials required for drone manufacturing and operations.
 



 • Manage the complete procurement cycle from requirement identification to vendor selection, negotiation, purchase, delivery, and quality coordination.
 



 • Develop alternate sourcing strategies for critical components to minimize supply\-chain risks.
 



 • Identify opportunities for cost reduction, localization, and process improvement.
 



 2\. Vendor Management \& Vendor Network
 



 • Build, develop, and maintain a strong and reliable vendor pool across India and international markets.
 



 • Leverage existing industry relationships to identify and onboard reliable suppliers quickly.
 



 • Develop vendors for drone components, electronics, mechanical parts, batteries, motors, sensors, flight controllers, frames, payloads, communication systems, and other relevant components.
 



 • Evaluate vendors based on quality, cost, capacity, lead time, reliability, and delivery performance.
 



 • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, credit periods, MOQ, lead times, and commercial agreements.
 



 • Maintain a strong database of approved and alternate vendors for critical materials.
 



 • Continuously identify new suppliers and develop alternate sources to avoid dependency on single vendors.
 



 • Monitor vendor performance and take corrective action where required.
 



 3\. Drone / UAV Industry Knowledge
 



 • Possess a good understanding of the Drone/UAV ecosystem and its supply chain.
 



 • Understand the basic functionality and sourcing requirements of major drone components.
 



 • Have knowledge of components such as:
 



 o Motors \& ESCs
 



 o Flight Controllers
 



 o GPS/GNSS
 



 o Batteries \& BMS
 



 o Propellers
 



 o Frames
 



 o Sensors
 



 o Communication/Telemetry systems
 



 o Cameras \& Payloads
 



 o Electronic and mechanical components
 



 • Work closely with R\&D, Engineering and Production teams to understand BOMs, specifications, component requirements, and sourcing alternatives.
 



 • Stay updated with developments in the drone industry, component suppliers, and emerging technologies.
 



 4\. Inventory \& Logistics Management
 



 • Establish effective inventory\-control systems for critical components and finished products.
 



 • Monitor stock levels, consumption, lead times, and reorder requirements.
 



 • Minimize excess inventory, dead stock, material wastage, and stock\-outs.
 



 • Oversee warehousing, transportation, dispatch, and logistics operations.
 



 • Ensure timely movement of materials between vendors, warehouses, manufacturing units, and project locations.
 



 5\. Administration \& Facility Management
 



 • Lead overall administration and facility\-management activities.
 



 • Manage office, warehouse, manufacturing/facility infrastructure, security, housekeeping, transportation, and other administrative services.
 



 • Manage administrative vendors and service providers.
 



 • Ensure smooth day\-to\-day functioning of facilities and operational locations.
 



 • Monitor administrative budgets and optimize operational expenses.
 



 • Ensure compliance with internal policies, safety standards, and applicable statutory requirements.
 



 6\. Team \& Stakeholder Management
 



 • Lead and develop the Supply Chain, Procurement, Stores, Logistics, and Administration teams.
 



 • Coordinate closely with R\&D, Production, Engineering, Finance, Projects, Sales, and Management.
 



 • Establish clear KPIs and performance metrics for procurement and supply\-chain teams.
 



 • Prepare and present MIS and management reports related to procurement, inventory, vendor performance, and logistics.
 



 Key Skills Required
 



 • Strategic Procurement \& Sourcing
 



 • Supply Chain Management
 



 • Strong Vendor Development
 



 • Established Vendor Network / Vendor Pool
 



 • Vendor Negotiation \& Commercial Management
 



 • Inventory \& Warehouse Management
 



 • Logistics Management
 



 • Material Planning
 



 • Cost Optimization
 



 • Vendor Performance Management
 



 • Team Leadership
 



 • Administration \& Facility Management
 



 • MIS \& Reporting
 



 • Strong stakeholder\-management and negotiation skills
 



 Ideal Candidate Profile
 



 The best\-fit candidate will:
 



 • Have 10\+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, or related functions.
 



 • Have strong hands\-on experience in the Drone/UAV industry.
 



 • Have a good understanding of drone technology, components, manufacturing, and the UAV ecosystem.
 



 • Bring an established and extensive vendor pool/network, particularly for drone components and technology products.
 



 • Have strong relationships with suppliers and the ability to quickly source critical components.
 



 • Have experience managing procurement for electronics, mechanical components, batteries, motors, sensors, and other high\-tech products.
 



 • Have experience working with manufacturing, R\&D, engineering, or technology\-driven organizations.
 



 • Demonstrate strong negotiation and cost\-optimization capabilities.
 



 • Have experience managing teams and multiple vendors simultaneously.
 



 • Be highly proactive, commercially aware, and capable of building a scalable supply\-chain ecosystem.
 



 Preferred Industry Background
 



 Priority 1: Drone / UAV / Unmanned Systems
 



 Priority 2: Aerospace / Defence / Robotics
 



 Priority 3: Electronics / EV / Automotive / Advanced Manufacturing / Engineering \& Technology
 



 Education
 



 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.
 



 MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, or related specialization will be an added advantage.
 



 Key Hiring Priority
 


* Drone Industry Experience \+ Drone Component Knowledge \+ Strong Existing Vendor Pool/Network \+ Strategic Procurement Expertise will be the key differentiators for this position.) is preferred.

Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do

* Improve workflows and enhance system efficiency

* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop individuals or small teams in operational environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage expectations and ensure process alignment
* Experience working with systems (e.g., LMS) and ensuring data accuracy and process compliance
* Strong organizational and planning skills, including capacity and workload management

 You will work with global L\&D teams, business stakeholders, faculty, vendors, and cross\-functional partners to deliver and continuously improve learning experiences.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**You’re Good At**

**Job Purpose**
 To take prompt and swift actions to mobilize ARFF resources during Aircraft Accident/ Incident, structural fires, other fires and incidents related to public health at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport in accordance with Aerodrome Emergency Plan, Standard Operating Procedures and coordinate with Air Traffic Control, Incident Commander, Command Post and Airport Operations Control Centre for effective incident management.
   

  

****ORGANISATION CHART****

**Key Accountabilities**
 To test and ensure proper functioning of ARFF watch tower equipments and communications systems.
   

  

 To monitor aircraft movements in maneuvering area, initiate necessary actions and coordinate with concerned emergency response agencies as per Aerodrome Emergency Plan and Standard Operating Procedures in case of any emergency situation involving aircrafts, buildings, and other critical facilities at RGIA for effective incident management.
   

  

 To obtain report from Manager\- ARFF Operations/ Lead Firefighter Operations with regard to serviceability of all ARFF appliances and initiate defect rectification with concerned agencies and maintain the records.

 To maintain records of ARFF vehicular movements, aircraft incident/ accident, fuel spillage, structural fires and other incidents occurring within the jurisdiction of Rajiv Gandhi International Airport for the purpose of evidence and audits by the regulatory and certification authorities.
   

  

 To monitor the Building Management System console and CCTV system and to take necessary actions in case of any abnormality is noticed.

title: Leather Production & Sourcing Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Orion Conmerx Private Limited is a leading manufacturer of high\-quality handcrafted leather apparel, bags, and accessories for international luxury brands, operating in India since 1993\. The company is SA8000, ISO 14001, and SMETA certified, reflecting a strong commitment to ethical practices, environmental responsibility, and sustainable supply chains. With advanced machinery, innovative product techniques, and a focus on product R\&D and operational excellence, Orion keeps pace with global fashion trends. A highly skilled workforce of around 1,500 professionals produces over 45,000 leather garments and bags per month, supported by in\-house tanneries and a global sourcing network across India, New Zealand, Africa, Saudi Arabia, and Europe. Orion is expanding with a state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facility in India, guided by experienced leadership focused on quality, efficiency, and long\-term growth.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Leather Production \& Sourcing Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi. This role is responsible for managing end\-to\-end leather sourcing from domestic and international suppliers, ensuring quality, cost\-effectiveness, and on\-time availability of raw materials and finished leather. The manager will oversee production planning for leather garments and bags, coordinate with tanneries and manufacturing teams, and monitor daily output, quality standards, and process efficiency. Day\-to\-day activities include vendor evaluation and negotiation, sample development coordination, documentation and compliance checks, and continuous improvement of production workflows. The role involves close collaboration with design, product development, procurement, and quality teams to align sourcing and production with brand requirements, sustainability goals, and delivery timelines.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong expertise in leather sourcing and procurement, including vendor management and negotiation with domestic and international suppliers.
* Hands\-on experience in leather production management, including planning, workflow optimization, and coordination with tanneries and manufacturing units.
* Solid understanding of leather types, tanning processes, finishing techniques, and quality control standards for premium fashion and luxury products.
* Knowledge of sustainability, ethical sourcing, and compliance frameworks, preferably with exposure to certifications like SA8000, ISO 14001, or SMETA.
* Proficiency in using production and inventory management tools or ERP systems, with strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with design, product development, and operations teams.
* Relevant academic background such as a degree or diploma in Leather Technology, Fashion Technology, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Prior experience in leather manufacturing or fashion accessories production, ideally in a high\-volume or export\-oriented environment.

description:
Art of Puja is looking for a responsible and hardworking Warehouse Manager / Warehouse Operations Executive who can take ownership of the day\-to\-day functioning of our warehouse. This is a hands\-on role. You will be responsible for maintaining inventory, managing inward and outward movement of goods, coordinating dispatches, supervising warehouse staff, and managing production and assembly work happening inside the warehouse.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who wants to learn, take responsibility, and grow with the company for the long term. You do not need fancy qualifications. We are looking for someone who is organised, sincere, disciplined, comfortable working on the warehouse floor, and capable of managing people and daily tasks.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage complete day\-to\-day warehouse operations.
* Maintain proper inventory and stock records for all products and materials.
* Handle all inward material entries and verify quantities received from vendors.
* Manage outward dispatches for B2B and B2C orders.
* Ensure orders are picked, packed and dispatched correctly and on time.

* Maintain proper records of inward, production, outward, damages and stock adjustments.

* Supervise production, packing and assembly activities happening inside the warehouse.
* Ensure daily production targets are completed on time.
* Coordinate between inventory, production and dispatch teams.
* Maintain proper storage and rack\-wise organisation of products.
* Ensure the warehouse remains clean, organised and safe.
* Maintain daily reports for production, inventory and dispatches.
* Report delays, damages, shortages or other operational issues immediately.
* Take overall responsibility for ensuring smooth functioning of the warehouse.


 Why Join Art of Puja?
   

  

 Art of Puja is a growing spiritual lifestyle and gifting brand. As we scale our B2C, marketplace, quick\-commerce, and corporate gifting business, our warehouse and production operations are also growing rapidly. This role provides an opportunity to work closely with the core team, learn complete warehouse operations, and gradually take on larger responsibilities as the company grows. We are specifically looking for candidates interested in a stable, long\-term role rather than a short\-term job.
   

  

 About Company: Art of Puja is a modern D2C brand that bridges the gap between spirituality and contemporary living. Our mission is to revive and modernize ancient traditions by offering thoughtfully designed spiritual products for today's lifestyle. We believe in creating meaningful experiences for our customers, blending authenticity with elegance. If you're passionate about blending tradition with innovation and want to work in a fast\-growing, purpose\-driven environment, join us in building something truly impactful!

title: Category Manager
description:
**MERCHANDISING MANAGER \- HOME** 




 Function: Merchandising \| Location: New Delhi (Tulsi Farms) \| Reporting to: Chief Merchandising Officer
 



 Experience: 6\-9 years in Merchandising (minimum 3 years handling the Home category)
 



**Step Into the World of Nicobar** 




 Founded in 2016 by Simran Lal and Raul Rai,
 **Nicobar** 
 is a modern, mindful, design\-led lifestyle brand from India.
 



*“We wanted to create a new Indian sensibility that wasn’t necessarily Westernised.”* 




 We’re reimagining a contemporary Indian way of living, dressing, and looking at the world—rooted in culture, shaped by design, and guided by intention. At Nicobar, we believe in culture as much as commerce, and that how we build is just as important as what we build.
 



 Our studio is tucked away in Tulsi Farms, Chhatarpur, Delhi. Nestled among trees, seasonal gardens, a citrus grove, and our beloved dogs Nico \& Dot, we call it
 *“
 
 the Treehouse.
 
 ”* 
 It earned its name when our architect reworked the blueprint to protect every single tree on the land. It’s a space where creativity brims and energy flows.
 



 If you’re drawn to thoughtful design, a youthful and nourishing team culture, and the chance to grow a brand with heart—we’d love to hear from you.
 



**Follow our journey:** 

 Instagram
 
 \|
 
 LinkedIn
 
 \|
 
 Nicobar.com
 
 \|
 **Watch our Co\-founders, Raul \& Simran talking about Nicobar**




**Reach out to us through the below link \-** 
 📩
 **https://lnkd.in/gghFi5Yz**




**Your Role in the Story** 




 You are the commercial engine behind Nicobar’s Home category – owning the numbers, the range, and the results across tableware, drinkware, textiles, décor, and furniture. Reporting to the CMO, you sit at the intersection of data and intuition, analysing what is selling, anticipating what should, and working across planning, design, sourcing, and retail to keep the category commercially sharp season after season.
 



**Where You’ll Make Impact** 



* Own the commercial performance of Home – sell\-throughs, best and worst sellers, markdowns, and replenishment against seasonal targets.
* Drive the Home range plan with design and sourcing – balanced, seasonally relevant, and aligned to pricing architecture and occasion (everyday, entertaining, gifting, festive).
* Manage width, depth, and open\-to\-buy – balancing core replenishable lines against seasonal drops, and keeping inventory and stock cover healthy.
* Build the seasonal buy and forecast – size and phase orders by channel, set OTB by sub\-category, and manage in\-season re\-orders to protect margin.
* Own markdown, ageing, and terminal\-stock strategy – act early on slow sellers, plan exit routes, and keep provision and liquidation under control.
* Ensure on\-time launches across channels, flagging critical\-path risks early enough to course\-correct.
* Set pricing and margin architecture for the category – benchmark against competitors, protect intake and realised margins, and guide sourcing on cost targets.
* Partner with the design team on newness and hero products – translate commercial signals into clear briefs for gifting, festive, and collection drops.
* Shop the market and competitors – identify white spaces and bring sharp, well\-evidenced range recommendations.
* Drive category expansion – spot adjacent sub\-categories and gaps in tableware, textiles, décor, and gifting, and build the case to enter them.
* Partner with VM and retail so the Home story is told well in\-store and online, and build reports and dashboards that turn numbers into decisions.



**What You Bring Along** 



* 5–8 years in fashion, home, or lifestyle merchandising, with a minimum of 3 years handling the Home category.
* Very strong analytical ability, including proficient, hands\-on command of Excel / Google Sheets.
* Fluent with AI and digital tools, and quick to apply them – turning technology into sharper planning, cleaner communication, and building efficient dashboards and workflows.
* You understand what makes Home aesthetically and commercially different – sub\-categories with distinct end uses, buying rhythms and margin logic.
* Strong cross\-functional skills with design, sourcing, planning, VM, and retail, and disciplined follow\-through across multiple drops.



**The Nicobar Spark** 



* A natural problem\-solver – you break messy, ambiguous situations into clear parts, and you'd rather bring a solution than escalate a problem.
* Strong stakeholder management – you build trust quickly across design, sourcing, planning, and retail, and you know how to influence without authority.
* A clear communicator – you turn numbers into a story people can act on, whether you're in a leadership review or a design huddle.
* Calm under pressure – drops, deadlines, and last\-minute changes don't rattle you; you re\-prioritise and keep the critical path moving.
* Detail\-obsessed without losing the big picture – you sweat the SKU\-level numbers but never lose sight of the season and the brand.
* A builder, not just a doer – you leave behind better templates, cleaner reports, and sharper ways of working than you found.
* Genuinely collaborative – you share credit, ask good questions, and make the people around you better.
* Commercially curious – you keep asking "why" behind the numbers and "what next" for the category.

title: Manager, APAC Client Risk
description:
**Proceed with Pride** 
 is Bain’s client selection and acceptance process. Developed in partnership with our Industry and Capability Practice Areas, it helps ensure we can be proud of the work we take on. When concerns arise, Partners are encouraged to engage the Proceed with Pride team for guidance and discussion.
   

  

 The focus is nearly always on identifying the right mitigating actions to enable us to Proceed with Pride, although in some instances we will jointly decide not to proceed.
   

  

 Regional Risk Officers (RROs) have been appointed to lead Regional Risk teams to align Proceed with Pride more closely with our line leadership. RROs are experienced, independent Advisory Partners and report to our
 **Chief Risk Officer** 
 , who reports to the Board Risk Sub\-Committee.
   

  

 In this role, you will support the
 **Senior Manager, APAC Client Risk** 
 , and the
 **APAC RRO** 
 , helping to shape and execute the region’s approach to client selection and acceptance. You’ll be a key driver of strategic thinking and operational execution across risk efforts in the region.
   

  

**Why you’ll want to join**
* Work at the intersection of ethics, reputation, and real\-world events: Apply critical thinking to complex topics (e.g., geopolitics, regulatory scrutiny, sensitive sectors, AI), and support senior decision\-making on whether and how Bain engages with clients and different types of work, balancing ethical and reputational trade\-offs with integrity, while protecting Bain’s values and enabling responsible growth.
* Build a critical capability for Bain’s future: Proceed with Pride is a growing, evolving function – help shape how we manage emerging risk issues, expand our scope, and modernise how we operate at scale.
* Direct exposure to senior leadership: Collaborate with Partners, Office Heads, Practice leaders, Legal, and PR/Comms, and support engagements with EMEA’s Regional Managing Partner (RMP) and Bain’s Board Risk Sub\-Committee.
* Have fun! Proceed with Pride is global, yet close\-knit – be part of a collaborative and supportive team with a meaningful mission, a strong culture of camaraderie and plenty of opportunities for professional growth.


**Key tasks**
* APAC Client Selection and Acceptance Process – Lead and manage end\-to\-end risk assessments
* Monitor the APAC opportunity pipeline to identify ‘higher risk’ cases flagged by risk guidelines, including work in regulated and reputationally sensitive sectors (e.g., gambling, sensitive areas of healthcare).
* Confirm assessment requirements with Partners and facilitate in\-depth discussions on client context and strategy, reputational considerations, and risk trade\-offs.
* Conduct relevant research, frame key questions, and coordinate input from Legal, PR, and other internal experts.
* Summarise decisions and mitigation plans, monitor implementation, and evaluate outcomes to protect Bain’s reputation and enable responsible growth.
* Risk Awareness, Education \& Engagement – Build and sustain a culture of risk mindfulness
* Own and produce reporting on client risk and reputational themes across APAC, highlighting strategic implications and emerging external drivers.
* Design and develop briefing materials and coordinate leadership updates for senior stakeholders (including APAC leadership and Practice Area Heads), strengthening Partners’ awareness of their role in client risk and reputation management for Bain.
* Design agendas and run regular sessions with Practice Area Managers (PAMs) to build awareness, surface risks, and strengthen risk capabilities across teams, supporting consistent decision\-making across the region.
* Team Enablement \& Innovation – Strengthen the Proceed with Pride team through scalable, forward\-thinking solutions
* Support initiatives to build and evolve the team’s purpose and mission, including leveraging AI to automate processes and improve insight generation.
* Continuously refine frameworks and guidelines to remain effective in an ever\-changing, volatile environment, reflecting evolving reputational expectations and strategic priorities.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve team efficiency, collaboration, and impact through innovative tools and approaches, enabling faster, higher\-quality decisions.


**About You**
**Experience \& Skills**
* 3\-6 years of professional experience in consulting, legal, audit, risk, or a similar field.
* Passion for governance and ethics, and for helping Bain decide which work to take on – strategically, reputationally, and responsibly – ensuring we can Proceed with Pride.
* Strong analytical skills; ability to synthesise complex information and anticipate risks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, especially with senior leaders.
* Strong understanding of current affairs and geopolitical dynamics, and their implications for client strategy and reputational risk.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.


**Personal Attributes**
* Collaborative: Works effectively across teams and functions. Service\-focused.
* Organised \& Detail\-Oriented: Keeps processes on track and ensures accuracy.
* Pragmatic: Strong problem\-solving ability with a practical sense of what’s achievable.
* Articulate: Communicates clearly and with impact – both verbally and in writing.
* Team player: Passionate, reliable, and great to work with.
* Tech\-savvy: Open to using AI tools and embracing new technologies with a growth mindset.

title: Operations Manager – Air & Sea Freight Forwarding | Import & Export | End-to-End Operations
description:
JOB TITLE: Operations Manager – Freight Forwarding (Air \& Sea)
 



  





 LOCATION: Gurgaon
 



 EXPERIENCE: 7–12\+ Years
 



 INDUSTRY: Freight Forwarding / Logistics / International Freight
 



  





 POSITION OVERVIEW
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager who can independently manage the complete freight forwarding operations across Air Freight and Sea Freight – Import \& Export.
 



  





 The candidate must have strong hands\-on knowledge of end\-to\-end shipment operations, pricing, costing, carrier/vendor coordination, documentation, customs coordination, transportation, customer handling, team management and operational profitability.
 



  





 This is a senior operational role. The candidate should understand not only how to execute shipments but also what every shipment costs, how it should be priced, where the margin is made or lost, and how the complete operation is controlled from booking to final delivery and billing.
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. END\-TO\-END FREIGHT OPERATIONS
 



  





 • Manage complete Air and Sea Freight operations from booking to final delivery.
 



 • Handle Import and Export shipments.
 



 • Manage FCL and LCL shipments.
 



 • Coordinate with customers, airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs, co\-loaders, overseas agents, CHAs, transporters, CFSs and warehouses.
 



 • Monitor shipment milestones and ensure timely movement.
 



 • Resolve operational issues and escalations proactively.
 



  





 2\. AIR FREIGHT OPERATIONS
 



  





 • Manage Air Import and Export shipments.
 



 • Airline booking and rate coordination.
 



 • Handle AWB, HAWB and MAWB.
 



 • Manage flight schedules, cut\-offs and cargo acceptance.
 



 • Handle pre\-alerts and documentation.
 



 • Track shipments and provide timely status updates.
 



 • Handle flight cancellations, rollovers, offloads, delays and re\-bookings.
 



 • Coordinate with airlines and handling agents.
 



  





 3\. SEA FREIGHT OPERATIONS
 



  





 • Manage Sea Import and Export operations.
 



 • Handle FCL and LCL shipments.
 



 • Coordinate with shipping lines, NVOCCs and co\-loaders.
 



 • Handle MBL and HBL.
 



 • Manage booking confirmation and vessel schedules.
 



 • Handle Shipping Instructions (SI) and VGM.
 



 • Coordinate container allocation, pickup, stuffing and gate\-in.
 



 • Check BL drafts and manage amendments.
 



 • Handle transshipment coordination.
 



 • Manage Arrival Notice, Delivery Order and final delivery.
 



 • Control detention, demurrage and free\-day issues.
 



  





 4\. PRICING, COSTING \& COMMERCIAL CONTROL
 



  





 • Understand Air Freight and Sea Freight buy and sell rates.
 



 • Obtain and negotiate rates with airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs and vendors.
 



 • Calculate complete shipment costs before quoting.
 



 • Understand origin and destination charges.
 



 • Manage THC, CFS, documentation, handling, carting, transportation and other applicable charges.
 



 • Calculate selling price and expected gross margin.
 



 • Identify cost leakages and unnecessary expenses.
 



 • Coordinate with the sales/commercial team for accurate quotations.
 



 • Verify vendor invoices against agreed rates.
 



 • Ensure correct customer billing and recovery of operational charges.
 



  





 5\. CUSTOMS \& CLEARANCE COORDINATION
 



  





 • Coordinate with CHAs and customs clearance teams.
 



 • Understand the complete Import and Export customs process.
 



 • Working knowledge of Shipping Bill, Bill of Entry, ICEGATE, examination, assessment, LEO and OOC processes.
 



 • Resolve customs queries and documentation discrepancies.
 



 • Ensure timely customs clearance and delivery.
 



 • Monitor shipments under customs hold or examination.
 



  





 6\. DOCUMENTATION
 



  





 The candidate should have strong knowledge of:
 



  





 • Commercial Invoice
 



 • Packing List
 



 • AWB / HAWB / MAWB
 



 • HBL / MBL
 



 • Shipping Bill
 



 • Bill of Entry
 



 • Shipping Instructions
 



 • VGM
 



 • Certificate of Origin
 



 • Delivery Order
 



 • Arrival Notice
 



 • Pre\-alerts
 



 • Insurance and shipment\-specific documents
 



  





 7\. VENDOR \& CARRIER MANAGEMENT
 



  





 • Maintain strong relationships with airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs, co\-loaders, transporters, CHAs, CFSs and warehouses.
 



 • Negotiate operational rates and service terms.
 



 • Monitor vendor performance.
 



 • Resolve rate disputes and service failures.
 



 • Ensure vendors work according to agreed commercial and operational terms.
 



  





 8\. TEAM MANAGEMENT
 



  





 • Lead and manage the Air and Sea Operations team.
 



 • Allocate shipments and responsibilities.
 



 • Monitor daily operational performance.
 



 • Establish and implement SOPs.
 



 • Train team members on operational procedures.
 



 • Coordinate between Operations, Sales, Documentation, Accounts and Customer Service.
 



 • Handle critical operational escalations.
 



  





 9\. CUSTOMER \& ESCALATION MANAGEMENT
 



  





 • Act as the senior operational point of contact for key customers.
 



 • Handle customer escalations related to delays, documentation, rates, clearance and delivery.
 



 • Provide accurate shipment updates.
 



 • Ensure service commitments are met.
 



 • Maintain strong customer relationships through reliable operational execution.
 



  





 10\. OPERATIONAL MIS \& CONTROL
 



  





 • Maintain shipment\-wise operational records.
 



 • Track shipment status and pending actions.
 



 • Monitor operational costs and revenue.
 



 • Track detention, demurrage and additional costs.
 



 • Review vendor bills and customer billing.
 



 • Prepare operational MIS and management reports.
 



 • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
 



  





 MUST\-HAVE REQUIREMENTS
 



  





 • 7–12\+ years of experience in Freight Forwarding / International Logistics.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience in Air and Sea Freight Operations.
 



 • Experience in both Import and Export.
 



 • Strong knowledge of FCL, LCL and Air Freight.
 



 • Strong understanding of freight rates, costing and margins.
 



 • Good knowledge of customs clearance and CHA coordination.
 



 • Strong documentation knowledge.
 



 • Experience dealing with airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs and logistics vendors.

title: Manager – Exports, Imports & Global Commercial Operations
description:
**Manager – Exports, Imports \& Global Commercial Operations** 




 End\-to\-end ownership of the international order\-to\-delivery cycle
 



  





**Company:** 
 APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited \| www.apacss.com
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 10 – 20 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 Chemicals / Specialty Chemicals / Ingredients / International Trading / Merchant Export / Global Sourcing
 



**Function:** 
 Export \& Import Operations / International Logistics / Supply Chain / Commercial Operations
 



 Employment Type: Full Time
 



  





**About the Company** 




 APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited is engaged in Global Sourcing, Merchant Export, Custom Manufacturing and Product Development — sourcing products from India and other Asian countries for customers across the USA, Canada, Europe and other international markets. Our business spans chemicals, pharmaceuticals, APIs, pharmaceutical intermediates, food and cosmetic ingredients, natural products, polymers, specialty 
 



 chemicals and custom\-manufactured products.
 



 We are looking for an experienced professional to take end\-to\-end ownership of international export execution. This is a high\-responsibility position and is not limited to routine export documentation or logistics coordination.
 



  





**Role Objective** 




 The incumbent will own the complete order\-to\-delivery cycle:
 



***Customer Order → Supplier Confirmation → Production / Material Readiness → Shipment Planning → Freight Negotiation → Container / Isotank Booking → Export Documentation → Customs → Vessel Departure → Shipment Tracking → Customer Communication → Delivery***




 The principal objective is to ensure that APAC consistently delivers the
 **right product, right quantity and right documentation, at the right freight cost, and within the customer’s committed ETA.** 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. End\-to\-End Export Order Ownership** 




 ● Take ownership of every confirmed international customer order.
 



 ● Establish a detailed execution plan from order confirmation to delivery.
 



 ● Track production, material readiness, shipment booking, documentation, customs, vessel departure and ETA.
 



 ● Maintain a live order and shipment tracker.
 



 ● Identify risks well in advance and initiate corrective action.
 



**2\. Customer ETA Management** 




 ● Work towards 100% adherence to committed customer ETA.
 



 ● Monitor vessel schedules, transit times, supplier readiness and shipment milestones.
 



 ● Identify potential delays before they affect the customer.
 



 ● Develop alternative logistics plans where necessary.
 



 ● Maintain clear visibility of customer\-required ETA versus actual / revised ETA.
 



**3\. Supplier / Manufacturer Coordination** 




*A critical part of the position — the incumbent is expected to actively drive supplier readiness rather than wait for supplier updates.* 




 ● Coordinate continuously with suppliers / manufacturers across India and Asia.
 



 ● Confirm production schedules and firm up material readiness dates; follow up on production progress.
 



 ● Coordinate QC / testing and COA availability; confirm packaging and dispatch readiness.
 



 ● Ensure material is ready sufficiently before vessel cut\-offs; coordinate pickup / loading.
 



 ● Identify and escalate supplier delays at an early stage.
 



 ● Ensure suppliers understand customer delivery commitments.
 



 4\. Freight Negotiation \& Cost Optimisation
 



 ● Obtain competitive ocean freight quotations and benchmark rates across major trade lanes.
 



 ● Negotiate with shipping lines, carriers, NVOCCs and logistics providers.
 



 ● Analyse freight components and surcharges; monitor PSS, GRI and other freight changes.
 



 ● Develop direct relationships with shipping\-line commercial teams.
 



 ● Identify opportunities for cost reduction and minimise unnecessary intermediary costs.
 



 ● Maintain freight\-rate records and benchmarks.
 



**5\. Direct Shipping\-Line Booking** 




 Where commercially feasible, develop APAC’s capability to book containers and isotanks directly with shipping lines / carriers, covering:
 



 Direct carrier relationship development • Vessel schedule identification • Rate negotiation • Space booking • Container / isotank availability • Booking confirmation • Equipment release • SI / VGM cut\-off management • Gate\-in coordination • Vessel rollover management • Carrier escalation
 



*Experience with isotank shipments and DG cargo will be an advantage.* 




**6\. Customer Communication \& Shipment Visibility** 




 Maintain proactive communication with international customers, providing timely updates on:
 



 Supplier / material readiness • QC / COA status • Expected dispatch • Container / isotank booking • Vessel details • ETD • Port status • Transshipment • Shipment movement • ETA • Any changes or delays • Shipping documents.
 



*The fundamental principle is: NO SURPRISES FOR THE CUSTOMER.* 




 If an ETA is at risk, the customer must be informed proactively along with the reason, revised timeline and corrective action.
 



**7\. Export Documentation** 




 Coordinate preparation and verification of:
 



 Commercial Invoice • Packing List • Certificate of Origin • COA • SDS / MSDS • DG Declaration • Shipping Instructions • VGM • Shipping Bill • Bill of Lading • Customer\-specific documentation • Product / regulatory documents as applicable
 



*Ensure documentation is accurate and completed before applicable cut\-offs.* 




**8\. Customs \& ICEGATE – In\-House Capability** 




 A key objective for APAC is to develop stronger in\-house control over export customs processes. The incumbent will manage direct preparation and filing of Shipping Bills through the ICEGATE portal, wherever applicable:
 



 ● Prepare Shipping Bill data; verify HSN / ITC classification and export details.
 



 ● File Shipping Bills through ICEGATE and monitor filing status.
 



 ● Resolve validation errors / queries and coordinate with Customs.
 



 ● Monitor the process through clearance / LEO and relevant post\-export stages; maintain proper records.
 



 ● Ensure timely filing so customs formalities do not affect vessel cut\-offs or customer ETA.
 



*APAC will continue to use CHA / C\&F agents primarily for physical customs, port and related activities requiring their involvement, while building greater in\-house capability for documentation, electronic filing, tracking and export execution.* 




**9\. CHA / C\&F / Port Coordination** 




 ● Coordinate with CHA / C\&F agents for customs and port activities; ensure timely customs clearance.
 



 ● Monitor Shipping Bill status and LEO; coordinate examination / inspection where required.
 



 ● Ensure containers reach port within cut\-off; resolve customs / port\-related issues promptly.
 



 ● Monitor DG\-related requirements where applicable.
 



**10\. Container \& Isotank Planning** 




 ● Plan container and isotank requirements in advance; ensure equipment availability before material readiness.
 



 ● Coordinate loading and dispatch; monitor equipment release and return requirements.
 



 ● Coordinate DG and special\-handling requirements; avoid last\-minute equipment shortages.
 



**11\. Shipment Risk \& Exception Management** 




 Proactively manage supplier / production / quality\-release delays, container and isotank shortages, vessel cancellations and rollovers, port congestion, customs issues, documentation errors, DG acceptance issues, transshipment delays and freight increases.
 



*Expected approach: Identify → Analyse → Act → Communicate → Resolve → Close* 




**12\. Management Reporting** 




 Maintain an updated shipment dashboard covering:
 



 Customer • PO • Product • Quantity • Supplier • Production status • Material readiness • QC / COA • Container / isotank • Booking • Vessel • ETD • Customer ETA • Current ETA • ETA variance • Documentation • Customs • Gate\-in • Risk status • Next action
 



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS** 




 The position will be measured primarily on outcomes:
 



 100% focus on committed customer ETA • Supplier readiness against agreed dates • On\-time shipment execution • Competitive freight rates \& direct carrier bookings • Container / isotank availability • Timely and accurate documentation • Timely ICEGATE Shipping Bill filing • Zero avoidable documentation\-related shipment delays • Proactive customer communication \& early risk identification • Reduction in emergency 
 



 freight and avoidable demurrage / detention • 100% visibility of active shipments
 



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




 10 – 20 years in export operations / international logistics / supply chain • Chemicals, pharmaceuticals, specialty chemicals or ingredients experience preferred • Strong knowledge of export documentation \& Indian export procedures • Container shipments experience; DG preferred; isotank an advantage • Strong freight negotiation \& direct dealings with shipping lines • Supplier / manufacturer coordination \& 
 



 strong customer communication • ICEGATE / Shipping Bill filing highly desirable; strong Excel / ERP / CRM • Able to manage multiple international shipments simultaneously
 



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 Strong ownership • Commercial orientation • Excellent follow\-through • High sense of urgency • Proactive communication • Strong negotiation skills • Problem\-solving ability • Attention to detail • Works independently • Manages pressure \& multiple priorities
 



  





***The mindset we are looking for: “Once APAC accepts a customer order, I own the execution until the shipment reaches the customer within the committed ETA.”***




 If you want to build and own an international export operation rather than merely process documents, this is an excellent opportunity to make an impact.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 Mail your resume to aloksrivastava@apacss.com and odes@apacss.com APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited \| Gurgaon \| www.apacss.com

1. the success of engagement(s)

title: On-site Technology Support ITAM Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**On\-site Technology Support ITAM Lead (Associate Director)**
**Enterprise Technology (ET)**
 Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure, and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.
   

  

 Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 As part of Enterprise Technology, the On\-site Technology Support’s mission is to help our customers fulfil their purposes and contribute to building a better working world by providing a fit for purpose support service.
   

  

 The On\-site Technology Support \- Information Technology Asset Management (ITAM) leader will be responsible for enterprise IT hardware asset management for all Global Delivery Service (GDS) centres globally. The leader will manage the entire IT asset lifecycle including planning, acquiring, deploying, managing, auditing, and retiring for end user asset library (Notebooks, Desktops, Mac, Printers, Audio / Visual equipment, Monitors, Peripherals, Consumables etc..). The person will manage the IT asset management portfolio with respect to business performance, risk, cost, and legal compliance. This position requires strategic thinking, strong financial acumen, passion for process excellence, strong business partnership and vendor management skills. Driving change, consolidation and service improvement is a key aspect of this role whilst keeping their team motivated in a highly changing, dynamic, diverse, and cross\-cultural environment.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Re\-imagine the next generation ITAM delivery model. Develop and maintain a roadmap and strategy for end\-to\-end IT asset lifecycle management including planning, sourcing, forecasting, capacity management, demand \& supply, delivery, disposal, and e\-waste management.
* Mature the ITAM program and create automated and sustainable ITAM operations, enhance and automate, by reducing manual efforts. Propose, plan, and partner with cross\-functional teams to deliver system automation as per firms’ strategy.
* Interface and collaborate directly with Finance, Procurement, Talent, Legal, Sourcing, Business Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effectiveness of ITAM program.
* Responsible for ensuring quality control throughout the lifecycle of all entity IT assets by developing and implementing appropriate procedures to track and manage them.
* Listen to the voice of the customer and own KPI metrics related to ITAM. Take appropriate action to drive satisfaction and operational excellence.
* Identify opportunities and develop plans for ongoing improvement across IT Asset Management, Configuration Management Database (CMDB) including optimize, re\-harvest, and/or repurpose unused or partially used IT assets, to achieve full efficiency and ROI from company resources.
* Govern and manage Fixed Asset Register (FAR) reconciliation, annual audit compliance, SEZ, regulatory, and customs related process.
* Plan and execute hardware refresh / upgrade programs and ensure availability of minimum inventory of different specifications all locations as per business demand.
* Serve as the single point of contact for all ITAM related contracts and sponsor for IT Asset Management vendor engagements.
* Oversee vendor reseller and OEM engagements to meet established service level targets and key performance indicators.
* Be the face of IT Asset Management to all Business Partners and Executive Leadership. Engage, create, and collaborate on solutions based on business demands.
* Participate in steering committee meeting representing ITAM strategy for Global Delivery Centres.
* Manage and develop IT Asset Lifecycle Management policies, standards, and procedures as per Global ITAM standards and their associated business value.
* Act as a coach to team to deliver scope, meet schedules, balance workload, and resolve roadblocks. Escalate timely to ensure programs and/or services are not jeopardized.
* Establish a service culture with sufficiently ITIL\-educated operations management and staff. Establish and administer the annual budgets and manage expenditures to operate within the approved budget.
* Maintain a high\-level understanding of the business objectives, processes and supporting
* Technology needs of all customers in the Region. Stay sensitive to unique local needs.
* Work with leadership to optimize the business value, quality, and cost of requested services to meet the Firm and EY Technology objectives and policies with a clear articulation of the service levels delivered.
* Collect viewpoints on Technology needs and service issues and communicate these to the appropriate EY Technology leader.
* This role is required to physically work in an EY office.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Ability to define the organization’s asset management \& inventory policy based on industry best practices.
* Demonstrated experience in financial management including budgeting, sourcing, and service costing.
* Understanding of technology and data visualization skills—artificial intelligence, machine learning, Internet of Things, analytics software, and apps.
* Ability to develop \& comprehend the data visualization reports to track orders and shipments, trends, demand and any weaknesses and inefficiencies based on different parameters.
* Advanced analytical skills are required to identify opportunities for service and process improvement across the geography supported.
* Comprehend market economics and dynamics. Predict possible future scenarios by gaining insights into the market trends.
* Work independently with limited oversight from a supervisor.
* High\-level decision\-making responsibilities include the prioritization of work for the IT Asset
* Management function and determining approaches to effectively address service delivery concerns of large customer base.
* Demonstrated ability to manage effectively with escalations, difficult situations and demanding individuals under pressure.
* Co\-ordinate, understand and successfully integrate the activities of a large cross\-cultural, cross\-border team including virtual interaction and ability to travel as per requirement.
* Demonstrated ability to manage all aspects of team management including hiring, development, and counselling.
* High level understanding of SEZ, regulatory, customs, compliance protocols relevant to the role.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 15\+ years of applicable work experience in large multi\-country teams.
* BE\-IT, B.Tech, Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology.
* Certification in ITIL \& IT Asset Management preferred
* 5\+ years’ experience of working directly in IT Asset Management role or experience in supply chain management preferred.
* Established experience in vendor relationship management, outsourcing strategy, and e\-waste management.
* Proven track record in leading positive team dynamics that drives efficiencies in throughput.
* Strong organizational, analytic, and complex problem\-solving skills
* Highly effective speaking, listening, writing, project management and interpersonal skills
* Effective communications and collaborative skills with ability to work with management, business and technical leaders and staff of all levels.
* Experience with IT service management tools and/or knowledge of major ITAM products such as Service Now or equivalent.
* Successful candidate will be an energetic passionate leader who demonstrates initiative, and the ability to generate creative solutions and deliver with excellence.
* Exceptional customer service orientation. Work schedule flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

**Continuous learning** 
 : You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
   

  

**Transformative leadership:** 
 We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
   

  

**Diverse and inclusive culture:** 
 You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
   

  

 We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Develop employee engagement strategy for the team to motivate and drive engagement.

 Primary interactions are within CT E\&PT Leadership team and CT’s engineering service providers.
   

  

 Planning horizon 1\-3 months tactical, 3\-36 months for S\&OP process resourcing, 5 years for strategic engineering footprint.
   

  

 People leadership \& development.

 Geography global.
   

  

 Up to 25% international and domestic travel on average can be expected.

**Person specification**
 This describes what is required to do the job, it may not describe the current job holder but should describe the typical attributes or traits needed for success in the position.

 Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent experience
   

  

 Understanding of technology development, engineering and licencing
   

  

 Member of a recognised Professional Institution

 Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners.
